jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About LiveX AI** LiveX AI is a fast\-growing startup based in the San Francisco Bay Area, building the next generation of physical AI agents—intelligent, embodied systems that interact with people in real\-world environments. We combine cutting\-edge language models, multimodal AI, and custom hardware to power transformative AI experiences in airports, stadiums, conferences, and more. We’re trusted by top enterprises and city partners, and backed by renowned investors. **About the Role** ------------------ We're building realtime, interactive AI avatars that can see, listen, and respond with natural speech and expressive motion. As an AI Engineer, you'll help train, fine\-tune, and serve the generative models behind them—from data curation and training diffusion and video models to low\-latency inference for live streaming. You'll work closely with our backend, product, and research teams to ship avatar experiences used in the real world. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Generative avatar models:** Train and fine\-tune generative models for talking\-head synthesis, audio\-driven facial animation, and full\-body avatar video. * **Data pipelines:** Build data pipelines for large\-scale video, audio, and multimodal datasets. * **Realtime optimization:** Optimize models for realtime serving, targeting sub\-200ms end\-to\-end latency, using techniques such as distillation, quantization, and custom kernels. * **ML infrastructure:** Build and maintain training, evaluation, and deployment infrastructure on GPU clusters. * **Quality metrics:** Define and improve metrics such as lip\-sync accuracy, identity preservation, expression naturalness, latency, and throughput. * **Ship with the team:** Work with backend, product, and research teams to ship avatar features and iterate on user feedback, while keeping up with the latest in generative video, multimodal AI, and neural rendering. **Who You Are** --------------- **Must\-haves** * 3\+ years of hands\-on ML engineering experience, or strong research experience with production\-quality code. * Deep PyTorch expertise and the ability to reproduce and extend research papers. * Background in diffusion models, video generation, computer vision, multimodal AI, speech synthesis, or neural rendering. * Experience optimizing realtime inference (e.g., TensorRT, ONNX, Triton, CUDA, mixed precision). * Strong Python skills and experience with multi\-GPU or multi\-node distributed training. * Comfort with ambiguity and fast\-changing environments, with a strong sense of ownership. **Bonus points** * Experience with talking\-head, lip\-sync, or digital human systems, or related areas such as 3D Gaussian Splatting, NeRF, or face reenactment. * Publications at top venues (e.g., NeurIPS, CVPR, ICCV, SIGGRAPH, ICLR, ICML) or notable open\-source contributions. **Why Join LiveX AI?** ---------------------- * **World\-Stage Experiences:** Your work goes live in front of millions—at the Super Bowl, major airports, and NVIDIA GTC—not just inside an office. * **Full\-Real Scope:** AI, hardware, and real customers—you'll build a skill set most people don't reach until years into their careers. * **Silicon Valley, Front Row:** Work at the center of the physical AI movement, with the connections and momentum that come with it. * **Mentorship That Matters:** Work directly with founders and senior leaders who want to see you grow—not hand you busywork. * **Real Ownership \& Growth:** Top performers take on more scope fast—leading projects, owning customers, and shaping the product. * **Compute to Build With:** Access to GPU compute for training and experimentation, plus competitive salary, equity, and benefits. Ready to launch the next phase of your career and build the future of physical AI? Apply to join LiveX AI today.

jobs.description: About the Role We are seeking a Cloud Engineer in Santa Ana to help manage, maintain and improve the cloud infrastructure supporting our applications and business systems. This role involves working with cloud platforms, monitoring system performance, supporting deployments and addressing infrastructure issues to ensure services remain secure, stable and accessible. You will work closely with software developers, IT professionals and other technical teams to maintain existing cloud environments while supporting new infrastructure requirements. The position suits someone who enjoys troubleshooting, understands how cloud\-based systems operate and can approach technical challenges in a structured way. What You'll Handle * Configure, maintain and monitor cloud resources across development, testing and production environments. * Support cloud infrastructure on platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud. * Investigate service interruptions, connectivity problems and performance issues. * Assist with application deployments, system updates and infrastructure changes. * Manage cloud storage, virtual machines, networking components and related services. * Review access permissions and security configurations to help protect cloud environments. * Monitor resource utilisation and identify opportunities to improve performance and control costs. * Maintain backup procedures and support disaster recovery planning. * Use scripting and automation to simplify recurring infrastructure tasks. * Work with development teams to support CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes. * Maintain technical documentation covering cloud configurations, system changes and troubleshooting procedures. * Participate in infrastructure reviews and recommend practical improvements to system reliability. Technical Background * Three or more years of experience in cloud engineering, infrastructure administration, DevOps or a related technical role. * Practical experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud. * Understanding of cloud architecture, virtualisation, storage and networking concepts. * Familiarity with Linux and/or Windows server administration. * Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Bash or PowerShell. * Knowledge of cloud security principles, identity and access management, and permission controls. * Familiarity with monitoring and logging tools used to assess system health. * Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes or other container technologies. * Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation tools such as Terraform or CloudFormation. * Ability to investigate technical issues, assess their impact and document solutions. * Good communication skills and the ability to work with both technical and non\-technical colleagues. A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related discipline is preferred. Equivalent professional experience and relevant cloud certifications will also be considered. You will take part in infrastructure planning, deployment preparation, system monitoring and the investigation of technical issues. Some tasks will involve routine maintenance and scheduled updates, while others will require responding to unexpected problems or supporting new project requirements. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: **Forward Deployed Engineer** **— Banking Platform** *Ship it, then go sit with the people using it. · Charlotte, NC* **Location** Charlotte, NC — on\-site at our headquarters, with travel to partner and client sites **Experience Required** 5\+ years building and shipping production software, including meaningful time in financial services and hands\-on experience building with Claude **Employment Type** Full\-time, exempt **Reports To** Technical Program Manager **Direct Reports** None. You work across engineering, product, operations, and directly with external partners. **Core Stack** React, Flutter, AWS, GitHub Actions, Claude (Claude Code and the Claude API) **Portfolio** Expected — see "Show Us Your Work" below **The Trade We're Offering** ============================ We're a smaller institution headquartered in a city full of very large ones, and we're not going to pretend we can match what the largest of them offer on every dimension. What we're offering instead is scope that those jobs structurally cannot give you. At a large bank, this work is split across four teams — a mobile team, a web team, a platform team, and a client\-facing integration group — and you'd own a lane in one of them. **Here, the whole path from commit to customer is yours.** You'll write the Flutter code, write the React code, own the pipeline that ships both, and then sit across the table from the people using what you built and watch where it breaks. Engineers who want that loop rarely get it at scale. If that's the job you've been trying to find, this is it.**About the Role** ================== We're hiring a Forward Deployed Engineer to build our banking platform and then take it into the field. This is a hybrid of product engineering and client\-facing solutions work: roughly two\-thirds building, one\-third embedded with the partners, vendors, and internal teams who depend on what you ship. The forward\-deployed part is the point. Most engineering organizations put layers between the person who writes the code and the person who has to live with it, and quality suffers in both directions. You'll close that gap. When an integration fails at a partner, you're the one who diagnoses it — not a support tier that escalates to a queue that eventually reaches engineering three days later. We also expect this person to be genuinely fluent with Claude — not as a novelty, but as core tooling. A small team competing against institutions a hundred times our size only works if each engineer's output is multiplied. You should already be building this way and be able to show us how. You'll work closely with the Senior Product Manager who owns the banking portfolio, and you'll have real influence over technical direction. We have opinions but not much legacy, which means your architectural decisions will still be standing in five years.**What You'll Own** =================== **Mobile Development — Flutter** -------------------------------- * Build and ship our customer\-facing mobile banking application in Flutter across iOS and Android. * Own the release process end to end — store submissions, staged rollouts, versioning, and the deprecation strategy for older clients. * Handle the parts of mobile banking that are genuinely hard: biometric authentication, secure local storage, session handling, offline states, and deep links from notifications. * Keep performance and app size honest on the low\-end devices real customers actually carry. **Web Development — React** --------------------------- * Build customer\-facing web banking experiences and the internal tooling our operations teams use daily. * Share logic and design language across web and mobile so the two products don't quietly diverge. * Build to accessibility standards — WCAG conformance is a regulatory expectation in consumer banking, not a nice\-to\-have. **Cloud Infrastructure — AWS** ------------------------------ * Design, deploy, and operate services on AWS — compute, storage, networking, secrets, and identity. * Own infrastructure as code so environments are reproducible and auditable rather than hand\-assembled. * Build for the availability and recovery expectations of a regulated financial institution, and be able to prove them to an examiner. * Watch the bill. Cloud cost discipline matters more at our size than it does at a bank that can absorb the waste. **Delivery Engineering — GitHub Actions** ----------------------------------------- * Own the CI/CD pipelines for web, mobile, and backend services. * Build automated testing, security scanning, dependency checks, and deployment gates into the pipeline. * Maintain the change controls and audit trail that a regulated environment requires — approvals, artifacts, and release evidence. * Make shipping boring. A deployment should be an ordinary Tuesday, not an event. **AI\-Assisted Engineering — Claude** ------------------------------------- * Use Claude Code as a daily part of how you build — across the codebase, in your hat You Get Here** **What You Won't Get Here** The full path from commit to customer, owned by one person Anywhere to hide when something you shipped breaks Architectural decisions that will still be standing in five years A platform team that handles infrastructure so you don't have to Direct contact with the people using what you build Insulation from customers when a deploy goes badly Deploys in days, not release trains scheduled a quarter out A mature engineering organization with established process Genuine influence on technical direction from your first month Deep specialization — you'll work across mobile, web, cloud, and AI A mandate to define how a company uses AI, not to inherit someone's rules An existing AI platform team, or someone else's guardrails to inherit Budget for conferences, certifications, and continued learning A remote or fully flexible arrangement — this role is on\-site **Education** ============= * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience. * **No degree requirement we'll hold rigidly.** Show us what you've shipped. Self\-taught engineers with production track records are welcome here. * AWS certifications are a plus and are not required. **Work Environment** ==================== On\-site at our Charlotte headquarters, Monday through Friday, standard business hours. Expect periodic travel to partner and client sites — typically a few days at a time, several times a year. Banking platform work occasionally means an evening or a weekend around a release, a core conversion, or an incident. We run a real on\-call rotation and we keep it humane.**Show Us Your Work** ===================== We ask candidates for this role to share code. A resume tells us where you've been; a repository tells us how you think. Send us **one or two repositories you've built** — ideally something involving Claude, a mobile or web application, or infrastructure you're proud of. Personal projects, open\-source contributions, and side work all count. **If your best work is proprietary, that is not a disqualifier.** Most engineers coming out of financial services cannot share what they built, and we're not going to penalize you for honoring an agreement you signed. In that case, tell us and we'll substitute a walkthrough conversation — you talk us through the architecture of something you built, the trade\-offs you made, and what you'd do differently. That serves the same purpose. What we're looking for either way: how you structure a project, how you handle the unglamorous parts, whether the README exists, and — where Claude is involved — what you chose to delegate to it and what you kept for yourself. We are not grading polish. A rough repository with clear thinking beats a tidy one with none. We will not ask you to complete an unpaid take\-home assignment. Your existing work, plus a conversation about it, is enough.**How to Apply** ================ Send a resume, links to your repositories (or a note that your work is proprietary), and a short note about something you shipped and then had to support in the field: what broke, what you learned from the people using it, and what you changed as a result. That story tells us more than a stack list does. If invited to initial screening, we'll ask you to share a portfolio or a few examples of your work so we can get a better understanding of your experience and creative approach.**Equal Employment Opportunity** ================================ *We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team that reflects the customers we serve. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Reasonable accommodations are available at any stage of the hiring process — just ask.* 2xzZRwQxlZ

jobs.title: Product Designer II, I/O
jobs.description: **About the Company** --------------------- Valon is the leading AI platform for mortgage servicing, building the AI\-native operating system for regulated finance. Before providing the system of record that powers the entire industry, we built and ran our own mortgage servicer on it. That gave us a real regulated environment to prove our technology could replace the mainframe systems servicers have used for decades. Carrington acquired that servicer and adopted ValonOS as its core platform, allowing us to focus entirely on scaling our SaaS platform. ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls. We recently raised a $150 million Series D at a $2\.3 billion valuation joined by new investor Ribbit Capital, with continued support from existing backer a16z, amongst others. **The Design Team at Valon** ---------------------------- Valon's Design team is a tight\-knit and ambitious team. We are a user\-centered design team that creates meaningful, intuitive experiences and sets the industry bar. Today, our core products include a mortgage servicing platform that empowers our servicing agents and a homeowner console that makes managing everything mortgage\-related easy. We are at the stage where you can help shape the core experiences of the homeowners we serve and the teams who serve them. Sitting inside the product organization, you will work closely with world\-class cross\-functional teams to build products that deliver value to homeowners, servicing agents, and mortgage lenders. A portfolio is required for consideration. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a Product Designer to join our I/O team. I/O owns how loans move in and out of Valon: onboarding loans onto our servicing platform and offboarding them to the next servicer. It covers data intake, mapping, validation, conflict resolution, transfer arrangements, and the document packages and borrower letters that go with them. Every loan Valon services passes through this work, so the experience has to be accurate, reliable, and fast, often across thousands of loans at a time. Your users are mostly operations teams and specialists who manage transfers and boarding day to day, both at Valon and at the servicers we work with. You will design the I/O Console and the surrounding tools so they can ingest messy data, spot and fix problems early, and track a transfer from start to finish with confidence. As we bring in more automation and AI\-assisted data parsing, you will help decide how that work is surfaced, reviewed, and trusted. The work is data and detail\-heavy. Transfers involve edge cases, strict timelines, and many handoffs between systems and parties. You will need to be comfortable with ambiguity, and you will work closely with product, engineering, and operations to turn that complexity into clear, simple workflows. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design end\-to\-end experiences for loan onboarding and offboarding, from research and prototyping through testing and delivery. * Build expertise in how loans are boarded and transferred, and switch context quickly across workstreams in a fast, iterative environment. * Design batch\-oriented, data\-dense workflows in the I/O Console (intake, validation, conflict resolution, offboarding batches) that make high\-volume work fast and hard to get wrong. * Create user journeys, wireframes, and high\-fidelity designs that explain your solutions clearly and support business goals. * Partner with product managers, engineers, operations, and client\-facing teams to make sure designs are feasible, scalable, and accurate. * Design clear states, errors, and status tracking for long\-running, multi\-step processes that span many loans and parties. * Advocate for users at every stage of product development. * Work within and help evolve our design system, keeping the visual language and experience consistent across products and platforms. * Share your work early and often, and give and receive feedback with the rest of the Design team. **What This Role Means at Valon** --------------------------------- * **Intuitive flows despite complexity.** You create clear experiences even with complicated edge cases, tight timelines, and technical constraints. * **Ownership.** You take projects from problem to shipped design with growing independence, flag risks early, and know when to cut scope. * **Domain depth.** You learn the loan boarding and transfer process well enough to challenge assumptions and improve it. * **Collaboration.** You work easily with product, engineering, and operations partners, and you speak up when you are blocked. * **Systems thinking.** You look past the single screen and consider how a pattern could be reused across I/O and the rest of the platform. **Qualities We Value On the Design Team** ----------------------------------------- * User empathy and advocacy. * Strong communication and collaboration. * Critical thinkers and thought partners. * A humble, growth\-oriented mindset. * Caring about the big picture as much as the pixel\-perfect work. * Excitement about working in a startup environment. **Ideal Background** -------------------- * 3\+ years of experience in user\-centered product design * A solid portfolio * Experience designing digital products * Experience designing data\-dense, workflow\-heavy, or operational tools, such as enterprise or internal software * Ability to balance methodological rigor with scrappiness and creativity * Excellent written and verbal communication skills Experience with the following is not required but is a big plus: * Startup experience * Familiarity with the mortgage landscape, loan transfers, or other financial systems * Experience designing bulk actions, import or data\-validation flows, or status tracking for long\-running processes * Experience designing for AI\-assisted workflows **Benefits** ------------ * **Compensation:** competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity, and 401(k) plan. The base salary range reflects multiple levels. We assess level based on a combination of experience and interview performance. * **Health \& well\-being:** we’ll invest in your physical and mental well\-being with comprehensive medical, dental, \& vision benefits. * **Free Food:** daily lunch, and dinner provided through Forkable for in\-office team members. * **Commuter benefits:** pre\-tax deductions for public transit, rideshares, and parking to simplify your daily commute. * **Grow together:** company wide orientation for you to successfully onboard and other learning \& development opportunities including regular review cycles that feature 360\-degree feedback. * **Play together:** quarterly budgets for team and company outings. Use it for team swag, cooking classes, or team dinners. * **Generous time off:** flexible paid time off with no annual limit, sick days, and 11 company holidays. * **Baby bonding time:** 12 weeks of fully paid leave for both birthing and non\-birthing parents, so you can spend uninterrupted time welcoming and caring for your newest family member. *Throughout the interview process, please remember that emails will only be from* *valon.com* *email addresses. We will never ask for any personally identifiable information during the interview process itself. Please reach out to talent@valon.com if you have any requests to verify the authenticity of an outreach.* *Valon is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. jobs.description: **Posting Title** ================= Researcher III – Infrastructure Resilience and Energy Security . **Location** ============ Remote . **Position Type** ================= Limited Term (Fixed Term) . **Hours Per Week** ================== 40 . **Working at NLR** ================== Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world\-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost\-effective energy solutions. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well\-being. **Job Description** =================== The Resilient Infrastructure and Security Center (RISC) advances energy security, infrastructure, and resilience technologies that can withstand and recover from disruptions—empowering secure, competitive economies and resilient, thriving communities. Within the RISC center, the Strategic Energy Security (SES) Group leads projects and initiatives to ensure our nation’s energy security, assists in disaster planning and recovery, enables resilient infrastructure assessment, and implementation, and works with national security partners to ensure that critical infrastructure remains resilient and operational during disruptive events. SES is hiring a researcher to support and lead various analysis efforts that are central to the Threat to Consequences demonstrations, a critically important capability and growing area of work for the lab. This role requires someone with a keen attention to detail, versatility, excellent analytical capabilities, and a willingness to work with a variety of teams to accomplish tasks in a timely manner. AI \& Agentic AI** * Amazon Bedrock, OpenAI, or Azure OpenAI. * CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, LangGraph, or equivalent. * Prompt engineering, function calling, and tool integration. * RAG architecture and vector databases (ChromaDB, Pinecone, pgvector). * AI guardrails, evaluation, and hallucination mitigation. * MCP (Model Context Protocol) and AI skills/tooling. **Cloud \& Data Engineering** * Hands\-on AWS and/or GCP experience. * BigQuery, S3, Glue, Lambda, Vertex AI, SageMaker, or equivalent services. * Data lakes, data warehouses, ETL/ELT, and cloud\-based data jobs.title: Senior Android Automation Engineer (Device Fleet Management) - Contract
jobs.description: **About the project** We're an agency building our own platform to manage a fleet of physical Android phones. We have a small working prototype and need an experienced engineer to turn it into a reliable production system. The platform will let our team remotely view and control phones, install apps, organize phones into groups, schedule workflows, and review results in a web dashboard. This is a hands\-on role covering Android device integration, backend infrastructure, and a practical operator interface. **Pay:** Discussed on call, based on experience and agreed scope. Contract, with potential for ongoing work. **What you'll build** *Android device management* * Connect and provision physical Android phones * Remote screen viewing and input control * App installs, updates, and device health monitoring * Organize devices by location, group, and rack position * Recover cleanly from network drops, restarts, and app crashes * Identify supported phone models, Android versions, and any root requirements *Workflow execution* * A framework for assigning and scheduling tasks across devices * Approved app workflows built with Android automation tools * Task status, completion evidence, errors, and retries * No duplicate runs and no overlapping tasks on the same device * Screenshots and logs for troubleshooting Early workflow discovery includes Google Maps search and navigation interactions for authorized testing. Please explain any technical limits and platform requirements you see. Location simulation, attribution to Google Business Profile reporting, and ranking effects are not established capabilities or expected deliverables. *Backend and dashboard* * Secure APIs, device registration, authentication, and access controls * Device inventory, grouping, task queues, and scheduling * Online status, task progress, and per\-device results * Real\-time commands and screen streaming * Monitoring, audit logs, and alerts **Required experience** * Automating or remotely managing **physical** Android devices (not emulator\-only) * Strong ADB, Android permissions, provisioning, and troubleshooting skills * Kotlin or Java, plus Android app or service development * Appium, UI Automator, or similar Android automation tools * Backend development in a production language * APIs, databases, async workers, and task queues * Real\-time communication, reconnect logic, and unreliable networks * Deploying, documenting, and maintaining systems on client\-owned infrastructure * Clear communication about tradeoffs, constraints, and estimates **Nice to have** * Device labs, mobile test infrastructure, or multi\-device platforms * scrcpy, GADS, or similar remote device tools * Android screen capture, video encoding, low\-latency streaming * WebSockets, WebRTC, or WebTransport * PostgreSQL, Docker, Linux, cloud deployment * React, Vue, or similar dashboards * USB hubs, powered racks, thermal management, fleet reliability * Secure handling of device credentials and app data We're open to adapting existing tools where licenses and capabilities fit. Tell us what you'd reuse and what needs custom work. **First paid milestone: 3–5 device prototype** Using hardware you recommend and we approve, the prototype should show: * Device registration and accurate online/offline status * Browser\-based remote screen viewing and control * Device grouping and bulk install of a test APK * An agreed, repeatable test workflow * Per\-device logs with success, failure, and evidence * Recovery after a device disconnects and reconnects, with no duplicate task runs * Deployment docs and a code walkthrough We'll agree on acceptance criteria, dates, and payment milestones before work starts. More work depends on the prototype's results. **Ownership and delivery** * Custom code committed regularly to our repository * Infrastructure and service accounts under our control * The agreement covers ownership of custom work and rights to any pre\-existing components * All third\-party dependencies, licenses, and recurring fees disclosed * Setup instructions, architecture docs, and an operational handoff * Any subcontractors disclosed before they start **How to apply** Apply here with: * Examples of Android automation, remote\-control, or device\-management systems you've built * Your specific part in each one * A short outline of your proposed architecture * Recommended hardware for the prototype * Your availability, timeline, and hourly rate or milestone estimate * Any ongoing software or hosting costs you expect Demos, repos, or private walkthroughs help a lot. Please separate physical\-device work from emulator\-only work. Application Question(s): * Have you built remote screen viewing/control for physical Android phones (scrcpy, WebRTC, or similar)? Describe it briefly and share a repo, demo, or portfolio link. Experience: * physical Android device automation: 3 years (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Infrastructure
jobs.description: Prolific Machines is ushering in a new era of biotechnology with light. Our first\-of\-its\-kind optogenetic platform delivers unprecedented control, precisely guiding cellular behavior when and where it matters most. Unlike existing tools used to control biology, our technology enables dynamic, tunable control over virtually any cellular function in any cell type. We're enabling partners to unlock robust efficiency, quality, and reproducibility advantages across the most complex pharmaceuticals and therapeutic proteins. Prolific is supported by leading investors, including Bill Gates’s Breakthrough Energy Ventures, Mayfield and SOSV. ### **About the Role** We’re hiring our first Senior Software Engineer dedicated to data infrastructure: the systems that power our science, engineering, and operations. Most of the big decisions are still ahead of you. You’ll choose our time\-series stack, design our data warehouse and analysis platform, and decide what we build versus buy, starting from a few foundations already in place. This is not a traditional analytics or SaaS role. Your users are down the hall: roughly 45 scientists and engineers across four growing teams (Biology, Bioprocess Development, Analytical Chemistry, and Hardware) who plan, run, analyze, and hand off experiments every day. Your data comes from lab instruments, liquid handlers, bioreactors, and our own illumination hardware. You’ll build the systems that turn it into structured, trustworthy records, so our scientists and engineers spend their time using their data instead of capturing, organizing, and sanity\-checking it. You’ll join our Software \& Data team, a growing team of software engineers (currently one, soon three, and roughly six within a year) responsible for our production systems, internal tools, and data infrastructure. As the team grows, you’ll help hire and mentor the Analytics Engineers who will own the data models, templates, and dashboards our internal customers use, while you own the pipelines, integrations, and infrastructure underneath them. You’ll thrive here if you like working in person, close to real experiments and equipment, and moving across abstraction layers, from an instrument’s serial port to a scientist’s dashboard. The role is based primarily on site in Emeryville, CA, with some hybrid flexibility depending on project needs.### **What You'll Deliver in Your First Year** * Online data from bioreactors (benchtop through pilot scale) and illumination systems captured, stored, and monitored on a single time\-series data stack * Lab automation (liquid handlers, automated microbioreactors) and high\-throughput instruments automatically generating structured records in our electronic lab notebook * Offline (sampled) and online (sensor) run data viewable together, without exporting to another tool * The data foundation for structuring our cell line development workflow end to end, so customer reports can come straight from the system of record ### **Responsibilities** * Architect, build, and own our data infrastructure: ingestion pipelines, time\-series storage, the data warehouse, and a data analysis platform * Integrate lab instruments, automation, and bioreactors with our data platform, working with scientists and vendors to get data out reliably * Manage configuration and infrastructure as code, with version control, testing, continuous integration, and change management * Share ownership of our cloud environment with the rest of the team, including access control, security, reliability, and cost * Partner with scientists and Analytics Engineers to turn lab workflows into reliable, well\-structured data * Mentor Analytics Engineers on software engineering practices * Make pragmatic build\-vs\-buy decisions and work with software vendors and contractors * Establish data integrity practices that can extend to validated (GxP) systems as our customer work requires ### **Requirements** * MS with 5\+ years or BS with 7\+ years of professional software development experience, or equivalent * Fluency in Python and SQL, and proficiency in at least one other general\-purpose language (e.g. TypeScript, Go, Rust) * Experience designing, deploying, and operating cloud\-hosted services and data pipelines * Experience designing and maintaining data warehouses or analytical databases * Experience owning the reliability of systems where downtime or data loss has real\-world consequences, including monitoring, alerting, and recovering quickly when things break * Experience defining product or project requirements and soliciting user feedback to balance bug fixes against new feature development * Experience setting up or improving a shared development environment, such as unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing and continuous integration ### **Nice to Haves** * Experience with infrastructure as code * Experience with laboratory information management systems (LIMS) or electronic lab notebooks (ELN) * Experience with data historians or time\-series databases * Experience interfacing software with hardware or lab instruments (serial, TCP/IP, OPC UA, vendor APIs, etc.) * Experience applying data integrity principles (e.g. ALCOA\+, FAIR) to scientific data, such as audit trails, versioning, and provenance, ideally in GLP or other regulated research settings * Wet lab biology exposure, or experience in the biotech or pharmaceutical industries * Experience mentoring data scientists, analysts, and analytics engineers on software development ### **About You** * Compassionate teammate, caring about people as whole individuals, assuming positive intent, and believing in everyone's capacity to grow, including your own * Mission driven, letting real\-world impact motivate your approach and effort * Extreme owner, holding a broad sense of responsibility for outcomes rather than tasks, owning the fix and the lesson when things go wrong, and sharing credit widely * Standard setter, keeping high standards for yourself and others while defining excellence for your discipline * Pragmatic prototyper, shipping fast, delivering value incrementally, continuously improving in the face of ambiguity or a clean sheet * Customer\-obsessed, centering the user in your design process and delivery * Cross\-functional collaborator, comfortable working with stakeholders across many domains while owning your own * Rigorous, systems\-level thinker, architecting modular, composable, extensible systems for reliability, maintainability, and continuous delivery Generous equity package in an early\-stage company, retirement plan with company contribution, flexible PTO with healthy time off minimums, company\-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability insurance, career coaching, mental health support, free team lunches every day, great snacks, and companywide social events! This role is salaried, exempt, and paid semi\-monthly. Starting salary will be dependent upon specific experience, knowledge, and skillset. The base salary range for this role is $160,000–$210,000\. **Benefits**: Generous equity package in an early stage company, retirement plan with company contribution, flexible PTO with healthy time off minimums, company\-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability insurance, career coaching, mental health support, free team lunches everyday, great snacks, and companywide social events! **Diversity:** Prolific Machines values diverse perspectives, backgrounds, experiences, and ideas. jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Engineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $180K – $250K **Senior Software Engineer, Packaging** Reports to: VP of Engineering **ABOUT FLOX** ============== Flox builds developer tools that help teams manage software environments securely and reproducibly. Powered by Nix, our platform brings together command\-line tools, cloud services, and build infrastructure for engineers who care about how software gets made. We’re also working on Secure Packages and an AI Release Engineer. **THE ROLE** ============ Secure Packages keeps a large set of open source packages current, patched, and built reproducibly, and delivers them to customers. Behind it is a distributed build system: a pipeline that watches upstream releases, updates packages, builds and tests them across many execution environments, and publishes the results. We’re looking for an engineer who knows how software gets packaged. You’ve maintained packages for an operating system or a language ecosystem, and you have good instincts about what a correct package and a sound fix look like. You’ll build and run the system that does this at scale, and when builds break, you’ll be the one who figures out why and fixes it. Much of the routine update work is automated, including with AI agents. Your packaging judgment is what tells a good change from one that only looks right. **CORE RESPONSIBILITIES** ========================= * Keep packages building, current, and patched: diagnose build failures, dependency conflicts, and regressions, and fix them properly. * Build and improve the pipeline that detects upstream releases, updates packages, tests them, and publishes them. * Operate and scale the distributed build infrastructure behind it, and share on\-call for the services you build. * Maintain our downstream package set on top of a fast\-moving upstream, including carrying, upstreaming, and retiring changes. * Review automated and AI\-generated package changes and improve the tooling that produces them. * Work with product, infrastructure, and security engineers on scope, architecture, and delivery. **WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR** ========================== * Hands\-on packaging experience with OS package managers (RPM, deb, apk, Nix, or similar) and language ecosystems (npm, Cargo, PyPI, Go modules, or similar). * Working knowledge of build systems such as CMake, Autotools, Meson, or Bazel, and how to debug them. * Experience building or operating distributed build systems: build farms, remote builders, binary caches, or CI at scale. * Solid software engineering: you can design, build, and ship production services and pipelines. Our backend is Python. * Strong Linux fundamentals. * An understanding of how security vulnerabilities relate to packages and versions, and what it takes to ship a fix. * Clear communication and sound judgment about tradeoffs. **STRONG SIGNALS** ================== * Nix packaging experience: contributing to Nixpkgs and understanding how changes move through staging and channels. * Upstream maintainer or distribution work, for example at Red Hat, Debian, Fedora, Ubuntu, Alpine, or Wolfi. * Experience with distribution build systems such as Koji, Open Build Service, Launchpad, or Hydra, or with self\-hosted CI and remote execution (GitHub Actions runners, Buildkite, Bazel). * Experience backporting security fixes. * Familiarity with vulnerability and supply\-chain data such as CVEs, OSV, VEX, SBOMs (SPDX, CycloneDX), or signing and provenance (Sigstore, SLSA). We don’t expect all of these. * Experience with workflow orchestration such as Temporal. Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.description: **About the Role** We're looking for a Senior iOS Engineer to own the iPad app that runs daily feed operations at commercial feedlots . This role blends hands\-on iOS development with technical ownership: you'll write code, review others' changes, and be the person the team turns to when something goes wrong in the field. **What You'll Do** * Own the iPad app's codebase, architecture and quality: features, fixes, and breaking large legacy view controllers into reusable components. * Build and harden the Bluetooth integration with Digi\-Star EZ 2805/2810 scale heads — model detection, frame parsing, presets and reconnects — so weights stay correct when the link drops. * Maintain MQTT messaging between loader, mixer and truck iPads and the automated injection controller, including the wire contracts agreed with the vendor. * Deliver features end to end from Azure DevOps stories, behind feature flags, across the iPad app, the .NET API and the React web portal. * Drive root\-cause analysis on field incidents using PostHog and AppSpector data, explain findings to support and product, and ship the fix. * Own releases: versioning, TestFlight builds for Beta feedlots through Azure DevOps Pipelines, and promotion to Production. * Use Claude Code day to day for code, investigations and documentation, and review AI\-assisted output for correctness. * Review pull requests and keep developer documentation (architecture, auto\-injection guide, release workflow) current. * Partner with product, QA and support on acceptance criteria and release readiness. **What We're Looking For** * 5\+ years of professional iOS development in Swift, including UIKit apps built with storyboards and in code. * Hands\-on CoreBluetooth experience with real peripherals: scanning, reconnects, characteristic streams, and parsing a byte or text protocol. * Swift concurrency (GCD, async/await) and app lifecycle handling; jobs.title: Senior/Staff Platform Engineer, Data & AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About the role** Keebler Health builds AI\-driven risk adjustment and hospitalization\-prevention products for healthcare organizations. Over the next few quarters we’re tripling the volume of clinical data we manage, and the systems that got us here won’t get us there. We’re looking for a hands\-on senior engineer to own the scaling of our data and AI infrastructure: storage, retrieval, model throughput, and the compute and network underneath it. This isn’t a greenfield role. You’ll work on real systems under real load in a HIPAA\-regulated AWS environment, alongside a small, senior team. This is a US\-based remote position. We have a strong preference for candidates based in North Carolina or New York, where our team hubs are. **What you’ll build** We’re tripling the clinical data we manage over the next few quarters. You’ll work on the data and AI platform that makes that growth routine rather than heroic, working in a HIPAA\-regulated AWS environment alongside a small, senior team. * **A retrieval layer that scales with the data.** Our embedding store is 8TB today and heading toward \~25TB. You’ll decide how semantic search is built for that scale: index strategy, quantization, partitioning, tiering, or a different storage engine entirely. You’ll set the latency and recall targets and the cost model behind them. * **A model gateway for every LLM workload.** Today, high\-volume workloads can run into provider rate limits. You’ll design the shared layer that all model traffic goes through: queueing and backpressure, batching, caching, prioritization, and routing across providers and models. The goal is that product teams never think about quotas. * **Network and cluster foundations that scale with us.** You’ll evolve the AWS networking and compute foundations behind our data and AI workloads, partnering with our DevOps engineer to anticipate capacity limits and address bottlenecks before they affect delivery. That could mean improving network addressing, cluster capacity, or resource utilization. * **A data architecture that separates workloads by design.** Bulk ingestion, transactional traffic, and analytics currently share Aurora. You’ll define how each should be served, whether through staging pipelines, replicas, CDC into a warehouse or lakehouse, or something else, so that ingestion volume can grow without touching application performance. * **A self\-hosted inference platform**. We already serve OCR models on vLLM and are expanding into open\-weight LLMs. You’ll build the platform around them: benchmarking and model selection, GPU capacity planning, autoscaling, throughput tuning, and a clear framework for which workloads belong on self\-hosted models versus commercial APIs. **Experience that’s relevant** You don’t need to have solved these exact problems before. We care about adjacent experience and sound judgment about tradeoffs. Strong candidates will have several of the following: * **Large\-scale search or retrieval systems.** This could be vector databases (pgvector, OpenSearch k\-NN, Pinecone, Turbopuffer, Milvus), but classic search infrastructure (Elasticsearch/Lucene), recommender candidate retrieval, or any work tuning latency on large indexes is directly applicable. You should understand the tradeoffs between ANN index types, memory footprint, recall, and cost. * **High\-throughput systems built on quota\-limited dependencies.** Work in payments, ad\-tech, data integrations, or anywhere you’ve had to push large volumes through third\-party APIs with hard limits. You know how to use token buckets, priority queues, idempotent retries, and graceful degradation. * **Postgres at scale.** Deep experience with query planning, partitioning, bulk ingestion (COPY, staging tables, batching), connection management, and replica strategy. Aurora\-specific experience is a plus. Experience separating OLTP from analytical workloads (CDC into a warehouse or lakehouse, for example) is especially valuable. * **AWS networking and Kubernetes.** You’re comfortable with VPC design, subnet planning, and EKS networking (VPC CNI behavior, prefix delegation, secondary CIDRs, IPv6\), or you have the equivalent depth on another major cloud. * **Capacity planning and cost modeling.** You can project how a system behaves at 3x, identify which components scale nonlinearly, and make a cost\-aware case for when to optimize and when to re\-architect. * **Observability.** You instrument before you optimize, and you’re comfortable with metrics, tracing, and profiling across application and database layers. * **Production model inference.** Experience serving models on GPUs in production, whether that’s LLMs on vLLM, SGLang, TGI, or TensorRT\-LLM, or earlier\-generation serving on Triton or TorchServe. You should understand the levers that matter for throughput and cost, including continuous batching, KV cache memory, quantization (AWQ, GPTQ, FP8\), tensor parallelism, and GPU instance selection. Experience running GPU workloads on Kubernetes (node pools, the NVIDIA device plugin, Karpenter or a similar autoscaler) is especially relevant. **Nice to have** * Experience in a regulated environment (HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI, or similar), including working under BAAs and data\-residency constraints * Familiarity with LLM application infrastructure: embedding pipelines, multi\-provider routing, Bedrock or OpenAI, batch inference APIs * Startup experience, where you were the person who both made the architectural decision and shipped it * Python and/or TypeScript fluency, plus infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, CDK, Pulumi) **What success looks like in the first six months** Semantic search latency is well within product requirements at current volume, with a credible path to 3x. Model throughput is no longer a recurring incident category. Nightly loads complete without database alarms. The team has a capacity plan it trusts. **What We Offer** * Competitive salary, equity options, and benefits package. * A fast\-paced, innovative environment. * Professional growth and development opportunities. * A collaborative and supportive team culture. * The chance to make a meaningful impact on the healthcare industry. Compensation Range: $190K \- $260K

jobs.description: **Job Title:** Software Engineer, Agents **Team:** Engineering **Location:** Onsite \- Sawtelle (Between Santa Monica \& West LA) **Employment Type:** Full\-time, Salary, Exempt **Reports To:** Head of Engineering **About Plug** Plug is an automotive fintech startup that’s building the marketplace for electric vehicles. Sellers can get an instant cash offer in minutes, backed by data\-driven pricing and battery state\-of\-health analysis, with pickup, payment, and title transfer handled end\-to\-end. Every vehicle Plug acquires is sold through a competitive wholesale auction, where franchise and independent dealers across the United States bid in real time on inventory sourced directly from consumers, dealers, and commercial partners. The result is a single platform that gives sellers a fast, fair exit and gives dealers a dedicated channel for sourcing used EV inventory. Founded in 2023 and led by former Tesla executives, Plug has facilitated over $150M in EV sales since launch and is backed by a $20M Series A from Lightspeed Venture Partners. Join us as we build the AI\-native transaction rails behind the used EV market’s exponential growth. Learn more at plugmotors.com. **Why Plug** * You’ll help build the biggest infrastructure opportunity in automotive. * You’ll work on a platform built exclusively for EVs, with nothing adapted from legacy automotive. * You’ll be part of an AI\-native company. We’re rethinking how work gets done at a fundamental level. * You’ll work directly with operators who have scaled multi\-billion dollar businesses in automotive, EV, and marketplaces. * You’ll ship constantly, with high autonomy and a direct line to company outcomes. **The Opportunity** Plug runs on a lot of manual work: reading titles and inspection reports, chasing paperwork with dealers, checking vehicle details, answering sellers, and moving each car from offer to sale. Learn to identify and fix what breaks, and tighten prompts, tools, and guardrails over time. * Ship full\-stack when the job calls for it: the TypeScript and React screens where people review and correct agent output, and the backend endpoints behind them. * Contribute to the reusable tools, examples, and short write\-ups that help the team build agents faster, growing into helping others adopt these patterns as you build experience. **What You’ll Bring** * 3\+ years of full\-time industry software engineering, with experience shipping features to production and supporting them after launch. * Solid TypeScript or Python, and comfort working across the stack: APIs, databases, and frontend when needed. * Some hands\-on experience with LLM features in production (tool use, retrieval, structured output) or strong interest and aptitude for learning this quickly. * Familiarity with an agent framework and observability stack (LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, or Langfuse) is a plus; we’re also open to candidates who’ve worked with other tools and can show us what you built. * Comfortable using agentic coding tools day to day, and curious about building your own tooling around them (skills, MCP servers, custom workflows, or evals) as you grow. * Comfort building inside systems other people designed. You can disagree, make your case, and then ship the agreed plan. * A habit of writing things down: short design notes, eval results, and runbooks that others can pick up. * You enjoy being part of a small team: pairing, reviewing each other’s work, and sharing credit. * A proactive mindset in an ambiguous, fast\-moving startup. You’re eager to find valuable workflows to automate and ship against them with support from the team. * BS in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience. **Nice to Have** * Experience with document\-heavy workflows such as titles, registrations, inspections, lending, or insurance. * Experience with vehicle, marketplace, or auction products. * Experience with human\-in\-the\-loop review tools, or with fine\-tuning and prompt optimization for production LLM features. **Compensation and Benefits** Annual salary: $145,000 to $175,000 Salary ranges come from independent, third\-party benchmarking against national compensation data. Where an offer falls within the range depends on relevant experience, specialized skills, training and qualifications, current business needs, and market conditions. We review ranges periodically and may adjust them as the market changes. **Benefits \& Perks** * Health, Vision, and Dental insurance * 401(k) plan * Daily lunch stipend * Equity (based on role and performance) * 30\-day remote work from anywhere policy * Unlimited PTO * Fully stocked kitchen * Dog\-friendly office * Ongoing opportunities for growth and development This full\-time position is an in\-person role based in Sawtelle (between Santa Monica and West Los Angeles). jobs.description: JOB SUMMARY Iambic Therapeutics is seeking a Senior Software Engineer to help build our Lab of the Future at our San Diego headquarters. This hands\-on role combines strong software engineering with an understanding of high\-throughput experimentation (HTE), turning scientific workflows into reliable, increasingly automated cycles of design, execution, and analysis. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES * Partner with scientists to translate experimental needs into software and automated workflows across the Design\-Make\-Test\-Analyze (DMTA) cycle. * Build Python services and integrations connecting laboratory schedulers, robotics, instruments, and our discovery platform; work with vendors to test and troubleshoot interfaces. * Design and operate APIs, databases, and AWS services that track experiment requests, samples, plates, execution status, and results. * Develop pipelines to parse, validate, and ingest instrument exports and assay data, preserving sample identity, experimental context, units, and provenance. * Make laboratory workflows reliable through testing, monitoring, and recovery procedures that account for instrument failures, partial runs, and manual intervention. * Partner with the Agentic AI team to expose well\-defined laboratory capabilities to AI\-driven workflows, with validated inputs, traceable actions, and appropriate human oversight. * Own technical projects from design through deployment and support; contribute code reviews, documentation, and mentoring, and explain tradeoffs clearly to scientific and technical colleagues. QUALIFICATIONS * Minimum of 10 years of related experience (building software for scientific or laboratory environment) with a bachelor's degree; or 8 years and a master's degree or equivalent experience. * Strong Python skills and a record of delivering tested, maintainable production software using version control, code review, and automated testing. * Experience building web services and APIs, designing relational data models, working with SQL, and deploying and operating software on AWS. * Practical experience with laboratory automation and familiarity with HTE workflows, including plate\-based experiments, liquid handling, instrument integration, and laboratory scheduling. * Enough chemistry or biology fluency to work with scientists on assay requirements, metadata, controls, and data quality, and translate those needs into software. * Ability to independently scope and deliver projects, troubleshoot across software and laboratory systems, and communicate clearly across disciplines. * An automation mindset: identify repetitive work, build reusable capabilities, and use sound judgment about validation, failure recovery, and when a scientist should remain in the loop. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS * Experience with platforms such as HighRes Cellario, Celltrio, or comparable automation and analytical systems; expertise in every platform is not expected. * Experience with scientific data ingestion, workflow orchestration, or integrating laboratory systems with shared data platforms. * Experience building or evaluating LLM\-based agents or other AI\-assisted workflows, especially where software interacts with experiments or scientific tools. ABOUT IAMBIC THERAPEUTICS Iambic Therapeutics (Nasdaq: IAM) is a technology and clinical\-stage life sciences company headquartered in San Diego. By utilizing molecular superintelligence — integrating proprietary AI with automated, scalable chemistry and biology experimentation — our platform is designed to address the totality of drug discovery and development. At Iambic, we are building an engine that is designed to power the future of medicine. Learn more at iambic.ai. MISSION \& VALUES Our mission is to make better technology for better medicines. Three values guide how we work: * Bold. We are courageous, take thoughtful risks, and approach challenges with tenacity. * Innovative. We are creative and find new solutions that deliver impact. * Collaborative. We respect one another and partner with integrity. We value the range of perspectives our people bring, and we work to build an environment where every team member can contribute and grow. PAY AND BENEFITS The pay range for this role is listed above. jobs.title: Tech Lead Manager
jobs.description: **Tech Lead Manager** ===================== **About Hamilton AI** --------------------- Hamilton AI is creating the operating system for business aviation. Unlike commercial aviation, business aviation lives in the dark ages, think emails, phone and spreadsheets that run most of the operations of operators from 2 aircraft to 1,000 aircraft. Hamilton is here to change that. We offer a fully vertically integrated platform that runs business operations at our customers. Our AI agents are the first point of contact for quote requests and we run these quote requests from A to Z. Think quoting, flight scheduling and optimization, route planning, aircraft tracking, payment processing, and back\-office invoicing and payroll. **Team** -------- Hamilton AI is founded by Wouter Witvoet, who previously founded Secfi.com ($1\.5bn AUM) and went on to take his second business public, DeFi Technologies, listed on the NASDAQ under DEFT with a market cap of $1\.2bn. Other members are ex\-Dropbox, Square, Airlabs, PagerDuty, Playbook, Walt Disney, Getaround, and NASA JPL. **Where we're at** ------------------ From January to March 2025, we took part in HF0 Residency—one of the world's most exclusive programs for repeat founders, backed by Google, Andreessen Horowitz, and visionary investors like Naval Ravikant. In just 90 days, we made a year's worth of progress—both in product development and real\-world results. Concretely: * We went from $150K to $1\.5MM in ARR with both small and large enterprises. * Raised $7\.2M across two rounds most recently February 2025\. Funded by leading VCs, including Bling Capital, TTV Capital, Cambrian VC, FJ Labs, Correlation VC, HF0, Mintaka Ventures, Weekend Fund Where will we be in three months? That's up to us. At Hamilton, you won't just watch the future unfold. You'll shape it. **Role** -------- Honest take: this is a Tech Lead Manager role where you'll write code most of the week. We're six engineers at seed stage with a product that already runs real operations for paying operators. We don't need someone to run process from a distance. We need a player\-coach who ships the hardest work on the roadmap and, in doing so, sets the bar for how everyone else ships. Plan on roughly 70% individual contribution and 30% management. As the team grows that may drift toward 50/50, but not past it. If you want to be out of the codebase within a year, this isn't the role. The management part is real, though: 1:1s, growth plans, hiring, and the rituals that keep six engineers pointed the same way. You'll partner with our Head of Product on roadmap and be the voice of engineering when the two of you decide what's realistic. And you'll be an engineering leader first, emphasis on "engineering": full\-stack across Next.js/React and Node.js, hands\-on with Postgres and AWS, and already building with AI tools every day. **What You'll Do** ------------------ **As a builder (most of your week)** * Ship major features end to end across our trip management platform: front end, back end, data model, deploy. * Lead integrations with flight management systems, FAA data, live aircraft tracking, and payments, where correctness matters and external APIs rarely cooperate. * Extend the AI agents that handle quote requests from first contact to booked trip, including the evals and guardrails that let us trust them with customers. * Make the architecture calls that keep us fast now without boxing us in later. **As a manager (the rest of it)** * Run 1:1s and growth plans for six engineers, and hire the next two to four with our Head of Product. * Own sprint and roadmap planning with Product. Push back when scope is wrong, commit when it's right. * Raise the bar on code review, testing, and reliability as the customer base grows. * Set the standard for building with AI tooling, and make the whole team faster, not just yourself. **First 6 Months in Seat** -------------------------- **0–30 days.** Learn the product, customers, and codebase. Ship something small to production in your first two weeks, sit in on customer calls, hold your first 1:1s, and form a view on where the architecture seams are. **30–90 days.** Lead a significant feature end to end. Take over sprint planning with Product, start the hiring plan, and make your first changes to how we build, showing the team the result rather than announcing it. **90–180 days.** Measure what's working and iterate. Onboard your first hires, build growth plans for the existing team, and co\-own the roadmap with Product. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 8\+ years of software engineering, including 2\+ years leading engineers as a Tech Lead Manager, tech lead, or founding engineer. You've run 1:1s, had hard conversations, and hired. * Still a strong full\-stack IC: shipping production code weekly in your current role, and intending to keep it that way. * Deep experience with React/Next.js and Node.js, plus solid SQL and Postgres. * Comfortable owning cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP) and CI/CD without a platform team. * Startup experience at the seed to Series B stage, where you've shipped 0 to 1 and lived with the consequences. * You build with AI every day (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) and have opinions about where it helps. * A degree in computer science or a related field, or the practical experience that makes the degree irrelevant. **Bonus points** ---------------- * LLM\-powered features in production: agentic workflows, evals, RAG, or structured extraction. * Payments, scheduling or optimization, or real\-time data pipelines (ADS\-B, telemetry, event streams). * Domain exposure to aviation, logistics, fintech, or another operationally heavy industry. * You've grown a team from roughly 5 to 10\+ and can say what you'd do differently. **You shouldn't apply if** -------------------------- * You want to manage full time. The IC share of this role is a feature, not a transition period. * You want the problem defined in detail before you start. We're moving too fast for that. * You prefer to own one layer of the stack. The work here spans database to deploy to customer call. **Why Hamilton AI?** -------------------- **Impact:** Work on cutting\-edge technology transforming a massive industry. **Mission\-driven:** Help solve some of the world's biggest optimization challenges. **Innovation:** Join a highly technical, fast\-moving team pushing the boundaries of AI and enterprise software. **Competitive Compensation:** Market\-leading salary and equity options. Compensation Range: $250K \- $300K

jobs.description: ***Every day, we work together for what matters – bold, swift, and equitable climate action.*** **ABOUT THE ROLE** At 3Degrees, a Certified B Corporation driving climate action, our proprietary, mission\-critical platform is the system of record for our transaction data and the core of our business. It brings teams across the company together around a single source of truth and powers high\-stakes, high\-value workflows where accuracy, auditability, and speed all matter. We are now reimagining that platform from the ground up, with AI at its core. Think intelligent document understanding that turns inbound emails and contracts into structured records, rules engines that validate every detail and explain their reasoning, agentic assistants that plan work in plain language or by voice, and open integrations that let the AI tools we choose work directly with our data. Through it all, one principle holds: the AI drafts, and a person approves. An early prototype has already shipped hundreds of improvements in a single month, and now we are building the team that will take it to production and beyond. How we build matters as much as what we build. Across 3Degrees, our engineering teams put AI agents to work throughout the development lifecycle: drafting code and tests, preparing pull requests for review, and even writing the release notes that tell users what is new, often several times a week. Engineers stay firmly in the loop as architects, reviewers, and decision\-makers, and they are always looking for the next way to work smarter. You will join a growing community of product engineers across the company who share ideas openly and raise the bar for one another. As Senior Engineer, Full Stack \& AI, you will be a core builder on a small, senior team, reporting to the Senior Director of Engineering and working closely with our Lead Engineer and the business teams who use the platform every day. You will own meaningful \& complex enough slices of the system end to end, from data models and services to polished user interfaces and AI\-powered features, and ship them at a pace that only an AI\-first workflow makes possible. This role is for builders who love modern tools, feel a genuine thrill with each new leap in AI, move fast with discipline, and want their work to matter. You will see your features used by colleagues in days, not quarters, and you will help prove what a next\-generation enterprise platform built around AI can be. *This is a full\-time role reporting to the Senior Director of Engineering. We value camaraderie, team collaboration, and the benefits of in\-person connection, while offering flexibility. For this role, we prefer candidates to join us in a voluntary, flexible hybrid work style in our San Francisco Bay Area office. We may also consider candidates who are able to join us at one of our office hubs in New York, NY, or Portland, ME.* *For exceptional remote candidates, we strongly prefer those located in states where we are currently eligible to hire: CA, OR, NY, WA, ME, TX, CO, MI, FL, MA, MN, VA, DC, GA, UT, and IL. While we prioritize candidates in, or open to relocating to, these states, we may consider outstanding remote candidates from other US states. Hiring in a new state would involve evaluating the implications of establishing a new hiring presence there. 3Degrees does not provide relocation assistance or work authorization sponsorship for this position; pre\-existing right\-to\-work status in the U.S. is required.* **WHAT YOU’LL DO** As Senior Engineer, you will design, build, and ship major parts of our next\-generation internal platform, using AI throughout your own workflow and building AI into the product itself. vertical slices of the platform, from a business user’s first request through production, and ship them on a fast, steady cadence * Build clean, intuitive interfaces for complex workflows, with strong jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI Agents (P345)
jobs.description: **84\.51° Overview:** 84\.51° is a retail data science, insights and media company. We help The Kroger Co., consumer packaged goods companies, agencies, publishers and affiliates create more personalized and valuable experiences for shoppers across the path to purchase. Powered by cutting\-edge science, we utilize first\-party retail data from more than 62 million U.S. households sourced through the Kroger Plus loyalty card program to fuel a more customer\-centric journey using 84\.51° Insights, 84\.51° Loyalty Marketing and our retail media advertising solution, Kroger Precision Marketing. *84\.51° follows a 5‑day in‑office work schedule to support collaboration, alignment, and team connection.* Join us at 84\.51°! \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Senior Software Engineer, AI Agents** --------------------------------------- **Summary** ----------- As a Senior Software Engineer on our AI agent team, you will design and build the tools, services, and data layer that our AI agents rely on, for both internal and external clients. That includes the APIs agents call, the integrations that connect them to our data and systems, and the platform that runs them reliably in production. We are a team of innovators, continuously exploring new technologies that keep 84\.51° on the cutting edge of application development. In this position, you will use TypeScript, Python, PostgreSQL, Redis, JSON, and SQL daily, working closely with the engineers who build the agents themselves. **Responsibilities** -------------------- Take ownership of stories and drive them to completion through all phases of the 84\.51° SDLC. This includes external\-facing and internal applications as well as process improvement activities such as: * Participate in the design of the tools and services AI agents use, built with TypeScript and Python: APIs, data access layers, integrations, and MCP servers * Develop backend services and APIs in TypeScript (Node.js) and Python * Design PostgreSQL schemas and queries that serve both applications and agents * Use Redis for caching, session state, rate limiting, and background task queues * Perform unit and integration testing, including contract tests for the tools and APIs agents depend on * Instrument services for observability: tracing, logging, and latency * Partner with senior resources, agent developers, and data scientists, gaining insights * Provide mentoring to junior resources * Participate in retrospective reviews * Participate in the estimation process for new work and releases * Maintain and enhance existing applications * Bring new perspectives to problems * Be driven to improve yourself and the way things are done **Qualifications, Skills, and Experience Required** --------------------------------------------------- * Bachelor's degree (Master's degree desired), typically in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Mathematics, Business Analytics, or another technically strong program * Understanding of Agile principles (Scrum) * 2\+ years of proven professional development experience in TypeScript and/or Python, with working proficiency in both * Familiarity with how AI agents use tools and APIs (function calling, structured outputs) * Proficient with automated testing (pytest, Jest/Vitest, Playwright, etc.) * Proficient with version control (Git) * Experience with a Python or TypeScript service framework (FastAPI, Express, NestJS, etc.) * Experience with dependency management (npm/pnpm, uv/Poetry/pip) * Experience with PostgreSQL, including schema design and query performance * Experience with Redis (caching, queues, pub/sub) * Experience with performance tuning enterprise applications * Experience with debugging enterprise applications * Experience with RESTful APIs * Understanding of CI/CD * Understanding of object\-oriented principles * Understanding of SOLID principles **Preferred Skills – Knowledge of the Following** ------------------------------------------------- * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (e.g., Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini) or agent frameworks (LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK, Vercel AI SDK, etc.) * Model Context Protocol (MCP), building or integrating MCP servers * Retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, and vector search (pgvector) * Observability tooling (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, LangSmith, etc.) * Service\-oriented and event\-driven architecture * Proficient in SQL * Docker and deploying services to a cloud platform (Azure, GCP, or AWS) \#LI\-SSS
