jobs.title: AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: A\&A Coatings is a thermal spray coatings company in South Plainfield, New Jersey. We are in process of building our own business platform: an AI\-assisted system that runs sales intake, quoting, the deal pipeline, production scheduling and analytics, used every day by our sales, operations, scheduling and purchasing teams. We are hiring an engineer to own it and keep building it. THE ROLE You will be the engineer responsible for the platform day to day: keeping it running, fixing what users report, and building the next modules together with the people who use them. You will work directly with the VP of Engineering and Quality, the President, the sales team, operations, scheduling and purchasing. This is a hands\-on role with a lot of ownership. A request raised in a morning meeting often becomes a shipped change within days. WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON * Sales intake: AI processing of the sales inbox (Gmail). Each email is classified, engineering data is extracted from RFQs and drawings (dimensions, tolerances, coating and specification requirements), repeat\-job and quote history is looked up in our ERP, and a reply is drafted for a person to review and send. * Quoting and pipeline: the quote workspace, the deal pipeline from first inquiry to won order, follow\-up reminders, customer records and sales rep assignment. * Operations: the production schedule that replaced our spreadsheet schedule, job routing, ship dates and purchasing. * Analytics: sales rep performance, lead quality (ad leads against organic leads, cost per lead) and business reporting alongside our Power BI reports. * Integrations: the JobBOSS2 (E2\) ERP API, Google Workspace (Gmail, Drive, Sheets), and our website forms and ad tracking. * Support and releases: run the issue tracker, triage and fix bugs, write release notes that non\-technical users can follow, train users, and join the daily scrum and production meetings. * What comes next: shipping with carrier integration (USPS, FedEx and others), powder inventory, a full purchasing module, a system for our sister company, and a sales prospecting tool. OUR STACK Python 3\.11 with FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Alembic and Pydantic. Next.js 14 with TypeScript. PostgreSQL on Cloud SQL. Google Cloud Run. Gemini on Vertex AI. Google sign\-in with role\-based access and audit logging. The code base is documented (architecture overview, deployment runbook, security model, and a design note for each feature), and you will get a structured handover. QUALIFICATIONS * 2\+ years building and running production web applications, or an equivalent record of shipped work that real users rely on. * Strong Python and TypeScript, and comfort across backend, frontend and database. * Hands\-on work with LLM APIs inside a real product: structured extraction, classification, prompt design, and checking output quality on real data. * SQL and schema migrations on a live database without losing data. * Experience deploying and operating applications on a cloud platform (Google Cloud preferred; AWS or Azure is fine). * Clear written English for release notes, status updates and short emails to the team. * Manufacturing, job shop or ERP experience (JobBOSS2 / E2 especially) will be a plus. * Gmail and Google Workspace APIs, Power BI, or carrier shipping APIs will be a plus. * **Note:** The company will provide visa sponsorship for this role. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $95,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in South Plainfield, NJ 07080

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Why This Role Exists** A2Z Sync runs the deal for dealership rooftops across the United States: digital retail, desking, F\&I, and in\-store operations on one platform. Every one of those transactions, and every integration with the DMS, CRM, and lender systems around it, produces data. Today that data runs on AWS, from dealer system integrations through an Athena semantic layer to the reports our teams and partners rely on every day. Now we are building A2Z 2\.0, an AI\-driven data and intelligence platform for dealers, on a new lakehouse. The agents and insights it delivers are only as good as the data underneath them: fresh, modeled, governed, and fast. That is the Data Engineer's job. You will architect, build, and operate the analytical data ecosystem that feeds reporting today and the intelligence platform tomorrow, with the reliability that a showroom floor demands. This is a builder's role on a small team. You will own pipelines end to end, from ingestion to the models analysts and agents query, and you will be in the room when the platform's data decisions get made. ### **Scope \& Scale** * Thousands of dealer tenants on the platform, each with isolated databases and per\-tenant configuration. * Data pipelines spanning 6 integration domains with multi\-protocol vendor connectivity (REST, SOAP, event\-driven). * An Athena semantic layer of 40\+ views feeding Power BI reports and the A2Z Insights self\-serve app, used by Product, Ops, Engineering, IT, Finance, and strategic partners. * A new dealer lakehouse (bronze, silver, gold on Iceberg) coming online for A2Z 2\.0, with Beta this fall and general availability early next year. * Production AI agents whose tools and context depend on the data you serve. ### **What You'll Own** * **Data workloads on AWS.** Architect, build, and operationalize pipelines and storage using Glue, Athena, S3, DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions, and, where the workload calls for it, Timestream, Flink, and Kafka. * **The lakehouse.** Bronze, silver, and gold layers on Iceberg: table design, partitioning, compaction, and the storage\-format decisions (Parquet, Iceberg, ORC) that keep queries fast as data grows. * **Data models and access.** Models that analysts, reports, and agents can trust; secure data access APIs in Java and/or Python; real\-time streaming where the use case earns it. * **Pipeline reliability.** Monitoring, alerting, logging, and freshness and completeness checks, so breaks are caught before the Data and BI Analyst or a dealer sees them. * **Anomaly detection and data quality.** Statistical and ML\-based monitoring of data quality and integration call volumes, so a spike, drop, or silent failure surfaces early. * **Forecasting and predictive features.** Model development in Python (scikit\-learn, pandas, numpy) for forecasting and predictive analytics that feed A2Z 2\.0 insights. * **Governance and security.** SSL/TLS, client authentication, access auditing, and the controls that keep dealer data inside its tenant. * **Cross\-functional delivery.** Working with engineers, product managers, and the Data and BI Analyst to turn data requirements into scalable, secure, high\-quality solutions. ### **First 90 Days / First Year** **First 90 Days:** Learn the platform, the integration domains, and the semantic layer well enough to trace any reported number to its source. Take ownership of the pipelines feeding reporting and add freshness and completeness checks where they are missing. Ship your first production change to the lakehouse. Publish a point of view on the ingestion and modeling patterns A2Z 2\.0 should standardize on. **First Year:** The A2Z 2\.0 lakehouse is in production with bronze, silver, and gold layers you built or hardened, serving reports and agents at GA. Pipeline incidents are caught by your monitoring before users report them. At least one forecasting or anomaly\-detection model is live and used in the product or in operations. The patterns you set are the ones the next data engineer inherits. ### **Hands\-On Expectations** Roughly 70% building and operating (pipelines, models, APIs, monitoring), 20% design and architecture with the platform and AI teams, and 10% working with analysts and product on requirements and enablement. You write and ship code every week. ### **Tech \& Tools** * **Data platform:** Amazon Athena (Presto/Trino SQL), AWS Glue, S3, Apache Iceberg lakehouse (bronze, silver, gold), DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions. * **Streaming and time series:** Timestream, Flink, Kafka (where the workload calls for it). * **Languages and ML:** Python (pandas, numpy, scikit\-learn), Java, SQL. * **Reliability and governance:** CloudWatch, OpenTelemetry, freshness and completeness checks, SSL/TLS, access auditing. * **Downstream:** Power BI, Amazon Quick (under evaluation), A2Z Insights, AgentCore\-based agents. ### **How You'll Use AI** This is not a "we are AI\-curious" company. We use Claude every day, and we expect you to as well. Concrete examples for this role: * Draft and test pipeline code, SQL, and data\-quality checks with Claude, then verify against known\-good numbers before anything ships. * Generate lineage and documentation from the models themselves so the map from source to report to agent stays current. * Summarize pipeline incidents into root\-cause notes and runbook entries the on\-call engineer can act on. * Build the data foundations the A2Z 2\.0 agents stand on: the tables, APIs, and context they query, held to the standard that the same question returns the same number. * Prototype forecasting and anomaly\-detection approaches faster, so you spend your time on evaluating them against dealer outcomes. **You will not be replaced by AI. You will be the Data Engineer who builds the data the AI runs on.** ### **Role Specifics** * **Department:** Engineering * **Location:** Denver, CO, hybrid (2 days/week in office) or Remote (US, outside the Denver market) * **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Requirements** ### **Must Have** * Extensive experience architecting, building, and operationalizing data workloads on AWS (Athena, Glue, S3, DynamoDB; Timestream, Flink, or Kafka a plus). * Deep understanding of high\-performance analytical data platforms, distributed systems, and modern data file formats (Parquet, Iceberg, ORC). * Expertise building services and APIs on top of data platforms in Java and/or Python. * Strong background in data modeling, data access API design, and production monitoring and alerting. * Python for analytics and ML (pandas, numpy, scikit\-learn), including anomaly detection with statistical or ML methods. * Clear writing: pipeline documentation, data definitions, and incident summaries that engineers and business users both understand. * Problem\-solving, collaboration, and continuous improvement in a fast\-paced, small\-team environment. ### **Strongly Preferred** * Lakehouse experience with Iceberg (or Delta/Hudi) and medallion\-style layering. * Real\-time streaming in production (Flink, Kafka, Kinesis). * Experience serving data to LLM agents or AI features: tool\-facing APIs, retrieval, feature stores. * Multi\-tenant SaaS data architecture: tenant isolation, row\-level security, per\-tenant configuration. ### **Nice to Have** * Automotive retail, fintech, or dealer\-tech experience, including DMS or CRM data. * Power BI or Amazon Quick semantic modeling, or dbt\-style transformation workflows. * Infrastructure as code (CDK or CloudFormation) and CI/CD for data pipelines. **Benefits** We pride ourselves on cultivating a fun, casual, and collaborative workplace culture where your hard work is recognized, your contributions drive real results, and your impact is felt every day. At A2Z Sync, we're deeply committed to our employees' well\-being, starting with comprehensive benefits designed to help you care for yourself and your family. **Here's what we offer:** * **Base Salary:** $160,000 – $175,000, depending on experience and qualifications, plus an equity grant. * **Employer\-Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance:** Comprehensive coverage for you and your family starting on day one. * **Flexible Work:** Denver hybrid (2 days/week in office) or fully remote anywhere in the US. * **401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match:** Build your future with our competitive matching program. * **Generous Paid Time Off (PTO):** Unlimited PTO and 10 paid holidays. * **Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Coverage:** Fully employer\-paid. * **Life and AD\&D Insurance:** Employer\-paid coverage for peace of mind. * **Free Mental Health Support:** Access to confidential therapy sessions through BetterHelp. * **Pet Insurance Options:** Affordable plans for your furry family members. * **Identity Theft Protection:** Voluntary services to safeguard your personal information. * **Other Cool Stuff:** On\-site gym in Denver, great co\-workers, and a stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages to keep you fueled.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, AI/ML
jobs.description: ### **Why This Role Exists** We operate a multi\-tenant automotive SaaS platform serving thousands of dealer groups across the United States, running on a native AWS backend: Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, Step Functions. That platform works. Now we are making it think: production agentic AI systems built code\-first and deployed on AWS Bedrock AgentCore, connected to real systems, making decisions and executing workflows against real dealer data and real money. This is a hands\-on builder role. Expect the large majority of your time in code. But we are not hiring a pair of hands. Every agent you ship makes decisions that touch dealer revenue, so we need an engineer who understands the business problem before writing the technical solution: someone who asks what a workflow is worth, weighs build cost against dealer impact, and knows when the right answer is a simpler tool, or no agent at all. ### **Scope \& Scale** * 5,000\+ destination dealer tenants, each with isolated databases and per\-tenant configuration. * Agent workflows that touch production transaction data: real dealer money, not a sandbox. * Tens of thousands of API requests across REST, SOAP, and event\-driven integration surfaces that your agents' tools will call into. * A growing portfolio of production agents, each with its own cost, latency, and evaluation budget. ### **What You'll Own** * **Production agents on AgentCore.** Agent logic, tool orchestration, and multi\-agent workflows built in Strands or LangGraph and deployed on AgentCore Runtime with Memory, Identity, and Gateway. * **Tool interfaces.** Framework\-agnostic Python tools, MCP servers, and AgentCore Gateway targets that let agents safely call production APIs. * **Evaluation harnesses.** Offline and online eval pipelines and LLM\-as\-judge CI/CD gates that catch regressions before dealers do. * **Guardrails and safe failure.** Approval gates and rollback paths that determine whether an agent fails safe or fails loud. * **Cost and latency management.** Per\-agent cost tracking and multi\-model routing so each workflow earns more than it costs. * **Production observability.** AgentCore session tracing, OpenTelemetry, and CloudWatch dashboards for every agent you ship. You work within the platform's established architectural patterns, and produce deliverables using agentic frameworks, AWS serverless core, MCP and tool design, and observability without someone looking over your shoulder. Prompt engineering and tool\-use design are core engineering disciplines here, not an afterthought. ### **First 90 Days / First Year** **First 90 Days:** Ramp on the platform architecture, existing agents, and integration surfaces, and on the dealer workflows behind them, so you know what the agents are for, not just how they run. Ship your first tool integration (MCP server or Gateway target) to production in month one. By month three, own end\-to\-end agent workflows from design through production on AgentCore: Strands agent logic, tool interfaces, evaluation harness with CI gates, and guardrails. **First Year:** Running autonomously from month four: shipping new agents and tools with minimal oversight, with observability and cost tracking in place for everything you own. A portfolio of production agents in your name, each with an eval harness, guardrails, and a cost and latency budget it stays inside. At least one case where you argued for the simpler tool, or no agent at all, and were right. ### **Hands\-On Expectations** The large majority of your time is in code: agents, tools, evals, and the observability around them. The rest is design within the platform's established patterns and working with the Tech Leads whose domains your agents touch. You measure your week in shipped code. ### **Tech \& Tools** * **AI and agents:** Strands Agents SDK on AWS Bedrock AgentCore (Runtime, Gateway, Memory, Identity, Observability); MCP servers; Bedrock Guardrails; Anthropic models (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus). * **AWS:** Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, Step Functions, ECS Fargate, Aurora, API Gateway, CDK. * **Languages:** Python primary, Java (Spring Boot) secondary. * **Observability:** AgentCore session tracing, OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch. ### **How You'll Use AI** This is not a "we are AI\-curious" company. We use Claude every day, and we expect you to as well. Concrete examples for this role: * Build the production agents themselves: Anthropic models on Bedrock AgentCore, orchestrated in Strands, calling production APIs through MCP servers and Gateway targets. * Write eval fixtures and LLM\-as\-judge CI gates so every agent is tested against what good looks like before a dealer sees it. * Use Claude as your pair for agent code, tool schemas, and prompt iteration, with the agentic development harness as your default workflow. * Instrument every agent for cost and latency and use multi\-model routing so the workflow earns more than it costs. * Decide, with evidence, when an agent is the wrong answer and a deterministic tool is the right one. **You will not be replaced by AI. You will be the engineer who builds the agents that do real work for real dealers.** ### **Role Specifics** * **Department:** Engineering * **Reports To:** Head of Data Platform * **Location:** Denver, CO, hybrid (2 days/week in office) or Remote (US, outside the Denver market) * **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Requirements** ### **Must Have** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, including hands\-on production experience building LLM agents in a code\-first framework. Strands Agents and LangGraph are equally acceptable, as are Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK, and comparable frameworks. If you have built and operated real agents in any of them, you will pick up Strands quickly. * Business\-conscious judgment: you start from the problem and its value, not the technology, and you have walked away from a clever solution because a simpler one served the customer better. * Strong Python; ability to read and contribute to Java (Spring Boot) services. * Hands\-on experience with AWS serverless (Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, Step Functions). * Experience with prompt engineering, tool/function\-calling design, and evaluating LLM output quality in production. * An appetite for a heads\-down building role: you measure your week in shipped code. ### **Strongly Preferred** * Direct experience with Strands Agents and/or AgentCore Runtime (or migrating agent workloads from Lambda/Fargate to a managed agent runtime); LLM\-as\-judge, agent\-to\-agent orchestration, and agent governance. * Direct production experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers. * Comfort owning production observability (OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch) for the systems you build. ### **Nice to Have** * Automotive, fintech, or multi\-tenant marketplace platform experience. * Familiarity with Bedrock Guardrails, LLM\-as\-judge evaluation, model cost/latency optimization, and multi\-agent orchestration patterns. * Experience with data pipelines (Glue/Athena) or ETL/data lake tooling. **Benefits** We pride ourselves on cultivating a fun, casual, and collaborative workplace culture where your hard work is recognized, your contributions drive real results, and your impact is felt every day. At A2Z Sync, we're deeply committed to our employees' well\-being, starting with comprehensive benefits designed to help you care for yourself and your family. **Here's what we offer:** * **Base Salary:** $160,000 – $180,000, depending on experience and qualifications, plus an equity grant. * **Employer\-Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance:** Comprehensive coverage for you and your family starting on day one. * **Flexible Work:** Denver hybrid (2 days/week in office) or fully remote anywhere in the US. * **401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match:** Build your future with our competitive matching program. * **Generous Paid Time Off (PTO):** Unlimited PTO and 10 paid holidays. * **Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability Coverage:** Fully employer\-paid. * **Life and AD\&D Insurance:** Employer\-paid coverage for peace of mind. * **Free Mental Health Support:** Access to confidential therapy sessions through BetterHelp. * **Pet Insurance Options:** Affordable plans for your furry family members. * **Identity Theft Protection:** Voluntary services to safeguard your personal information. * **Other Cool Stuff:** On\-site gym in Denver, great co\-workers, and a stocked kitchen with snacks and beverages to keep you fueled.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Partner Integration
jobs.description: ### **Why This Role Exists** We operate a multi\-tenant automotive SaaS platform serving thousands of dealer groups across the United States, running on a native AWS backend: Lambda, EventBridge, DynamoDB, S3, Step Functions. That platform doesn't operate alone. It sits between dealer groups and the systems they already run: DMS platforms (CDK, Reynolds \& Reynolds, Tekion, DealerTrack, Procede), CRMs, digital retail tools, F\&I providers, and lenders. Over 40 partner platforms feed or consume our data today, and every one of them has its own auth model, its own schema, its own idea of what a "deal" is, and its own opinion about how much traffic you're allowed to send. That integration surface is the product. If a dealer's data doesn't land clean and on time, nothing downstream works: not the desking tool, not the reporting, not the AI. This role owns that surface end to end. You are the engineer who reads the partner's spec, gets on the call with their team when the spec is wrong, builds the ingestion in Python on AWS, and keeps it healthy in production. The engineering is only half of it. You write the Python, define the mapping, and own the result. * **The partner\-facing technical relationship.** You're the engineer on the call with their integration team: clarifying undocumented behavior, negotiating payload changes, driving certification, and escalating when their sandbox is down. * **Ingestion and normalization pipelines.** Webhook receivers, polling clients, and file\-based feeds landing into S3 and promoting through the medallion layers into the normalized model. * **Resilience under someone else's SLA.** Idempotency and deduplication, exponential backoff, rate\-limit handling, replay of missed events, and graceful degradation when a partner goes dark. * **Integration security.** Webhook signature verification, OAuth2/JWT credential lifecycles, KMS encryption, and credential storage in SSM/Secrets Manager. No secrets in code, ever. * **Contract testing and validation.** JSON Schema validation at the boundary, contract tests against partner sandboxes, and CI gates that catch a partner's breaking change before a dealer does. * **Observability and integration health.** CloudWatch dashboards, alarms, and structured logging per partner, so a 2 AM failure is diagnosable without guessing. * **Documentation that survives you.** Mapping specs, runbooks, and onboarding guides per partner. New partner onboarding is measurably faster and less bespoke because of the patterns and tooling you built. ### **Hands\-On Expectations** This is a building role, and the balance shifts with the calendar. Between onboardings you're heads\-down in code: clients, transformations, tests, instrumentation. During an active partner onboarding, expect several calls a week with their engineering team and real time spent in their documentation. Both modes are the job. ### **Tech \& Tools** * **Integration core:** Python (AWS Lambda Powertools), API Gateway, EventBridge, Step Functions, SQS; REST, SOAP/XML, webhook, and SFTP surfaces. * **Cloud services (native AWS stack):** Lambda, S3, DynamoDB, EventBridge, Step Functions, ECS Fargate, Aurora, API Gateway, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager, KMS, CDK. * **Languages:** Modern Python. * **Data platform:** S3 data lake with medallion layering (landing, bronze, silver, gold), DynamoDB single\-table design, endor API docs, WSDLs, and sample payloads into typed Python client skeletons and mapping code. * Using Claude Code to scaffold Lambda handlers, JSON Schemas, and unit tests from a partner spec. * Diffing a partner's new spec version against the old one to find the breaking change fast. * Drafting integration runbooks and mapping documentation from the code you just wrote. * Reasoning over production logs to isolate whether a failure is ours or theirs. **You will not be replaced by AI. Denver HQ nice to have. * **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Requirements** ### **Must Have** * 10\+ years of software engineering experience with strong, current Python. * Judgment about scope: you start from what the integration is worth to the dealer, not from the most interesting way to build it, and you've shipped the boring version when the boring version was right. * Hands\-on production experience integrating third\-party APIs you don't control, including at least one integration you owned through spec, build, certification, and production support. * **Comfort across integration styles, not just modern REST: SOAP/XML, webhooks, and file\-based feeds are all in scope here.** * **Hands\-on AWS experience (Lambda, S3, EventBridge, DynamoDB, Step Functions, Secrets Manager/SSM).** * **Real experience mapping and normalizing inconsistent external schemas into a canonical model, and the judgment to know when the partner's data is simply wrong.** * **Ability to debug distributed, event\-driven systems from logs and traces and be able to put observability in place.** * Willingness to be the person on the partner call. Direct, clear, and unbothered by pushing back on someone else's engineering team. ### **Strongly Preferred** * Idempotency and deduplication patterns for at\-least\-once delivery (e.g., DynamoDB\-backed dedup). * Webhook security: HMAC signature verification, mTLS, replay protection. * OAuth2 / JWT credential flows and rotation for machine\-to\-machine integrations. * JSON Schema or comparable contract validation at system boundaries. * Infrastructure as code (CDK) and CI/CD (CircleCI). ### **Nice to Have** * Automotive retail, DMS/CRM, fintech, or multi\-tenant marketplace platform experience. * Experience standing up a partner integration program from scratch (templates, scorecards, onboarding runbooks). **Benefits** We pride ourselves on cultivating a fun, casual, and collaborative workplace culture where your hard work is recognized, your contributions drive real results, and your impact is felt every day. jobs.title: ServiceNow ITSM Developer
jobs.description: We are seeking a ServiceNow ITSM Developer to join the team! The ITSM Developer builds the Service Desk portion of an Enterprise Technology Management platform for a municipal government client. The work replaces or modernizes the City’s current help desk processes with ServiceNow IT Service Management. This role handles hands\-on configuration, scripting, and workflow development so that City employees can request and track IT support easily and City IT staff can work tickets efficiently. This is a full\-time, hybrid position based out of our Tysons, VA office with periodic travel to the client site in Danville, VA. **Responsibilities** *ITSM Configuration \& Development* * Configure Incident, Problem, Change, Request, and Knowledge Management to ITIL 4 practices * Build the Service Catalog, record producers, variable sets, and fulfillment workflows using Flow Designer * Develop business rules, client scripts, UI policies, and script includes where out\-of\-the\-box functionality isn’t enough * Configure the Employee Service Center / Service Portal for self\-service requests, knowledge search, and ticket status * Set up SLAs, assignment rules, notifications, and escalations * Build reports, dashboards, and Performance Analytics for service desk metrics *Integrations* * Build integrations with email, Microsoft Teams, and Active Directory/Entra ID under the direction of the Solution Architect * Configure inbound email actions and virtual agent conversations where in scope *Testing \& Go\-Live* * Perform unit testing and support system and user acceptance testing (UAT) * Resolve defects found during testing, hypercare, and the post\-acceptance warranty period * Ensure portal and forms meet Section 508 / WCAG 2\.1 AA accessibility requirements * Provide go\-live and hypercare support to the City’s service desk team C*ollaboration* * Work with the ServiceNow Architect on platform standards and integrations * Work with the Data Migration \& Test Lead on loading historical tickets, knowledge articles, and catalog items * Partner with the Training Lead to provide content for agent and end\-user training **Deliverables** * Configured ITSM modules, Service Catalog items, and Service Portal * Developed scripts, flows, and integrations, with technical documentation * SLA definitions, notification matrix, and service desk dashboards * Unit test results and UAT defect resolution log * ITSM configuration workbook for City support staff **Qualifications** * Bachelor’s Degree or higher (or equivalent experience) * 4\+ years of ServiceNow development experience, including 2\+ full\-lifecycle ITSM implementations * ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and Certified Implementation Specialist – ITSM (CIS\-ITSM) required; Certified Application Developer (CAD) a plus * ITIL 4 Foundation certification preferred * Strong JavaScript skills and working knowledge of Glide APIs, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, and Service Portal widgets * Strong verbal and written communication skills * Ability to travel to Danville, VA as required * Ability to pass a criminal background check required by the client contract Flexible work from home options available.

Skills in: * Design application solutions using C\#, Python, Angular, React, TypeScript, JavaScript, AJAX, SOAP, JSON, etc. * Design database solutions using pgSQL and T\-SQL. * Understand and use object\-oriented software design with primary focus on web applications using Visual Studio Code and Visual Studio tooling. * Understand \& use SQL management platforms such as pgAdmin and SQL Server Management Studio tooling. * Understand \& use business intelligence components and reporting platforms such as Tableau Server/Desktop. Must be able to work with minimal supervision and continual interruption. Must be able to function with a high degree of independence within levels of delegated authority. * Use independent judgment in the research and recommendation of application design decisions before making appropriate recommendations to management, team members and end users. * Establish and maintain a good working relationship with AHFC personnel, contractors, customers, consultants, suppliers, and vendors. Interpersonal skills will be utilized daily through interaction with a diverse cross\-section of people and organizations. * Read \& understand written material, interpret \& apply rules. jobs.title: Founding Product Designer
jobs.description: **About Arini** --------------- Arini is building the single platform to run all healthcare operations. Healthcare has spent the last decade consolidating under large enterprises, but operations are still fragmented, manual, and expensive. A large group runs dozens of disconnected systems for scheduling, billing, insurance, accounts payable, and reporting, with people moving data between them by phone, fax, and spreadsheet. Outpatient healthcare is a $650 billion market, and almost every dollar of it still runs on manual work. Consolidators bought thousands of clinics on the promise that scale would expand margins and lift their EBITDA multiple. Scale alone has not delivered it. Automation is now the only way to hit the numbers they promised investors, and Arini is how they get there. We partner with some of the largest healthcare enterprises in the country, covering thousands of clinics and billions of dollars in annual revenue. We ship the systems that run their operations end to end, and the best of that work becomes the platform that scales across enterprises. When operations run themselves, patients feel it: calls answered on the first ring, appointments booked in seconds, insurance sorted before they walk in, and clinicians who spend their day on care instead of paperwork. That is what we are building, for every clinic in the country. We are backed by Y Combinator (W24\) and on track to grow more than tenfold in 2026\. **The team** ------------ Everyone at Arini ships code, including operators, growth, and customer leads. Our founders, Rami and Abdul, have worked together for over a decade. Rami studied computer science at MIT, Abdul at Harvard. Everyone carries more than one job, and nobody has time for work that does not matter. If AI can do it, a person should not be doing it. We move extremely fast and take extreme ownership. **The role** ------------ You will design the products that run operations for the largest healthcare enterprises in the country. Our forward deployed engineers find the problems inside each customer, and our software engineers build the systems that solve them. You make sure the people who depend on those systems love using them. That is three groups of people: front desk staff who work alongside our agents every day, operators at headquarters who run hundreds to thousands of locations, and our own FDEs who stand up a new enterprise in weeks. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Shadow operators at every level, from the front desk of a clinic to regional managers to C\-suite executives. Combine what you learn with requirements from engineering and data on how our products are actually used, and design something that holds up to all three. * Design the products operators at multi\-billion dollar healthcare enterprises use every day, working directly with the FDEs who build them: business intelligence and reporting across thousands of clinic locations, agents that automate accounting, procurement, insurance verification, and more. * Decide how our agents show their work. What a person sees after an agent books an appointment, flags an invoice for review, or hands off a call it could not handle. * Prototype in code. Use Figma when it helps, but expect to build in Cursor or Claude Code and ship small changes yourself. * Build the design system our engineers and growth team use, so they ship good interfaces without waiting on you. **First 90 days** ----------------- * Day 30: shadow operators alongside an FDE, then redesign one interface operators use daily and ship it. * Day 60: own one product surface end to end, such as call review or agent setup, from research through what ships. * Day 90: have a design system our engineering and growth teams build with on their own. **Who you are** --------------- * You have shipped B2B products where you were not the user, and you worked closely with the people who were. * You care about craft. Your type, spacing, and interaction details hold up when someone looks closely. * You prototype in code and build with AI every day. If a model can do it, you do not do it by hand. * You have a view on how AI should show its reasoning in an interface, and when it should not. * You question the workflow before the screen. When an interface feels crowded, you ask whether the work should happen there at all, and you change the workflow instead of polishing the UI. * You are opinionated, you back it up with what you saw in the field, and you say it directly. You hold your ground with engineers, founders, and customers, and change your mind when the evidence says to. **Benefits** ------------ * Competitive salary with meaningful equity * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Lunch and dinner in the office * Unlimited PTO

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Specialist AI Tooling, AWS Specialist Technology Team (STT)
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- AWS Specialist Technology Team (STT) is seeking a Senior Software Development Engineer to join the Specialist AI Tooling engineering team, the group building AI\-native, agentic solutions that are fundamentally transforming how thousands of AWS technical specialists and field team members develop expertise, get matched to customer engagements, and how AWS service teams consume customer feedback at scale. If you want to set the technical direction for production agentic AI systems that impact thousands of users daily, not research prototypes but real AI agents solving real problems, this is the role for you. As a Senior SDE you will own the architecture and technical roadmap across four interconnected products that collectively power the intelligence layer of AWS's specialist ecosystem: \- AWS Learning Agent \- A new generative AI\-powered, agentic learning system that replaces static training paths with personalized, cross\-domain skill development for every builder in the AWS technical field. Powered by a structured skill graph, persistent learner profiles, and the Specialist Knowledge Vault, the Learning Agent delivers adaptive learning journeys via a custom console, in Kiro, Claude, Quick and wherever builders work. \- Intelligent Routing Agent \- A new AI\-driven routing engine that matches 136K\+ annual specialist requests to verified domain experts using validated skill profiles rather than manually maintained lists, reducing resolution time (currently 7\.72 days) and enabling precision matching at scale. \- Technical Field Community (TFC) Hub \- The platform powering 46 Technical Field Communities, managing member engagement, competency tracking, learning path orchestration, and community\-driven content curation across AWS's specialist network. \- Service 360 \- A GenAI summarization and prioritization engine that aggregates customer feedback signals (PFRs, SpecReqs, SFDC Opportunity data) into categorized, prioritized service recommendations, automating what was previously a manual closed\-loop feedback process to influence the roadmap for AWS public service teams. This is a high\-impact, AI\-first senior engineering role where you will decide how these systems fit together, make the architectural decisions the rest of the team builds on, and solve hard problems at the intersection of knowledge graphs, multi\-agent orchestration, LLM\-powered personalization, and retrieval\-augmented generation, all at AWS scale, using the very AI services AWS builds for its customers. You will be the technical leader for a team of SDEs, raising the bar on design quality, operational excellence, and engineering velocity while mentoring engineers and shaping how the team builds with GenAI. Key job responsibilities * Own the end\-to\-end architecture of production agentic AI systems built on LLMs, knowledge graphs, RAG, and multi\-agent orchestration. Make the design decisions on agent boundaries, state management, orchestration, and data models that the team builds on for years. * Lead the design and evolution of GenAI pipelines for summarization, content ranking, skill assessment, and intelligent routing. Set the latency, quality, and cost targets for these pipelines and drive the team to meet them at scale. * Define the evaluation strategy, guardrails, and release standards for production LLM systems. Decide how the team measures quality and safety, when a model or prompt change is ready to ship, and how regressions are caught before users see them. * Set the embedding, retrieval, and knowledge representation strategy for the Specialist Knowledge Vault, choosing how domain expertise is indexed, versioned, and contextualized for agent consumption across all four products. * Own the architecture of the distributed systems and APIs that power the TFC Hub platform, including the migration from the current TFC Hub to the new platform for 46 technical communities without disruption to members. * Raise the operational bar for the team's production services by defining SLOs, reviewing operational readiness, leading incident response and correction\-of\-error reviews, and removing the root causes of recurring issues. * Drive technical strategy for the team and with partner teams. Write design documents, lead design reviews, influence adjacent teams' roadmaps, and make build\-versus\-buy and technology choices with clearly stated tradeoffs. * Mentor and grow SDE I and SDE II engineers, and partner with Product Management, Science, and senior field leaders to turn ambiguous, multi\-quarter problems into a sequenced technical plan the team can execute. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Imagine building intelligent systems that improve how millions of customers discover and shop for products on Amazon. The Catalog System Services (CSS) organization is at the heart of Amazon's global shopping experience, ensuring that product information is accurate, consistent, and trustworthy across marketplaces. We are looking for a talented and passionate Software Development Engineer II (SDE II) to join our team and help build the next generation of catalog quality and intelligence systems. Our team works at the intersection of large\-scale distributed systems, machine learning, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Agentic AI to solve some of the most complex challenges in Amazon's product catalog. In this role, you will design and develop highly scalable systems that normalize product information, intelligently identify and resolve catalog defects, and continuously improve data quality through automated feedback loops. You will have the opportunity to work on cutting\-edge technologies, influence technical architecture, and deliver solutions that directly impact customers and sellers worldwide. If you enjoy solving complex engineering problems, building innovative AI\-powered solutions, and operating systems at Amazon scale, this is an exciting opportunity to make a meaningful impact. Key job responsibilities 1\.Design, develop, and operate highly scalable, reliable distributed systems that process and improve product catalog data across Amazon's global marketplaces. 2\.Build intelligent catalog normalization and validation services to ensure product attributes are accurate, consistent, and aligned with established catalog standards. 3\.Develop AI\-powered solutions leveraging machine learning, LLMs, and Agentic AI to automatically detect, evaluate, and correct product data quality issues. 4\.Build and enhance Self\-Learning Systems (SLS) that continuously improve catalog quality by incorporating seller feedback, customer signals, and automated model evaluations. 5\.Design scalable mechanisms to ingest and process external signals, including customer feedback and seller inputs, to identify catalog defects and drive automated corrections. 6\. Develop robust evaluation frameworks, automated quality guardrails, and monitoring mechanisms to ensure the accuracy, reliability, and safety of AI\-driven catalog improvements. 7\.Collaborate with engineers, applied scientists, product managers, and partner teams to translate complex business challenges into scalable technical solutions. 8\. Drive end\-to\-end ownership of software solutions, including technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. About the team We are part of Amazon's Catalog System Services (CSS) organization, responsible for building foundational technologies that improve the accuracy, consistency, and quality of Amazon's global product catalog. Our team focuses on two critical areas: Catalog Normalization: We build large\-scale systems that standardize and validate product information across marketplaces, ensuring customers receive consistent, accurate, and meaningful product attributes regardless of where they shop. Self\-Learning Systems (SLS): We are building the next generation of intelligent catalog quality systems using machine learning, LLMs, and Agentic AI. Our systems continuously learn from seller feedback, customer signals, and automated evaluations to identify quality issues, improve validation models, and enable scalable catalog corrections. We work on challenging problems involving billions of product records, complex distributed architectures, AI\-driven automation, and continuous feedback mechanisms. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS DevOps Agent
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Build the AI agent that investigates production incidents for AWS customers. The AWS DevOps Agent reads the same telemetry a human operator would — logs, metrics, traces, topology — reasons about what went wrong, and delivers a written root\-cause analysis in minutes. We're hiring an SDE II to work on the investigation agent: the core reasoning engine that turns an alarm into an answer. This is not wrapper code over an LLM. You'll work on agent orchestration, tool design over MCP (Model Context Protocol), prompt engineering at scale, sandbox isolation for untrusted code execution, and evaluation systems that measure whether the agent actually got the diagnosis right. The system spans Rust, Python, and TypeScript services across a hundred packages, and ships to production across all commercial AWS regions. Key job responsibilities * Design and build agent reasoning systems that investigate production incidents end\-to\-end — from alarm to root\-cause analysis — using large language models and a tool\-calling architecture over MCP. * Own and evolve the investigation agent's tool surface: the capabilities the agent uses to read CloudWatch, X\-Ray, Kubernetes, CloudTrail, and service topology on a customer's behalf. * Build and improve evaluation systems (offline scenarios with ground\-truth grading, online trajectory evaluation of production runs) that measure agent quality and catch regressions before customers do. * Work across the stack — Python agent runtime on Strands, Rust Data Plane services, TypeScript control plane and CDK infrastructure — in a system where a single investigation crosses half a dozen services. * Design prompt and skill architectures that shape how the agent reasons without hard\-coding investigation logic, balancing model flexibility with reliability. * Collaborate with security, AppSec, and partner service teams on the trust boundaries that let an AI agent safely read customer telemetry at scale. A day in the life You might start the morning reviewing an eval regression — the agent's accuracy on a new scenario class dropped, and you're digging into the journal trace to understand what the model missed. After lunch you're pairing with a teammate on a new MCP tool that gives the agent access to deployment history, deciding what information to surface and what to withhold. By end of day you're reviewing a CR that changes how the agent handles multi\-signal incidents where logs, metrics, and traces tell conflicting stories. The problems are ambiguous, the feedback loop is fast (run the agent, read the trace, grade the result), and the work ships to every AWS commercial region. About the team The AWS DevOps Agent team builds an AI agent that investigates incidents, reviews releases, and answers operational questions about running AWS environments. We own the full vertical: the agent runtime, the tool servers, the sandbox, the evaluation pipeline, and the data plane that records what every run did. Our system serves AWS customers across all commercial regions, and the investigation agent is the flagship — the thing that turns "an alarm fired" into "here's what happened and what to do about it." jobs.title: Systems Engineer III (Loveland, CO)
jobs.description: We understand that the world we want tomorrow starts with how we do business today, and that’s why we’re inspired to make A Better World for Pets. Antech is comprised of a diverse team of individuals who are committed to each other’s growth and development. Our culture is centered on our guiding philosophy, The Five Principles: Quality, Responsibility, Mutuality, Efficiency and Freedom. Today Antech is driving the future of pet health as part of Mars Science \& Diagnostics , a family\-owned company focused on veterinary care. Current Associates will need to apply through the internal career site. Please log into Workday and click on Menu or View All Apps, select the Jobs Hub app, then click the magnifying glass to Browse Jobs. The Target Pay Range for this position is $99,000 \- $124,000 annually. At Antech, pay decisions are determined using factors such as relevant job\-related skills, experience, education, training, and budget. The Systems Engineer III is a senior member of Antech’s In\-House Diagnostics (IHD) R\&D Engineering team, leading the advancement of veterinary clinical diagnostic platforms. This role demands strategic cross\-functional collaboration and leadership in complex engineering projects. The Systems Engineer III helps define system architecture and drives communication and coordination across diverse teams. The Systems Engineer III contributes to shaping engineering best practices and processes within the R\&D organization. Mentoring engineers and scientists across the organization is expected. Essential Duties and Responsibilities Lead the definition and development of system architecture, ensuring scalable, robust, and efficient design solutions aligned with product goals. Lead the development and refinement of comprehensive system\-level requirements, ensuring alignment with product strategy and stakeholder needs. Oversee and coordinate complex integration activities across multiple engineering disciplines to guarantee timely and successful achievement of critical project milestones. Manage cross\-functional projects encompassing technology transfers, sustaining engineering for on\-market products, and new product development, driving technical solutions and coordinating with multiple stakeholders to deliver high\-quality outcomes. Serve as the primary technical liaison and communication hub between hardware, software, and assay development teams, as well as broader Antech stakeholders, championing a holistic systems\-level engineering approach. Ensure rigorous compliance with design controls, risk management protocols, and quality standards, consistently delivering high\-quality and reliable engineering solutions. Drive and support cross\-functional initiatives including technology transfers, sustaining engineering for existing products, and spearheading new product development efforts. Develop, lead, and execute robust verification and validation plans to confirm product performance, safety, and regulatory compliance. Lead coordination of system prototyping activities, including detailed performance tracking and thorough documentation of continuous improvement efforts. Provide strategic support for the design and prototyping of manufacturing tools to enhance production scalability and efficiency. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to process improvements that elevate team performance and project outcomes. Perform other duties as assigned to support organizational goals and innovation. Education and Experience Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in an engineering discipline, or equivalent demonstrated expertise in a related engineering environment. At least 5 years’ experience in hardware design and systems engineering, preferably focused on small opto\-mechanical or opto\-electronic devices. Demonstrated expertise in supporting engineering product design, development, and commercialization. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Skilled at influencing product strategy and technical direction. Ability to deliver new and improved system engineering practices and tools. Deep expertise in veterinary diagnostic systems design and the full development lifecycle, with a proven track record of delivering complex systems. Demonstrated accountability and ownership of critical system\-level deliverables, driving projects from concept through commercialization. Advanced proactive problem\-solving skills, capable of navigating and resolving complex challenges within multidisciplinary and dynamic environments. Strong leadership in managing workflows and optimizing processes in fast\-paced R\&D settings, ensuring efficiency and high\-quality outcomes. Proven ability to lead and mentor engineering teams, effectively managing priorities, resources, and schedules to meet or exceed project goals. Exceptional capability to work autonomously while fostering collaboration across cross\-functional teams and stakeholders. Comprehensive knowledge of quality management systems, including ISO 9001 and ISO 13485 standards, with experience driving compliance and continuous improvement. Familiarity with statistical process control (SPC) in manufacturing environments is advantageous, supporting data\-driven quality and process enhancements. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, Commercial
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ As an Applied AI Engineer on the Commercial team at Anthropic, you will be a trusted technical advisor to the companies that run the real economy, across software, financial services, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, and professional services, as they go from using Claude to building on it. Commercial is one of Anthropic's largest and fastest\-moving books of business, covering thousands of mid\-market and small companies. Some of these companies put Claude inside the product they sell, and others put agents to work inside their own engineering, operations, finance, and support teams, and this role works with both. You'll lead deep technical engagements, partnering directly with customer engineering teams to take their hardest agent builds from idea to production on the Claude API, the Agent SDK, Claude Managed Agents, Claude Code, and Claude for Enterprise. Many of these teams are lean, with years of existing systems and no dedicated AI function, and you will bridge the gap between what Claude can do and what it takes to run it inside a business that already has customers depending on it. Working closely with Applied AI Architects, Account Executives, and Anthropic's Product, Engineering, and Research teams, you'll go deep where hands\-on engineering changes the outcome, then turn what you learn into something the rest of the book can use. You'll leverage your AI engineering expertise to develop custom evaluation frameworks, design scalable architectures, and create the reference implementations, tooling, and technical resources that enable Commercial customers to succeed with Claude. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Serve as a deep technical advisor to high\-potential Commercial customers, whether Claude sits inside the product they sell or inside the way they run their own business, bringing them use cases worth building and pushing the boundaries of what agents can do in engineering, operations, finance, customer support, and more * Work hands\-on with customer engineering teams through build sprints, pair programming, and architecture reviews that move agents from idea to production, and understand their stack, data, and workflows end to end so that your guidance fits the systems, security requirements, and team they have today * Ship working code. Develop prototypes, near\-production examples, and technical documentation, including evaluation suites that become the customer's acceptance criteria, AI engineering techniques, and architecture diagrams, that enable customers to build, operate, and scale with Claude * Create reference implementations, blueprints, and sample code that many companies can adopt without starting from scratch, for example multi\-agent systems on the Agent SDK or Claude Managed Agents, MCP servers for common business systems, or Claude Code running across the software development lifecycle * Collaborate closely with Applied AI Architects and Account Executives to decide where engineering depth changes the outcome, and to maintain context and continuity across customer engagements * Identify patterns across engagements, including what is hard about running agents inside established companies such as legacy systems, messy data, permissions and security review, cost and latency at scale, and model migrations, then build repeatable evaluations and solutions and contribute insights back to Product, Engineering, Research, and the broader Applied AI team * Build the demos, agents, and internal tooling that scale the Commercial Applied AI team itself, and pair with architects on their hardest technical problems * Create technical content for customer and partner engineering audiences including documentation, tutorials, and sample code * Foster community engagement through hackathons, webinars, technical office hours, and customer events * Travel to customer sites for workshops, implementation guidance, and relationship building **You may be a good fit if you have** ------------------------------------- * Deep software engineering experience, gained by designing, building, and operating production systems, along with strong opinions of your own about how to bridge the gap between what AI can do today and how established companies get work done * 4\+ years of technical experience as a software engineer, forward deployed engineer, ML engineer, product engineer, or technical founder, with production experience building LLM\-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, MCP, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale, and the ability to work in  degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **For roles performing work in California:** We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Physical AI
jobs.description: Apptronik is a human\-centered robotics company developing AI\-powered robots to support humanity in every facet of life. Our flagship humanoid robot, Apollo, is built to collaborate thoughtfully with people, starting with critical industries such as manufacturing and logistics, with future applications in healthcare, the home, and beyond. We operate at the cutting edge of Applied AI, applying our expertise across the full robotics stack to solve some of society's most important problems. You will join a team dedicated to bringing Apollo to market at scale, tackling the complex challenges like safety, commercialization, and mass production to change the world for the better. #### **JOB SUMMARY** We are looking for a highly technical Staff or Principal Technical Program Manager to lead the programs that train Apollo's AI. This role owns the full physical AI training lifecycle: the compute infrastructure we train on, the data engine that feeds it, the pretraining, mid\-training, and post\-training runs that produce our models, and the path that takes those models onto robots in the field. You will operate as a technical peer to research and infrastructure leadership, not a schedule keeper. You will set the strategy for how training programs are planned and resourced, own the build\-out and utilization of our cloud and on\-premises GPU capacity, and turn research goals into executable plans with clear gates and decisions. As the function grows, you will define the program management practices that let Apptronik train and ship models faster than anyone else in physical AI. #### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES or KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES** * **Compute Strategy \& Infrastructure:** Own the strategy and execution for Apptronik's training compute across cloud and on\-premises GPUs. Drive capacity forecasting, build\-vs\-buy decisions, vendor and cloud partnerships, cluster bring\-up, and the utilization, cost, and allocation of compute across research teams. * **Training Program Execution:** Run pretraining, mid\-training, fine\-tuning, and distillation efforts as disciplined programs. Define compute budgets, data freeze dates, checkpoint and evaluation gates, and go/no\-go criteria, and lead the response when a run diverges or infrastructure fails. * **Data Engine:** Own the program that turns model needs into training data, spanning teleoperation, human demonstration, and simulation. Translate research requirements into collection plans, quality standards, and SOPs, and scale data throughput with the pipelines and storage behind it. * **Evaluation \& Model Release:** Establish a rigorous evaluation and release process across simulation and real robots. Drive statistically sound benchmarks, regression gates, and clear promotion criteria so release decisions rest on evidence, not demos. * **Deployment \& Fleet Learning:** Own the path from trained checkpoint to on\-robot inference, including model optimization for edge hardware and integration with software, controls, and firmware. Build the loop that brings fleet data back into post\-training and safely rolls out improved policies. * **Ownership:** Own program execution end to end. Set strategic direction, identify resource requirements, and be accountable for delivering on company goals and roadmap. Challenge assumptions at the org level and foster a results\-driven culture. * **Communication:** Proactively communicate program status, risks, trade\-offs, and decisions to executive stakeholders. Make compute, data, and model trade\-offs legible to leadership and clearly articulate requirements, goals, and milestones across teams. * **Leadership \& Mentorship:** Mentor TPMs and engineers, and define the frameworks, tooling, and operating rhythms that let research move fast without losing rigor. Raise the technical bar of the program management function. #### **SKILLS AND REQUIREMENTS** * **Large\-Scale Training Programs** — Deep experience leading programs for large model training, including pretraining, mid\-training, fine\-tuning, and distillation. Fluency in how runs are planned, resourced, monitored, and recovered when they fail. * **GPU Compute \& ML Infrastructure** — Hands\-on understanding of GPU clusters across cloud and on\-premises environments, including schedulers, distributed training, high\-speed interconnects, and storage. streamlined scripting automation. * Modernize test software tools, reducing Manufacturing Value Add (MVA) time without sacrificing test coverage or product quality.**Contract Manufacturer (CM) \& fault diagnostic capabilities to meet target yields. * Provide clear diagnostic \& decision trees and root\-cause analysis procedures for returned product and factory fallout. **Test Equipment \& Fixture Lifecycle Strategy** * Define replacement cycles and preventive maintenance plans for high\-wear test consumables (e.g., test cables, chassis connectors, backplanes, expansion test cards, and socket adapters). * Implement wear\-monitoring frameworks to proactively replace degrading test fixtures before connector plating wear causes false failures or product damage. * Manage test equipment line duplication, alternate tool qualification, and emergency fixture provisioning. * Design for Testability (DFT) \& Cross\-Functional Alignment * Partner with Product Development and R\&D teams during NPI phases to embed Design for Testability (DFT) principles into next\-generation printed circuit board assemblies (PCBAs). * Collaborate with Quality, Global Trade, and Regulatory Compliance Science in Electrical Engineering Technology (BSEET), Electrical Engineering (BSEE), or equivalent technical discipline. * Experience: 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in manufacturing test engineering, hardware diagnostics, or product repair engineering within enterprise communications, networking, or telecom device environments. * Hardware Expertise: Proven track record supporting complex electronic assemblies, including digital/analog media modules, power supplies, ARM/PowerPC/x86 architectures, and audio endpoints. * Test Automation \& Scripting: Strong proficiency in developing automated testing scripts (e.g., Python, Linux CLI tools, Shell, or legacy script automation frameworks). * Factory Process Knowledge: In\-depth understanding of full\-process manufacturing test flows: SMT, ICT, J\-Tag/Boundary Scan, Hi\-Pot isolation testing, Functional Board Run\-In, and Final Box Build / OBA. * Failure Analysis: Expert knowledge of root cause analysis methodologies for electronic hardware failure modes spanning component defect, process variability, and board\-level design defects. * Global CM Management: Demonstrated capability to work effectively across diverse culture and time\-zone environments with offshore manufacturing partners. Travel: Ability to travel up to 20\-25% internationally to factory sites in North America (Mexico) and Asia (Taiwan/China). **Preferred / Nice to Have Qualifications** * Acoustic Audio Testing: Hands\-on experience with acoustic chambers, artificial mouth/ear simulators, and automated audio response calibration for IP phones and conference speakerphones. * Regulatory Trade Familiarity: Familiarity with manufacturing flow constraints related to TAA (Trade Agreements Act) country\-of\-origin transformations, and global environmental standards. * OS Migration Experience: Experience converting legacy factory test rigs over to Linux\- based test environments. \#LI\-CM1 \#LI\-REMOTE **Experience** -------------- 5\+ Years of Experience **Footer** ---------- Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: **COMPANY OVERVIEW:** Balchem is committed to making the world a healthier place by delivering trusted, innovative, and science\-based solutions for the health and nutritional needs of the world. Balchem employs approximately 1,400 employees worldwide who provide the service, quality, and technology that enables our customers to win with their customers. We have built a reputation for delivering results to all of our stakeholders. Founded in 1967, Balchem, a Maryland corporation, became a publicly\-traded company in 1970 and is listed on Nasdaq under the symbol “BCPC.” Our corporate headquarters is located in Montvale, New Jersey, and we have a broad network of sales offices, manufacturing sites, and R\&D centers, primarily located in the U.S. and Europe. The Company consists of three business segments: Human Nutrition and Health, Animal Nutrition and Health, and Specialty Products. **POSITION SUMMARY:** The AI Engineer will design, build, and deploy AI agents and AI\-enabled automations for Balchem's supporting functions (Finance, Operations, HR, Legal, etc.) and Business Segments. This is a hands\-on technical role focused on applying commercially available AI platforms and large language models to real business processes, not on building or training foundation models. Success in this role requires strong software development and integration skills, practical experience with generative AI and agent tooling, and the business acumen to turn a process problem into a working, reliable solution. The AI Engineer will collaborate with functional teams to understand how work gets done today, then build agents that connect to Balchem's systems and data and deliver measurable productivity gains. While working closely with specific business segments and functions to ensure each solution fits its context, the AI Engineer builds with an enterprise\-wide perspective, favoring reusable components, common standards, and secure, supportable designs that can scale across Balchem. The AI Engineer will work within Balchem's AI Governance Process, helping to execute the Corporate AI Strategy by delivering prioritized use cases and ensuring every solution meets the organization's AI guardrails for security, privacy, and responsible use. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** **AI Agent Design \& Development** * Design, build, and deploy AI agents, copilots, and assistants using existing AI platforms, large language models, and agent frameworks to automate and improve business processes across Balchem's functions and business segments. **Systems Integration \& Automation** * Integrate AI agents with Balchem's enterprise applications and data sources (ERP, CRM, collaboration, and data platforms) using APIs, connectors, and workflow tools. * Build AI\-driven automations that reduce manual steps, shorten cycle times, and improve the accuracy of routine work. **Solution Delivery \& Lifecycle Management** * Own the full delivery lifecycle for AI solutions, from requirements and prototyping through testing, deployment, documentation, and ongoing support. * Translate business requirements into technical designs and help prioritize the delivery backlog based on potential benefit and business objectives. * Ensure solutions are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable business impact. **Use Case Discovery \& Prototyping** * Work with business stakeholders to identify and assess high\-value use cases for AI agents and automation across the organization. * Build rapid prototypes and proofs of concept to validate feasibility and value before committing to full development. **Prompt Engineering \& Knowledge Grounding** * Apply prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, and tool calling to ground agents in Balchem's data and knowledge, improving the accuracy, relevance, and reliability of their output. **User Enablement \& Adoption** * Support the rollout of new AI solutions with clear documentation, demonstrations, and hands\-on guidance for end users. * Partner with functional teams to gather feedback, resolve issues, and refine solutions so they are adopted and continue to deliver value. **Security, Compliance \& Responsible AI** * Build solutions that protect company data by applying appropriate access controls, data handling practices, and testing for accuracy and misuse. * Ensure all solutions comply with Balchem's AI Policy and IT security standards. **Monitoring \& Continuous Improvement** * Monitor the usage, quality, and cost of deployed agents, track KPIs, and continuously tune solutions to improve their performance and impact. **Collaboration \& Technology Awareness** * Work closely with IT, cybersecurity, and business teams, and stay current on emerging AI tools and practices to recommend those that fit Balchem's needs. **REQUIREMENTS:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of experience in software development, automation, or systems integration, including at least a year of hands\-on work building generative AI solutions. * Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents or LLM\-powered applications into production using existing platforms and APIs (for example, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI services, or comparable agent frameworks). * Working knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval\-augmented generation, agent orchestration, and solution evaluation. Experience training or building foundation models is not required. * Proficiency in Python or a similar language, REST APIs, and low\-code automation tools, with experience integrating solutions into enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, and Microsoft 365\. * Understanding of data security, privacy, and responsible AI practices, with a commitment to continuous learning as AI technologies and best practices evolve. * Strong communication, collaboration skills and documentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non\-technical audiences and work effectively with business stakeholders. The expected salary range for this position is $150,000 \- $180,000 a year Balchem is committed to a workplace culture that values and promotes diversity, inclusion, equal employment opportunities, and a work environment free of harassment and hostility.
