jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: Banyan Software is the best permanent home for software businesses that serve specialized industries, their employees, and their customers. With a buy\-grow\-and\-hold\-for\-life approach and a permanent capital base, Banyan acquires and grows companies worldwide, honoring founder legacies and helping portfolio companies modernize through shared AI expertise and operational discipline. Founded in 2016, Banyan operates more than 120 portfolio companies across North and South America, Europe, and APAC, and has appeared on the Inc. 5000 list for six consecutive years. The Banyan Software Foundation, endowed with $100 million in Banyan stock, leverages technology to build a greener and more equitable world. ### **Overview** We are looking for an exceptional full\-stack software engineer who will act as a **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)** to serve as the critical interface between the central AI Application Modernization Factory and our application teams. The FDE will be temporarily embedded within delivery teams to directly drive the modernization of key applications, ensuring technical success, **accelerated adoption of AI\-assisted SDLC practices**, and lasting upskilling of team members. This is a high\-impact, hybrid role requiring advanced software engineering skills, deep knowledge of cloud\-native patterns, and proven expertise in consultation, change management, and building strong rapport with diverse teams. ### **Key Responsibilities** * **Application Modernization Execution:** Embed with application teams to provide hands\-on technical leadership, driving the design, development, and delivery of modernization efforts (re\-platforming, microservices adoption) to AWS cloud\-native architectures. * **AI\-First SDLC Adoption \& Upskilling:** Act as the subject matter expert on the AI Modernization Factory's tools and processes (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code). Drive the adoption and change management necessary to embed AI\-assisted software development practices into the team's daily workflow. * **Consultative Engineering \& Change Management:** Build trust and rapport with new, diverse teams quickly. Identify team\-specific technical and process bottlenecks, recommending and implementing solutions, and effectively managing the people/process side of technical change. * **Hands\-on Software Development:** Make significant code contributions, focusing on setting up architectural scaffolding, CI/CD pipelines, IaC (Terraform), and solving complex, blocking integration challenges for the embedded team. * **Feedback Loop:** Serve as the primary feedback channel, relaying practical challenges, tool deficiencies, and necessary process adjustments back to the central Principal Engineer and Architect to continuously improve the factory's capabilities. * **Standards \& Quality:** Ensure embedded teams adhere to the central factory's engineering standards, including Twelve\-Factor App principles, DevSecOps practices, and high\-quality coding standards. ### **Required Qualifications \& Experience** * **Experience:** **5\+ years** of progressive experience in Software Engineering, with a focus on enterprise applications and application modernization. * **Full Stack Proficiency:** Strong hands\-on experience across the full application stack (front\-end, back\-end, database, infrastructure). Expert proficiency in one or more modern technology languages (e.g., Python, TypeScript, C\#, Java). * **Cloud Native \& IaC:** Deep practical experience building and deploying scalable applications on AWS. Strong proficiency with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), specifically Terraform. * **Consulting \& Change Management:** Proven ability to onboard rapidly, assess team dynamics and technical landscapes, influence technical direction without formal authority, and drive organizational/process change within established engineering teams. * **DevSecOps \& CI/CD:** Hands\-on mastery of setting up and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating DevSecOps best practices. * **Architectural Understanding:** Solid understanding of modern architectural patterns (microservices, serverless, event\-driven architecture) and the principles of Domain\-Driven Design (DDD). * **Communication \& Interpersonal Skills:** Exceptional communication, presentation, and listening skills. Ability to articulate complex technical issues and solutions to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders effectively. ### **Preferred Skills (A Plus)** * Prior experience in a consulting, Staff Engineer, or Forward Deployed role, specifically focused on technical adoption or modernization. * Direct experience training or mentoring other software engineers in new technologies or methodologies. * Hands\-on experience with modern UI frameworks like React, NextJS, or similar. * Experience utilizing AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) in a professional development environment. * Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and  cs and technical landscapes, influence technical direction without formal authority, and drive organizational/process change within established engineering teams. * **DevSecOps \& CI/CD:** Hands\-on mastery of setting up and optimizing CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) and integrating DevSecOps best practices. * **Architectural Understanding:** Solid understanding of modern architectural patterns (microservices, serverless, event\-driven architecture) and the principles of Domain\-Driven Design (DDD). * **Communication \& Interpersonal Skills:** Exceptional communication, presentation, and listening skills. Ability to articulate complex technical issues and solutions to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders effectively. ### **Preferred Skills (A Plus)** * Prior experience in a consulting, Staff Engineer, or Forward Deployed role, specifically focused on technical adoption or modernization. * Direct experience training or mentoring other software engineers in new technologies or methodologies. * Hands\-on experience with modern UI frameworks like React, NextJS, or similar. * Experience utilizing AI\-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) in a professional development environment. * Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless architectures (AWS Lambda). **Job Location** – Remote (USA \& Canada) The expected base salary for this position is: CAD 145000 / USD 170,000 excluding annual bonus (when applicable). Salary is based on a number of factors including market conditions, location and may vary depending on job\-related skills and experience. As a collective, our goal is to impact lasting change through our actions. Together, we unite for equality and equity. Banyan is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of any protected characteristic, including race, color, genetic information, creed, national origin, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, lawful alien status, ancestry, age, marital status, or protected veteran status and will not discriminate against anyone on the basis of a disability. All candidates must apply through our official Careers site to be considered for employment. Applications submitted outside of our applicant tracking system will not be reviewed. ***Recruitment Notice*** Banyan Software may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in screening and/or assessing applicants during the recruitment process. All hiring decisions are made by our team. Personal information submitted through your application will be collected and used for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. Contact us at any time with questions about our process or to request accommodation. ***Beware of Recruitment Scams*** We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. jobs.title: Senior Mobile App Engineer (React Native)
jobs.description: Beacon Biosignals is transforming precision medicine for the brain, from clinical development to clinical care. For Life Sciences partners, we offer the leading at\-home EEG platform for clinical development of novel therapeutics for neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders. Our Diagnostics business is building the most comprehensive at\-home platform for precision diagnostics, combining EEG and cardiopulmonary signals to deliver reimbursable assessments for sleep and central nervous system disorders. Together, we're changing the way patients are diagnosed and treated for any disorder that affects brain physiology. As a Senior Mobile App Engineer, you'll help power Beacon's mission by building cross\-platform apps that interface with our EEG headbands and other wearables to capture high\-fidelity data and enable seamless experiences for patients and clinicians. This isn't just another app. You'll be crafting tools that help unlock insights into neurological, psychiatric, and sleep disorders, with the potential to improve lives at scale. Beacon's robust asynchronous work practices ensure a first\-class remote work experience, but we also have in\-person office hubs located in Boston and New York. For this position we will consider candidates based anywhere in the US Eastern time zone. ### **What success looks like:** As part of our small, mission\-driven Mobile Apps Team, you will: * Develop our React Native mobile applications and our native iOS and Android BLE device SDKs. * Design and implement UX workflows for clinical trial participants and at\-home diagnostic patients. * Own the user experience, app performance, reliability, and observability of the apps and features you develop, leveraging feedback from real users in a diverse set of use cases and environments. * Partner with our Devices team, other Platform teams, and product designers to develop user\-centric mobile app capabilities that are deeply integrated with the rest of Beacon's product ecosystem. * Help shape the roadmap and technical direction of our mobile platform. In your first 3–6 months, you might: * Build a new in\-app feature to validate EEG signal quality before data capture. * Improve BLE pairing and reconnection reliability across both iOS and Android. * Streamline onboarding for new patients and trial participants to help make our devices easier to use than ever. * Deploy new features to help our Clinical Operations team track compliance. ### **What you will bring:** You'll be a great fit if you have: * 5\+ years of experience in mobile development (native iOS/Android and/or React Native). * Experience working with BLE, sensor integration, or health data streams. * A product mindset — you care deeply about UX, edge cases, and performance. * Familiarity with our tech stack (TypeScript, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Expo, GitHub) * Strong communication skills and comfort working in a collaborative, async environment Bonus points if you've: * Worked with medical devices, EEG, or wearables. * Integrated BLE peripheral devices into iOS and/or Android applications. * Written native code extensively for either iOS or Android, in addition to React Native. * Worked on apps for clinical trials, patients, or in some other regulated environment. * Contributed to open source mobile or BLE projects. The salary range for this role is $150,000 – $170,000, depending on past experience, specific skills, and qualifications. The base salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes equity, PTO, and other benefits. At Beacon, we've found that cultural and scientific impact is driven most by those that lead by example. As such, we're always seeking new contributors whose work demonstrates an avid curiosity, a bias towards simplicity, an eye for composability, a self\-service mindset, and \- most of all \- a deep empathy towards colleagues, stakeholders, users, and patients. We believe a diverse team builds more robust systems and achieves higher impact.

Own the feature store (SageMaker Feature Store, Tecton, or Feast) with guaranteed online/offline parity — training\-serving skew is treated as an incident, not a tradeoff. + * *CI/CD and Deployment Patterns*Build CI/CD for ML — model registry, automated retraining triggers, model versioning, lineage from feature training run deployed model + live prediction. Implement champion/challenger, shadow deployments, and canary releases as platform primitives so individual model teams do not reinvent them per project. + * *Monitoring, Drift \& Reliability* + Stand up drift detection, data quality, and model performance monitoring (Evidently, Arize, or SageMaker Model Monitor — pick one and standardize) with paging that routes to humans who can fix it. Inside Bowery, we’re a people\-forward company dedicated to providing a productive and inspiring working culture. We are a collection of hard\-working and enthusiastic types focused on building great teams to support great work. We balance our dedication to success with a commitment to gratitude, kindness, and a team\-first attitude. **About the Role** ------------------ Bowery is in a new phase: rethinking the whole appraisal process with AI at the core. We’re hiring a Software Engineer to join our AI\-first engineering team, reporting to our Head of Technology. As the first truly tech\-enabled appraisal firm \- having raised over $80mm backed by Goldman Sachs, Capital One, and numerous venture funds \- Bowery has a strong foundation to build on: a proprietary appraisal\-writing platform, high\-quality data, and a team of 100\+ appraisers across 17 offices from more than 1,000 clients. We’ve grown over 30% year\-over\-year and are fully profitable. Few industries are better suited for AI than appraisal. The work is structured, repetitive, and data\-driven, and it pulls from fragmented sources. We want to use AI to turbocharge appraisers, who can spend their time on judgment, comparables, and compliance instead of data entry. The result will be a better product for our clients and a transformation in the industry. This is a senior engineering role, not a prompt\-writing role. We want someone with a strong software engineering foundation who also uses AI tools like Claude Code and Codex to get far more done than they could alone. You’ll make product decisions, own systems end to end, and hold a high bar for how they’re built. Bowery is a post\-Series B company with clear product\-market fit and material scale, but with a small engineering team. You get the security and data of a late\-stage startup with the impact of a very early one. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design, build, and ship features end to end across our appraisal platform and AI\-powered workflows, from data extraction and analysis to narrative generation * Work directly with appraisers and Ops to understand the problem, decide what to build, and make the product calls to get it shipped * Use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) every day, and help shape how the team uses them well, including knowing where not to trust them * Build LLM\-backed features with evaluation, testing, and monitoring in place so quality is measured, not guessed at * Own infrastructure and deployments on AWS, including CI/CD with GitHub Actions, infrastructure as code with Terraform, and containerized services with Docker * Keep the bar high on system design, code review, testing, and observability as we move faster **Experience and Skills** ------------------------- * 4\+ years building and shipping production software, ideally including time at an early\-stage or fast\-moving company * Strong fundamentals in system design, data modeling, APIs, and testing * Fluent in TypeScript and Node.js; React experience is a plus * AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) are a real part of how you work today, and you have opinions on how to use them without giving up quality * Experience building with LLMs: prompt design, RAG, structured outputs, and evals * Experience with AWS preferred, along with GitHub Actions, Terraform, and Docker **Why You’d Be a Good Fit** --------------------------- * **You want ownership.** You’d rather figure out what should be built than wait for a fully specced ticket, and you’re comfortable making and defending product decisions. * **You think critically.** You use AI to multiply your output, and you review its work the way you’d review a teammate’s. You know when something is good enough to ship and when it isn’t. * **You care how things are built.** Speed matters, but so do clean interfaces, tests, and systems that the next engineer can understand. * **You enjoy having direct access to end users.** Our core users (appraisers and Ops teams) are all in\-house, so you’d be iterating with a tight feedback loop. Many of them work 3x/week from our office in Cooper Square. * **You value a remote\-first eng culture.** Our engineers prioritize async communication and make space for deep focus time to help us ship faster. **Why You Might Not Be a Good Fit** ----------------------------------- * **You want well\-defined tickets and a narrow scope.** This role means wearing many hats and working through ambiguity with the business. * **You’d rather not use AI tools in your work.** They’re central to how our team operates and how we expect to scale. * **You’d ship code you don’t understand.** AI\-generated code still needs to meet our engineering standards, and you own what you merge. **Bowery’s Tech Stack** ----------------------- * **Languages:** TypeScript, JavaScript * **Frontend:** React * **Backend:** Node.js (NestJS framework) * **Database:** MongoDB, Postgres * **Infrastructure:** AWS, Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions **Bowery Leadership** --------------------- * John Meadows, Chief Executive Officer; LinkedIn * Madeline Pinkner, Head of Technology; LinkedIn * Eliot Jenkins, President and Chief Operating Officer; LinkedIn * Steve Schaller, Chief Revenue Officer; LinkedIn **The pay range for this role is:** 180,000 \- 200,000 USD per year(New York)

jobs.description: **Please Note:** **1\. If you are a first time user, please create your candidate login account before you apply for a job.** **2\. The Application Networking and Security (ANS) division develops advanced security solutions—including distributed firewall and micro\-segmentation technologies—that protect east\-west traffic across enterprise data centers. Today's enterprise networks face an expanding attack surface and an ever\-changing threat landscape. Our team is on a mission to meet this challenge by delivering powerful, cutting\-edge capabilities for **VMware vDefend Advanced Threat Prevention (ATP)** and the **VMware vDefend Firewall**. Hosted on the **Security Services Platform (SSP)**, **Security Intelligence** is a state\-of\-the\-art analytics platform that provides deep network security visibility within virtualized data centers. It streamlines software\-defined Layer 3\-7 firewall network segmentation by offering graphical visualization of workloads and traffic flows, alongside automated security policy recommendations that enable micro\-segmentation at massive scale. Our team is looking for engineers who share our passion for innovation in distributed systems, container networking, and big data. Database (CMDB) metadata, automating the definition of hierarchies, bulk tag assignments, group creation, and policy bootstrapping—reducing segmentation planning from months to minutes. * **Continuous Segmentation Monitoring \& Drift Detection** — Developing tools that continuously monitor network traffic to surface new or unapproved flows, track traffic leakage (for infrastructure workloads and between environments), and alert administrators to unauthorized activity, ensuring continuous compliance. * **Runtime Threat Detection \& High\-Throughput Streaming** — Building detection capabilities that identify anomalous behavior and policy violations using high\-throughput data processing systems. * **Distributed \& Stateful Workloads** — Configuring and managing workloads that require consensus, replication, and fault tolerance—including analytical databases and message buses running on Kubernetes via Operators or StatefulSets. **How You'll Work** * **Own components end\-to\-end** cluster\-level stateful workloads using Prometheus, Grafana, kubectl debug, and audit logs. * **Build automated tests** — Validating security correctness and OpenAPI compliance to prevent regressions in a highly scalable micro\-service environment. * **Collaborate across teams** — Working closely with platform, UI, and QA engineers, while sharing knowledge and mentoring junior engineers. * **Ship in agile sprints** — Participating in all phases of the software development cycle, utilizing Jira, Confluence, and Git\-based workflows. **What Makes You a Strong Fit** * **Kubernetes Internals** — Hands\-on experience with Kubernetes architecture and cluster management. * **Strong Programming Skills** — Deep expertise in Go, Java (big data, stream processing, Spring/SpringBoot), and Python. * **Distributed Systems \& Stateful Workloads** — Experience managing consensus, replication, fault tolerance, and running databases (e.g., PostgreSQL\-HA, Redis) on Kubernetes. * **High\-Volume Data Systems** — Experience with analytical databases (e.g., Apache Druid, ClickHouse), large\-scale data ingestion (Kafka), and complex querying workloads. * **Modern Build Tooling** — Experience working in large repos using advanced build systems like Bazel, alongside Docker/Helm deployments. * **Collaborative Mindset** — Ability to work independently on complex problems while collaborating across a global team with a "Team First" mentality. * *Experience with VMware vDefend is a strong plus.* **Education \& Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Computer Science and 8\+ years of related experience, or Master's degree in Engineering/Computer Science and 6\+ years of related experience. **Compensation and Benefits** The annual base salary range for this position is USD 121,900\.00 To USD 195,000\.00 As a valued member of our team, you'll be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and the opportunity to receive not only a competitive new hire equity grant, but also annual equity awards, connecting your success directly to the company's growth. All subject to relevant plan documents and award agreements. Broadcom offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits package: Medical, dental and vision plans, 401(K) participation including company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company paid holidays, paid sick leave and vacation time. The company follows all applicable laws for Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence. **Broadcom is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Crusoe Managed Data Transfer
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role:** Crusoe's Managed Platform Services (MAPS) organization builds the managed services that make Crusoe Cloud easy to adopt and hard to leave, including Crusoe Container Registry, Cloud Monitoring and Managed Logs. Managed Data Transfer (MDT) is its newest service. MDT moves petabyte\-scale training data from AWS S3, and later other clouds, into Crusoe storage with a single API call: the service shards the work across a fleet of transfer workers, verifies every object, and asks the customer to run nothing. For AI labs and Physical AI companies whose data lives with a hyperscaler, it removes one of the biggest obstacles to training on Crusoe GPUs. We are hiring Senior Software Engineers to build the MDT control plane: the job API, scheduler and job state that turn a customer request into a coordinated, resumable transfer. You will join a new team at the beginning, take the service from first commit to its preview launch with design\-partner customers, and shape the API that new clouds and Crusoe\-internal transfers will plug into later. You will work closely with the Storage, Network, IAM and Cloud Console teams, and report to the Engineering Manager of Managed Data Transfer. **What You'll Be Working On:** * **Job API and Lifecycle:** Design and build the data\-transfer API (create, list, get, cancel) with a provider\-neutral model for sources and destinations, so new clouds and storage types can be added without breaking customers. * **Scheduling and Job State:** Build the scheduler and state machine that split a bucket listing into units of work, place them on regional worker pools, and track progress, retries and resume across failures. * **Correctness at Scale:** Make petabyte\-scale jobs safe to retry and cancel, with end\-to\-end checksum verification and clear errors when a customer's permissions or destination are wrong. * **Cross\-Cloud Identity:** Implement secure access to customer buckets with short\-lived, least\-privilege credentials (AWS role assumption first, other clouds next), integrated with Crusoe IAM and audit logging. * **Customer Surfaces:** Ship the CLI and, with partner teams, the Terraform and Console experiences for creating and monitoring transfers. * **Operational Excellence:** Instrument the service with metrics, logs and alerts, write the runbooks, and take part in the team's on\-call rotation. * **Cross\-Team Collaboration:** Agree the interfaces MDT depends on with Storage, Network, IAM and Console, and work with Product and Solutions Architects on early customer onboarding. **What You'll Bring to the Team:** * **Backend Engineering Craft:** Experience designing and shipping production backend services and APIs, ideally in Go, with gRPC or REST, relational databases and Kubernetes. * **Professional Experience:** 5\+ years building cloud infrastructure or platform services, including taking a service from zero to general availability. * **Distributed Systems Judgment:** Comfort with long\-running, failure\-prone work: idempotency, retries with backoff, leases, checkpointing and partial failure. * **API Design:** Ability to design public APIs that customers automate against and that can grow without breaking changes. * **Security Mindset:** Working knowledge of authentication, authorization and least privilege, and care in handling customer credentials. * **Operational Ownership:** You have run services in production, been on call, and built the dashboards and alerts that keep incidents short. * **Collaboration and Writing:** You work well across teams with different priorities, and your design docs settle decisions. * **Educational Foundation:** A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. **Bonus Points** * Experience with large\-scale data movement, such as S3 multipart uploads, rclone, s5cmd, AWS DataSync or Google Storage Transfer Service. * Hands\-on experience with cross\-cloud identity: AWS IAM and STS, GCP service\-account impersonation, or Azure workload identity. * Experience with storage systems (object storage, NFS, parallel file systems) or high\-throughput networking. * Experience with job orchestration systems such as Temporal, Argo, or Kubernetes operators. * Experience building on GPU or AI infrastructure. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $170,000 \- $205,000 \+ Bonus. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Create an environment where it's safe to fail and set the team's reputation for being collaborative, responsive, and excellent. **What You’ll Bring to the Team:** * **Distributed Systems Depth:** Hands\-on expertise designing and operating distributed systems at scale — sharding, replication, consensus, load balancing, concurrency. You've resolved the hard problems, not just read about them. * **Range:** Comfort operating anywhere in the stack — from on\-prem infrastructure bring\-up to customer\-facing product features — and switching contexts as priorities shift. * **Prototyping Speed:** Proven ability to rapidly build high\-fidelity prototypes across a range of technologies, exploring multiple approaches in parallel and knowing when good enough is the right call. * **AI\-Augmented Development:** You use AI tools to accelerate development, research, and decision\-making — and you push their limits, building AI\-powered tooling for others rather than just consuming it. * **Performance \& Operational Excellence:** You benchmark, profile, and fix. Customer\-facing on\-call experience required — you eliminate the conditions that cause incidents rather than just responding to them. * **Product Instincts:** Ability to engage in ambiguous product spaces, ask the right questions, and translate fuzzy requirements into scoped, buildable increments tied to business outcomes. * **Cross\-Functional Influence:** Proven ability to drive technical outcomes across org boundaries without formal authority — earning trust through technical credibility, clear thinking, and consistent delivery. * **Communication:** Exemplary. Right level of context, concise, checks for understanding, keeps stakeholders informed without being asked. * **Professional Experience:** 10\+ years of software development experience with significant time at staff level or above. Proficiency in Go or a modern compiled language (Go strongly preferred) and cloud\-native infrastructure. **Benefits:** * Competitive compensation and equity packages * Restricted Stock Units * Paid time off, paid holidays \& leave of absence programs * Comprehensive health, dental \& vision insurance * Employer contributions to HSA account * Paid parental leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Professional development \& tuition reimbursement * Mental health \& wellness support * Commuter benefits (parking \& transit) * Cell phone stipend * 401(k) Retirement plan with company match up to 4% of salary * Volunteer time off * Global travel insurance \& emergency assistance * Daily meals allowance * Additional perks \& programs specific to location **Compensation Range** Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $250,000 \-$300,000 \+ Bonus. jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description: Caregility (caregility.com) is a telehealth solution provider connecting care everywhere. We are a Virtual Care Platform that brings bedside care, virtual encounters, and AI capabilities together at the point of care. Doctors, nurses, and patients around the world rely on our intelligent telehealth edge devices and virtual nursing, observation, and engagement applications to enhance clinical insights, patient safety, and efficiency. Trusted by over 75 health systems, deployed in more than 1,000 hospitals, and supporting over 30,000 connected devices, Caregility is helping to transform healthcare delivery across inpatient and outpatient settings. As a Backend Software Engineer, you will be responsible for developing and enhancing Caregility's cloud\-based services, focusing system performance, and backend infrastructure. You are expected to be hands\-on engineer, drive software development, and build scalable, reliable backend solutions. You will collaborate closely with Product Management, cross\-functional teams, and stakeholders to deliver high\-quality, impactful software solutions. Caregility is seeking a Full\-Time Backend Software Engineer. This is a remote position. Travel to our headquarters in Wall Township, NJ and other locations may be required but are not frequent. This role reports to the Manager, Cloud Platform Engineering. **Roles \& Responsibilities** * Strong experience writing high quality code * Continuously optimize queries, reports, and dashboards for performance and scalability, ensuring a seamless user experience for large datasets. * Continuously optimize backend services for performance, scalability, and reliability, handling large datasets efficiently. * Design, develop, and maintain robust data pipelines using Java and Spring Boot to transform and migrate data from source systems * Apply data analytics best practices to contribute to the design and development of data models and reporting solutions that enhance business intelligence. * Troubleshoot backend issues, ensure timely resolution, and provide recommendations for long\-term solutions. * Contribute to building a strong engineering culture, with focus on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement. * This description isn’t an exhaustive list of duties. **Skills \& Abilities** Leadership and Management:* Develop scalable, reliable, and maintainable services. * Focus on usage metrics and maintain a strong customer\-centric mindset. * Build strong relationships with internal teams, external partners, vendors, and customers. * Troubleshoot issues, make recommendations, and ensure timely problem resolution. **Education \& Qualifications** * Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience. * Required 5\+ years of experience. We are looking for a very strong developer. * Experience writing Java, Spring Boot, and a strong understanding of RESTful API development * Demonstrated experience in writing optimized queries and stored procedures. * Knowledge of data warehousing and data modeling concepts. * A passion for software engineering tooling, infrastructure optimization, and scalable system design * Experience leading agile delivery teams and implementing continuous improvements **Additional Requirements** * Must be willing to complete background checks , monthly exclusion screening, and drug tests as required by current or future contracts. * Must be authorized to work in the US without sponsorship. Must reside in the US. If you share our passion to make healthcare more connected, more efficient, and more personal, join us and you’ll be rewarded with an excellent salary and benefits package, including 401k and Section 125 plans. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Ag & Trading
jobs.description: Cargill is committed to providing food and agricultural solutions to nourish the world in a safe, responsible, and sustainable way. Sitting at the heart of the supply chain, we partner with farmers and customers to source, make and deliver products that are vital for living. Our 155,000 team members innovate with purpose, providing customers with life’s essentials so businesses can grow, communities prosper, and consumers live well. With over 160 years of experience as a family company, we look ahead while remaining true to our values. We put people first. We reach higher. We do the right thing—today and for generations to come. **Job Purpose and Impact** -------------------------- The Senior Software Engineer designs, develops and maintains software applications and systems. With minimal supervision, this job collaborates with cross functional teams to define, design and implement new software features to meet user needs and business goals, and upgrade existing software to improve performance and functionality through writing clean, efficient and scalable code and troubleshooting and debugging complex issues. This job also participates in code reviews to maintain high code quality and share knowledge with software engineering team members. **Key Accountabilities** ------------------------ * SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT: Designs and develops high quality software solutions by writing clean, maintainable and efficient codes. * AUTOMATION: Leads the application of internal software deployment platform, methodologies and tools to automate the deployment process, ensuring smooth and reliable releases. * COLLABORATION: Partners with cross functional team of product managers, designers and different engineers to gather complex requirements and deliver solutions that meet business needs. * TESTING \& DEBUGGING: Writes and maintains complex unit tests and integration tests, and performs debugging to maintain the quality and performance of the software. * CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT: Suggests options for improving the software development and deployment processes, and implements the approved standards to improve efficiency and reliability. * DOCUMENTATION: Builds and maintains comprehensive documentation for complex software applications, deployment processes and system configurations. * TECHNICAL SUPPORT: Provides technical support and troubleshooting for complex issues with deployed applications to ensure minimal downtime and fast resolution. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Minimum requirement of 4 years of relevant work experience. Typically reflects 5 years or more of relevant experience. * 4\+ years of experience building modern web applications with React and TypeScript * 4\+ years of experience building scalable back\-end services using Spring Boot and/or Python. Preferred Qualifications * Experience developing modern web applications using React and TypeScript. * Ability to translate UX designs into intuitive user experiences and reusable components. * Experience integrating APIs and supporting real\-time or event\-driven application updates. * Knowledge of building scalable solutions with a focus on testing, performance, and accessibility. * Experience developing backend services and APIs using Spring Boot and/or Python. * Proven ability to transition proof\-of\-concepts into production\-ready applications. * Familiarity with asynchronous and event\-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka, pub/sub). * Understanding of security, resiliency, logging, monitoring, and observability best practices. jobs.title: IAM & Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **At Caris, we understand that cancer is an ugly word—a word no one wants to hear, but one that connects us all. That’s why we’re not just transforming cancer care—we’re changing lives.** We introduced precision medicine to the world and built an industry around the idea that every patient deserves answers as unique as their DNA. Backed by cutting\-edge molecular science and AI, we ask ourselves every day: *“What would I do if this patient were my mom?”* That question drives everything we do. But our mission doesn’t stop with cancer. We're pushing the frontiers of medicine and leading a revolution in healthcare—driven by innovation, compassion, and purpose. **Join us in our mission to improve the human condition across multiple diseases. If you're passionate about meaningful work and want to be part of something bigger than yourself, Caris is where your impact begins.** **Position Summary** The IAM \& Automation Engineer is an ITSM automation developer, primarily on ServiceNow, responsible for designing, building, and continuously improving complex workflow automation for the business, with a strong focus on identity and access processes. This role modernizes the ITSM experience by building dynamic service catalog items, intuitive self\-service portals, and end\-to\-end automated workflows that replace manual, email\-based, and form\-driven processes. The engineer integrates ServiceNow with enterprise systems, such as HR, identity, and business applications, using APIs and integration tools. The engineer brings a solid understanding of IAM concepts, such as identity lifecycle, access approvals, least privilege, and segregation of duties, to ensure every automation is secure, auditable, and compliant. A strong background in software development, ITSM platform development, and integration patterns is essential. **Job Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain service catalog items, record producers, and dynamic forms with conditional logic, validation rules, and reusable variable sets (primarily in ServiceNow). * Build complex, multi\-step ITSM workflows with approvals, tasks, notifications, and SLAs using Flow Designer, subflows, and custom actions. * Modernize and redesign outdated catalog items, forms, and self\-service portal experiences (e.g., Service Portal, Employee Center) to improve usability and adoption. * Replace manual, email\-based, and form\-driven processes with fully automated end\-to\-end workflows that reduce turnaround time and improve traceability. * Develop server\- and client\-side scripts and components, including Business Rules, Script Includes, Client Scripts, UI Policies, and scheduled jobs. * Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise systems (e.g., HRIS, identity platforms, and business applications) using REST APIs, IntegrationHub, and other integration patterns. * Automate access\-related request, approval, fulfillment, and audit workflows, applying IAM principles such as least privilege and segregation of duties. * Create reusable components, templates, and standards so new forms and workflows can be delivered quickly and consistently. * Partner with business units to gather requirements, map current processes, and design automated solutions that improve efficiency and user experience. * Act as technical owner of workflow automation design standards and integration patterns for the team. * Identify and deliver automation opportunities across IT and Information Security processes (e.g., access reviews, offboarding, security intake, and exception requests). * Build reports and dashboards to measure workflow performance, SLA compliance, and automation impact. * Apply structured development practices, including Update Sets or source control, automated testing (e.g., ATF), peer code reviews, and the organization's standard change management process. * Design workflows that capture audit\-ready evidence (approvals, timestamps, and history) to support compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR). * Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across workflows, scripts, and integrations. * Support platform upgrades and releases by testing and remediating custom automations. * Provide operational support for the automations this role delivers, rather than day\-to\-day request fulfillment. * Assist with proofs of concept (POCs) for new platform capabilities, automation tools, and integration approaches. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, design specifications, and SOPs. * Participate in an on\-call rotation to support critical workflow and integration issues. **Required Qualifications** * High School degree or equivalent. * 5\+ years of experience in ServiceNow or other ITSM platform development, software development, or workflow automation. * Hands\-on experience with ITSM platform development (ServiceNow strongly preferred), including: * + Service catalog, record producers, and dynamic forms + Complex, multi\-step workflows with approva  PowerShell. * Solid understanding of IAM concepts, including identity lifecycle, access requests and approvals, least privilege, role\-based access, and segregation of duties. * Familiarity with identity integration standards (e.g., SCIM, OAuth) and platforms such as Okta or Microsoft Entra ID. * Experience with structured development and release practices (e.g., Update Sets, source control, automated testing, and change management). * Understanding of security and compliance requirements (e.g., SOX, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR) and how they apply to workflow design. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex systems and integrations. * Proven ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment, manage multiple priorities, and deliver high\-quality work with strong attention to detail. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to gather requirements from and explain technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders. * Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically Word, Excel, Outlook, and general working knowledge of Internet for business use. **Preferred Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field. * 2\+ years of experience supporting or automating IAM processes, such as joiner\-mover\-leaver provisioning, access requests, and access certifications. * Knowledge of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) and Privileged Access Management (PAM). * Working knowledge of the NIST Cybersecurity Framework and its application in IAM. * ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) and/or Certified Application Developer (CAD). * ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (e.g., ITSM) or ITIL Certification. * Identity certification such as Okta Certified Professional/Administrator or Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator (SC\-300\). * Experience designing scalable, reusable ServiceNow solutions for large organizations. * Familiarity with: * + UI Builder or Workspaces * + Automated Test Framework (ATF) or CI/CD practices for ServiceNow * + Other low\-code automation tools (e.g., Okta Workflows, Power Automate) * Experience automating access workflows between ServiceNow and identity platforms (e.g., Okta, Microsoft Entra ID), including SCIM\-based provisioning. * Experience integrating HRIS systems (e.g., Workday, SuccessFactors) with ITSM workflows. * Familiarity with IGA platforms (e.g., SailPoint, Saviynt) and processes such as access reviews, certifications, and role modeling. * Exposure to privileged access management (PAM) tools (e.g., CyberArk, BeyondTrust). * Experience in Healthcare, Life Sciences, or regulated industries. **Physical Demands** * Must possess the ability to sit, stand, and/or work at a computer for long periods of time. * Ability to work extended hours during implementations and on\-call rotations. **Training** * All job specific, safety, and compliance training are assigned based on the job functions associated with this employee. **Other** * Periodically scheduled on\-call may require after\-hours response for technical emergencies not explicitly related to assigned job responsibilities. * Other duties as assigned. **Conditions of Employment:** Individual must successfully complete pre\-employment process, which includes criminal background check, drug screening, credit check ( applicable for certain positions) and reference verification. This job description reflects management’s assignment of essential functions. Nothing in this job description restricts management’s right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. Caris Life Sciences is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability.

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.description: **Welcome to Cascades!** As the **Process Engineer** at Greenpac, you’ll work alongside experienced manufacturing professionals in a highly automated environment where technology, data and continuous improvement drive operational success. Our Niagara Falls facility produces lightweight linerboard using 100% recycled fiber on a world\-class 328\-inch\-wide Valmet paper machine capable of producing more than 540,000 tons annually. Bring your expertise to a people\-first, dynamic environment where your ideas come to life and excellence shapes everything we do. Join AARON CUSHMAN's team as a **Process Engineer** in **Niagara Falls** and help build a more sustainable future. **What’s in it for you** Taking care of our people is in our nature \- so you’ll enjoy:* Annual base salary between **$94,000 \- $130,000** * *In addition, the following benefits are available subject to plan provisions and eligibility requirements:* * + Profit Sharing Bonus + Employee Share Purchase Plan + 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan With Company Match + Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision Coverage + 24/7 Access to Virtual Medical \& Counseling Services + Annual Lifestyle Spending Account (taxable benefit) + Wellness and Employee Assistance Programs + Life and Disability Insurance + Minimum of 3\-weeks Paid Vacation upon hire and 11 Company\-paid Holidays + Paid Sick Leave in accordance with applicable laws + Ongoing Learning and Professional Development Opportunities **Your Role** As **Process Engineer**, you’ll take on real challenges that bring out your full potential. Your scope includes:* Optimize manufacturing processes, product quality, and asset performance within the paper mill * Provide technical leadership for process control, centerline management, product development, trials, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Develop, implement, maintain, and continuously improve Standard Operating Procedures that support equipment and process centerlines to ensure stable operating conditions and optimal performance. * Identify production losses and implement corrective actions to improve efficiency, quality, and reliability. * Lead root cause investigations for process deviations, quality concerns, and operational issues. * Evaluate process constraints and recommend improvements that increase throughput and reduce waste. * Train and coach operators on centerline adherence, process controls, troubleshooting, and trial execution **What you bring** You're a natural fit for **Process Engineer** if you have:* Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Paper Science, Industrial Engineering, or related technical discipline. * Minimum 4 years of manufacturing, process engineering, operational excellence, or continuous improvement experience. * Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or Operational Excellence methodologies * Experience in paper, packaging, corrugated, pulp, tissue, converting, chemical processing, or other continuous manufacturing environments. * Strong data analysis, problem\-solving, and root cause investigation skills. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and manufacturing data analysis tools. If you bring the same care to who you are as to what you do, we’d love to meet you! Apply now and join our team as **Process Engineer** in **Niagara Falls.** *Cascades values diversity and inclusion and considers all applications equitably.* This posting is for an active vacancy within our organization. Artificial intelligence may be used at certain stages of our recruitment process to enhance efficiency and the candidate experience.

jobs.title: Staff Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** ‎ At Castlight, we are looking for a Staff Data Engineer who lives and breathes healthcare data end\-to\-end, understands how to make BigQuery purr across ML and Looker, and champions data as the fundamental lifeblood of our product. Operating on Google Cloud Platform, you will build unified models from multi\-source data while informing leadership of emerging trends and breathing the "art of the possible" into our products and processes. If you are a high\-agency builder who can elevate data from "something we look at" to the core engine driving consumer experiences for millions, we want to talk to you. ‎ **How will you make an impact \& Requirements** ‎ **Who You Are:** * **A Healthcare Data Native:** You breathe healthcare data end\-to\-end. You understand the nuances, complexities, and operational realities of acquiring, ingesting, and transforming fragmented multi\-source data—from raw claims and clinical feeds to benefit designs and user telemetry. * **A Value\-Obsessed BigQuery Virtuoso:** To you, BigQuery isn't just a passive storage warehouse—it’s your ML engine, your clean room, and your business catalyst. You know data is only as valuable as its downstream impact, and you know how to make BigQuery purr to directly power ML models, advanced analytics, Looker dashboards, and real\-time consumer experiences. You bridge the gap between raw bytes and real utility. * **A Cultural Evangelist \& Advocate:** You advocate fiercely for the organization to see data not as a static byproduct or "a thing we look at," but as the foundational lifeblood of our product. * **A Multi\-Source Data Architect:** You excel at taking disparate, messy inputs from dozens of health plans and employers and unifying them into clean, highly structured, production\-grade data models that drive actual decisions and actions. * **An End\-to\-End Pipeline Operator:** You design, orchestrate, and maintain bulletproof data pipelines using Python, Apache Airflow, and GCP native tools. You take total ownership of data quality, latency, and uptime from raw ingestion to active consumption. * **High\-Agency \& Execution\-Driven:** You maintain a ship\-first, high\-impact mindset. You eliminate operational drag, build resilient pipelines, and serve as the technical authority who ensures data isn't just sitting in a database, but actively moving the business forward. **Who We Are:** At Castlight, we’re making it as simple as humanly possible for people to navigate the complicated, often frustrating, world of healthcare. We partner with America’s largest employers and health plans, transforming employee benefits into a deeply personalized and guided journey for millions of users. What we build genuinely helps people live happier and healthier lives. **What You'll Do:** Reporting into Engineering Leadership, you will serve as a premier Staff Individual Contributor driving the architecture, scale, and actionable value of Castlight's core data ecosystem on Google Cloud Platform. You will take ownership of multi\-source healthcare data processing, building the foundational engine that powers personalized care navigation, predictive analytics, and enterprise intelligence for millions of users. In this role, you will: * **Inform Strategy \& Trends:** Continuously analyze and inform engineering and executive leadership of emerging data trends, operational patterns, and architectural opportunities across our entire data surface. * **Inspire Innovation:** Breathe the "art of the possible" directly into our products, engineering processes, and user journeys by uncovering new ways to leverage modern data tools and AI/ML capabilities. * **Champion Data as Lifeblood:** Advocate relentlessly across the entire organization so that data is treated not as a report we look at, but as the core, real\-time lifeblood that fuels our consumer product experience. * **Architect \& Scale Data Engines:** Design, build, and optimize end\-to\-end data pipelines using BigQuery, Python, and Airflow on GCP to process high\-volume healthcare data streams. * **Unify Multi\-Source Data:** Transform complex, heterogeneous healthcare data feeds (claims, eligibility, clinical, engagement) into normalized, highly performant data models designed for immediate operational use. * **Bridge the Value Gap:** Unlock BigQuery as an all\-in\-one execution engine—connecting backend data architectures seamlessly to downstream consumers like Looker, machine learning models, and consumer\-facing application APIs. * **Partner with Product \& AI/ML Teams:** Collaborate directly with engineering, analytics, and product leaders to ensure clean, low\-latency data actively fuels predictive models, reporting suites, and intelligent user touchpoints. **Skills \& Qualifications:** * **Technical Experience:** 8\+ years of data engineering experience with a focus on building distributed data platforms and pipelines at enterprise scale. * **Domain Expertise:** Deep hands\-on experience working with complex, multi\-source healthcare data domains (claims, clinical, eligibility, benefit structures, or HL7/FHIR formats). * **GCP \& BigQuery Value\-Centric Mastery:** Advanced expertise in Google Cloud Platform, specifically using BigQuery as a high\-performance engine to power ML workflows, analytics, and BI tools like Looker. * **Pipeline Orchestration:** Expert\-level capability in Python and Apache Airflow (Cloud Composer) for orchestrating complex batch and event\-driven data workflows. * **Data Modeling for Utility:** Proven track record of designing scalable schemas, entity\-resolution pipelines, and semantic layers that bridge raw database tables to active consumption. * **Communication \& Evangelism:** Exceptional ability to translate complex data architectures into clear business strategy, inform leadership of key trends, and advocate for data\-driven product transformation across technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **What You'll Get:** * **Competitive Compensation:** A highly competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package. * **Technical Autonomy \& Vision:** Full ownership over the architecture and direction of core healthcare data engines on GCP, with the mandate to shape how our product uses data. * **High\-Visibility Scale:** Direct impact on data systems that process massive healthcare workloads for millions of active users. * **Work That Matters:** Build data systems where every pipeline directly enables personalized, actionable health insights for real people. ‎ **Compensation Range:** $144,368\.00 to $216,552\.00 *The anticipated base salary range represents the Company's good\-faith estimate of the compensation it reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, internal equity, and business needs.*

jobs.title: 2027 MineStar Training Development Program
jobs.description: **Career Area:** Sales**Job Description:** **Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.** When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it. **Kickstart Your Career with Caterpillar!** At Caterpillar, we do more than build machines. We help build the infrastructure that powers the world. When you join Caterpillar, you become part of a global team working together to create stronger, more sustainable communities through innovation, collaboration, and customer\-focused solutions. If you're ready to learn, grow, and make an impact early in your career, this is where your journey begins. ### **About the Program** Caterpillar’s MineStar Solutions, within Mining Solutions, is seeking candidates for the **2027 MineStar Training Development Program**. This two\-year development program provides hands\-on learning and exposure across four key MineStar areas: **Training, Service Center, Service Engineering, and Implementation**. Along the way, you'll build technical expertise, strengthen your customer support skills, and develop a deeper understanding of MineStar products, services, and solutions. jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Chorus Innovations is a fast\-growing healthcare technology company with an adaptive platform as a service (PaaS) that enables the rapid development of mobile, desktop, text messaging and interactive voice applications. Chorus' platform currently powers transformative healthcare, biomedical research and community health projects across institutions and public health agencies nationwide. We believe every community should have world\-class health technology so they can thrive. Our mission is to improve the lives of people and communities by democratizing technology development in health and research. **About the Role** Chorus builds an AI\-first healthcare SaaS platform for behavioral health specialists and beyond. We are hiring Staff Platform Engineers who treat that opportunity seriously: apply modern LLM and agent\-harness techniques without trading away systems correctness. You are a hands\-on technical backbone for the platform. You design durable, multi\-tenant systems. You ship them across the stack. You encode how they work — RFCs, engineering docs, Skills, Runbooks, and agent context — so hungry engineers (and midtier coding agents) can move fast without creating vibe\-coded slop. This is documentation\-first, not code\-first. Syntax is cheap. Understanding the problem, designing the contract, and leaving a system that others can learn and extend is the job. You get high leverage from midtier models (for example Cursor Auto, Haiku/Sonnet\-class, Composer\-class) through strong harnesses — not by blasting maximal models for high\-speed volume. Your impact shows up as velocity with correctness: reusable platform building blocks (modules, SDKs, UI kits, Skills/Runbooks) that make the next engineer (and the next agent session) 10x — not heroics that only you can repeat. This role carries a high mentorship burden. You are a primary technical guide for Senior Platform Engineers and for Implementation Engineer (IE) teams across the product line squads. You still ship hard yourself — and you spend real time raising others' ceiling through pairing, review, design coaching, and durable docs. **What You'll Be Doing** * **Own platform systems end\-to\-end:** Design, build, and maintain shared platform capabilities that product teams and tenants depend on — data models and migrations, NestJS/GraphQL BFFs, ui\-kits and control\-plane (ACP) surfaces, tests, and rollout safety. You work full\-stack when the system requires it. * **Carry high mentorship load for Seniors and IEs** Guide Senior Platform Engineers on systems design, documentation\-first delivery, and AI harness craft. Guide Implementation Engineer teams on how to reuse shared modules, SDKs, and UI kits safely: permissions, lifecycle, tenant vs platform lanes, and when to escalate to an RFC. Expect substantial time in pairing, design review, and PR review — mentorship is part of the job, not an afterthought. * **Design before you code** Define the problem and the correctness properties first (permissions, lifecycle, view\-state, layouts, auth boundaries). Write RFCs and contracts that other engineers can implement against. Prefer durable abstractions over one\-off feature patches. * **Encode knowledge at discovery** Leave systems easy to learn. Capture decisions in engineering docs, Skills, Runbooks, and agent\_context so humans and agents enforce the same rules. Prefer machine\-readable enabling constraints over tribal knowledge. * **Practice AI harness craft** Use AI\-assisted development as a force multiplier with judgment. Use and improve Skills/Runbooks; contribute new harness artifacts when work recurs. Prompt and review with security, performance, and domain correctness in mind. Teach Seniors and IEs the same discipline. Reject high\-speed slop — volume without understanding is not velocity. * **Force\-multiply the organization** Ship reusable platform building blocks — shared modules, SDKs, UI kits, generators, and Skills/Runbooks — so product and IE teams do not reinvent the same capability. Coach through pairing, heavy review, and durable artifacts. Make yourself replaceable in specific domains by teaching patterns, not by gatekeeping them. * **Operational excellence across tenants** Own reliability for what you ship: migrations, authz, observability, staged rollouts, and recovery. Healthcare and multi\-tenant blast radius are first\-class concerns. * **Cross\-functional technical leadership** Translate tradeoffs for product, clinical solutions, QA, and delivery. Align on domain vocabulary (care objects, programs, roles, statuses) so the platform stays coherent as it grows **What We're Looking For** * **Deep systems experience** 9\+ years building and operating complex systems. Proven ownership of cross\-cutting platform work — not only feature tickets in a single app layer. * **Systems design \+ strong writing** You define the problem accurately, write clear design docs, and treat documentation as part of delivery. Yo uires it **Frontend** * React with TypeScript * Material UI and Emotion for component development and styling * Strong understanding of component composition, state management, and performance considerations * Comfort building staff\-facing and admin/control\-plane UIs that encode platform configuration **Platform and Tooling** * Nx monorepo tooling * Docker and Kubernetes for local and deployed environments * AWS infrastructure including managed databases, identity, and networking * CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar * Agent harnesses: Skills, Runbooks, MCP\-backed workflows, and repo agent context **Engineering Practices** * Domain\-driven design concepts and practical application * Documentation\-first delivery (RFC/ADR implementation encode for agents and humans) * Strong SQL fundamentals and database design * Testing at multiple levels, including unit and integration / DB\-backed tests * Experience designing systems meant to be extended by other teams and by AI agents under human authority **Nice to Have** * **Computer\-science fundamentals** Deep computer\-science fundamentals (systems, data structures, concurrency, networking) — whether from a CS or related degree or equivalent self\-directed study. Formal CS education is a plus; self\-trained candidates who already know how computers work are welcome. **Why Join Us?** * Work on important, meaningful problems in healthcare * Shape the foundation of a platform that will power dozens (eventually hundreds) of applications * Collaborate with a team that values design, pragmatism, and velocity * Competitive compensation, equity, and full benefits **Compensation Disclosure** The anticipated base salary range for this position is $185,000 \- $200,000 in the Los Angeles market. Actual offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and may include additional components such as performance bonuses, stock options, and benefits. We welcome applicants of every background and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. If you need assistance, email careers@joinchorus.com Chorus Innovations values diversity as a core principle of the work we do and the communities we serve. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religious creed, citizenship, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, military and veteran status, gender, gender identity, gender expression, or any other protected characteristic. **Disability Accommodation for Applicants to Chorus Innovations** At Chorus Innovations, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace environment for all individuals, including job applicants with disabilities. We recognize the value that individuals with diverse abilities bring to our organization and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for all applicants. jobs.title: AI Lead Engineer
jobs.description: Citian is a fast growing, venture backed SaaS technology company based in Washington, DC. Our software solutions revolutionize how our transportation and infrastructure systems – roads, rail, transit, bicycle, pedestrian – operate. Our tech solutions: * **Reduce traffic fatalities** * **Enhance pedestrian accessibility** * **Empower system operators to save time \& money** You'll work with some of the brightest minds in the software and transportation industries. Our engineers and data scientists apply the latest in emerging tech, Artificial Intelligence, and Machine Learning to build smarter, more advanced tools for our diverse client base. We work with clients across the United States, with global ambitions in the years ahead. **Who You Are:** As an AI Lead Engineer on Citian's Data Success team, you ensure our digital products meet the engineering\-level accuracy required by state and local government clients. Every agency's network has both common and unique features of geometry, structure, labeling, and management practices. You use AI, customized reasoning and logic, and mathematical models to convert these assets into clean, standardized data that powers our CRASH and ADAPT products. You plan and optimize the full lifecycle of digitalizing different assets to meet accuracy requirements. You build and run data cleaning, ingestion, and extraction pipelines; apply LLMs, computer vision, mathematical models, and reasoning where they accelerate the work; and design, improve, and execute evaluation plans that prove the output is correct. You work directly with agency GIS, IT, and engineering staff, and you can explain data issues clearly to both traffic engineers and software engineers. You are resourceful with mathematics and AI technologies, have strong engineering judgment, care about getting the details right, and want your work to have a direct impact on transforming transportation infrastructure. **Expected Duties:** * Own data accuracy for the digitalization of new and existing state and local government clients, from the initial data request through production\-ready data in Citian's products. * Work directly with agency GIS, IT, and engineering staff to understand their management needs and existing data sources, obtain access, and resolve gaps or inconsistencies. * Build, optimize, improve, and maintain pipelines that collect spatial and temporal data (such as 3D\-registered spherical images) and integrate data from other sensors and client systems, including databases, APIs, Esri/ArcGIS services, open data portals, and file transfers. * Own the accuracy of extracting roadway and infrastructure assets from point clouds, imagery, measurements, and other geospatial sources. * Apply AI\-assisted development, mathematical modeling, logical reasoning, and coding to map each agency's infrastructure data onto Citian's standard data model. * Build automated and rigorous QA/QC checks that validate digitalized results against ground truth, and design methods to collect or estimate ground truth. * Evaluate third\-party AI tools, APIs, and mathematical models for extraction work, and weigh build\-versus\-buy tradeoffs with Engineering. * Document data sources, mappings, and processes for each client so onboarding is repeatable and scalable. * Partner with Customer Success, Account Management, and Product to set data timelines, communicate data issues, and feed client needs back into the product roadmap. **Required Skills \& Experience:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, GIS, or a related field. * 3\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, AI/ML engineering, or a related role. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience applying AI, machine learning, and advanced mathematical models to real\-world data, ideally in a product environment. * Proficiency in Python and SQL for building data pipelines and transforming data. * Hands\-on experience using LLMs, mathematical models, and reasoning to digitalize physical environments at high accuracy. * Experience with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, and related data tools. * Experience building engineering\-based and computer\-based data validation and quality checks. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work directly with external clients and explain technical issues to non\-technical audiences. Salary Range: $150,000 \- 250,000 **Your Citian Advantage:** * Competitive salary and benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance and generous PTO. * 401(k) company match and monthly commuter transportation benefit * On\-site gym and free snacks in the office * High\-growth potential and opportunities for advancement within a fast growing, venture\-backed SaaS startup! Let's build smarter cities together! jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (Full Stack & Backend)
jobs.description: Cloaked is a consumer privacy and identity platform on a mission to give people back control of their personal data. We let anyone generate unlimited identities \- masked emails, phone numbers, and payment cards \- scrub their information off data\-broker sites, and shield themselves from spam, scams, and breaches, all from one app. Backed by a $375M Series B, we've protected 10M\+ identities and removed 1B\+ records from the data brokers who profit off personal information. Now we're building the AI\-native future of privacy: autonomous agents that monitor, manage, and defend your digital footprint for you. **About the Role** ------------------ We’re looking for strong **Staff Software Engineers (Full Stack \& Backend)** who want real ownership and range. At Cloaked, our engineers aren’t boxed into a single feature. They go where the hardest problems are, whether that’s building AI agents and voice AI, shipping new features in Cloaked Pay and Call Guard, scaling the systems underneath it all, or launching something new from scratch. We hire builders, and we give them room to run. The team is growing fast, and there’s plenty of space to own your direction and shape both what we build and how we build it, all on a zero\-knowledge, end\-to\-end\-encrypted architecture built to scale. **What will you do?** --------------------- * Own the technical direction for the systems and initiatives you lead, from scoping and architecture through to shipping * Work across the stack and across teams, taking on the highest\-impact problems wherever they sit * Lead zero\-to\-one work, from new consumer features to our expansion into enterprise * Strengthen our foundations: scalability, reliability, performance, and cost efficiency as we grow 10x * Partner closely with product and design to turn ambiguous problems into products customers love * Raise the engineering bar through architecture decisions, code reviews, and mentorship * Build AI\-natively, using and shaping the tools that help us ship faster without compromising on privacy or quality **What we’re looking for** -------------------------- * Significant experience building and shipping production software end to end, ideally at a consumer or growth\-stage company * A track record of technical leadership at the Staff level: setting direction, making sound architecture and system\-design calls, and raising the bar for the engineers around you * Strong backend depth in Python or a similar language, including scalable systems, secure production\-grade APIs, databases, and backend architecture patterns * For full stack candidates: strong frontend fundamentals and experience building high\-quality, responsive user interfaces (we care more about fundamentals than any specific framework). For backend\-focused candidates, frontend experience is a plus * Product sense: you think about the user and the “why,” not just the implementation, and you’re comfortable making scope trade\-offs * AI\-forward: you use AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and others) fluently to ship faster, and you’re excited to build where AI is core to what we make. Experience shipping AI\-powered features is a plus, not a requirement * Familiarity with modern tooling, testing, and CI/CD practices **What do we like?** -------------------- * A get\-it\-done mindset: you’re driven to create new solutions and solve problems in a fast\-paced environment * Comfort working across teams to find the best solution * Passion for security and internet ethics * Interest in data and analytics * Care and respect for our customers’ privacy as if it were your own **What we offer** ----------------- Cloaked is a well\-funded Series B startup based out of NYC. Although we are a distributed team, the NYC team operates with a hybrid model. The office building is home to several amenities, including a gourmet cafe, cocktail bar, and a rooftop work area. We have a fully built out kitchen packed with drinks and snacks. The Cloaked team has diverse interests and so we frequently embark on team outings and go out for socials! **Our Values** -------------- 1\. Do the impossible for everyday people. 2\. Use what we build, build what we would use. 3\. Prioritize value delivery. 4\. Stay curious and get better. 5\. Be candid and kind. 6\. Under one cloak toward one mission. **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- We offer above market rate pay and equity based off of the market’s best commercially available data. Your compensation will be a combination of salary, bonus and equity. Cloaked employees have 401K, as well as top of the line Health, Dental, and Vision benefits. We offer flexible work arrangements and the ability to work remotely as needed. Cloaked provides a home office stipend in addition to a new company laptop (and other tech depending on the role). **Perks** --------- **Competitive PTO:** We encourage employees to take a minimum \# of vacation per quarter. We see PTO as a preventative burnout measure and are committed to changing the industry standard. **Monthly health stipend:** Used for any kind of physical, mental or emotional care you’d like to take for yourself, be it a gym membership, a meditation app, or time with a personal trainer. **Late Night Meals:** We understand that sometimes work can get in the way of meal prep. In response to that, we offer employees a monthly meal stipend to be used when they don’t have time to get a home cooked meal going! **Professional Growth:** Opportunities for career development and personal growth are provided to all employees who seek to further their knowledge and capabilities through an unlimited professional development fund. Additionally team members are encouraged to regularly attend conferences and industry events. We are really excited about having you join our mission\-driven team and help us build the future of online privacy! Compensation Range: $180K \- $300K
