Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations. **What you need to have to be considered** Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering or related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. 8\+ years of software development experience, including 5 or more years of **hands\-on experience with Java, Spring and Spring Boot** and recent experience with Java 17 or Java 21\. At least 3 years of **Angular development** experience, including hands\-on knowledge of Angular 22, signals, standalone components and zoneless applications. Demonstrated experience using **Devin Local** or Cloud, **Claude Code or Cursor** to deliver production\-ready software across the development lifecycle. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (AI Solution Owner)
jobs.description: CompassX is a boutique business and technology consulting firm. We help Fortune 500 and high\-growth clients deliver their most strategic initiatives, from enterprise transformations to digital and data\-driven projects. With over 15 years of proven results, we’ve expanded across industries including financial services, pharmaceuticals, aerospace, consumer products, and quick service restaurants. We are honored to be recognized as a three\-time winner of Consulting Magazine’s Best Boutique Firms to Work For, and previously recognized as a “Best Place to Work” in Southern California and one of INC.’s 5000 fastest\-growing private companies in the U.S. We're looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work inside our clients' businesses and build the AI\-powered applications they need. You'll sit with the people who do the work, understand how the process runs today, and build a working version quickly with AI coding tools. Our teams are small and move fast, so you'll own your application from the first conversation to the last user. Much of our current work is with large, fast\-growing industrial and manufacturing clients whose teams still rely on spreadsheets, email approvals, and disconnected systems. We've been building custom internal tools that replace those, working alongside the platforms the client already uses, such as ERP, CRM, and data and BI systems. The majority of our team are based local to Southern California (LA/OC), and we have some others based across the USA. Occasional travel to client sites is expected. ### **What You'll Do** * You'll work with business users and stakeholders to understand how work really gets done, decide what's worth building, and agree a first release. * You'll build a working prototype yourself using AI coding tools and use it to get early feedback and sign\-off. * You'll take the application to production: connecting it to the client's data and systems, defining the logic and data it needs, testing it, and bringing in our architects and engineers for the parts that need deeper expertise. * You'll make sure people use it, through training, feedback and fixes after launch. * You'll also present progress and results to senior stakeholders, and travel to client sites now and then for workshops and rollouts. ### **What You'll Bring** * Real experience building and shipping applications with AI coding tools (such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or Emergent), and the judgment to review and fix what they produce * Working knowledge of how applications are built and deployed: front\-end frameworks such as React, Python, SQL, APIs, authentication, and testing * Experience taking something from prototype to production in an enterprise environment, including security, integration, and client sign\-off * Strong product instincts: discovery with business users, scoping a first release, and prioritizing * Clear, concise communication with executives and business teams * 8\+ years of experience across consulting, product, solution architecture and/or engineering, ideally with time at a small or mid\-size consulting firm * Bachelor's degree or higher (Computer Science, Engineering, Business) or equivalent demonstrable experience * A plus: experience with ERP, manufacturing, supply chain or enterprise data (for example Oracle) You don't need to train models or do machine learning research. The work is building and deploying applications. $140,000 \- $180,000 a year The posted compensation range reflects the anticipated compensation for this opportunity. Depending on the role, client requirements, and business needs, compensation may be structured as a salaried position with bonus eligibility or as an hourly contract engagement (including 1099 independent contractor arrangements). identify relevant data, and partner with engineering and data engineers to drive delivery. **Work Location**: Scottsdale, AZ – Hybrid **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Responsibilities:** * Embed directly within the client's engineering and business teams to drive hands\-on, end\-to\-end delivery of production\-scale data and ML systems. * Set the technical direction for the customer's data platform, defining data strategies and building the foundational data layer for organization\-wide data orchestration across diverse consumers. * Partner closely with business and product teams to understand the business domain, define use cases, and identify relevant data sources. * Collaborate with engineering and data engineering teams to drive execution and take accountability for system uptime in production. * Design, build, and manage lakehouse architectures using Databricks (Spark, Delta, Unity Catalog), Databricks Genie, and hands\-on ownership of bronze, silver, and gold data layers. * Architect and maintain scalable ingestion and streaming pipelines (Kafka, ETL/ELT at scale, blob storage) with self\-healing and automated alerting capabilities. * Build and optimize operational data stores, including production PostgreSQL, pgVector, embeddings, vector databases, and Redis caching strategies. * Design and tune search and retrieval solutions using Azure AI Search, covering index and schema design, indexers, hybrid retrieval, semantic reranking, and freshness/relevance tuning. * Develop semantic models and BI solutions leveraging Microsoft Fabric and Power BI. * Deliver machine learning models in production, owning the lifecycle from classifier training through serving, evaluation, drift detection, and retraining. * Build document intelligence and multi\-modal RAG pipelines capable of extracting and grounding information across unstructured, scanned, text, table, and image sources. * Establish MLOps and reliability practices, including CI/CD for data and models, observability, monitoring, alerting, and on\-call ownership. * Lead live platform migrations, moving data architectures from one platform to another with zero disruption to active consumers. * Manage Azure cloud infrastructure at depth, driving active cloud and data platform cost optimization. * Build query interfaces for AI agents, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and text\-to\-SQL tooling over governed data. **Requirements** * 12\+ years of hands\-on engineering experience building and maintaining production\-scale systems with direct accountability for uptime. * Proven ability to define data strategies and build foundational data layers from the ground up for organization\-wide orchestration. * Concrete, hands\-on experience across most of the following technical areas: * **Lakehouse \& Processing:** Databricks (Spark, Delta, Unity Catalog), Databricks Genie, and ownership of bronze, silver, and gold layers. * **Ingestion \& Streaming:** Kafka, ETL/ELT at scale, blob storage, and self\-healing, automated ingestion pipelines with alerting. * **Operational Data Stores:** Production PostgreSQL, pgVector, embeddings, vector databases, and Redis caching strategies. * **Search \& Retrieval:** Azure AI Search (index and schema design, indexers, hybrid retrieval, semantic reranking, freshness and relevance tuning). * **Semantics \& BI:** Microsoft Fabric, semantic modeling, and Power BI. * **ML in Production:** End\-to\-end classifiers from training through serving, evaluation, drift detection, and retraining. * **Document Intelligence \& Multi\-Modal RAG:** Extraction from unstructured and scanned sources, grounded over mixed text, table, and image content. * **MLOps \& Reliability:** CI/CD for data and models, observability, monitoring, alerting, and on\-call ownership. * **Platform Migration:** Hands\-on experience migrating data architectures between platforms with live consumers. * **Cloud \& Cost Management:** Deep Azure expertise paired with active cloud and data platform cost management. * **Query Interfaces for Agents:** Building MCP servers and text\-to\-SQL tooling over governed data. * Willingness and ability to work in a hybrid model in **Scottsdale, AZ.** **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, or a related field. * 12\+ years of hands\-on software, data, or machine learning engineering experience in production environments. **Good to Have:** * **Agentic AI \& Orchestration:** Familiarity with agentic AI patterns and orchestration engines such as LangGraph or equivalent frameworks, understanding how downstream agents consume data and ML platforms. * **Advanced RAG Architecture:** Deep understanding of retrieval strategies, grounding, context assembly, and failure modes beyond basic implementations. * **Workflow Architecture:** Ability to determine where deterministic workflows vs. non\-deterministic agentic workflows are appropriate and maintain clean boundaries between them. * **AI System Evaluation:** Experience with offline and online evaluations, golden datasets, regression suites, and evaluating output quality where there is no single right answer. * **Domain Experience:** Previous experience working within the retail or grocery domain. jobs.title: Data Engineer I
jobs.description: Come join our team at DIS\-TRAN Steel! Our people – not our machinery \- are our biggest assets. DIS\-TRAN Steel’s leadership team lives by our company values, modeling our culture of respect and integrity each day. **We're a team that likes to have fun, but we also know how to get stuff done.** DIS\-TRAN Steel is looking for a Data Engineer to build reliable data pipelines, connect business and manufacturing systems, and make data easier to use. Your work will help teams turn information from across the organization into trusted data for reporting, analysis, and better decisions. In this role, you’ll develop and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines, improve data quality, and optimize data workflows. You’ll also help establish the standards, ownership, and documentation that keep our data accurate, accessible, and secure. This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys hands\-on technical work, solving business problems, and collaborating with the people who use the solutions they build. At DIS\-TRAN Steel, we believe the future is built by people who are inspired to grow, empowered to innovate, and committed to make a lasting impact. Together, we’re building stronger careers, stronger communities, and the infrastructure that powers them. ### **EXPECTATIONS:** * Performs quality work within deadlines with or without direct supervision. * Interacts professionally with employees, customers, and business partners. * Works effectively as a team contributor while taking ownership of individual responsibilities. * Communicates progress, challenges, and priorities with their supervisor and other team members. * Looks for opportunities to improve processes, strengthen data reliability, and expand technical knowledge. ### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Develops and maintains scalable ETL/ELT pipelines to collect, transform, and deliver data from structured and unstructured sources. * Connects data across manufacturing and business systems, including manufacturing execution systems (MES), supervisory control and data acquisition systems (SCADA), enterprise resource planning systems (ERP), and customer relationship management systems (CRM). * Collaborates with data architects to understand database models and improve data storage in SQL databases and cloud data warehouses. * Builds and maintains data quality checks to identify errors and ensure data is accurate, complete, and reliable. * Monitors and troubleshoots data pipelines, resolving issues and improving performance and cost efficiency. * Works with stakeholders to understand business needs and deliver data that supports reporting and analytical solutions. * Maintains documentation, naming conventions, version control practices, and change management processes for data pipelines and infrastructure. ### **ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Helps develop and implement data governance standards, including data quality, metadata, master data, privacy, and access controls. * Works with department leaders to define data ownership, common business definitions, and how data moves between systems. * Coordinates with Crest Corporate on shared data governance needs and standards. * Supports the selection and adoption of data catalog, metadata management, and governance tools. * Monitors adherence to data policies and works with business and technical teams to resolve issues. * Facilitates collaboration among business and technical leaders through a data governance council or steering committee. * Creates documentation and training to help employees understand data practices and responsibilities. * Partners with legal, security, and compliance teams to align data practices with applicable requirements. * Performs other duties as assigned. ### **REQUIREMENTS:** * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Information Systems, Data Management, Library and Information Science, Computer Science, Business Administration with a Data/IT focus, or a related field. * Five or more years of experience in data engineering, data integration, software development, data management, data quality, data governance, or a similar role. * Demonstrated experience building data products, using business data to solve problems, or implementing data governance frameworks. * Familiarity with SQL, cloud data warehouses, and enterprise systems such as ERP, MES, or CRM. * Familiarity with data integration and transformation tools such as dbt, Airbyte, Fivetran, Apache NiFi, or custom\-built solutions. * Understanding of manufacturing processes, data compliance, and risk management practices. * Strong troubleshooting, organization, and communication skills. * Ability to explain technical concepts clearly and work with both technical and business teams. * Experience implementing data governance practices is a plus. ### **WORKING CONDITIONS:** * Works indoors in an office and manufacturing environment. * Regularly sits, walks, and uses a computer, including repetitive hand and wrist movements. * May stand or walk on concrete floors. * Works independently and with others. * No travel is required. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Search Core
jobs.description: Join the company that's building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world's biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what's next. We're one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we're remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd. **Why You'll Love This Role** Cribl Search powers high\-speed investigations for security and IT teams at some of the world's largest enterprises. Whether data lives in Lakehouse Engines or is spread across Federated sources, Search unifies ingest, storage, and analysis into a single experience — no tool\-hopping, no complex orchestration. Teams collect once, search anywhere, and investigate with no blind spots. Now add agentic AI to the picture. AI\-driven workloads are exploding, autonomous agents are firing queries alongside human analysts, and the volume and complexity of concurrent searches is growing fast. The query engine at the heart of Cribl Search needs to be faster, more concurrent, and more resilient than ever — and that's where you come in. Cribl is looking for a backend\-focused Staff Software Engineer to join a remote\-first, diverse, inclusive, cross\-functional team of software developers focused on making search stupid fast. You will play a central role in evolving the query engine at the heart of Cribl Search – breaking through concurrency ceilings, optimizing query dispatching and execution, and tuning performance for workloads ranging from interactive analyst investigations to AI agents firing thousands of concurrent queries. This is an ideal role for anyone who is passionate about making Search blazing fast at a massive scale. On top of it all, you will have fun! Cribl strives to be a great place to work for everyone. **As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will …** * Contribute to technical direction, bringing strong, loosely held, opinions to shape how Cribl Search evolves as a platform for multiple products * Own high\-impact changes to large\-scale systems, increasing performance and concurrency for both human and AI\-driven agentic workloads * Build and support a strong foundation for Cribl Search as a whole, collaborating across various teams and divisions * Champion improvements to performance, reliability, and operability * Drive clarity across multiple stakeholders and ambiguous requirements, communicating tradeoffs and risks of competing priorities * Partner with leadership to translate organizational needs from across the business into actionable plans on our roadmap * Lead projects end\-to\-end – from ideation, scoping and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support * Mentor and coach engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and pairing * Write clean, maintainable, and testable code with an eye toward observability and resilience * Share on\-call responsibilities as part of a team that embraces service ownership * Help define and refine the software development practices that make our team effective – everybody's feedback helps shape our process * We are a remote\-first company and work happens across many time\-zones – this position will require stand\-by, on\-call, or off\-hours duties **If You've Got \- We Want It** * Strong experience designing and operating multiple\-petabyte\-scale data systems, including object and distributed storage * Experience building search, query, and/or analytic systems working with structured and unstructured data * Deep understanding of how search tools work – indexing, inverted indices, query parsing, and execution (think Lucene/Solr, Elasticsearch) * Experience working on high\-performance, data\-intensive applications where concurrency, throughput, and latency matter * Familiarity with compilers, ASTs, and query language internals * Polyglot engineer – C\+\+ experience is highly desirable * Ability to problem\-solve from first principles and maintain focus on overarching objectives * Demonstrated ability to lead projects through ambiguity, driving technical decisions across team boundaries * Experience working in a fast paced, dynamic environment where priorities shift quickly * Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written – able to explain complex technical topics to stakeholders in remote, distributed environments * Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar on a team * Experience with C\+\+, Typescript/JavaScript, NodeJS, and SQL \#LI\-JB1 \#LI\-Remote **Bring Your Whole Self** Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We're building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying. Interested in joining the Cribl herd? Learn more about the smartest, funniest, most passionate goats you'll ever meet at cribl.io/about\-us.

jobs.title: Manager - Data Strategy, Enterprise Reporting and Implementation
jobs.description: CrossCountry Consulting is the transformation partner for the Office of the CFO. As a trusted advisor to Fortune 500 companies, emerging growth market leaders, and private equity sponsors, we combine deep domain expertise with the power of data, AI, and technology to modernize workflows, drive human\-centered change, and maximize transaction value. Grounded in our Core Values, we are committed to solving today's most complex challenges while delivering a better experience for our clients, our people, and our communities. When you join CrossCountry, you become part of a team that believes in collaboration, generosity, and the drive to help our clients work smarter, build resiliency, and prepare for the future. For CFOs, CIOs, and corporate leaders to cost\-effectively achieve strategic growth, real\-time data insights, competitive differentiation, and complete compliance, they need a robust digital architecture that maximizes technology investments and process efficiencies. Our data systems specialists design, build, and deploy leading data, analytics, and automation programs that generate rapid ROI across the enterprise. By joining our rapidly growing Data Transformation \& Analytics practice you will serve as a trusted partner to our clients. You will bring your first\-hand experience, unique perspectives, and functional knowledge to deliver tailored integrated solutions that help our clients solve today's challenges and set the foundation for future success. As an Associate Director at CrossCountry Consulting you will be responsible for a mix of client delivery, leading teams and developing junior team members, and participating in business development activities. ### **What You’ll Do:** * Serve as a strategic thought partner to C\-suite executives on data initiatives, understanding client personas (CFO, CIO, CHRO, CAO) and advising on harnessing data to support strategic goals. * Advise clients on establishing a technology and data strategy program that democratizes data, leverages modern cloud platforms, promotes data management, uncovers critical control needs, monitors data quality, and more. * Enhance clients’ technology stack and serve as Solution Architect to implement, collect, store, transform, process, and analyze data in a single source of truth consistently, efficiently, and without siloes. * Architect and design scalable, secure, and high\-performance data solutions across multiple cloud platforms. * Lead end\-to\-end data solution implementation, including ingestion, storage, transformation, and visualization using tools like Snowflake, Databricks, Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery, Azure Synapse Analytics, Fivetran, Talend, PowerBI, Tableau, and Sigma Computing. * Collaborate with business stakeholders, data engineers, and developers to define technical requirements and best practices. * Develop and technologies and recommend solutions to improve data infrastructure and analytics capabilities. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to data engineers and other team members. * Ensure seamless integration of data platforms within the enterprise architecture. * Support clients with the design and implementation of forecasting and predictive analytics models. * Interview clients to identify root causes of challenges; define and document business requirements. * Conduct current state / future state gap analysis for business and data processes. * Create executive level communications and presentations * Mentor team members by coaching colleagues, providing regular ongoing feedback and annual performance reviews, and helping project teams resolve complex issues. * Support business development by building relationships with key internal and external stakeholder * Contribute to go\-to\-market strategy and practice\-specific programs ### **What You’ll Bring:** * Prior experience managing client and/or internal teams by guiding performance against objectives, creating an atmosphere of trust and collaboration, and encouraging continuous improvement and innovation. * Experience and proficiency advising clients on modernizing their data architecture and using data analytics tools for cleansing and visualization (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx). * Knowledge of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, Lean, Waterfall). * Understanding of key finance (and other) processes like Lead to Cash / Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Record to Report, Hire to Retire. * Experience in supporting Large Enterprise organizations, Private Equity portfolio companies or Private Equity sponsors preferred. * Experience mentoring and developing junior team members and guiding project teams in resolving complex and multi\-faceted issues. * Passionate about building, developing, motivating, and leading others. ### **Qualifications:** * 9\+ years of professional experience leading initiatives or client engagements with a focus on data strategy, data architecture, data engineering, or cloud\-based analytics solutions, dealing with large data sets and interpreting data to draw meaningful insights and recommendations. * 5\+ years of experience in implementation of Snowflake, Databricks, Amazon Redshift, Azure Synapse Analytics. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP * 5\+ years of experience managing technical teams focused on delivering analytical products and solutions * Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, data lake architectures, and real\-time data processing * Understanding of data security best practices, compliance standards, and access control. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and ability to work in a fast\-paced, agile environment. * Strong communication skills with the ability to convey technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders * Bachelor’s degree or higher Pandas, NumPy, matplotlib packages) * MBA / CPA \[preferred]. * Certification in Snowflake / Alteryx / PowerBI / Tableau \[preferred]. * SnowPro Advanced Certification \[highly preferred]. * Willingness to travel based on client preferences. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-NB1 ***Benefits Summary*** *The CrossCountry total rewards package includes comprehensive healthcare options, including medical, jobs.description: **Job Summary:** This entry level/early career professional, applied technology position creates software that is sold as an integral part of Eaton’ products. Tools include code editors, integration tools, static analysis tools, compilers and hardware in the loop test tools. Details specific to this role may be found at the end of this document. Responsible for interacting and collaborating with cross\-functional teams. Provides independent execution of established work processes and systems, while still developing technology or product knowledge; engages with the improvement of systems and processes. Involves minimal direct management of people, but could involve the coordination and direction of work amongst technicians and/or temporary student employees. Contributes effectively toward team goals, exhibits influence within a work group and continues to develop proficiency in the competency areas critical to success in the role. **Competencies:** Product Failure Mode Avoidance \- Mitigates potential product failure modes, by identifying interfaces, functions, functional requirements, interactions, control factors, noise factors, and prioritized potential failure modes and potential failure causes for the system of interest to effectively and efficiently improve the reliability of Cummins’ products. System Requirements Engineering \- Uses appropriate methods and tools to translate stakeholder needs into verifiable requirements to which designs are developed; establishes acceptance criteria for the system of interest through analysis, allocation and negotiation; tracks the status of requirements throughout the system lifecycle; assesses the impact of changes to system requirements on project scope, schedule, and resources; creates and maintains information linkages to related artifacts. Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co\-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. jobs.description: ### **About CWILL** CWILL (pronounced 'quill') is a post\-purchase and retention suite built for Shopify brands. Prior Go experience is optional; willingness to learn the team's technology stack is expected * Frontend basics (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and at least one framework (React or Vue) * Backend fundamentals: HTTP, RESTful API design and MVC; able to build basic APIs on your own * At least one relational database (MySQL or PostgreSQL): able to write SQL and understand indexes and transactions * Comfortable using Git for version control and team collaboration * Good coding habits, with attention to readability and maintainability * Strong learner who picks up new technologies quickly and solves problems by reading documentation * Clear logical thinking: able to break down problems and explain technical choices * Good communication and ownership; you share progress proactively and stay calm under pressure * Professional working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese and English (you will work daily with our engineering team in China) **Nice to Have** * A complete full\-stack project you can show (coursework, competition, open source or internship) * Internship experience on a software team * Familiarity with TypeScript, Docker, CI/CD or cloud services (AWS, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, etc.) * An active GitHub history or technical blog * Programming competition awards (e.g., ICPC) * Experience with Shopify apps or APIs, order tracking, customer support tools, or AI applications such as agents, chatbots and knowledge bases * Hands\-on experience with AI coding tools such as Cursor, Codex or Claude Code **Benefits** Starting Pay: 80k \- 110k depends on experiences, open to negotiation * *401(k)* * *PTO* * *Paid Holidays* * *Insurance*

jobs.description: **THE OPPORTUNITY** We are seeking a highly technical and engineering\-driven Technical Support Manager to lead and elevate our Support organization. This position reports to the Director of Technical Support and requires on\-site presence in St. Louis, MO. The Technical Support Manager will lead a team of highly technical support engineers responsible for diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving complex product issues across cloud, data, and security environments. This is not a traditional support management role. **RESPONSIBILITIES:** **Technical Leadership** * Lead a team of Technical Support Engineers handling advanced troubleshooting across cloud environments (AWS/Azure/GCP), APIs, data pipelines, and enterprise integrations. * Serve as the highest\-level escalation point for complex technical cases. * Drive root\-cause analysis (RCA) for critical incidents and systemic product issues. * Partner with Engineering on bug triage, defect prioritization, and long\-term fixes. * Establish technical standards for case handling, diagnostics, and escalation workflows. * Ensure technical enablement of Subject Matter Experts through lab environments, sandbox systems, and reproducible test cases. * Lead internal technical reviews of recurring issues to identify architectural or product improvements. **Engineering Partnership \& Product Feedback Loop** * ﻿Act as the bridge between Support and Engineering. * Participate in bug triage sessions and sprint planning as the voice of customer impact. * Identify patterns in technical cases and proactively escalate product gaps. * Collaborate with Product and Technical Writing to improve documentation and reduce ticket volume through better self\-service resources. **Operational Excellence** * Build and refine processes that improve time\-to\-diagnosis and time\-to\-resolution for complex issues. * Define and track technical KPIs (MTTR, escalation rates, defect density, recurrence rate, severity trends). * Implement structured RCA processes and post\-incident reviews. * Oversee technical training programs to elevate team capability in debugging, scripting, and systems analysis. * Plan and lead internal “bug\-a\-thons” focused on systemic issue reduction. **Team Development** * Recruit, mentor, and develop highly technical support engineers. * Create technical career paths within Support (e.g., Tier 3, Escalation Engineer, Product Liaison). * Foster a culture of ownership, analytical rigor, and continuous improvement. * Promote engineering\-level thinking within Support rather than reactive ticket handling. Requirements: **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:** **Required Technical Background** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent technical experience. * 5\+ years in a technical support, support engineering, DevOps, SRE, or software engineering role. * 2\+ years leading or mentoring technical teams. * Strong understanding of: * Cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP) * Distributed systems and SaaS architectures * APIs (REST), authentication (SSO, OAuth, SAML) * Logging and monitoring tools * Data stores (SQL/NoSQL) and data pipelines * Ability to analyze logs, debug production issues, and identify systemic patterns. * Experience collaborating directly with software development teams. **Preferred** * Experience in cybersecurity or data security domains. * Familiarity with containerization (Docker/Kubernetes). * Scripting experience (Python, Bash, etc.). * Experience in high\-growth SaaS environments. * Experience building or managing lab environments for technical validation. **Leadership Competencies** * Technical credibility with enterprise IT and security stakeholders. * Strong systems thinking and structured problem\-solving. * Ability to balance operational responsiveness with long\-term product improvement. * Data\-driven decision\-making. * Comfort operating in ambiguity and scaling processes in a high\-growth environment. **We are looking for someone who:** * Has hands\-on engineering experience * Understands distributed systems and cloud\-native architectures * Can read logs, interpret stack traces, and analyze system behavior * Is comfortable working alongside R\&D to drive root\-cause resolution * Builds technical credibility with enterprise security and infrastructure teams You will be responsible for raising the technical bar of the organization while ensuring operational excellence, customer trust, and strong cross\-functional alignment with Product and Engineering. **COMPENSATION INFORMATION:** Compensation Range: $130,000\-$160,000\. The range represents total compensation, and may include incentive for sales roles, equity or benefits, as applicable. This compensation range represents Cyera’s good faith and reasonable estimate of the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of posting, and Cyera may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. The final salary for this position will be determined in Cyera’s sole discretion, consistent with applicable law, and based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to the employee’s work experience, skills, and qualifications for the role, as well as the needs of Cyera’s business and other operational considerations. Final compensation will vary based on seniority and relevance of experience, location, and position requirements. This role may be eligible for potential merit increases based on factors such as individual or company performance, time in role, and other discretionary factors. **BENEFITS \- Why Cyera?** * Ability to work remotely, with office setup reimbursement * Competitive salary * Unlimited PTO * Paid holidays and sick time * Health, vision, and dental insurance * Life, short and long\-term disability insurance

Knowledge of other enterprise e\-commerce systems is valued. * **Mentorship and Leadership**: Ability to collaboratively solve problems and share knowledge. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The Opportunity:** -------------------- Data privacy has become one of the most strategic challenges facing modern enterprises — sitting at the intersection of AI governance, data operations, and customer trust. As companies adopt AI at scale, they need new ways to automate privacy and manage risk without slowing innovation. DataGrail has launched the first agentic privacy platform, and we're entering a pivotal phase of growth as we scale toward the next stage of the business. As a Staff Software Engineer, you'll be the technical lead for our Consent product, which shapes how people experience privacy on our customers' websites and apps. Reporting to the VP of engineering, you'll own Consent's architecture across a Ruby on Rails, React, and AWS stack and ship consent experiences that are fast, reliable, and easy for customers to deploy, and you'll help shape how our engineering team continues to advance adoption of AI tooling. Claude Code is part of how we work every day, and you'll set the workflows, standards, and guardrails that help the whole team move faster without lowering the bar on quality or security. In a year, you'll be able to point to products you helped launch and to an engineering practice you helped define. This is a chance to show what AI\-native engineering looks like at a company where getting trust and privacy right is the product. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Serve as technical advisor and architect for the Consent platform, setting the long\-term vision and reviewing significant design decisions across runtime, ingestion, analytics, web and mobile SDKs, supply\-chain controls, and regulatory frameworks like Google CMP and IAB TCF. * Set the architectural bar for how DataGrail exposes its platform to AI agents, from external tools like Claude, Codex, and Cursor to our own internal agents, owning authentication and authorization, agent\-facing tool patterns, safety annotations, observability, and rollback paths. * Drive solutions to complex, ambiguous problems that span multiple teams, establishing patterns and frameworks others can build on. * Build with Claude Code every day and set the standard for how the team plans, writes, tests, and reviews code with AI. * Establish shared AI engineering workflows, including project context files, reusable skills and commands, MCP integrations, and guardrails for security and sensitive data. * Mentor engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and pairing, helping them get more out of AI tools while keeping quality high. * Partner with your VP of Engineering and Product Manager to scope milestone\-based plans and lead delivery of new features. * Partner with Staff Engineers across teams to shape our engineering principles and technical direction. * Provide hands\-on guidance on the highest\-leverage problems and lead resolution of high\-severity issues as part of the on\-call rotation. **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * Deep full stack experience building and operating production systems with Ruby on Rails, React with TypeScript, and Postgres or similar databases, including performant JavaScript that runs in the browser. * Hands\-on experience running services on AWS, with a strong grasp of scalability, reliability, and observability. * A track record of driving architecture for complex, cross\-team problems and seeing them through to delivery. * Daily, hands\-on experience shipping production code with Claude Code or a comparable agentic coding tool, and concrete examples of how it changed the way you work. * Experience building custom Claude Code skills, subagents, hooks, or MCP servers, or running AI agents in CI/CD. * Strong judgment about AI\-generated code, including how to give agents the right context, verify their output, and catch the correctness and security issues they introduce. * Experience raising the bar for a team through mentorship, technical standards, or tooling others adopted. * Clear written and verbal communication in a remote environment, including flagging cross\-team risks early and driving issues to resolution. ### **Bonus Points** * Familiarity with consent management, cookies and tracking technologies, or privacy regulations such as GDPR, CCPA, and CPRA. * Experience building LLM\-powered product features. * Familiarity with GitHub Actions and Terraform. * Experience with Python or similar languages. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- ### **Within 90 Days You'll:** * Ship your first Consent features end\-to\-end with Claude Code while learning our product, customers, architecture, and deployment process. * Bring cross\-domain universal consent to general availability. * Build cross\-device universal consent so every platform stays in sync and is treated as a first\-class experience. ### **Within 180 Days You'll:** * Lead the design and delivery of universal consent for TV and connected devices. * Reduce friction in how customers onboard and deploy Consent. * Build tooling and education that help engineers, Customer Success, and Solutions Architects self\-serve on Consent. * Help lead resolution of high\-severity issues as part of the on\-call rotation. ### **Within 365 Days You'll:** * Play a lead technical role in launching major new Consent capabilities. * Help grow AI tooling and adoption across the engineering team. * Mentor engineers and serve as the go\-to technical expert for Consent. Please note that the base compensation range below is a guideline and the final compensation will be based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, and competencies. Our compensation ranges apply to all US\-based job postings regardless of state. All full\-time regular employees are eligible for equity, health, dental \& vision insurance plans, remote\-first working environment, 401k savings plan, parental leave, wellness benefits, flexible time off, paid holidays, and a work from home stipend. Benefits are subject to change. Compensation Range $205,000 \- $240,000 USD **About Us:** ------------- DataGrail is the Agentic Data Privacy Platform. We help the world’s leading brands such as HubSpot, FanDuel, Dexcom, Major League Soccer, and Okta automate privacy and control risk with secure, human\-governed AI that scales. Powered by Vera, the complete privacy AI agent, and underpinned by an unrivaled 2,500\+ integrations and no\-compromise security architecture, DataGrail is built to solve complex privacy challenges that others can't. DataGrail is rated 4\.8/5 stars on G2 and is a two\-time recognized privacy leader by IDC. *DataGrail provides equal opportunities for everyone that works for us and everyone that applies to join our team, without regard to sex or gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, race, religious creed, color, national origin, ancestry, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, any service, past, present, or future, in the uniformed services of the United States (military or veteran status), or any other consideration protected by federal, state, or local law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer III, Backend
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Dataminr is the global leader in AI\-powered real\-time event, threat \& risk intelligence, and the pioneer of Autonomous Real\-Time Intelligence (ARI) . Our mission\-critical platform delivers the earliest warning on breaking events and emerging risks across physical, digital, and cyber domains, so people can act quickly with confidence. We didn’t join the AI wave. We built it. Founded in 2009, Dataminr is trusted by more than two\-thirds of the Fortune 50, half of the Fortune 100, 100\+ U.S. government agencies, and 20\+ international governments to protect people, assets, and operations. Join our mission\-driven team of 700\+ builders, creators, and visionaries across nine global offices, united by a passion to use AI for the greater good. **About the opportunity:** As a Software Engineer III, Backend, you’ll join a fast\-moving product engineering team building the future of our customer platform. You’ll ship code to production from day one, take ownership of multiple microservices, and design significant features that span several services, all within a modern, distributed application that ingests and processes hundreds of thousands of data points every second. You’ll also help shape the next generation of our architecture, raising the bar for engineering excellence as we deliver critical alerts to our clients faster and with near\-perfect reliability. This is a US based position that can be remote or based out of our NYC office. **The opportunity** * Ship code to production from day one and see your work make an immediate impact * Take ownership of multiple microservices, and design and deliver significant features that span several services * Shape the next generation of our architecture as we deliver more alerts to clients faster and with near\-perfect reliability * Design and develop SQL\-based databases that power performant, scalable data solutions * Build secure, seamless access experiences by implementing identity and access management with OAuth, Okta, and similar technologies * Raise the bar for engineering excellence by applying industry best practices alongside novel patterns and technologies that strengthen our codebase and product Partner with talented teammates to plan and deliver the next iteration of our customer applications, supporting emerging use cases * **What you bring** At Dataminr, we value you for who you are. We encourage you to apply for this role, even if you don't meet every qualification. Our candidates are reviewed on the basis of their skill and potential to succeed. * 5\+ years of experience building scalable back end services and applications * Proficiency in Java, Scala, Python, or other object\-oriented languages, with hands\-on experience in microservices, distributed systems, and real\-time streaming data * Strong skills in object\-oriented design, API design, data modeling, and coding, backed by a solid grasp of data structures and algorithms * Experience with SQL\-based database development * Familiarity with identity and access management, including OAuth, Okta, or similar technologies * A proven track record of championing strong engineering practices through hands\-on coding We’re AI\-first: you’ll design AI\-assisted workflows, build reusable prompts, and share what you learn. * \#LI\-BM \#LI\-hybrid We offer a competitive benefits package aimed at keeping you healthy and happy: * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance plan options for employees, domestic partners and their dependents * Generous PTO / flexible sick days * Paid parental leave and family forming benefits * Mental health benefits and support Company equity (RSUs) * **Join our global team:** At Dataminr, we serve a global community made up of many cultures and strive to reflect the diversity of the world in which we live. At Dataminr we actively condemn racism and discrimination in any form. We believe our differences give us strength. Our employees are empowered to be their best, authentic selves through various opportunities, such as our robust employee resource group (ERG) network, learning and development funds, and more. Dataminr is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. Individuals seeking employment at Dataminr are considered without regards to race, sex, color, creed, religion, national origin, age, disability, genetics, marital status, pregnancy, unemployment status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status. The annual base salary range for this position is $120,800 \- $177,500\. You will also be eligible to receive a discretionary bonus and Company equity. Actual salary will be based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, geographic location, applicant skills, and prior relevant experience. ***Dataminr will collect and process your personal data in accordance with Dataminr’s candidate privacy notice available*** ***here*** ***. By providing your details and applying via our careers website, you acknowledge that you have read our candidate privacy notice. If you have any queries, please contact*** ***recruiting@dataminr.com*** ***or*** ***privacy@dataminr.com*** ***.*** ***Notice Regarding Automated Employment Decision Tools in New York City***

jobs.title: Head of Deployments
jobs.description: **About David AI** ------------------ At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models. Founded in 2024, we're a fast\-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with \~70 people across San Francisco and New York City. **About this role** ------------------- We’re hiring a **Head of Deployments**, the leader who will own all post\-sales activity at David AI. You’ll lead engagements with our top customers to support their voice AI model development, from evals to datasets to continuous improvement, and make sure they realize the full value of their partnership with David AI. Your role will act as the strategic lighthouse of the business, influencing internal strategy, product roadmap, and research direction. **In this role, you will** -------------------------- * Take over each customer engagement at signature and own it through delivery, renewal, and repeat purchase. * Partner with our top customers’ research teams to accelerate their model improvement cycle, turning evaluation findings into targeted datasets and measurable gains release after release. * Act as the senior point of contact for executives, AI researchers, and engineers at our most important customers. * Lead delivery across our internal teams: scoping, timelines, quality bar, and escalations, so customers get what they need when they need it. * Surface expansion opportunities and partner with GTM team to close * Bring customer insight back into the company to shape product, operations, and how we sell. * Build the operating model for Deployments: process, metrics, and playbooks that scale. * Lead and grow the Deployments team: hire, coach, and set the bar for how Deployment Strategists run engagements. **Your background looks like** ------------------------------ * 5 to 10\+ years of relevant experience in strategy consulting at a top\-tier firm, or deployment experience at a fast\-growing or incumbent technology company. * A track record of leading complex, high\-stakes client engagements end to end and owning the outcome, not just advising on it. * Executive presence: you've earned the trust of senior, demanding stakeholders, ideally including technical ones such as researchers, engineers, or scientists. * Strong operator instincts: you can run multiple workstreams across teams, set a quality bar, and hold it. * Credibility with researchers and engineers: you're intellectually curious and technically fluent without needing to be an engineer yourself. Familiarity with the AI training lifecycle, and intuition for what makes high\-quality training data, is a strong plus. * Commercial awareness: you understand that great delivery drives renewals and growth, and you spot those opportunities naturally. **Bonus points if you have** ---------------------------- * Consulting experience along with forward\-deployed or deployment leadership experience at a top\-tier technology company. * Experience managing and coaching a team of client\-facing strategists or consultants. **Benefits** ------------ * Unlimited PTO. * Top\-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans. * FSA \& HSA access. * 401k access. * Meals 2x daily through DoorDash \+ snacks and beverages available at the office. * Unlimited company\-sponsored Barry's classes. **Visas** --------- We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H\-1B *transfers*, H\-1B1, O\-1, E\-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on STEM OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

jobs.title: Founding Engineer

jobs.title: Founding Product Engineer

The company serves agent platforms, businesses that want to sell to agents, and end users. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the Company** Our client is a well\-funded AI startup in New York City automating accounting and the financial close. Backed by top\-tier venture investors and experienced finance leaders, the company has grown quickly and is expanding from finance automation into accounting and strategic finance. Customers see meaningfully faster month\-end closes and much less manual finance work. The founding team brings deep enterprise software experience working with large organizations. ### **About the Role** You'll do backend\-heavy engineering, building AI agents for the accounting domain. jobs.title: Systems Administrator
jobs.description: Build something that matters. At Delta Star the work we do has a real impact. Every transformer we build helps deliver reliable electricity to homes, businesses, and communities across North America. As we continue to grow, we are looking for people who want more than just a job. We are looking for individuals who want to learn, contribute, solve challenges, and build a meaningful career alongside a team that is committed to delivering power at all times. Summary Delta Star Inc. is seeking a highly motivated and technically skilled Systems Administrator to support and enhance our hybrid infrastructure across on\-premises and cloud environments. This role is responsible for maintaining the reliability, performance, and availability of our enterprise infrastructure, including Windows Server, virtualization, Microsoft 365, Azure, storage, and backup platforms. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure challenges, implementing modern technologies, and working across both server and cloud environments, we’d like to hear from you. What You'll Do As the Systems Administrator, you will be responsible for administering Delta Star’s core infrastructure while supporting a hybrid Microsoft environment that spans on\-premises data centers and Azure. You’ll work closely with the IT Manager, Network Engineering, Cyber Security Manager, Service Desk, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable IT services. This role combines day\-to\-day operational support with infrastructure modernization projects, automation, and continuous improvement initiatives. A Day in the Life Your day may include deploying new virtual servers, troubleshooting Microsoft 365 or Azure connectivity issues, maintaining virtual infrastructure, implementing PowerShell automation, supporting hybrid identity services, or assisting with disaster recovery planning. You’ll collaborate with the Network Engineer on hybrid networking initiatives and help ensure Delta Star’s infrastructure remains highly available, secure, and ready to support our growing business. Specific Duties * Manage, administer, and maintain: * On prem Windows Server infrastructure, including Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, and certificate services. * Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, and hybrid identity environments. * VMware vSphere infrastructure, virtual machines, clusters, and storage resources. * Enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions and business continuity and disaster recovery testing. * Data center technologies: servers, interconnects, storage infrastructure, including SAN and NAS platforms. * Support Azure infrastructure, including Virtual Networks, Virtual Machines, storage accounts, SD\-WAN connectivity, monitoring, and hybrid services. * Configure, maintain, and perform and/or automate operating system, firmware, and infrastructure patch management. * Monitor infrastructure health, capacity, and performance while proactively identifying opportunities for improvement. * Develop and maintain PowerShell scripts and automation solutions to improve operational efficiency. * Collaborate with and support Network Engineer team to troubleshoot network connectivity, hybrid cloud networking, IP, DNS, SD\-WANs, VPNs, and routing issues. * Lead and manage infrastructure design, upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh projects. * Maintain infrastructure documentation, standards, and operational procedures. * Provide Tier III/IV technical support for complex infrastructure related issues. * Develop, create, and administer sandbox testing environments for major version, security patches, and bug fix updates along with configuration and architecture updates and changes. * Coordinate third\-party vendors, hardware suppliers, warranty providers, and managed service partners supporting. * Assist networking team with Wi\-Fi and Wired NAC and security services. What We're Looking For We’re looking for a collaborative infrastructure professional with strong technical skills across Windows Server, virtualization, Microsoft cloud technologies, and hybrid infrastructure. The ideal candidate enjoys solving complex technical problems, continuously learning new technologies, and working across multiple infrastructure disciplines while partnering closely with networking and cybersecurity teams. Position Requirements * Technology field related degree or certifications. * 5\+ years of enterprise systems administration experience. * Experience administering Windows Server, Active Directory, VMware, Microsoft 365, and hybrid environments. * Experience supporting Microsoft Azure infrastructure. * Experience in enterprise storage platform administration. * Experience with enterprise backup and disaster recovery solutions. * Experience automating administrative tasks using PowerShell. * Ability to travel up to 15% as needed. Skills and Competencies * Strong knowledge of Windows Server administration and Microsoft enterprise technologies. * Experience supporting Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, and hybrid identity. * Experience administering VMware virtualization platforms. * Working knowledge of Azure infrastructure services, including Virtual Networks, Virtual Machines, SDWAN, Azure Storage, and monitoring services. * Solid understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, VPNs, and hybrid cloud networking. * Ability to troubleshoot infrastructure issues spanning servers, storage, virtualization, networking, and cloud services. * Experience with PowerShell scripting and/or related scripting languages and automation tools. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Lead the evaluation and implementation of new technologies, processes, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. * Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining a high level of customer service. * Strong documentation and organizational skills. * Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across IT disciplines. Why Our Employees Join, Grow, and Stay At Delta Star, you will find more than a job. You will join a team that values people, supports growth, and trusts you to make an impact. Whether you're on the shop floor, in the field, or in the office, you will work alongside talented people to solve meaningful challenges, power communities, and build a rewarding career. With opportunities to learn, advance, and contribute, plus a culture built on respect, teamwork, and work\-life balance, Delta Star is a place where you can thrive for the long term Benefits That Support You We believe that a rewarding career starts with feeling supported both at work and at home. That's why we offer a competitive total rewards package designed to support your health, financial well\-being, professional growth, and work\-life balance. Eligible employees have access to medical, dental, and vision coverage, retirement savings programs, paid time off, life and disability protection, wellness resources, employee assistance programs, and additional voluntary benefits that help you and your family thrive. Pay Transparency We are committed to fair and transparent pay practices. Compensation for this position will be determined within the posted salary range based on factors such as candidate qualifications, relevant experience, internal equity, market competitiveness, skills, and certifications. For union\-represented roles, pay is established by the applicable collective bargaining agreement. Other Duties Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice. AAP/EEO Statement Delta Star is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

jobs.title: Robotics Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Robotics Software Engineer** Devonics Automation, Inc. · San Diego, CA · Full\-Time * Title: Robotics Software Engineer * Location: San Diego, CA (on\-site, full\-time) * Experience: 2–5 years * Pay: $90,000–$120,000 **About the role** Devonics Automation builds modular, production\-ready cobot integration cells for precision machining, medical device, semiconductor, and laboratory environments. We are a small, high\-output team where every engineer works directly on real systems that ship to real customers. This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who has already worked with physical robot hardware and is eager to deepen that experience fast. You will work side\-by\-side with other engineers daily, developing and learning how to take a full automation solution from concept through customer deployment while contributing meaningfully from week one. **What you'll do** * Develop and maintain robot applications in C\+\+ and Python on ROS 2, including motion planning * Program and integrate collaborative robots through vendor SDKs, APIs and teach pendants (e.g., Fairino, Universal Robots, Doosan) * Integrate cobots with PLCs, sensors, grippers and end\-of\-arm tooling over Modbus TCP, EtherNet/IP and digital I/O * Configure and validate safety functions: speed and separation monitoring, safety I/O and risk\-assessment inputs * Take over in\-flight projects, read existing code and documentation, and keep delivery dates on track * Commission and debug cells in our shop and at customer sites; write clear handoff documentation * Create and manage backend services and APIs (REST, gRPC or MQTT) that orchestrate robot cells or bridge ROS 2 to other systems * Improve reusable libraries, tooling and test setups so each new cell ships faster **What you bring** * Bachelor's in Robotics, Computer, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent hands\-on experience * 2–5 years building software for physical robots, ideally industrial arms or cobots * Solid C\+\+ and Python on Linux; comfortable with Git and code review * Working experience with ROS 2 (nodes, topics, services, actions, launch files, tf2\) * Hands\-on experience with at least one cobot or industrial robot SDK * Practical knowledge of PLC integration and industrial protocols * Able to troubleshoot across software, electrical and mechanical boundaries on the shop floor * Eagerness to develop into leadership within a small team **Nice to have** * Backend services and APIs (REST, gRPC or MQTT) that orchestrate robot cells or bridge ROS 2 to other systems * Operator HMIs or web dashboards (React/TypeScript) for cell control, production data or OEE * MoveIt 2, Gazebo or Isaac Sim simulation * Machine vision for pick\-and\-place (2D/3D cameras, hand\-eye calibration, OpenCV) * Allen\-Bradley or Siemens PLC programming (ladder logic, Structured Text) * Familiarity with ISO 10218 and ISO/TS 15066 cobot safety standards * Docker, CI pipelines and automated testing for robot software * SQL databases and production data logging **Working conditions** This role is fully on\-site in San Diego, split between the office and the robot lab. Occasional customer\-site travel for commissioning (estimated 15%). **What we offer** * Hands\-on work with production cobot systems across precision machining, medical, and semiconductor applications * A structured growth path: from assisted integration in year one to independent project ownership in year two * Competitive salary of $90,000–$120,000 based on experience * A small, collaborative team where your contributions are visible and your voice is heard * Competitive benefits, flex schedule, unlimited PTO **How to apply** Submit your resume along with any links to relevant projects, coursework, GitHub repositories, or hands\-on work involving physical robots. Tell us briefly what robot hardware you have worked with and what your role was. Applications without any evidence of hardware exposure will not be prioritized. Devonics Automation, Inc. \| devonics.com \| San Diego, CA Pay: $90,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Education: * Bachelor's (Preferred) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: SMT Engineer
jobs.description: Brooklyn, NY \| $40–45/hour 4 week training 9am\-5pm then transition to 1st shift (7am\-4pm) or 2nd shift (3pm\-12am) **About Diode** --------------- Diode designs and manufactures custom printed circuit boards (PCBs). We combine AI\-native electrical engineering software with in\-house PCB manufacturing and assembly, helping teams design, validate, and bring hardware into production. As AI streamlines custom PCB design, a far broader array of hardware products will become viable, shifting the core engineering challenge toward rapid, reliable, high\-mix assembly. We’re building toward this future where more teams develop hardware tailored to specific needs, without the time and complexity that have historically made custom electronics difficult to justify. Our platform combines AI board design, DFM manufacturing techniques, sourcing and tracking part availability, and more to take boards from concept to assembled hardware in days instead of months. We work on electronics ranging from robotics and aerospace to medical technology and consumer devices, with designs ranging from power electronics to high\-density interconnect boards. Our team has shipped hardware at Apple, Tesla, Anduril, and other companies. **About the role** ------------------ Run Diode’s full SMT line, from setup and changeovers through assembly and inspection. Keep equipment operational, troubleshoot production issues, and improve the reliability and efficiency of our builds. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Set up and operate SMT equipment using production instructions and Diode’s software. * Own line changeovers, routine checks, maintenance, and troubleshooting. * Monitor builds, catch defects early, and reduce downtime. * Inspect placement, orientation, polarity, and soldering quality. * Work with engineering and manufacturing to resolve blockers and improve production flow. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * Hands\-on SMT equipment, PCB assembly, and troubleshooting experience. * Mechanical and electronics aptitude, attention to detail, and sound safety judgment. * Clear communication and a methodical approach to improving production.

100% coverage, accuracy, completeness, and usability of extracted business rules. * Validate extracted rules to ensure they are consumable by IES business partners and business analysts. * Identify and functional specifications. * Develop business analysis artifacts, including: * + Business process flows and workflow diagrams. + Use cases and user stories. + Requirements traceability matrices. + Data dictionaries. + User interface specifications. + Wireframes and mockups. + Functional and technical specifications. * Facilitate requirements gathering sessions with agency stakeholders, local district subject matter experts, end users, and executive leadership. * Support the development and documentation of system requirements using established IES business analysis methodologies, processes, and tools. * Assist with project planning, workflow documentation, and requirements management throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). * Participate in peer reviews and jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Scientist, Applied Causal Inference
jobs.description: **About the Team** ------------------ The Market Optimization team builds decision systems that help DoorDash invest in Dasher supply where it creates the greatest marketplace value. Market Optimizer brings together supply forecasts, causal response models, and constrained optimization to inform spending across acquisition, pay, and incentives. We work with the teams that own these levers to improve delivery speed and reliability while managing cost and supporting a healthy Dasher marketplace. **About the Role** ------------------ We are looking for a hands\-on technical leader to advance the causal models and production systems behind Mobilization. You will help answer where and when to offer incentives, how much to offer, and how long they should run. You will estimate the additional supply these decisions create and translate those estimates into dependable policies with Engineering, Product, Analytics, and Operations. **You are excited about this opportunity because you will** ----------------------------------------------------------- * Build and calibrate response curves that estimate how incentive amount, timing, duration, and location affect incremental Dasher hours and marketplace outcomes. * Connect causal estimates and supply forecasts to constrained optimization, balancing delivery outcomes, incentive cost, and uncertainty across markets and time periods. * Design learning experiments and evaluation plans with Analytics. Account for marketplace spillovers, supply shifting between nearby areas or time periods, and interactions with other incentives. * Develop policies that direct spending toward periods when additional supply creates the most marketplace value, accounting for diminishing returns and non\-linear delivery outcomes. * Own models through production deployment, calibration, monitoring, and incident diagnosis. Build diagnostics that explain policy changes and surface model or data regressions. **We are excited about you because you have** --------------------------------------------- * 5\+ years of experience developing causal inference or causal ML systems, with a record of using the results to change production decisions. * A record of leading ambiguous projects across team boundaries, making technical tradeoffs explicit, and developing other engineers. * Strong statistical judgment about randomized experiments and observational estimation, including confounding, treatment overlap, uncertainty, and the limits of causal claims. * Experience with treatment effect estimation or dose\-response modeling and relevant methods such as doubly robust estimation, double machine learning, or off\-policy evaluation. You choose methods based on the decision and available evidence. * Strong software and ML engineering skills. You can build reliable data and training pipelines, write maintainable production code, and diagnose failures across models and services. * Experience connecting models to constrained optimization, pricing, or resource allocation, and assessing how estimation errors affect production decisions. * The ability to explain modeling assumptions and incentive recommendations to partners who need to act on them. **About DoorDash** ------------------ At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door\-to\-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods. DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well\-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks including premium healthcare, wellness expense reimbursement, paid parental leave and more. **Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** --------------------------------------------- We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. jobs.description: **About Dust** ============== **Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.** With enterprise\-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest\-moving companies to rewire how work gets done. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Partner with Sales to drive technical wins** ---------------------------------------------- * Act as a trusted technical counterpart to Account Executives throughout the sales cycle * Clearly articulate Dust’s value to both technical and business stakeholders * Build credibility and trust with customers by combining strong technical fluency with a consultative, customer\-first approach * Help shape the foundation of Dust’s global Pre\-Sales Solutions Engineering organization as one of our first US hires **Lead technical discovery and product evaluations** ---------------------------------------------------- * Run deep technical discovery to uncover high\-impact use cases aligned with customer workflows and business priorities * Design and deliver tailored, high\-impact product demonstrations grounded in real customer problems * Own the technical evaluation process end\-to\-end, from discovery and custom demos through hands\-on pilots ----------------------------------------- * Build lightweight prototypes, agents, workflows, or integrations that demonstrate practical applications of Dust * Develop deep expertise in Dust’s platform capabilities, AI workflows, and prompt engineering best practices * Help customers move beyond curiosity about AI into real operational impact inside their organizations * Translate complex AI platforms, or workflow automation * Ability to write code (Python, JavaScript, etc.) to work with APIs, automate workflows, or build demos and prototypes You should still consider applying even if you
