jobs.title: Software Engineer, Systems
jobs.description: **About E2B** ============= E2B is a fast\-growing Series A startup with over $37M in funding and 9\-figure revenue. We are building the Agent Cloud and power the infrastructure behind AI labs and some of the most widely used consumer and enterprise agents, including Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, and Artificial Analysis. Our team includes original authors of Firecracker, the AWS microVM technology powering Lambda, along with alumni of Cognition, JetBrains, Zapier, and Wish. **About the role** ================== E2B has started billions of Firecracker sandboxes across regions on Google Cloud, AWS and Azure. Every sandbox is a real virtual machine that has to start in well under a second, resume from a snapshot on a different host, and share a host with up to about 200 others without noticing them. Your job will be to build and own the Go service on every host that creates, pauses, resumes and tears down sandboxes, along with the Linux underneath it: host networking, memory and isolation. You'll work closely with our sandbox team in Prague, who own the Firecracker runtime, the guest kernel, sandbox storage and live migration, and with our infrastructure engineers, who put the platform together. We're hiring more than one engineer into this role, each with a different focus: some go deepest on Linux and how sandboxes run on the host, others on sandbox networking. Our runtime is open source at github.com/e2b\-dev/runtime, and the sandbox package is a good place to see what you'd work on. Responsibilities include: * Making sandboxes start fast and keeping them fast as the fleet grows to millions and later billions of sandboxes, with starts under 200ms * Evolving the architecture of the software that runs sandboxes on every host, so it can change without disrupting them * Making the sandbox lifecycle reliable under failure, so no sandbox is leaked or lost when a process or host dies * Keeping the host OS and kernel current across the fleet, rolling out upgrades without disrupting running sandboxes * Building the sandbox network: isolation, egress control and addressing for untrusted workloads * Enforcing resource isolation between sandboxes on shared hosts, so every sandbox gets the CPU, memory and I/O it was allocated * Building host\-level observability, so we understand what every sandbox costs the host it runs on * Being on call for the platform you build, alongside the rest of the platform team This role requires a high amount of ownership. You'll write the code and the design docs for the hardest changes in your area, and ship every day. If you aren't afraid of going deep into the Linux kernel when a problem needs it, and words like eBPF, cgroups, network namespaces, nftables, conntrack, or noisy neighbor problem sound exciting to you, we want to hear from you! **What we're looking for** ========================== * Experience building and operating systems software across a large production fleet: node agents, container or VM runtimes, schedulers, or similar * Strong Go, or strong Rust or C/C\+\+ and the willingness to pick up Go quickly; our services are in Go * Deep Linux knowledge: processes, CPU scheduling, memory management, cgroups and namespaces, and the network stack * Experience making software correct under failure: crash recovery, reconciling recorded state with what is actually running, and cleanup when a process or host dies * For a networking focus: Linux networking for multi\-tenant workloads, such as network namespaces, virtual interfaces, iptables/nftables and egress control * A performance mindset: you've shaved milliseconds off hot paths, profiled production systems under load, and treat p99 as a number you own * Excited to work in person from San Francisco * Comfortable with our code and infrastructure being public We expect this experience will often come from around five or more years of relevant work, but the depth of what you've built matters more than a specific number. **Bonus points for:** ===================== * Experience with VM or container runtimes such as Firecracker, KVM, gVisor or runc, including memory management and snapshot and restore * GPU or accelerator infrastructure, passthrough or GPU\-as\-a\-service * Kernel tracing and eBPF tooling * OS\-level hardening, such as seccomp and Linux security modules * Running workloads on Kubernetes, which our fleet runs on * Contributions to the Linux kernel, Firecracker, CNCF or similar open source projects **What it’s like to work at E2B** ================================= We’re a fast\-growing startup with in\-person (4 days on\-site, 1 day WFH) offices in **San Francisco and Prague, Czech Republic**. We already generate 9\-figure revenue and work directly with top\-tier AI companies like Manus, Genspark, Lindy, Groq, Artificial Analysis and other exciting teams pushing the frontier of AI. We offer healthcare, vision, and dental insurance, unlimited PTO, 401k, and a variety of perks for in\-office employees. Compensation Range: $250K \- $350K

tune before anyone asks. * **You're excited about where AI is going.** You want to build the platform that lets an organization run many agents well, not just one. **The Azure AI Platform Engineer Foundry environments, model deployments, and our private Azure subscription as production infrastructure, including onboarding, upgrading, and retiring models. * Own the AI gateway on Azure API versioning, and reuse standards, so a tool built once serves every agent. * Build fleet\-wide observability: logging, compliance log collection, monitoring, alerting, and usage telemetry attributed by agent and user. * Build and operate the evaluation infrastructure that gates releases and continuously scores agents in production. * Own identity and access: Entra ID group\-based, least\-privilege RBAC, managed identities, just\-in\-time elevation, and drift detection against the code. * Own cost and performance: budgets and alerts, tagging, recurring cost reviews, and latency and token tuning or Azure DevOps), and scripting in Bash, PowerShell, or Python. * Observability on Azure: Log Analytics, Application Insights, and writing KQL. * Working knowledge of how LLM applications and agents work (model endpoints, tool calling, tokens, evaluation), enough to design a platform for them. * Clear communicator who documents well and can explain infrastructure tradeoffs to engineers and business leaders. **Preferred Experience and Skills:** * Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry) or Azure OpenAI in production: model deployments, agents, evaluations, and the control plane. * Azure API jobs.title: Senior Data Acquisition & Controls Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Energy Recovery and Help Build a Sustainable Future** At Energy Recovery, we build products that help limit global temperature rise, reduce carbon emissions, provide safe drinking water for millions of people, and bring efficiency and sustainability to a range of industries. Our products help customers avoid approximately 19\.7 million metric tons of carbon emissions per year \- equivalent to removing over 4\.7 million cars from the road! In addition to innovating world\-class products that help our customers and the environment, our employees enjoy a diverse, collaborative work culture, as well as extensive company benefits that support the overall wellbeing of our staff. This includes everything from generous health plans and time off, paid family leave, subsidized lunches and company events, and opportunities for charitable giving and volunteering in the community. **What You Can Look Forward To:** Energy Recovery is seeking a Data acquisition \& Controls Engineer for an immediate, full\-time opening in San Leandro, CA. The role reports to the Engineering Manager of the Testing \& Validation team, within the New Technology and Product Development (R\&D) department. You will join a multidisciplinary R\&D team of engineers and technicians with diverse backgrounds, several of whom hold Master’s and PhD degrees. Together, the team develops new energy recovery products and technologies based on our proprietary isobaric pressure exchanger. This is a hands\-on, lab\-based role that combines product development, with a strong focus on data acquisition systems and test loop controls. To support product development \& enhancement, you will design, build and upgrade high\-pressure test loops, develop their control and data acquisition systems, and plan and run tests for validating their performance and reliability. ### **What You Will Do:** * Design, program and maintain LabVIEW/NI\-based control and data acquisition systems for R\&D and production test loops, including high\-pressure water (up to 3,000 psig / \~200 bar) and CO₂/refrigeration loops. * Implement closed\-loop control of VFD\-driven pumps, compressors and motors, control valves and electric heaters including PID tuning. * Design and implement safety interlocks, alarms and fail\-safe shutdown logic using hardwired safety relays/safety PLCs and software interlocks; support HAZOP and safety reviews. * Support Operations with production test loops: troubleshoot control and DAQ issues, implement upgrades, and develop controls and DAQ for new production test stands. * Plan and execute beta tests at customer sites: instrument products, set up secure remote data collection and monitoring (cellular routers, MQTT/cloud platforms), track performance, and report results and recommendations. * Take ownership of existing test system software and hardware; document, refactor and maintain LabVIEW code under source control. * Specify and select instrumentation and DAQ hardware (pressure, temperature, flow, vibration); maintain calibration records and quantify measurement uncertainty. * Create P\&IDs, electrical schematics and control panel layouts; build or oversee build of control panels in line with applicable electrical codes. * Support new product development through mechanical design and test setup builds: specify components and assemblies for pressure exchangers and test rigs, size pumps, valves, relief devices and filters for high\-pressure service (up to 3,000 psig / \~200 bar), and produce SolidWorks models, drawings and BOMs. Develop test plans, execute tests, analyze data and report results for new product development and product enhancements. * Partner with technicians, mechanical engineers, Operations, Sourcing and Business Units to deliver testing on schedule and within budget. * Perform other duties as assigned. ### **What You Bring to the Table:** * B.S. in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Instrumentation \& Controls Engineering or a related field. * 5\+ years of hands\-on experience developing control and data acquisition systems for test loops, test stands or industrial process equipment. 3\+ years with an advanced degree is acceptable. * Strong LabVIEW proficiency (LabVIEW Core 2 or equivalent proficiency preferred). * Experience with NI data acquisition hardware and software, such as CompactDAQ (cDAQ), CompactRIO (cRIO) and NI MAX. * Experience with PLC programming (e.g., Allen\-Bradley/Rockwell or Siemens); HMI development experience desirable. * Experience with industrial communication protocols such as Modbus (RTU and TCP), OPC and MQTT (e.g., AWS IoT) desirable. * Experience with remote monitoring and management platforms and hardware, such as Teltonika RMS and Teltonika or Cradlepoint routers is a plus. * Experience with test instrumentation, including pressure and temperature transducers, flow meters, proximity probes and accelerometers and their calibration. * Experience with fluid flow loops and high\-pressure equipment along with designing and implementing safety interlocks, alarms and emergency shutdown systems. * Ability to read and create P\&IDs and electrical schematics; working knowledge of industrial power and control wiring (including 480V three\-phase). * Experience with the design or operation of fluid machinery such as pumps, turbines and compressors. * Working proficiency in SolidWorks or Onshape and Visio. * Willingness to travel to customer sites for field installation, instrumentation and beta testing. ### **What's in it For Me?** * **Health Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with options for family coverage * **Retirement Plans:** 401(k) plan with company matching to help you save for the future * **Paid Time Off:** Generous vacation policy, paid sick leave, and paid holidays to ensure a healthy work\-life balance * **Wellness Programs:** Mental Wellness Support with therapy and coaching in addition to an employee assistance program * **Fitness Perks**: Enjoy access to our on\-site gym with an on\-site trainer, yoga classes and gym reimbursement for remote employees * **Team Events:** Regular team\-building activities and social events to foster a positive work culture such as; ping\-pong tournaments, gratitude lunches, and summer BBQs * **Referral Bonus:** Earn up to $1,500 for referring friends * **Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA):** Pre\-tax savings for medical expenses, commuter, and dependent care, helping you manage out\-of\-pocket costs * **Tuition Reimbursement:** Financial support for continuing education, including courses and degree programs to help you advance your career * **Paid Parental Leave**: Generous paid leave for new parents to bond with their children and support family needs The salary range for this role is $140,000 to $160,000/year with bonus opportunity, equity grant, and other perks. The stated range is the range that we reasonably believe to be the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and this range is only applicable for jobs to be performed in California. This range may be modified in the future. *We are an EOE/AA employer committed to workforce diversity.**No recruiters or phone calls.*

jobs.title: Sr. 3D C++ Software Engineer
jobs.description: United States of America, California, Pomona R5026291 United States of America Engineering **Job description** **About the Team:** The software team is part of the Global Manufacturing Engineering (GME). Alongside GME's Hardware Controls, Manufacturing Process, and Automated Quality Control teams, we build the geometrical compiler behind Spark™ Clear Aligners: the math\-heavy software stack that turns digital treatment intent into physical parts at production scale. Our systems decide how geometry gets transformed, nested, validated, and translated into instructions that run across a global factory footprint producing more than 100,000 unique parts per day. This is not generic application development. Our code drives scanners, printers, mills, and other fab equipment. Physical reality is the unit test. When the math is wrong, parts are wrong. **Job Summary:** We are hiring a Sr. 3D C\+\+ Software Engineer who is genuinely strong in applied math, understands the physics behind manufactured parts and processes, and can turn that reasoning into production\-grade C\+\+. You will work on the core algorithms and services that bridge CAD to CAM: geometry processing, numerical optimization, physical constraint modeling, and the software interfaces that let those models run reliably in production. You should be comfortable moving from formulating a problem from first principles to shipping the implementation without handholding. If deriving a normal from three points on a triangle, reasoning about numerical stability, or solving a nonlinear equation numerically feels outside your daily toolkit, this is likely not the right role. At this production volume, a solver running at 99\.9% reliability still generates roughly 100 support escalations per day. Correctness isn't a quality bar — it's a throughput constraint. This is a full\-time and on\-site five days/week engineering role in Pomona, CA. Rapid development here depends on being next to the hardware and the people using it. You will work directly with R\&D equipment such as scanners, 3D printers, CNC systems, and metrology tools, shortening the loop between idea, code, experiment, measurement, and revision from weeks to days. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** * Build the mathematical core: Formulate, design, and implement algorithms for 3D geometry processing, numerical optimization, spatial reasoning, and CAD/CAM translation in a production manufacturing environment. * Model physical constraints in software: Turn real\-world process behavior, machine limits, material effects, and measurement data into robust computational models that survive contact with actual hardware. * Write expert\-level C\+\+: Develop high\-performance, maintainable C\+\+20 systems for compute\-heavy workloads where correctness, numerical robustness, and runtime behavior all matter. * Prototype with purpose: Use Python, NumPy, SciPy, and related tools when they speed up discovery, then harden the right ideas into production services. * Run tight hardware\-software loops: Work side by side with R\&D and Operations to test algorithms on equipment, inspect outputs, understand failure modes, and iterate quickly based on measured results. * Ship math in real systems: Package algorithms behind gRPC and Protobuf interfaces, operate within Bazel\- and Conan\-based builds, and make sound choices about how compute\-heavy services run in Docker and AWS Kubernetes environments. * Any duties or tasks assigned by Manager. **Examples of the Work:** * Detect geometry with no downward path to the build plate and automatically generate support structures that prevent mid\-print failure — without adding unnecessary material or obstructing neighboring parts. * Given a hollow 3D\-printed part with non\-uniform structural loading, compute the wall thickness profile it actually needs — then implement the custom offset surface that produces it. * Register a 3D scan of a printed mold against its digital blueprint, segment the surface into regions by structural importance, and produce a localized devtaion map that flags quality failures at production scale. * Given a 5\-axis CNC toolpath, find the velocity profile that keeps every drive within its speed and acceleration limits without unnecessarily slowing the overall cut. **Job requirements** **Basic Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial work in large modern C\+\+ codebases. * Deep fluency in 3D geometry, linear algebra, numerical methods, and optimization. You should be able to reason from first principles. * Experience in the physics that sit underneath geometric or manufacturing problems, with the judgment to translate continuous models into stable discrete implementations. * Demonstrated ability to formulate and implement mathematically demanding algorithms in production\-quality C\+\+ wit ies (Envista) will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate. Envista will consider unsolicited referrals and/or resumes submitted by vendors such as search firms, staffing agencies, professional recruiters, fee\-based referral services and recruiting agencies (Agency) to have been referred by the Agency free of charge and Envista will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt such unsolicited resumes. An Agency must obtain advance written approval from Envista's internal Talent Acquisition or Human Resources team to submit resumes, and then only in conjunction with a valid fully\-executed contract approved by the Global Talent Acquisition leader and in response to a specific job opening. jobs.description: **Company Description** See how Epsilon powers connected marketing by unlocking the full potential of data and identity. **Overview** Epsilon is building the next generation Retail Media Network (RMN) platform to power onsite advertising at scale, leveraging services from our industry\-leading platform that already serves billions of offsite ads across the open web. Our vision is a unified platform for both onsite and offsite ads, delivering low\-latency, high\-throughput performance across the board. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Core Platform Engineering team, someone with a self\-starter mindset who thrives with minimal direction, can quickly grasp business and technical goals, and takes ownership from concept through delivery. This is a high\-impact role where you'll shape the architecture, optimize performance, and ensure our systems are built for scale, reliability, and innovation. You'll be at the forefront of building a next\-generation advertising platform that combines the speed and sophistication of programmatic ad serving with the personalization and commerce power of retail media. Your work will directly shape how millions of users experience advertising across top retailers and brands. **Responsibilities** * Own the features and services you build, from design through production, with the support of the broader team. * Design, implement, and maintain high\-performance, low\-latency services for advertising. * Collaborate with product, platform, and operations teams to integrate new capabilities into the platform. * Help optimize system performance, troubleshoot production issues, and address bottlenecks across the stack. * Contribute to frontend integrations (SPAs, dashboards, tools) when needed, ensuring smooth workflows for internal and external users. * Work with data engineering teams to integrate event tracking, analytics, and reporting pipelines. * Follow and help improve code quality, testing practices, and CI/CD automation. * Deliver enhancements that enable fast, accurate, and scalable ad delivery. * Build reliable services and interfaces that support rapid feature development. * Improve system observability, monitoring, and fault tolerance. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent experience). * 3\+ years of experience in backend and/or full stack software development. * Strong development practices, including writing and testing code, version control (Git), and automated builds. * Solid backend skills in Java, with exposure to distributed systems. * Experience with streaming or pub/sub platforms (e.g., Kafka, Kinesis, Pulsar). * Proficiency with relational databases (SQL); jobs.description: ### **Principle Product Manager, Verticals Agents \& Data** * JR\-164773 * Hybrid * Toronto * Dallas * Technology * Full time **Who are we?** Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. Help us challenge assumptions, uncover bias, and remove barriers—because progress starts with fresh ideas. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership role. You will work in a forward\-deployed way with vertical teams, and with other product teams on shared platform pieces such as on\-prem language models and evals. **Responsibities** Partner with production: scope, data readiness, launch criteria, rollout, and adoption * Define how business outcomes and agent outcomes are measured, and build the dashboards and review cadence to track them * jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist (AI Evaluation & Improvement)
jobs.description: **Your Future Evolves Here** Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones. Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business. Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture. **What You’ll Be Doing:** **Core Responsibilities** * Own the diagnostic loop for LLM\-based clinical services: take failure modes surfaced by clinical reviewers and product managers, form root\-cause hypotheses (prompt design, context assembly, retrieval, guideline encoding, model behavior, upstream data), and design experiments that isolate the cause. * Test candidate fixes — prompt and configuration variants, context changes, model alternatives — and verify improvements with structured evaluations, not anecdotes; confirm fixes don't regress other behavior. * Own the evaluation roadmap and quality bar for the team's AI services: which metrics gate deployment, how golden sets and regression suites grow, and what "good enough to ship" means in evidence. * Use and extend the team's evaluation platform: build golden sets and regression suites, define metrics (accuracy, guideline adherence, grounding/faithfulness), run and interpret eval batteries. Fluency in \*using\* modern eval tooling matters; the platform exists — extending it thoughtfully is in scope, rebuilding it is not. * Partner with clinical reviewers (medical directors) to turn review findings into labeled evidence and executable evaluation criteria; partner with product managers to prioritize which failure modes matter most. * Mentor others in evaluation methods and grow the evals function as it scales, including readiness to take direct reports as the team expands. * Support the annual clinical\-guidelines update cycle with regression evaluation as guidelines, prompts, and models change; ramp with the team's senior data scientists in Q4 2026\. * Document the diagnostic playbook: failure taxonomies, experiment templates, variant history — a method others can run, not a private intuition. This is a practicing role — the diagnostic loop is the job, at every level of seniority. * Handle clinical data (including PHI) according to organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements. **Minimum Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field — or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of data science or applied machine learning experience, including shipping and maintaining models or AI systems in production. * 2\+ years of recent, hands\-on experience evaluating and improving LLM\-based systems: structured error analysis, prompt/configuration iteration, experiment design, metrics interpretation — as a practitioner, not only as a reviewer of others' work. * Demonstrated experience with LLM evaluation methods and tools — golden/regression sets, LLM\-as\-judge with validation, tracing and observability tooling. * Strong Python and solid data\-analysis skills (SQL a plus); comfort computing and reasoning about metrics such as sensitivity, specificity, and PPV. * Hypothesis\-driven working style: the instinct to isolate variables and prove a fix, rather than tweak and hope. * Strong written communication — findings and go/no\-go evidence must be legible to engineers, clinicians, and leadership. **Preferred Requirements** * Healthcare experience: utilization management, prior authorization, clinical documentation, or clinical/claims data; comfort reading clinical guideline and medical\-policy content. * Experience mentoring data scientists or leading small technical workstreams; interest in growing into people leadership as a function scales. * Experience working with clinical reviewers or other domain experts to convert expert judgment into labeled data and evaluation criteria. * Experience with LLM observability/telemetry stacks (OpenTelemetry\-based tracing, Logfire, Langfuse, or similar). * Statistics or experimentation background (A/B testing, statistical significance, sample\-size reasoning). * Master's degree in a quantitative field. \#EvolentAi To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. The ideal candidate thrives in dynamic, customer\-facing environments, possesses strong data engineering and analytical capabilities, and can translate complex technical challenges into scalable solutions that deliver measurable customer value. Document technical processes, integrations, and best practices to enable scalability. **What You Need** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 5\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, solutions engineering, or a related technical role. * Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience developing data transformation, validation, and automation workflows. * Hands\-on experience designing, building, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and processing large, complex datasets. * Experience integrating disparate data sources through APIs, structured data exchanges, and custom integration workflows. * Strong understanding of data modeling, data normalization, data quality management, and reconciliation techniques. * Experience working with structured and semi\-structured data formats, including JSON, CSV, XML, and relational databases. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, identify root causes, and implement scalable, sustainable solutions. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and identify meaningful insights. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Experience collaborating directly with customers or external stakeholders to gather requirements, resolve technical challenges, and deliver solutions. * Ability to operate independently in a fast\-paced environment, manage competing priorities, and balance immediate customer needs with long\-term technical scalability. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Customer Engineer, or Technical Consultant role supporting enterprise customers. * Familiarity with supply chain management, supply chain risk management (SCRM), third\-party risk management (TPRM), or supplier intelligence solutions. * Experience working with Bill of Materials (BOM), part\-level data, supplier master data, or manufacturing and procurement datasets. * Knowledge of supply chain risk factors, including critical mineral dependencies, supplier concentration, geographic exposure, and material provenance. * Experience with cloud\-based data platforms and infrastructure, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Familiarity with modern data engineering technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Airflow, or dbt. * Experience developing automated data validation, monitoring, and exception\-handling frameworks. * Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns, REST APIs, and data orchestration tools. * Experience leveraging AI/ML technologies, including large language models (LLMs), to automate data enrichment, entity resolution, or analytical workflows. * Experience supporting enterprise\-scale deployments involving complex data environments, multiple stakeholders, and evolving technical requirements. * Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance considerations when handling sensitive customer information. * Experience translating customer feedback and technical requirements into actionable product enhancements in collaboration with Product and Engineering teams. \#LI\-Hybrid Exiger is named a Leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management, twice selected as one of Fast Company's 'Brands That Matter,' and recipient of the Third Party Risk Association's Innovator Award, Exiger's technology has been recognized by leading analyst evaluations and 50\+ awards. jobs.title: Senior Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: **About Figure** Figure Technology Solutions, Inc. (Nasdaq: FIGR; OPEN: FGRS) is the leading blockchain\-native capital marketplace for the origination, funding, sale, and trading of tokenized assets. More than 480 partners use its loan origination system and capital marketplace. Collectively, Figure and its partners have originated over $30 billion of loans to date, among other products. The fastest growing components are Figure Connect, its credit marketplace, and Democratized Prime, Figure's on\-chain lend\-borrow marketplace. Figure's ecosystem also includes DART (Digital Asset Registry Technology) for asset custody and lien perfection, and $YLDS, a yield\-bearing stablecoin registered with the SEC as a security under the Securities Act of 1933\. Figure is the market leader in real\-world asset (RWA) tokenization. The company has received triple\-A ratings from S\&P and Moody's on multiple loan securitizations, the first of its kind for blockchain finance. We're proud to be recognized as one of Forbes' Top 50 Fintech Companies and CNBC's World's Top Fintech Companies. **About the Role** As a Senior Application Security Engineer at Figure, you will be pivotal in the security of our software from the first line of code through deployment. You'll own and set the direction for our application security program, build and scale our vulnerability management program, embed secure coding practices into engineering workflows, and help ensure security standards are met at every stage of the software development lifecycle. We're looking for a collaborative, hands\-on senior engineer with a strong background in reading and writing code. You'll partner closely with Engineering, DevOps, and IT to ensure our security processes are resilient, scalable, and seamlessly integrated into our workflows. **What You'll Do** * Own and evolve Figure's vulnerability management program, including triage, prioritization, tracking remediation, and reporting on risk reduction over time. * Collaborate with DevOps to integrate security gates at various points throughout the software development lifecycle, ensuring automation and repeatability of secure deployments. * Manage third\-party penetration tests, including scoping, vendor coordination, and tracking remediation of findings. * Automate sources of toil, such as routine patching or dependency upgrades. * Lead threat modeling, architecture reviews, and security design reviews for new features and services, partnering with engineering teams early in the design process. * Lead cross\-team initiatives that significantly improve our security posture while balancing speed and innovation. * Define and drive Figure's application security strategy and roadmap, including secure coding standards and security requirements for new services. * Mentor engineers across the organization and build a security champions program that scales secure development practices. * Evaluate, select, and own application security tooling and vendors. * Track program metrics and communicate application security risk to engineering and executive leadership. * Actively participate in incident response, on\-call rotations, and post\-incident reviews to continuously improve defenses. * Leverage AI to augment threat hunting, vulnerability scanning, and triage, using it to surface signal faster and reduce manual review load. * Design and build AI agents to perform in\-depth testing and analysis of our infrastructure and code. **What We Look For** * 6\-8\+ years in application security, product security, or a security\-focused software engineering role. * Strong coding ability in one or more languages used in modern web/backend development (e.g., Go, Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java/Kotlin) — enough to read unfamiliar code, build tooling and automation, and propose concrete fixes, not just file findings. * Hands\-on experience building or scaling a vulnerability management program, including triage, prioritization, and remediation workflows. * Experience integrating security tooling into CI/CD (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, IaC scanning) and tuning it for signal over noise. * Familiarity with software supply\-chain security and dependency vetting (e.g., SCA platforms, tools like Semgrep, Snyk, Socket, or comparable). * Deep knowledge of the OWASP Top 10, secure coding patterns, and common vulnerability classes, with the ability to teach them to other engineers. * Extensive experience leading threat modeling and security design reviews. * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills and the ability to drive remediation across teams without owning the code yourself. * Track record of leading application security initiatives end to end, from strategy and roadmap through rollout and measurable results. * Experience mentoring engineers and acting as a technical leader, including running or growing a security champions program. * Ability to communicate risk and tradeoffs clearly to both engineers and leadership. * Deep expertise in at least one area, such as authentication and authorization, cryptography, API security, or cloud\-native application security. * Relentless curiosity and persistence in investigating root causes and driving long\-lasting improvements. * Cloud security exposure (GCP a plus) and prior blockchain/Web3 security experience are pluses, not requirements. * Familiarity with security and compliance requirements in regulated financial services (e.g., SOC 2, PCI DSS, GLBA) is a plus. * Hands\-on proficiency with AI\-assisted security tooling and a practical sense of its strengths and limits. * Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures. * Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes. * Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team. **Salary** * Base Compensation Range: $112,320 \- $140,400/yr * 25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly * Company equity in the form of RSUs This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate's experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above. **Benefits** * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer\-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans * Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits * Employer\-paid life and disability insurance * 11 observed holidays and PTO plan * Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave * Continuing education reimbursement Depending on your residential location certain laws might regulate the way Figure manages applicant data. California Residents, please review our California Employee and General Workforce Privacy Notice for further information. By submitting your application, you are agreeing and acknowledging that you have read and understand the above notice. Figure will not sponsor work visas for this position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. \#LI\-JR1 \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Design Engineer - Embedded Hardware, Software & AI (Robotics, Energy, IoT)
jobs.description: **The interesting problem right now is connecting AI to the physical world.** Not chatbots. Agents with their hands on real things: a power supply and a debug probe on the bench, a board under test, a radio mesh across a solar field, a fleet of devices reporting to the cloud. We already work this way. Our agents drive our lab benches, flash and test boards, read a live site's history from the cloud, and help operate field sites through their gateways, with an engineer reviewing every move. We use this on real client work in alternative energy, robotics, lighting, utilities and municipal services, and we are just getting started. If this is the thing you have wanted to work on, read the rest. **Who we are** Firia is a small engineering team in Madison doing commercial product development for clients nationwide. We design the hardware, write the firmware, build the cloud, and ship it. We also make our own products: the CodeBot robot, the CodeAIR drone, the CodeX handheld and the CodeSpace platform, used by students in classrooms across the country. **What the job is** You will move across the whole stack: * **Hardware.** Schematics, PCB layout, power, RF, bring\-up and debug. Hands on the bench. * **Firmware.** C, MicroPython, wireless mesh stacks, over\-the\-air updates. Code that survives in the field. * **Software and cloud.** Python services, web dashboards, device management, internal tools. * **AI systems.** MCP servers, skills and tools that put agents to work on the bench, in the design flow and in the field. * **Clients.** You sit in the room with them, executives included, and own the technical story. **Who we are looking for** * **Hardware fluency.** EE or Computer Engineering preferred. A CS degree works if you have real hands\-on hardware experience: you read schematics, you own a scope, you were building things before anyone paid you to. We have grown CS grads into strong embedded developers and circuit designers. We cannot grow someone who is not already curious about hardware. * **Real software ability.** Comfortable from a datasheet up to a cloud service. * **AI as a tool you already use.** You know what an MCP server is, you have written skills or tools for an agent, and you have a working sense of where AI multiplies your impact. If you have wired an agent into something physical, lead with that. * **You build things, think for yourself, and say so.** If the president is about to make a bad call, say so, with evidence. * **Organized, a clear communicator, with taste.** Writing and client meetings are core technical skills here. You can tell good design from bad in a circuit, a UI or a codebase. * **Confident and humble at once.** We hire across experience levels. A recent graduate with a portfolio of things they actually built is more interesting to us than fifteen years of maintaining someone else's program. **The honest part** The pace is fast and the expectations are high. You will be closer to customers and consequences than almost anywhere else in this market. If you want real ownership early and to look back in two years at shipped products with your fingerprints on them, this may be a good fit. **Benefits** * Medical and dental (Blue Cross Blue Shield), with Firia paying half the premium. * 401(k) with a 4% company contribution, and profit sharing. * Three weeks of vacation and eight paid holidays. **Logistics** On\-site in Madison, Alabama. Hands\-on hardware and a collaborative team, so this is in person, not hybrid or remote. **To apply** Send a resume and **tell us about something you built**: a robot, a board, a tool, an agent you taught to do something useful, a weird automation that only makes sense to you. A paragraph and a link or a photo is plenty. We're far more likely to consider your application if you provide this! If the Indeed platform doesn't provide an easy way to submit something, just email us using our info@ Firia address \- we'll get it. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Health insurance * Paid time off Work Location: In person

jobs.description: Requisition ID: 50934 Business Unit: Fitch Group Category: Information Technology Location: New York, NY, US Date Posted: Nov 17, 2026 As a leading, global financial information services provider, Fitch Group delivers vital credit and risk insights, robust data, and dynamic tools to champion more efficient, transparent financial markets. This is a hands\-on technical role that bridges engineering and governance: the successful candidate will build and maintain integrations between our PAM platform (Delinea Secret Server / Delinea Platform), our IGA platform (SailPoint Identity Security Cloud), and the wider technology estate, design and implement lifecycle and access request workflows, and contribute to platform development using Python and modern tooling. business requirements into working solutions. **How You’ll Make an Impact:** * Build and maintain privileged\-access integrations with Delinea Secret Server / Delinea Platform, including vault configuration, secret lifecycle, and external\-secrets distribution. * Design, develop, and maintain integrations between SailPoint Identity Security Cloud, Delinea Platform and internal and external systems (HR platforms, cloud providers, SaaS applications, on\-premises directories), using connectors, REST APIs, and custom rules/scripts. * Govern privileged access across the estate: onboard privileged and administrative accounts into the PAM platform, enforce least\-privilege and just\-in\-time access patterns, and include privileged entitlements in access certification campaigns and break\-glass procedures. * Author Python scripts and automation to extend IGA platform capabilities: provisioning logic, aggregation customization, transformation rules, reporting pipelines, and operational tooling. * Design and implement joiner–mover–leaver (JML) workflows, access request workflows, and access certification campaigns within SailPoint, aligning them to business policy and control requirements. * Manage the full development lifecycle of IGA artefacts — version\-controlled in Git, containerized where appropriate using Docker, and deployed through structured change processes. * Operate and administer the IGA program: account onboarding, entitlement management, role engineering (RBAC), separation of duties, least\-privilege enforcement, and attestation cycles. * Maintain and develop the IGA operations portal and team\-facing tooling; Vue.js front\-end experience is a practical advantage when extending or customizing web\-based components. * Monitor platform health, integration performance, and connector status; raise and track issues with vendors or internal teams through timely resolution. * Evidence of IGA governance controls for audit engagements (e.g., SOX, Dodd Frank, SOC 2, internal audit), preparing walkthroughs, evidence packs, and remediation tracking. * Maintain technical documentation, runbooks, SOPs, and architecture diagrams; keep them current as integrations and workflows evolve. * Manage non\-human identities: service accounts, API credentials, certificates, and secrets — includ urity domains (e.g., SailPoint Certified IdentityNow Engineer, CISSP, CISM, CISA, Security\+) are beneficial but not mandatory. * Experience with Vue.js or a comparable JavaScript front\-end framework, particularly in the context of extending or building identity\-related web interfaces or portals. * Familiarity with infrastructure\-as\-code or CI/CD tooling in the context of deploying identity integrations and automation. * robust data solutions. **What does a DATA ENGINEER III do?** * Build and optimize scalable ETL/ELT data pipelines using Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Synapse, and/or Snowflake. * Set up, manage, maintain, and troubleshoot Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, and other modern data stack technologies to keep pipelines reliable and performant. * Implement data quality checks, validation rules, reconciliation, and error\-handling frameworks to ensure trusted data delivery. * Optimize Snowflake performance and cost through warehouse sizing, query profiling, clustering and caching strategies, streaming via Kafka/Event Hub (as needed). * Partner with BI teams to deliver governed datasets and models that support Power BI reporting and self\-service analytics. * Apply data governance and security in Snowflake using Snowflake Horizon, including role\-based access control, masking and row access policies, object tagging, data classification, lineage, and data quality monitoring. * Follow CI/CD, change management, version control (Git), and release practices using Azure DevOps. * Contribute to solution design, mentor junior engineers, and help drive best practices across data engineering standards. **What is required?** **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field required. **Certifications:** * Snowflake, dbt certifications * Azure/AWS certifications or data engineering certifications preferred. **Experience**: * Minimum of 8 years of experience in data engineering, ETL development, or related roles. * Advanced SQL skills and strong experience with Microsoft SQL Server at very large scale (up to petabyte\-class environments). * Hands\-on experience with Snowflake, dbt, airflow, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Synapse Analytics, and Databricks. * Strong programming skills in Python or Scala for transformation and automation. * Experience supporting production workloads, troubleshooting issues, and optimizing jobs.description: We create a place where people can grow, be their best, be safe, and feel welcome, valued and included. Discover more about our company\-wide benefits and life at GSK on our webpage *Life at GSK \| GSK* Find out more about GSK and R\&D: Our approach to R\&D **Senior AI/ML Engineer, Human Physiology Modeling** GSK is building a computational capability that models human physiology as an interconnected, multiscale system. You will also connect models across scales, from molecular and cellular to tissue, organ and whole\-body level and turn that scope into a prioritized modeling roadmap, choosing the right method for each question. Recommend sequencing based on scientific tractability, data availability and portfolio relevance. * Build, calibrate and validate multiscale models of physiological function, regulation and disease. * Define how models of different organ systems and scales interface and compose. * Integrate heterogeneous data into models: human genetics and genomics, single\-cell and spatial omics, imaging, clinical and EHR data, and published physiology knowledge. * Establish standards for uncertainty quantification, sensitivity analysis, parameter identifiability and model validation. * Write reproducible, tested, version\-controlled and containerized code that runs on GSK cloud and HPC infrastructure, in partnership with platform engineering. * Work with experimental colleagues to design studies that test or constrain model predictions. * Communicate results and their limits clearly to scientists and senior leaders. * Help hire, onboard and mentor future team members. Evangelize and enforce code\-review, documentation and modeling standards set by the group. * Track the external literature and open\-source ecosystem, and contribute or publish where appropriate. **Basic Qualifications:** **We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:** * A minimum of a BS, MS, or PhD in computational or systems biology, biomedical engineering, physics, applied mathematics, computer science or a related field. * A minimum of 4 years of experience with a PhD, a minimum of 5 years of experience with an MS and a minimum of 8 years of experience with a BS. jobs.title: Sr. Engineer, Platform Engineering (Enterprise Applications)
jobs.description: **Be the one building AI\-powered experiences where they matter most.** At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI\-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships. Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real\-world enterprise environments every day. **Role Overview:** The Senior Genesys Cloud Engineer shapes the technology behind employee\-facing HR experiences at Genesys, making it easier for employees to find information, navigate HR services, and receive timely support. Using Genesys Cloud, AI, automation, and enterprise integrations, this role influences how internal HR services scale while improving employee self\-service and service efficiency. As part of the IT Platform Development team, you will own the design and delivery of internal Genesys Cloud solutions supporting HR and People Operations. You will work closely with developers, product partners, and HR stakeholders to translate employee experience needs into reliable, scalable technical solutions while contributing technical guidance and expertise across the team. You will design and evolve Genesys Cloud Architect flows, conversational bots, workflows, integrations, and AI\-driven capabilities, connecting Genesys Cloud with ServiceNow and other HR systems. Your work will strengthen automation accuracy, containment, platform reliability, and the overall experience employees have when interacting with HR support. At Genesys, technology and empathy come together to create better experiences. This role provides exposure to enterprise AI and automation initiatives, opportunities to expand expertise across Genesys Cloud and integrated enterprise platforms, and the ability to influence engineering approaches that can scale across employee experience programs. **Key Responsibilities:** * Design and deliver scalable internal Genesys Cloud solutions that improve employee self\-service, HR support experiences, and service efficiency * Develop high\-performing Genesys Cloud Architect flows, Dialog Engine Bot Flows, and Knowledge Workbench assets that improve automation accuracy and access to HR information * Drive automation across HR service processes by building and enhancing Genesys Cloud Data Actions, Workflows, and integrations with ServiceNow and other HR systems, reducing manual effort and improving service delivery * Implement agentic AI and AI\-driven capabilities, including conversational bots, topic and sentiment analytics, predictive routing, and summarization, to strengthen automation effectiveness and employee experiences * Develop and strengthen CI/CD pipelines for flows, bots, integrations, and related assets, enabling safe, repeatable, and reliable deployments * Develop production\-quality, reusable code and scripts using modern programming technologies to improve automation, integrations, monitoring, and platform capabilities * Drive technical alignment with the product owner, manager, developers, and HR stakeholders to refine backlog priorities, assess technical effort, manage dependencies, and support achievable sprint commitments * Partner with HR and People Operations stakeholders to translate employee experience needs into clear technical requirements and scalable Genesys Cloud solutions * Lead peer reviews, testing, and release validation practices that improve solution quality, reliability, maintainability, and production readiness * Analyze flow and bot performance to identify opportunities to improve automation accuracy, containment, service efficiency, and employee satisfaction * Establish clear technical documentation for Genesys Cloud flows, bots, integrations, automation components, and deployment procedures to strengthen operational support and knowledge sharing **Required Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of experience designing and implementing contact center as a service (CCaaS), contact center automation, or comparable enterprise customer or employee experience solutions * Strong experience with AI\-driven contact center capabilities, including natural language understanding, conversational automation, and predictive routing * Demonstrated proficiency with ServiceNow or comparable enterprise workflow automation platforms * Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git\-based source control, and modern software delivery practices * Experience developing enterprise integrations using REST APIs, JSON, OAuth authentication, and related integration technologies * Proficiency in at least one modern scripting or programming language, such as Python, Node.js, or TypeScript * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving capabilities, including experience diagnosing issues across complex integrated systems * Strong co efits. **Working at Genesys** * **AI at enterprise scale** – Build, support and operate AI\-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150\+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year. * **A flexible\-first culture** – Join a global team of nearly 7,000 employees with flexible ways of working designed to help people do their best work. * **Growth in the AI era** – Build future\-ready skills through mentorship, learning programs, leadership development and education support. * **Time to recharge and give back** – Benefits include paid volunteer time, August Free Fridays, well\-being resources and regionally tailored programs for employees and their families. * **Recognized globally** – Genesys is Great Place to Work® certified in 17 countries and 94% of employees are proud to tell others they work at Genesys. jobs.title: Software Engineer II, Enterprise Server
jobs.description: About GitHub: GitHub is the world’s leading platform for agentic software development — powered by Copilot to build, scale, and deliver secure software. Over 180 million developers, including more than 90% of the Fortune 100 companies, use GitHub to collaborate, and more than 77,000 organisations have adopted GitHub Copilot. Locations: In this role you can work from Remote, United States Overview: Do you want to make software development a delight for the entire world? Join us at GitHub! We want you to help build and deliver the best end to end software development experience across GitHub. We’re looking for a highly motivated engineer to work with the GitHub Enterprise Server team. GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES) is a self\-hosted version of GitHub that provides all the features and functionalities of GitHub.com but allows organizations to host it on their own infrastructure. It is designed for companies that require enhanced security, compliance, and control over their software development processes. GHES can be deployed on various environments, including on\-premises data centers and cloud services. If you are passionate about software and systems engineering, enterprise grade infrastructure, are excited by constantly learning in an ever\-changing environment and market and above all, love to focus on customers and deliver products they love – we want to hear from you! Responsibilities: * Plan, design, code, review, and test the software platform that powers GitHub's user\-facing enterprise products. * Evaluate and recommend solutions and collaborate in team decision making. * Work closely with other Platform and Application teams to ensure we ship the highest quality Enterprise experience. * Maintain and diagnose the software as it runs in production on our customers’ on\-premises data center or cloud. * Document the systems you help build, provide feedback and code reviews to your peers in a constructive way. * Focus on the customers and last mile delivery of our products. * Work within a shared ownership model, working collaboratively with peer teams on all facets of our product. Qualifications: Required Qualifications* 2\+ years experience in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience maintaining production software coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C\+\+, C\#, Java, JavaScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, or Python + OR Associate’s Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Math, Physics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 1\+ year(s) experience + OR Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field + OR equivalent experience. * Experience writing and debugging code in Ruby, Go, or a similar programming language. * Knowledge of linux or bash script Preferred Qualifications* Experience with GitHub's underlying technology stack (resque, nomad, redis, MySQL, unicorn, etc.). * Knowledge of containerization and container orchestration * An understanding of systems monitoring and troubleshooting. * Experience building infrastructure and automation * Experience with monitoring, alerting and operations * Experience with distributed systems with high availability requirements Compensation Range: The base salary range for this job is USD $83,400\.00 \- USD $221,400\.00 /Yr. These pay ranges are intended to cover roles based across the United States. An individual's base pay depends on various factors including geographical location and review of experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant. At GitHub certain roles are eligible for benefits and additional rewards, including annual bonus and stock. These rewards are allocated based on individual impact in role. In addition, certain roles also have the opportunity to earn sales incentives based on revenue or utilization, depending on the terms of the plan and the employee's role. This position will be open for a minimum of 3 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled. jobs.title: Commercial Solutions Engineer, Texas
jobs.description: **About Glean:** Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full\-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business \- without vendor lock\-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context\-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities \- AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real\-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025\), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026\), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50\+ industries and 1,000\+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI\-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. **About the role:** As a Commercial Solutions Engineer, you’ll collaborate with Mid\-Market customers to show how Glean’s AI\-powered search uncovers critical institutional knowledge and streamlines mission\-critical workflows. Drawing on deep product mastery and a consultative approach, you’ll design and guide tailored technical solutions from initial discovery through successful deployment. **You will:** * Partner with Account Executives to navigate complex, multi\-stakeholder deal cycles with C\-level executives * Create and demo custom environments based off of customer industry and line of business * Run and manage a technical POC cycle * Perform customer facing activities including technical discovery calls * Lead security based conversations to make customers comfortable with Glean’s security posture * Work cross functionally with product and engineering to deliver customer request and be a voice of the customer * Develop ROI and business justification reports and presentations **About you:** * 5\+ years of sales engineering or solution consulting experience in a SaaS organization * Bachelor's degree in CS or a related field * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * Highly motivated, driven and self\-starting individual * Ability to work in a fast paced, team environment * Clear examples of partnering with AEs to run technical deal cycles with Enterprise customers * A consultative approach with solving your customer’s business challenges and having a track record of successfully overcoming technical and security objections * Familiarity with any cloud environment (GCP, AWS, Azure) * Proficiency in Python or Java * Ability to configure, monitor, and maintain API based integrations **Location:** * This role is remote, but must be based out of TX \- ideally in Austin. **Compensation \& Benefits:** The standard OTE salary range for this position is $160,000 \- $210,000 annually. Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including competitive compensation, Medical, Vision, and Dental coverage, generous time\-off policy, and the opportunity to contribute to your 401k plan to support your long\-term goals. When you join, you'll receive a home office improvement stipend, as well as an annual education and wellness stipends to support your growth and wellbeing. We foster a vibrant company culture through regular events, and provide healthy lunches daily to keep you fueled and focused. We are a diverse bunch of people and we want to continue to attract and retain a diverse range of people into our organization. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse company. We do not discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. \#LI\-REMOTE \#LI\-HYBRID **AI\-First Mindset at Glean:** At Glean, AI fluency is core to how we work and we're committed to ensuring every new hire feels confident integrating AI into their everyday work. **As part of the interview process, you'll complete a brief AI\-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about, design, and use AI to drive impact in your role.** Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today — prior Glean experience isn't required. **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants:** Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), or other privacy laws may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. Our full notice outlining how data will be processed as part of the application procedure for applicable locations is available in our **Privacy Policy**. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. US applicants and their applications are subject to arbitration of disputes as outlined in our **Applicant Arbitration Agreement**.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: At **Going**, we help people travel and experience the world. As a bootstrapped and profitable travel\-tech company with over 2\.5 million members, we’re building the most delightful and intelligent travel platform in everyone’s pocket. As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer at Going, you'll be a key contributor to building, scaling, and improving the systems that power our deals, alerts, price drops and new member experiences, and help more people experience the world through travel. We're looking for an experienced, product\-minded engineer who is comfortable working across the stack but brings particular strength in backend development, especially Ruby on Rails. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering to build new features, improve existing systems, and help shape technical decisions that support our long\-term growth. You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of features from conception through delivery, whether that means designing APIs, improving data models, building backend services, or contributing to the frontend experiences our members interact with every day. We're a collaborative team that values autonomy, thoughtful engineering, and pragmatic solutions. We're looking for someone who can navigate ambiguity, balance technical quality with business needs, and help elevate the engineers around them. We're also evolving how we build. AI coding agents and LLM tools are becoming a bigger part of how we work, from spec to production, and we want engineers who are excited to help shape how we use them well: with strong judgment, a high quality bar, and care for our members' data. **In the short term, you will** ------------------------------- * Get up to speed on our codebases, architecture, engineering practices, and products, and ship to production early, using AI\-assisted tools where they help you learn and move faster. * Contribute to the design, development, and delivery of full\-stack features, with an emphasis on backend systems built with Ruby on Rails. * Collaborate with cross\-functional partners in Product, Design, and Engineering to translate product requirements into scalable, maintainable technical solutions. * Design, build, and maintain APIs, database models, and backend services that support our web and mobile applications. * Contribute to frontend development using React and Next.js, helping deliver cohesive end\-to\-end experiences. * Help improve the accuracy, freshness, and reliability of the systems behind our deal, alert, and price drop experiences. * Refactor, test, debug, and improve existing systems, with an emphasis on reliability, performance, and maintainability. * Participate in technical discussions, code reviews, and architectural decisions, bringing thoughtful recommendations and helping others navigate tradeoffs. **In the long term, you will** ------------------------------ * Take ownership of complex, end\-to\-end projects, helping guide technical direction from initial design through implementation and ongoing maintenance. * Become a trusted technical resource for our Ruby on Rails applications, APIs, and the broader systems that power Going. * Help improve the scalability, performance, reliability, and maintainability of our backend infrastructure as our products and member base continue to grow. * Identify opportunities to simplify existing systems, reduce technical debt, and improve the developer experience. * Help build the internal tools, APIs, and safe, well\-permissioned access that let teams across Going (such as Member Success, Operations, and Data) automate more of their own work, with clear guardrails and human review. * Partner with engineers across teams to establish patterns, share knowledge, and advocate for engineering best practices, including how we use AI tools responsibly and the quality bar we hold AI\-assisted code to. * Mentor and support other engineers through collaboration, code reviews, technical guidance, and knowledge sharing. * Bring creative, pragmatic solutions to challenging technical and product problems, balancing long\-term sustainability with the need to deliver value to our members. * Continue growing your technical expertise while helping cultivate a collaborative, curious, and accountable engineering culture. * Be on call from time to time. **Our Values** -------------- * **Champion travelers \-** We grow by delivering measurable value to members. * **Pilots, not passengers \-** We take ownership with a bias for action, urgency, and shared responsibility. * **Bet boldly \-** We tackle ambitious problems by making data\-driven bets. * **Start simple \-** We iterate quickly to quality. * **Make it magical \-** We spark the joy of travel through thoughtful moments of surprise and delight. * **Go further \-** We push a little harder and care a little more, especially when it matters most, because effort compounds over time. **What you know** ----------------- * You’re legally authorized to work in the Unite ous communication. * **Mentorship and shared ownership:** You enjoy helping other engineers grow, sharing your knowledge, and contributing to a team where everyone takes responsibility for delivering great work. * **Resilience and accountability:** You recognize that mistakes and challenges are part of engineering. You take ownership of outcomes, learn from setbacks, and help foster a culture of continuous improvement rather than blame. **Must Have's** --------------- * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience through meaningful projects and technical contributions. * Strong professional experience developing and maintaining production applications using **Ruby on Rails**. * Experience building, designing, and maintaining RESTful APIs and backend services. * Strong knowledge of relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL, including schema design, SQL queries, and performance optimization. * Experience with JavaScript and modern frontend frameworks, preferably React or Next.js. * Experience writing automated tests, debugging production issues, and maintaining reliable applications. * Familiarity with asynchronous processing and background job systems, such as Sidekiq. * Solid understanding of software architecture, design patterns, and the tradeoffs involved in building and maintaining complex applications. * Experience working with Git, CI/CD pipelines, feature flags, and frequent, incremental releases. * Demonstrated ability to independently own complex technical projects while collaborating effectively with others. ### **Nice to have’s:** * Experience with React, Next.js, or TypeScript in production environments. * Experience with Redis, Sidekiq, and background job processing at scale. * Familiarity with AWS, Kubernetes, or cloud\-based infrastructure. * Experience modernizing legacy systems, improving application architecture, or incrementally refactoring large codebases. * Experience building and supporting APIs consumed by both web and mobile applications. * Familiarity with authentication, authorization, payment integrations, or subscription\-based products. * Experience with monitoring, observability, and performance optimization. * Experience working on consumer\-facing products, growth initiatives, or experimentation platforms. * Experience building LLM\-powered features, evaluations of AI output quality, or agent tooling (such as MCP integrations) in production. * Experience with real\-time pricing, alerting, or data pipelines. **Why you might love working here** ----------------------------------- * The salary for this role is $148,732 \+ equity * 100% remote work environment * Annual team retreats, with past destinations including Scottsdale, Washington D.C., Vancouver, and Mexico City. * Open vacation policy, with a 15\-day minimum * Comprehensive health, vision, dental, and life insurance * 401(k) with a 5% match * $750/quarter remote work, wellness, and wisdom stipend * Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave * Meetup stipend when you cross paths with a co\-worker * Continuing education \& development reimbursement * Challenging problems to solve and an awesome team to collaborate with every single day *We want you to bring your authentic self to work every single day. We accept you for who you are and consider everyone on an equal opportunity basis without regard to ancestry; age; appearance; color; gender identity and/or expression; genetics; family or parental status; marital, civil union, or domestic partnership status; mental, physical, or sensory disability; national, social or ethnic origin; past or present military service; sexual orientation; socioeconomic status; race; religion or belief; hair length; organ donor status. Going is an E\-Verify employer.* ‍*If you require a reasonable accommodation or assistance for any part of the interview and employment process, please contact us at* *careers@going.com* *and let us know the nature of your request.*

This opportunity will remain online based on business needs which may be before or after the specified date.### **Minimum qualifications:** * PhD in Laser Physics, Optics, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience in the design, implementation, and characterization of optical systems. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Deep experience working with single\-mode laser systems, such as ECDL and fiber lasers. * Experience managing vendor relationships, both for purchasing and joint technology development. * Experience with automation and remote control and monitoring of laser or other scientific systems. * Expertise in design and operation of optical systems, both free\-space and in\-fiber. * Familiarity with commercially available laser technologies, and tradeoffs between different technologies and vendors. * Understanding of quantitative measures of stability, such as RIN, phase\-noise, laser linewidth, and how to control these parameters. **About the job** ----------------- As an organization, Google maintains a portfolio of research projects driven by fundamental research, new product innovation, product contribution and infrastructure goals, while providing individuals and teams the freedom to emphasize specific types of work.
