jobs.title: Principal Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: We’re looking for talented professionals to join us in bringing smart money management and payment solutions to everyone’s fingertips. This position is classified as structured hybrid, with an expectation of three (3\) days per week working in the office and flexibility to work remotely on the remaining days. On\-site expectations may evolve over time to support business needs, with clear communication provided in advance. \<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\> **JOB DESCRIPTION** Location Requirement This position is open only to candidates who currently reside in one of the following approved locations: West Los Angeles, CA **About Green Dot** We're looking for talented professionals, anywhere in the United States, to join us in bringing smart money management and payment solutions to everyone's fingertips. Green Dot is a financial technology and registered bank holding company. Our platforms support millions of customers and enterprise partners, and they must run securely, reliably, and in compliance with banking and payment\-industry standards. **Role Overview** As a **Principal Site Reliability Engineer**, you will be the senior technical leader for reliability, release management, and database operations across Green Dot's cloud and hybrid platforms. You will set the strategy and standards for how we build, deploy, observe, and recover our services. You will own the end\-to\-end release process from code merge to production, and you will make sure our data tier (SQL Server, Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, and related data stores) is highly available, performant, and resilient. This is a hands\-on, high\-impact individual contributor role. It requires deep expertise in software and systems engineering, sound judgment in a regulated environment, and the ability to influence engineering teams across the organization. **Key Responsibilities** **Site Reliability Engineering** * Define and drive the SRE strategy, standards, and roadmap for availability, latency, scalability, and resilience across critical payment and banking services. * Establish and govern **SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets** with product and engineering stakeholders, and report on reliability KPIs regularly to leadership. * Architect and maintain highly available, fault\-tolerant infrastructure across **Azure and AWS**, including multi\-region and disaster recovery (DR) designs. * Govern and improve the observability platform (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting) with **Datadog** as the primary tool, supplemented by Prometheus/Grafana and native cloud monitoring (Azure Monitor, CloudWatch). * Lead **incident management**: act as Incident Commander for high\-severity events, run blameless post\-incident reviews (RCAs), and track corrective actions to completion. * Take part in and improve the on\-call rotation, including runbooks, alert quality, and escalation paths. * Make sure messaging and event\-driven systems (e.g., **Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ**) process messages efficiently, and monitor them for lag, dead\-lettering, and throughput. **Proactive Reliability \& Resilience** * Lead capacity planning, performance testing, and cost optimization for cloud infrastructure. * Reduce toil through automation and self\-service tooling. * Run chaos engineering, resilience testing, and DR/business continuity exercises to validate RTO/RPO targets. **Release Management** * Own the **enterprise release management process**: release planning, scheduling, release calendars, change windows, and go/no\-go decisions. * Design and implement predictable, automated deployment strategies (**blue/green, canary, rolling, feature flags**) across Dev, QA, UAT, Staging, and Production. * Architect, standardize, and maintain **CI/CD pipelines** in **Azure DevOps** and **GitHub Actions** (Jenkins where applicable), with automated testing, security scanning, and quality gates built in. * Drive **GitOps** practices (e.g., Argo CD) so that infrastructure and application deployments are declarative, version\-controlled, and auditable. * Lead **Change Advisory Board (CAB)** participation and change management, and make sure releases have the approvals, evidence, and audit trails needed for regulated environments (e.g., SOX, PCI DSS). * Define branching, versioning, and environment\-promotion strategies, and oversee rollback and hotfix procedures. * Coordinate cross\-team releases with Development, QA, Product, Security, and Operations, and communicate release status, risks, and outcomes to stakeholders. * Track and improve **DORA metrics** (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, mean time to restore). * Maintain release documentation, release notes, and post\-release reviews in **Jira** and **Confluence**. **Database Reliability Engineering** * Act as the reliability lead for the data tier: **Microsoft SQL Server, Azure SQL Database / Managed Instance, Cosmos DB**, and related stores (e.g., **PostgreSQL, Redis**). nd audits with evidence. * Evaluate emerging tools and practices, and lead adoption where they add measurable value. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * **10\+ years** of experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Release Engineering, or Infrastructure Engineering, with a record of running complex, high\-availability production systems. * **5\+ years** of hands\-on experience leading release management or CI/CD for multiple teams or services. * **5\+ years** of hands\-on database experience with **Microsoft SQL Server and/or Azure SQL**, and hands\-on experience with **Azure Cosmos DB**, including HA/DR, performance tuning, and production troubleshooting. * Deep expertise in **Azure** (required) and working knowledge of **AWS**. * Production experience with **Kubernetes (AKS/EKS)**, **Docker**, and **Helm**. * Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code and **GitOps**: **Terraform** (required), plus Ansible and Argo CD or similar. * Expertise with CI/CD tooling: **Azure DevOps** pipelines, **GitHub Actions**, and Git\-based workflows. * Expert\-level observability experience with **Datadog** or comparable platforms (logging, APM, metrics, alerting). * Strong scripting and automation skills in **PowerShell, Python, and Bash**; strong T\-SQL skills. * Experience with messaging and event bus technologies (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, or similar). * Experience running incident response, RCAs, and on\-call programs. * Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to engineers and executives. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in **financial services, banking, payments, or fintech**, including working under PCI DSS, SOX, or similar regulatory controls. * Experience with progressive delivery or feature\-flag platforms. * Experience with caching technologies (**Redis**) and PostgreSQL. * Familiarity with service mesh (Istio, Linkerd) and Kubernetes security best practices. * Experience with .NET application environments and Windows Server/IIS as well as Linux. * Certifications such as **Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate, CKA/CKAD, AWS Solutions Architect**, or ITIL. **\*\*Ability to work in the U.S. without sponsorship\*\*** **\*\*Ability to meet the location requirement outlined above\*\*** **POSITION TYPE** Regular**PAY RANGE** The targeted base salary for this position is $129,000 to $193,400 per year. The final compensation will be determined by a number of factors such as qualifications, expertise, and the candidate’s geographical location. \<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\>\<\<\>\> **We’re Here to Support You—Accommodations Upon Request** Green Dot is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible hiring experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation during any part of the application or interview process, we encourage you to let us know. We will work with you to meet your needs in a way that respects your privacy and ensures equal opportunity. Our goal is to support every applicant in showcasing their talents and potential. **Work Authorization Requirement** At Green Dot Corporation, we value diversity and strive for fair and inclusive hiring practices. However, we are currently unable to offer visa sponsorship. All applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and throughout the duration of employment, without the need for current or future sponsorship. **Important Notice on Application Accuracy** We value integrity in our hiring process. Please ensure that all information provided in your resume and application is accurate and authentic. Submissions found to be fraudulent or misleading will result in disqualification from consideration, and any offers extended may be rescinded.

jobs.title: BUILDING ENGINEER
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Responsible for the daily operation, maintenance, preventative maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of city buildings, including plumbing, electrical, mechanical, HVAC, building automation, life safety, fire protection, security and related building systems. The Building Engineer must have working knowledge of modern facility operations, including connected equipment, digital work order systems, BMS/BAS operation, trend logs, alarms, energy management tools, mobile documentation and safe coordination with outside contractors. The position requires the ability to identify abnormal conditions, respond quickly, perform hands\-on repairs where appropriate, and support reliable, safe and energy\-conscious building operation. **Essential Job Duties Under the Direction of the Chief Engineer:** **1\.** Inspect buildings, grounds, mechanical rooms, equipment and systems for unsafe, abnormal or malfunctioning conditions. **2\.** Conduct general preventative maintenance on mechanical, electrical, HVAC, plumbing and building automation systems. Work includes lubrication, adjustment, cleaning, filter changes, belt replacement, sensor checks, calibration support, consumable part replacement and periodic equipment testing. **3\.** Perform troubleshooting, diagnostics and repairs on all mechanical and HVAC equipment, including air handling units, rooftop units, split systems, pumps, boilers, chillers, cooling towers, exhaust systems, VFDs, motors, hydronic components, refrigeration circuits and related controls. **4\.** Operate, monitor and maintain the Building Management System / Building Automation System (BMS/BAS), including schedules, setpoints, alarms, graphics, trend logs, overrides, controller communication issues and basic control sequence verification. **5\.** Use BMS/BAS data, trend logs, meters, gauges, test instruments and field observations to diagnose comfort complaints, equipment faults, nuisance alarms, energy waste and abnormal system operation. **6\.** Respond quickly to emergency situations, equipment failures, leaks, environmental complaints, loss of heating/cooling, alarms and other building\-related issues. **7\.** Assist with installation, modification, replacement and commissioning support of building equipment, controls, sensors, networked devices and system upgrades. **8\.** Perform and/or oversee electrical and plumbing repair and troubleshooting within the limits of licensing, safety requirements and department procedures. **9\.** Perform and/or oversee water treatment, testing, documentation and follow\-up for boilers, cooling towers, closed loops and related systems. **10\.** Use digital work order / CMMS platforms, tablets, mobile devices, photos and electronic records to receive, prioritize, document and close out work orders accurately. **11\.** Prioritize service calls, document corrective actions, communicate status updates and follow up upon completion. **12\.** Troubleshoot, evaluate and recommend equipment repairs, service upgrades, controls improvements, energy conservation measures and capital replacement needs. **13\.** Coordinate maintenance and repair efforts with outside contractors, vendors, controls technicians, IT support and city departments when work cannot be completed in\-house. **14\.** Coordinate contractor access, tenant/user communication and management approvals for work orders requiring outside support. Maintain accurate records of contractor work, findings and recommendations. **15\.** Order parts, filters, supplies and materials as required, while maintaining stock, inventory control and proper documentation. **16\.** Work with the Chief Engineer and Building Manager in planning, budgeting and supporting annual maintenance, capital projects and equipment replacement planning. **17\.** Be responsive to occupant complaints in the areas of safety, plumbing, HVAC, mechanical, electrical, indoor air quality and environmental needs through direct contact and the work order system. **18\.** Prepare and maintain maintenance logs, equipment records, digital files, inspection documentation, BMS notes, alarm history and repair records. **19\.** Be familiar with and conform to all written operating procedures, safety procedures, lockout/tagout requirements, cybersecurity awareness practices and site\-specific building procedures. **20\.** Maintain clean, safe and professional work areas, mechanical rooms, storage rooms, shops and equipment spaces. **21\.** Perform other duties as assigned. **Technology and 2026 Work Environment Expectations:** **Ability to work in a modern, technology\-supported facility environment using BMS/BAS platforms, digital work orders, mobile devices, cloud or network\-based documentation, electronic drawings, equipment histories and remote support tools.** **Working knowledge of modern HVAC and controls\-related technology such as BACnet/Modbus communication, VFDs, VRF/VRV systems, smart sensors, connected thermostats, energy dashboards, alarming, trending and basic networked device troubleshooting.** **Ability to document work with clear notes, photos, readings, alarm history, trend captures and repair recommendations in a professional manner.** **Ability to coordinate with IT, controls contractors and equipment vendors while following department policy for passwords, remote access, network security and equipment access.** **Skills, Education and Experience:** **Minimum of 10 years of experience in building operations, engineering, HVAC, equipment maintenance, troubleshooting and repair.** **Hands\-on mechanical aptitude and ability to troubleshoot and repair building HVAC and mechanical equipment.** **Working knowledge of building mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC, controls, life safety, fire protection and security systems.** **Experience operating and maintaining BMS/BAS systems, including schedules, setpoints, alarms, trends, overrides and basic controller\-level troubleshooting.** **Ability to use computers, tablets, smartphones, digital meters, test instruments, CMMS/work order software, email and electronic documentation systems.** **Ability to read and understand blueprints, mechanical drawings, control diagrams, wiring diagrams, equipment manuals and sequence of operation documents.** **Ability to handle multiple projects, prioritize work and make sound operational decisions.** **Holds necessary and required licenses and certifications for assigned work (D2,S2 or OE2\). HVAC, refrigeration, electrical, plumbing, BMS/BAS, Building Operator, OSHA, EPA 608 or other applicable technical training is preferred where applicable.** **Completion of college, trade school, technical school, HVAC certificates, Building Operator Program coursework, engineering technical training, or building operations and maintenance training certificates preferred.** **Possession of a valid driver’s license.** **Strong customer service, communication, documentation and computer skills.** **Other Job Requirements:** **Available for emergency response and on\-call coverage as assigned.** **Able to lift 50 pounds.** **Able to climb ladders, access mechanical rooms, rooftops, equipment spaces and other building areas safely.** **Able to use required personal protective equipment and follow all safety procedures.** **Schedule:** Monday through Friday \- 8:00am \- 4:00pm **\*\*\*This is a union position covered under the applicable collective bargaining agreement.** **\*\*\*Benefits are provided in accordance with the collective bargaining agreement and include paid time off, recognized holidays, sick leave, pension/annuity/welfare contributions, training benefits, and other negotiated employment benefits.** Guardian Service Industries is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, among other things, race, religion, color, national origin, sex, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, citizenship, status as a protected veteran, or status as a qualified individual with a disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Guardian Service Industries is committed to integrity, excellence, and diversity among its employees. Our company participates in E\-Verify to confirm employment eligibility. Pay: $50\.45 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Recovery & Restoration Coordinator - Remote (Anywhere in the U.S.)
jobs.description: GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three\-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation's top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best\-fit solutions that mitigate risk. **General Description:** The Recovery \& Restoration Coordinator of is a client\-facing leader within the Recovery \& Restoration (R\&R) team, responsible for driving the successful delivery of external incident response engagements from inception through completion. This role serves as the primary point of contact for clients during active incidents; fielding questions, establishing trust, and setting clear expectations across all incident\-related matters. You will own the overall direction of containment and recovery efforts, ensuring all parties, including clients, insurance carriers, legal counsel, and internal engineering teams are aligned on objectives, timelines, and deliverables. Working in constant coordination with lead engineers executing containment and recovery strategies, you will translate technical progress into clear, actionable communication for stakeholders at every level. This is a dynamic, high\-tempo role requiring adaptability, sound judgment under pressure, and a readiness to respond at a moment's notice as part of the team's on\-call rotation. This position reports directly to the Recovery \& Restoration Manager. **About the Recovery \& Restoration Team:** The Recovery \& Restoration (R\&R) Team is responsible for responding to large\-scale cybersecurity incidents and supporting the technical remediation efforts required to restore client environments to a secure, operational state. We operate within GuidePoint Security's Digital Forensics \& Incident Response (DFIR) and Incident \& Advisory (IA) practice, serving as the hands\-on rebuild arm that brings clients back online after ransomware and other destructive cyber events. Our team of Recovery \& Restoration Engineers focuses on infrastructure rebuild, identity recovery, and environment hardening across on\-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments — including Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Azure/Entra ID, VMware, Hyper\-V, and enterprise backup platforms. We partner with DFIR forensic investigators, Threat Actor Communications, insurance carriers, legal counsel, and client IT teams to deliver rapid, secure, and defensible recovery outcomes. **Core Responsibilities:** Engagement Coordination * Coordinate multiple external, client\-facing technical projects from inception through completion, following established core processes, project templates, and methodologies * Lead Professional Services stand\-ups and team meetings, driving accountability and progress across active engagements * Collaborate on project planning, design, preparation of deliverables, timelining, and contingency planning * Interpret Statement of Work (SOW) requirements and convert them into realistic, executable project plans * Track and manage project budgets from outset through successful completion, including Time \& Materials (T\&M) scope and related time entries, confirming their validity * Employ creative measures to keep project scope contained and ensure Quality Assurance (QA) standards are met before project delivery * Outline goals, strategy, and execution plans with GuidePoint Security's engineering teams, including assisting in initial triage and establishment of access for engagement kick\-off * Leverage conflict management techniques to address disagreements and align stakeholders * Follow up with engineers on a weekly, daily, or (when necessary) hourly basis to understand the progress of assigned work and identify potential roadblocks Stakeholder Communication \& Reporting * Monitor and summarize progress of projects to stakeholders, including company leadership, finance, client contacts, and Incident Response (IR) partners * Set and conduct status meetings with client contacts, keeping them informed of progress and setting proper expectations * Lead the creation of presentations and status updates as required for large engagements * Participate in incident response on\-call rotation for incoming IR projects * Identify and escalate issues to higher\-level resources when necessary * Conduct post\-mortems to outline lessons learned and improve internal processes Problem Solving * Become an active part of project teams solving technical or business roadblocks until a resolution is reached and the outcome is personally verified * Leverage an understanding of intermediate to advanced systems configuration, management, and maintenance across the following areas: * + Microsoft technologies: Windows Server, Exchange, SQL Server, SharePoint, Active Directory, Group Policy Objects (GPO), Local Administrator ta, and memory dumps for troubleshooting + Security\-enhancing solutions for systems and applications, including Multi\-Factor Authentication (MFA) and endpoint protection **Required Experience and Education:** Experience \& Technical Knowledge * Minimum of 5 years of experience delivering IT projects in an engagement coordination capacity, with direct exposure to systems engineering, virtualization, and enterprise infrastructure environments * Demonstrated experience managing client\-facing projects as the assigned engagement coordinator, not solely as a contributing engineer * Proven track record of establishing consultative client relationships resulting in high satisfaction levels upon project closure * Working knowledge of waterfall project delivery methodologies with exposure to enterprise\-scale infrastructure environments * Familiarity with incident response workflows, containment strategies, and recovery operations * Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes Communication \& Organizational Skills * Superb written and verbal communication skills: Able to translate complex technical concepts for C\-Suite audiences as seamlessly as engaging in technical discussions with engineers * Professionally worded, grammatically precise written communications with appropriate tone and personality * Proven organizational system for keeping yourself and others on task while ensuring exceptional quality * Ability to convey energy, confidence, and genuine interest on calls while projecting competence, professionalism, and trustworthiness in person **Travel Requirements:** * Up to 25 % travel **Physical Requirements:** * Sedentary work * Substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers for a minimum of 8 hours a day * Required to have close visual acuity to view computer terminal and/or extensive reading for a minimum of 8 hours a day **We use Greenhouse Software as our applicant tracking system and Zoom Scheduler for HR screen request scheduling. At times, your email may block our communication with you. Please be sure to check your SPAM folder so that you don't miss updates on your application.** **Why GuidePoint?** GuidePoint Security is a rapidly growing, profitable, privately\-held value added reseller that focuses exclusively on Information Security. Since its inception in 2011, GuidePoint has grown to over 1,300 employees, established strategic partnerships with leading security vendors, and serves as a trusted advisor to more than 6,200 customers. Firmly\-defined core values drive all aspects of the business, which have been paramount to the company's success and establishment of an enjoyable workplace atmosphere. At GuidePoint, your colleagues are knowledgeable, skilled, and experienced and will seek to collaborate and provide mentorship and guidance at every opportunity. This is a unique and rare opportunity to grow your career along with one of the fastest growing companies in the nation. **Some added perks….** * Remote workforce primarily (U.S. based only, some travel may be required for certain positions, working on\-site may be required for Federal positions) * Group Medical Insurance options: Zero Deductible PPO Plan (GuidePoint pays 90% of the premium for employees and 70% for family plans (spouse/children/family) or High Deductible Health Plan with HSA (GuidePoint pays 100% of the employees premiums and 75% for family plans (spouse/children/family). If you choose the High Deductible / HSA plan, GPS will contribute in 4 equal quarterly installments: ($850 per EE annually / $1750 per family annually (includes spouse/children/family options) * Group Dental Insurance: GuidePoint pays 100% of the premium for employees and 75% of family plans * 12 corporate holidays and a Flexible Time Off (FTO) program * Healthy mobile phone and home internet allowance * Eligibility for retirement plan after 2 months at open enrollment * Pet Benefit Option

This team is responsible for modernizing legacy cost management processes and building the future of cost management at H\-E\-B. Engineers on the team work closely with Product Managers, business stakeholders, and other engineering teams to deliver capabilities that improve visibility into cost drivers, simplify workflows, and support major modernization initiatives, including legacy platform retirement and adoption of H\-E\-B's modern cost management ecosystem. **Location:** Austin, TX (Onsite) As a **Software Engineer II**, you’ll deliver complex code solutions. jobs.title: Principal Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: **About HG** HG Insights is the pioneer of Revenue Growth Intelligence. For more than a decade, we have delivered comprehensive, AI\- driven datasets on B2B buyers, technology adoption, IT spend, and buyer intent, sourced from billions of data points. Today, we are a trusted partner to Fortune 500 technology companies, hyperscalers, and innovative B2B vendors seeking precise go\-to\-market analytics and decision\-making. Through an evolving suite of AI agents that incorporate first\-party data and buyer signals, HG Insights enables AI\-powered GTM automation across sales, marketing, RevOps, and data analytics teams, modernizing GTM execution from strategy through activation. **About the Role** HG Insights is evolving Enterprise Customer Success into Customer Revenue Outcome Engineering. As a Principal Customer Success Manager, you will own the success of HG's largest, most strategic accounts and guide them from data\-driven GTM toward agentic and autonomous GTM, where customers buy outcomes (revenue growth and retention) delivered through agents, MCP connections and agentic mesh solutions. This is not a traditional CSM role. You are comfortable being technical, program\-minded and use\-case forward. You partner with Sales Account Managers, who own the commercial relationship, and with Forward Deployment Engineers, who build customer\-specific integrations and agentic workflows. You own the customer's outcomes: the use cases, the program that delivers them and the proof of value. **What you'll do** Own strategic account outcomes * Serve as the lead customer success owner for a book of large enterprise accounts, jointly accountable with the Account Manager for retention and expansion. * Build and run customer success plans, adoption scorecards and maturity assessments that show increasing business value over time. * Lead QBRs and EBRs that tie HG usage to the customer's revenue growth and retention goals. Drive use\-case\-led programs * Translate each customer's revenue goals into prioritized use cases across sales, marketing, SDR and RevOps, from microagents to agentic workflows and meshes. * Run each use case as a program: scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, risks and a clear definition of done. * Guide customers along the path from data\-driven to agentic to autonomous GTM, including MCP adoption and agent deployment. Partner with Forward Deployment Engineering * Shape customer projects with the FDEs, setting scope and success criteria before work starts. * Stay close to implementation, remove blockers on the customer side, and make sure what is built gets adopted. * Flag solutions that should become core platform capabilities. Advise technically and commercially * Act as a trusted technical advisor to RevOps, GTM Ops, data, AI automation and executive sponsors. * Work with Account Managers on integrated account plans, expansion pipeline and renewal readiness. * Lead workshops on data fabric, integration, and AI strategy. Be the voice of the customer * Give Product and Engineering structured feedback that influences the roadmap, AI capabilities and packaging. * Support advocacy programs, customer advisory boards and references. * Contribute to the Enterprise CS playbooks, leading and lagging indicators, and value realization frameworks as the team standardizes them. **What we are looking for** * 8\+ years in customer success, solutions consulting, technical account management or post\-sales program management, with several years owning large enterprise accounts. * Track record of retaining and expanding complex accounts with multiple stakeholders and six\- or seven\-figure ARR. * Technical fluency: APIs, data integration, CRM and marketing automation platforms, and the ability to discuss architecture with customer data and engineering teams. * Strong project management skills: you scope, sequence and deliver multi\-stakeholder initiatives on time. * Experience building value realization artifacts such as success plans, scorecards and ROI models, and presenting them to executives. * Comfort working alongside engineers and Account Managers where ownership is shared. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with AI tools, agents, MCP or workflow automation, and curiosity about where agentic GTM is heading. * Background in B2B data, intelligence or revenue technology (RevOps, sales and marketing tech). * Experience in a forward deployed, solutions engineering or outcome\-based delivery model. * Familiarity with Salesforce, Vitally, SQL or similar tools. * A systems thinker who starts with the customer's outcome, then works back to the use case and the technical path. * Credible with executives and with practitioners. * Comfortable with ambiguity in a team that is redefining its model. **What we offer/Benefits** We take care of our people fully and genuinely. Every HG Insights employee receives comprehensive healthcare coverage for themselves and their families, a monthly wellness reimbursement and access to Able To professional mental health coaching for stress, anxiety and depression support as per the regions. For your financial future, US employees benefit from a 401(k) with up to 5% company matching and UK and India employees are enrolled in a pension scheme. Every employee also receives stock options because the people who build this company should share in its success. **Equal Opportunity Employer** HG Insights is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. jobs.title: AI Engineer Team/Project Lead
jobs.description: We are looking for the right people\- people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry. **The role:** As an AI Engineering Team/Project Lead on our Data \& AI team, you will work on a project team with two other engineers, leading the work of turning real engineering and operations workflows into agents that people across Halliburton rely on every day. You will build on our established agent platform, which spans Databricks and Azure, and extend it as you go. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role with no direct reports. You will write code every day, set the technical direction for your team, and put working agents in people's hands. You lead by building, not by managing tickets or running status meetings. Success is measured by what is live and in use, not by plans and presentations. **What you'll do:** * Lead from the keyboard\- Work on a project team with two other engineers, write production code every day, and take on the hardest technical problems yourself. * Ship workflows that get used\- Lead your team in turning real engineering and operations workflows into production agents on our platform, from first conversation to daily use. * Own requirements and roadmap\- Work with business stakeholders and the people who do the work to define requirements, cut scope and keep a roadmap focused on what delivers the most value. * Set and review architecture\- Define the architecture for your team's agents, review designs and code, and hold a high bar for reliability, security and maintainability. * Connect agents to the business\- Use secure tool and data connectors (including MCP servers) to give agents governed access to Halliburton data and engineering applications. * Prove it works\- Use the platform's evaluation and tracing to show each agent is reliable, then track adoption and time saved in production. * Keep agents on track\- Build optimization routines and monitoring that catch drift, regressions and failures early, so agents keep operating as designed long after launch. * Raise the team's speed\- Make AI\-first development the norm on your team, using coding agents, shared templates and code reviews to help every engineer ship faster. * Own what you ship\- Fix what breaks and keep improving your team's agents based on real use. * Add to the platform\- When you hit a gap, contribute the template, connector or evaluation that closes it, so the next workflow ships faster. **Who you are:** * AI\-first by default\- You reach for an agent before you open a ticket. Your own workflow is already heavily automated, and you can show us how. * A builder with high agency\- You don't wait for a perfect spec. You get the smallest useful version live fast, then harden and expand it. * A leader who builds\- You earn trust through your code and decisions, not status meetings. * Allergic to repeated work\- When you see the same task done twice, you build a tool so nobody has to do it a third time. * Comfortable in the mess\- Legacy systems, messy data and shifting requirements don't slow you down. * Results over demos\- A demo is not the finish line. You measure success by evaluation results, adoption and demonstrated time savings for the business. * Fluent in business and code\- You turn business needs into a roadmap, then build it with your team. **What you'll need:** * Must have 6\+ years building and shipping production software, or equivalent demonstrated work. * Degree in Computer Science, Data Science or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. * Experience leading the technical work of a small engineering team (setting architecture, reviewing code and mentoring) while remaining a hands\-on contributor. * Track record of working directly with business stakeholders to turn ambiguous needs into clear requirements and a delivery roadmap. * Strong Python, and comfort working across the stack (APIs, services, simple internal user interfaces). * Shipped LLM\-powered agents to real users, ideally multi\-agent systems rather than single prompt chains: tool calling, RAG, structured outputs, and prompt and context engineering. * Hands\-on experience with agent frameworks and protocols (for example LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework / Semantic Kernel, OpenAI Agents SDK, Model Context Protocol) — and the judgment to know when not to use one. * Experience testing non\-deterministic systems: building eval sets, automated scoring and regression checks. * Solid engineering fundamentals: Git, automated testing, CI/CD, containers and cloud deployment. * Hands\-on Azure experience, such as Microsoft Foundry (Azure AI Foundry) Agent Service, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure Kubernetes Service or Container Apps, and Entra ID. **Nice to have:** * Databricks\- Mosaic AI Agent Framework / Agent Bricks, MLflow tracing and evaluation, Unity Catalog, Model Serving, Vector Search. * Developer tooling\- You have contributed to SDKs, internal platforms or shared libraries that other engineers use. * Total ownership\- You treat what you build as your own. You take it from idea to production and stay accountable for the outcome, not just your piece of it. * Open source\- Contributions to AI or developer tooling projects. * Energy or industrial exposure\- Helpful, not required. We will teach you the domain; we can't teach you to build. **What success looks like:** * First 30 days\- You know the platform and your team, and have agreed on the team's first workflow, its success measure and an initial roadmap with business stakeholders. * First 90 days\- Your team's first workflow is shipped and in regular use by the people it was built for, with a measured result such as hours saved. You wrote a meaningful share of the code. * First 6 months\- Your team has several workflows live and in daily use, stakeholders trust the roadmap, and the architecture and review standards you set help the team ship faster. **World Class Benefits:** At Halliburton, we're committed to providing you and your family with a comprehensive and affordable benefits package \- which means we offer support for your physical, emotional, financial and parental needs, both now and in the future. When you join our team, you'll have access to a wide range of resources designed to help you thrive at work and at home. By clicking here, you can review a summary of the benefits available once you join. **Halliburton is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.** **Location** Houston, Onsite **Job Details** **Requisition Number:** 213139 **Experience Level:** **Job Family:** Engineering/Science/Technology **Product Service Line:** Global R\&D **Full Time / Part Time:** Full\-time **Compensation Information** Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. *Please Note: This posting is intended to collect candidate information for Halliburton’s talent pool, and is not considered an application. By completing the candidate profile, recruiters will have visibility to your information in order to contact you for a future related job opportunity. In addition to providing your information on this posting, we encourage you to create a Job Alert within our career site. The Job Alert allows you to select search criteria for positions that match your interest(s). Once positions are posted that match your search criteria, you will receive an email notification.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description: **Senior Software Developer** **Independent Contractor \| Hybrid — Tucson, AZ \| Paid Development Project** **Are you an experienced software developer looking for the opportunity to create something from the ground up—and see it become a real commercial product?** Hartman Glass \& Mirror (HGM), an established specialty\-glass contractor in Tucson, Arizona, is seeking an exceptional independent software developer to lead the creation of a new, commercially marketable AI\-assisted dispatch and scheduling platform. We have the business, the operational experience, an existing technical partner, and a real\-world environment ready to test the product. **We're looking for the right developer to turn our vision into working software.** The Opportunity This is more than a typical programming assignment. You'll take a leading technical role in designing, developing, testing, and delivering an independent Windows\-based scheduling application intended for future licensing to other contractors. Our goal is a professional, reliable product that makes complex scheduling decisions easier for dispatchers. The system will analyze technician availability, skills, crew requirements, job priorities, travel considerations, customer preferences, and other scheduling constraints to recommend the **two best appointment options—with clear explanations.** The application's critical scheduling functions must operate offline. AI may provide additional assistance, but dependable optimization and practical functionality come first. What You'll Develop * A professional, intuitive Windows desktop dispatch application. * A powerful scheduling and constraint\-optimization engine. * An independent, locally hosted SQL database. * Smart job assignments based on availability, crew size, skills, workload, customer preferences, and travel. * A reliable, secure, multiuser application with backups and audit trails. * A documented API for connecting with existing business systems. * Software designed for commercial licensing, maintainability, and future expansion. Our vision is a **stand\-alone application without a mandatory cloud subscription**, capable of operating in real business environments. The Developer We're Looking For We are interested in highly capable, hands\-on developers with demonstrated experience in: * Windows desktop software development. * SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or comparable database architecture. * Scheduling algorithms, constraint optimization, or complex business logic. * Secure API development and software integration. * Offline\-capable, multiuser business applications. * Full software lifecycle development, including testing, documentation, and deployment. Experience with contractor\-management software, dispatching, field\-service scheduling, or commercial desktop products is especially valuable. **Formal credentials are welcome, but proven accomplishments matter more.** We want someone who can show us successful software they have personally developed and delivered. Work Arrangement — Hybrid / Tucson, Arizona **Most software development may be performed remotely.** Occasional in\-person meetings at our Tucson office will be needed for planning, demonstrations, workflow reviews, product testing, and important project milestones. * Day\-to\-day development may be performed remotely. * Meetings will be scheduled in advance whenever practical. * Applicants must be able and willing to attend occasional meetings in Tucson. * Meeting frequency and any applicable travel arrangements will be established before contracting. We welcome qualified developers from outside the immediate Tucson area who can accommodate these requirements. Why Work With Hartman Glass? **A real\-world development environment.** You'll have direct access to the business team responsible for using and testing the software. **Meaningful responsibility.** You'll lead the development of the new product—not simply perform isolated coding tasks. **An experienced technical partner.** You'll collaborate with our longtime software developer, who maintains our existing business systems and will lead integration changes on that side. **Direct communication with ownership.** We believe in open communication, practical decision\-making, and clearly defined responsibilities. **A paid, structured project.** We anticipate a compensated discovery/design phase followed by milestone\-based development, testing, integration, and delivery. **Commercial potential.** The finished product is intended to serve a broader contractor market, not just our own company. Compensation \& Project Structure This is a paid independent contractor opportunity. We are open to qualified developers proposing hourly or milestone\-based compensation. Scope, milestones, acceptance criteria, payments, software ownership, and source\-code/documentation handoff will be established through a mutually agreed written development contract. A reasonable mutual confidentiality agreement will be required before sharing nonpublic business or technical information. Ready to Build Something That Matters? **We are not looking for someone who only knows how to talk about AI. We are looking for someone who knows how to BUILD dependable software.** If you enjoy solving real operational problems, value quality work, and want to help bring a new software product to market, we'd like to hear from you. **Please include the following with your application:** * Examples of Windows desktop or commercial software you've personally developed. * Your experience with SQL databases, optimization, and system integration. * Your proposed approach to developing this type of application. * Your availability and hourly or milestone\-rate expectations. * Your location and ability to attend occasional meetings in Tucson. * Your approach to testing, documentation, and long\-term support. Links, screenshots, or demonstrations of publicly shareable projects are encouraged. **Hartman Glass \& Mirror \| Tucson, Arizona** *An established business. A genuine opportunity. A product worth building.* Pay: $20,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Tucson, AZ 85705

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Engineering
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- All Cost CentersResearch \& DevelopmentEngineering \& TechnologyEngineering **Compensation** ---------------- * $182,750 – $278,500 • Offers Equity We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential. 1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. **Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access.** We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work \- credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation \- is a nightmare. We've automated that. But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2\.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M\+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better. **About Agentic Engineering at Headway** Building a new mental healthcare system at Headway is only possible because of the scale and leverage that software can provide. Agentic Engineering is one of three teams in Engineering Foundations, alongside Infrastructure Engineering and Eddy, Headway's internal AI platform. Not all engineering work is interesting. We want engineers to spend less time on repetitive maintenance and more time on work for our customers. AI tools change every few months, so we do not try to own one correct way to build. We find what works and make it the easy default. We build only the Headway\-specific parts that no vendor will build for us. We measure our work by business results, not by the number of tools we ship. When product teams ship faster, Headway can do more for patients, providers, and payers. Today, our work has three parts. Every engineer uses the best AI coding tools. Agents move a change from ticket to merged pull request. Engineers get new ways to understand and review code that they did not write line by line. **Principles that Guide Us** * Focus on the mission: We view software as a means of effecting change in the world, not as an end unto itself. We write software to empower our patients and therapists to better solve the problems they're facing. * Ship small, learn fast: We are building new and novel products and believe that we learn what our users need by quickly shipping and iteration. * Everything is a product: Whether it's our patient search experience or a developer productivity improvement, we treat everything we build at Headway as a product with end\-users in mind. * Optimize for trust: We believe that engineers should be continually learning. To learn effectively and to be productive, engineers must feel safe asking questions and discussing mistakes. **About this role** Help Headway's engineers go fast and have a blast as AI agents write more of the code. Find what slows product teams down, and build the agentic tools and habits that fix it. You will be a senior engineer on Agentic Engineering. Your users are other Headway engineers. You will work closely with the product teams that build for patients, providers, and payers. You will not wait for requests. You will go to the teams, start the conversation, and find the large themes behind their problems. Start with a business goal. For example, if Headway wants more patients on the platform, talk to the patient team. Find what slows them down, and help them go faster. The fix can be an agent workflow for a manual task that a team does every week. It can be context that teaches agents one part of our codebase. Sometimes a team only needs a tool that we already built. Then your job is to show the tool to them and help them use it. Some of the work is building. Some of it is teaching: demos, show\-and\-tells, and short guides that other teams can use. We measure your work by how much faster the teams around you ship, not by how much code you write. You will also help decide what our team builds next. **What you'll own** * **Product team partnerships.** Work with product teams to find the delays that cost the bu nding.** Help engineers understand code that agents write. Find new ways to explain, review, and show changes. * **Impact measurement.** Connect each tool to a business result. Measure throughput, time saved, and adoption. Stop work that does not show results. * **Team operations.** Share on\-call, code review, design review, and interviews with the team. **Tools we use** Cursor, Claude Code, and other AI coding agents · Eddy (our internal AI platform) · Python 3, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Temporal, Celery · TypeScript, React · Postgres, Redis · AWS, Terraform · Datadog · GitHub, Buildkite **Who you are** You are a senior engineer who uses AI to build every day. You use tools such as Claude Code or Cursor in your own work, and you made your own workflow better with them. For every project, you first ask who the customer is and what problem you solve for them. Your users are other engineers, and you go to them. You do not hesitate to message an engineer that you have never met. You are comfortable when the best answer changes every few months. When a better tool becomes available, you replace your own tool with it. **Experience we're seeking** * You have 5 or more years of software engineering experience, much of it on backend systems, platforms, internal tools, or developer tools. * You built internal or developer tools, and you got an organization to adopt them. You can explain how you got that adoption and how you measured it. * You built something real with LLMs or coding agents. You know where they fail, and you used evals, guardrails, or human checks to control those failures. * You write strong backend code in a large production codebase. Python is a plus. * You changed how a team works without being its manager. You did this through close partnership, trust, and changes based on feedback. **Nice to have** * Agent frameworks, workflow engines, or orchestration (Temporal or similar) * Context and retrieval systems, or LLM evals * CI/CD and test infrastructure * Teaching or enablement, such as workshops, internal guides, or champions programs * Experience in healthcare or another regulated domain **You'll love this role if you want to** * Help decide how a full engineering organization builds software with agents * Work each week with the engineers who use what you build * See a team change how it works because of something you showed them * Do work that helps make mental healthcare accessible and affordable **Comprehensive benefits:** --------------------------- Medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k) including match for 2027!, Carrot Fertility reimbursement, and paid parental, medical and caregiver leave. We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Headway is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Headway will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview. Headway participates in E\-Verify. A notice to Headway applicants: To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that Headway only accepts applications through our official careers page at https://headway.co/careers. Headway will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. All official communication will come from a @findheadway.com email address. If you are contacted by someone claiming to be from Headway via an unofficial channel, please do not share any information and report it as spam.

jobs.title: Senior Ai Engineer
jobs.description: Senior AI Software Engineer About Us Health Data Analytics Institute (HDAI) is a commercial\-stage HealthTech company. Our Intelligent Health Management System, HealthVision™, is a first\-in\-class enterprise solution leveraging real\-time predictive analytics and generative AI to deliver improved outcomes, efficiencies, and economics for health systems and value\-based care organizations. HDAI is located in Dedham, MA near the Dedham Corporate Center Commuter Rail station on the Franklin/Foxboro line (25 minutes from Back Bay and South Station, Boston) and I\-95/128\. Summary We are hiring a Senior AI Software Engineer to join our Product Engineering team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between Data Science and production software by owning our full AI/ML backend. This includes a high\-throughput predictive inference engine (scoring 580\+ patient risk models in real time) and generative LLM pipelines on Amazon Bedrock (powering clinical summaries and diagnostic discovery). You will work across the entire backend stack as priorities shift, developing deep domain expertise while ensuring complete system coverage. We expect you to use AI tools daily to multiply your output. Responsibilities * **Inference engine.** Own the system that scores patients against hundreds of predictive models in production. Understand the scaling concerns (580\+ models, memory pressure, compute efficiency) and drive architectural improvements. * **ML productization.** Work with Data Science to take model artifacts (coefficient files, scoring logic built in R) and ensure they run correctly in the production Python inference pipeline. Understand the underlying model logic and statistical outputs well enough to validate data and parity between the R development environment and production output. Build tooling that automates validation and reduces the manual reimplementation cycle. * **LLM applications.** Build and maintain production LLM integrations on Amazon Bedrock (Claude) for AI summaries, PDD, and conversational interfaces. Manage prompt lifecycle: design, versioning, testing, and evaluation. Handle the specific challenges of LLM applications in production: token management, output validation, evidence citation, structured output parsing, and graceful degradation. * **Production AI engineering.** Build and maintain production Python services on AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, S3\). Work across the existing stack including FastAPI and legacy services during migration to serverless. * **Evaluation and quality.** Build testing and evaluation frameworks for both model inference and LLM outputs. Define what “correct” means for AI\-generated clinical content in collaboration with Clinical and Data Science teams. Write tests for critical paths. Monitor production output quality and catch regressions. * **Cross\-functional collaboration.** Partner with Data Science on model release planning, validation, and new prompt development. Work with Platform Engineering on deployment infrastructure. Collaborate across the full Product Engineering team on features that span frontend and backend. Qualifications **Required:** * 7\+ years of experience as a software engineer, ML engineer, or AI engineer building production systems. * Strong Python proficiency for production service development. * Experience building and operating services on AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS, S3\) or equivalent cloud platforms. * Experience in at least one of these areas, with willingness to grow into the other: ***ML engineering:*** taking model artifacts from data science and deploying them to production. You understand model scoring, feature engineering, and what it takes to validate that a production implementation matches the original model. ***LLM engineering:*** building production LLM applications (not just prototypes). You have worked with model APIs (Bedrock, OpenAI, or similar), designed prompt architectures, and handled the failure modes of generative AI in production. * AI\-native engineering practice. You use AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar) as a core part of your daily workflow. * Comfort with ambiguity. Requirements evolve as we scale to new health system partners; you make sound decisions with incomplete information. * Clear written and verbal communication. **Preferred:** * Experience across both ML engineering and LLM engineering (see above). * Experience with Amazon Bedrock or similar managed LLM services. * Experience with R or familiarity reading R code (our data science team works in R). * Experience with model serving at scale (hundreds of models, multi\-tenant environments). * Healthcare or regulated industry experience. * Experience building evaluation/testing frameworks for AI system outputs. * Experience with FastAPI, event\-driven architectures (SQS, SNS), or serverless patterns. * Familiarity with Terraform and infrastructure\-as\-code. Equal Opportunity HDAI is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Pay: $160,367\.00 \- $185,457\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Dedham, MA 02026

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer, Beacon Platform
jobs.description: **About Hirebotics** Hirebotics builds turnkey collaborative robot systems for welding, cutting and painting, used by metal fabricators and manufacturers across the country. Our Beacon platform is the software that drives these systems. It's how customers program, run and manage their robots. We're a small team, so the code you write ships to real robots on real shop floors, and you'll see the results. **The role** We're looking for an early\-career developer to join the software team and work directly on the Beacon platform and our robot applications. This is a good fit for a recent graduate or someone with a year or two of experience who wants real ownership and wants to learn fast. We are an AI\-first team. We use AI coding tools every day to design, write, test, and debug software, and we're looking for people who already work that way. We care less about which tool you've used and more about whether you reach for AI by instinct, know how to steer it, and can judge whether its output is good. **What you'll do** * Build and maintain features across the Beacon platform using TypeScript, React, and Node * Work on the robot applications that connect Beacon to our welding, cutting and painting systems * Use AI tools throughout your workflow to move quickly while keeping code quality high * Write tests, review code and help improve our development practices * Work closely with engineering, product, and field teams to solve real customer problems * Spend time with the hardware, so you understand how your code behaves on an actual robot **What we're looking for** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field * Hands\-on experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, React, and Node * A portfolio of school or side projects where you used AI to help build the software. Be ready to show us the work and walk us through how you used AI to get there * Comfort with Git and modern development workflows * Curiosity, a willingness to learn hardware and manufacturing concepts, and good communication skills **Nice to have** * Experience with ROS (Robot Operating System) * C\+\+ experience * Experience with cloud platforms and tools (AWS, GCP, Azure, Docker, CI/CD) * Robotics, embedded or hardware projects, whether from school, competitions or personal builds **Work arrangement** This is mainly an in\-office role at our Nashville location, since a lot of the work involves the robots themselves. Remote days are available when the work allows. Pay: $70,000\.00 \- $90,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) 4% Match * AD\&D insurance * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Prescription drug insurance * Vision insurance Location: * Nashville, TN 37211 (Required) Ability to Commute: * Nashville, TN 37211 (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Electrical-Automation Engineer
jobs.description: **Electrical / Automation Engineer** ==================================== **Location:** Greenville, South Carolina **Employment Type:** Long\-Term Contract (12 Months with Potential Extension) **Schedule:** Full\-Time \| Onsite \| Monday–Friday **Travel:** Approximately 30% **Help Bring Advanced Manufacturing Technology to Life** -------------------------------------------------------- Are you an experienced Electrical\-Automation Engineer who enjoys taking projects beyond the drawing board and seeing equipment come to life on the production floor? We are partnering with a well\-established global manufacturing organization seeking an Industrial Electrical\-Automation Engineer to support equipment modernization, automation improvements, and the implementation of new manufacturing technologies. This position offers the opportunity to work on complex industrial systems, collaborate with experienced engineering teams, and play an important role in delivering successful equipment installations and production startups. The ideal candidate combines strong electrical controls knowledge with practical experience in PLC programming, industrial equipment integration, and manufacturing project execution. **Role and Responsibilities** ----------------------------- In this role, you will help deliver engineering solutions that improve manufacturing capabilities, equipment reliability, and operational performance. **Responsibilities:** * Develop, review, and improve electrical control systems for industrial manufacturing equipment. * Work with PLC\-based automation systems, operator interfaces, motor controls, and industrial networks. * Coordinate technical activities associated with new equipment installations and existing system upgrades. * Support equipment testing, commissioning, troubleshooting, and production startup. * Collaborate with equipment manufacturers, contractors, maintenance teams, and plant engineering personnel. * Review electrical drawings, control schematics, equipment specifications, and technical documentation. * Assist with engineering estimates, project timelines, equipment procurement, and installation planning. * Identify technical issues and work with project teams to implement effective solutions. * Ensure automation equipment meets established electrical, operational, and safety requirements. * Provide technical guidance to plant personnel following equipment implementation. **Qualifications** ------------------ We are interested in engineers who have worked directly with industrial automation systems in manufacturing environments. **Key qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Electromechanical Engineering, or equivalent technical experience. * Practical experience with industrial electrical controls, automation, and PLC\-based equipment. * Working knowledge of Allen\-Bradley / Rockwell PLC systems and programming. * Experience interpreting or developing electrical schematics using CAD\-based engineering tools. * Familiarity with motor drives, variable frequency drives (VFDs), HMIs, and industrial communication networks. * Experience supporting manufacturing equipment installations, modifications, or commissioning activities. * Ability to coordinate engineering activities and communicate effectively with technical teams and equipment suppliers. * Strong troubleshooting abilities and a hands\-on approach to solving complex equipment problems. **Nice To Have** ---------------- Candidates with any of the following backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply: * Siemens PLC systems, including TIA Portal or Step 7\. * Electrical design using EPLAN, SEE Electrical, or AutoCAD Electrical. * FANUC, Yaskawa, or other industrial robotic systems. * Automated conveyors, material\-handling equipment, automated storage systems, or AGVs. * Motion control, servo drives, industrial sensors, or machine vision systems. * Capital equipment projects involving engineering, procurement, installation, and startup. * Experience working with equipment suppliers and coordinating industrial installation projects. **What Makes This Opportunity Interesting?** -------------------------------------------- This is not simply a maintenance or troubleshooting position. You'll have the opportunity to participate in significant manufacturing engineering projects, working with modern automation technologies and helping introduce new equipment into active production environments. The position is based in Greenville, SC, and requires onsite collaboration with engineering and manufacturing teams. Some travel and occasional weekend or holiday support may be necessary during equipment installations and scheduled plant shutdowns. **Interested in Learning More?** -------------------------------- If you have a strong background in industrial controls and enjoy combining engineering expertise with real\-world manufacturing projects, we'd like to hear from you. Apply today for a confidential conversation about this opportunity.

enterprise endpoints. * Strong proficiency in automation and scripting, including PowerShell and REST APIs, to scale EPM, Idira, and IAM operations. * Hands\-on experience with Endpoint Privilege be able to work effectively in a group environment and maintain positive relationships with team members and clients * Organized and detail\-oriented with excellent interpersonal skills * Proficiency
