jobs.title: Senior AI-Native Engineer
jobs.description: **About the company** --------------------- Marshall Reddick Real Estate is an established real estate investment firm headquartered in Newport Beach, CA in business since 1979, with hundreds of employees. We're a vertically integrated real estate syndicator with investment funds, and we make our money owning real estate. Our business spans brokerage, property management, private lending and investment funds, with offices in California, Texas, Tennessee and Florida. We will never sell software, but we're very tech\-forward in how we run the business. We're hiring a senior AI\-native engineer to turn our product ideas and prototypes into production software and help form and shape our software department. Learn more at marshallreddick.com. We don't build software to sell. We build it to run our business. We use best\-in\-class third\-party platforms where they fit and build our own where they don't, and we're agnostic about the tool as long as it's the right one for the job. The roadmap is large and growing, and most of it is connecting, automating and getting more out of third\-party software through API integrations and MCPs. We are moving from a traditional software development lifecycle to a model where AI agents write, test and review code, and engineers direct, verify and approve the work. ### **The Role** You write, test and ship production code with AI agents every day. You work directly with our CEO and our forward deployed engineer, who set product direction and design. You own how it's built and getting it to production. **Who thrives here:** an energetic, passionate builder who loves investing and loves building with talented people. You'd rather ship than talk about shipping, you take ownership past the point where most people stop, and you pour real energy into the work. This is an intense, high\-output role with high upside, not a 9\-to\-5, Monday\-to\-Friday job. If you want a steady job you can coast in, this isn't it. * **Type:** Full\-time employee. Not consulting, not a contract, not fractional. * **Reports to:** CEO, working day to day with our forward deployed engineer * **Team:** You'll work alongside a product manager and a small engineering team. No direct reports. * **Time split:** about 80% building and 20% code review and helping teammates use AI tools. The work is 60% integrating and automating third\-party platforms and 40% building new software * **Location:** Newport Beach, CA. In office preferred, open to hybrid, not a remote role. ### **What You'll Do** * Rebuild our core website pages first: Mortgages, the Loan Application, the Investment Fund page and Homes for Rent * Connect HubSpot to our core systems, working with our HubSpot implementation partner * Finish the rest of the website * Automate property management and lending workflows across AppFolio and Lendr * Build small internal tools that help employees work faster * Improve operational efficiency and user experience in our existing software platforms * Move us to production releases every 2 weeks within 60 days of start date * Move us to weekly production releases within 120 days of start date * Build the AI cross\-model pipeline: specs first, tests before code, code by one model, review by another * Choose and migrate us to agent\-friendly code hosting, CI/CD and task tracking * Own architecture, security, code quality and production releases; business owners approve specs * Take prototypes from our product team to production * Work with outside partners, such as our HubSpot implementation partner, on integrations; build custom MCP servers for our third\-party platforms; and keep the stack current as models and tools improve ### **Building Our Agentic Stack** We're moving to an agentic tech stack, and this role leads that move. We're open to any products and tools, and we want you to help us choose them and build it with us. Today we run on Confluence, Jira, GitLab, a legacy PHP CRM, a React/TypeScript website and portals, and AWS. That's what we're moving away from. You'll integrate with platforms including HubSpot, AppFolio (Property Manager and Investment Manager), Lendr, DocuSign, SkySlope, and RingCentral, moving to Zoom. The new stack needs to cover: * Task tracking * Code hosting and CI/CD * An AI coding workbench * Models from more than one AI vendor * Testing * Error tracking and AI bug triage * Product usage analytics * A team hub * AI access to our business systems, read\-only for financial systems * Hosting You'll have real say in the tools, as long as the result stays AI\-first and cross\-model, with more than one model vendor writing, testing and reviewing code. ### **What You Need** * You have shipped production code built with AI agents in the last 6–12 months, and can show it * Integrating third\-party platforms through their APIs and webhooks, building custom MCP servers for them, and migrating data between systems cleanly * Finding operational efficiencies: automating manual work across departments, often with software we already pay for * Daily use of agentic coding tools * Experience with more than one model vendor, and a clear view of when to use which * Tests\-first habits and frequent small releases with CI/CD gates and feature flags * Comfortable in legacy PHP and modern React/TypeScript; AWS fundamentals * Track record of getting work all the way to production, not just built, with security fundamentals for apps that handle sensitive financial and investor data * Explains technical tradeoffs in plain English to a non\-engineer CEO, including when to buy instead of build **Nice to have:** MCP servers or team\-chat automations; error tracking, product analytics and automated testing tools; financial systems such as lending, payments or investor reporting; helping a team adopt AI tools; real estate, proptech or fintech. ### **Compensation** $200,000 base salary plus an annual performance bonus of up to $50,000, with new bonus targets set each year. Full benefits: health, dental, vision, 401(k) and PTO. Company\-paid AI tool subscriptions. Eligible to co\-invest in the company's real estate investments employee shares. ### **Our Hiring Process** We value what you've built and shipped just as much as your professional experience. Our hiring process is designed to evaluate your technical capabilities, approach to AI\-driven development, and alignment with our team. We value what you've built and shipped just as much as your professional experience. Our hiring process is designed to evaluate your technical capabilities, approach to AI\-driven development, and alignment with our team. **Here's what you can expect:** * **Initial Screening:** Be prepared to share an example of something you've shipped using AI agents within the last 6–12 months. * **Interview Process:** Meet with our forward deployed engineer, CEO, and an independent technical reviewer. * **Paid Work Trial:** Ship one real ticket through our engineering pipeline over the course of three days. * **Final Interview \& References:** Meet with our engineering team and complete reference checks. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Autonomy Controls Engineer
jobs.description: May Mobility is transforming cities through autonomous technology to create a safer, greener, more accessible world. Based in Ann Arbor, Michigan, May develops and deploys autonomous vehicles (AVs) powered by our innovative Multi\-Policy Decision Making (MPDM) technology that literally reimagines the way AVs think. Our vehicles do more than just drive themselves \- they provide value to communities, bridge public transit gaps and move people where they need to go safely, easily and with a lot more fun. We're building the world's best autonomy system to reimagine transit by minimizing congestion, expanding access and encouraging better land use in order to foster more green, vibrant and livable spaces. Since our founding in 2017, we've given more than 500,000 autonomous rides to real people around the globe. And we're just getting started. We're hiring people who share our passion for building the future, today, solving real\-world problems and seeing the impact of their work. Join us. **Job Summary** =============== As a member of the behavior and controls team, you are responsible for helping May deliver a safe, smooth, comfortable ride. Within the behavior team, you help drive the design and delivery of control policies that enable core vehicle capabilities, ranging from vehicle following, lane change, and more. You collaborate with our Autonomous Driving Kit (ADK) team to maintain our interfaces to the actuators that control the vehicle. Alongside our localization engineers, you maintain the vehicle dynamics models that estimate how our vehicles move through the world and provide feedback to our controls modules. **Essential Responsibilities** ============================== * Work with cross functional teams to develop software and system requirements * Participate in team code quality activities including design and code reviews * Coordinate with cross functional teams to develop software and system requirements for Autonomous Vehicle behavior and controls subsystems * Participate in team quality activities including design review, code review, and documentation of Autonomous Vehicle subsystems * Collaborate with data science team members to design and implement metrics capturing key performance indicators of Autonomous Vehicle control subsystems * Develop and test state\-of\-the\-art software in C/C\+\+ to enable comfortable and safe behavior and control for Autonomous Vehicles * Develop unit and simulation tests to validate vehicle performance across target operational domains * Coordinate and execute on\-vehicle tests to validate performance of Autonomous Vehicle software in real\-world scenarios * Diagnose and root\-cause issues reported by commercial operations through the May Field Response process **Skills and Abilities** ======================== *Success in this role typically requires the following competencies:* * Strong ability to decompose complex tasks into simpler sub\-components * Foundation in the scientific method and being data\-driven in decision making * Comfort engaging in areas outside of core area of expertise (e.g. when defining cross\-system requirements) * Clear and concise technical communication **Qualifications and Experience** ================================= *Candidates most successful in this role typically hold the following qualifications or comparable knowledge or experience:* ***Required*** * 3\+ years demonstrated experience working on real\-world robotic systems \- in a lab, in industry, etc. * Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineer, or a field that requires a strong mathematical and/or engineering foundation (e.g. physics, aerospace engineering) * Experience developing and deploying capabilities for robot perception, localization, behavior, path planning, and/or vehicle control * Strong programming skills in C/C\+\+ * Expertise with software development in a Linux environment * Familiarity with standard development tools such as git, valgrind, and gdb ***Desirable*** * Master's or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, or Computer Engineering (or other relevant field) Strong background demonstrated through high quality capability deliveries to robots working in the field in any of the following areas: perception, intent prediction, machine learning (applied to robotic problems), behavior development, planning, optimization, sensor processing and fusion, and vehicle control. * **Physical Requirements** ========================= * Standard office working conditions which includes but is not limited to: * + Prolonged sitting + Prolonged standing + Prolonged computer use * Travel required? \- Moderate: 11%\-25% **Benefits and Perks** * Comprehensive healthcare suite including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability plans. Domestic partners who have been residing together at least one year are also eligible to participate. * Health Savings and Flexible Spending Healthcare and Dependent Care Accounts available. * Rich retirement benefits, including an immediately vested employer safe harbor match. * Generous paid parental leave as well as a phased return to work. * Flexible vacation policy in addition to paid company holidays. * Total Wellness Program providing numerous resources for overall wellbeing Don't meet every single requirement? jobs.title: Full Stack Solution Engineer
jobs.description: McKesson is an impact\-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well\-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. **Job Summary** =============== We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Full Stack Solution Engineer** to design, develop, and modernize scalable software solutions within McKesson Medical Surgical's Data \& Advanced Analytics (DAAA) organization. The role will work across the full application stack, with a strong focus on **Python, React, APIs, cloud\-native development, and modern software engineering practices**. The engineer will also play an important role in the upcoming **migration and modernization of DAAA applications onto Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**. We are increasingly adopting **AI\-assisted and agentic software development practices**, so we are particularly interested in engineers with experience using AI coding assistants, coding agents, or agentic development workflows to accelerate software delivery while maintaining appropriate engineering standards and human oversight. **Job Responsibilities** ======================== * Lead the end\-to\-end design, development, testing, deployment, and support of full\-stack applications. * Develop modern web applications using technologies such as **React, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, and REST APIs**. * Design and implement secure, scalable back\-end services, APIs, and microservices using modern architectural patterns. * Design intuitive, responsive, and accessible user interfaces using contemporary front\-end frameworks. * Play an active role in the **migration and modernization of existing applications to Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, including application assessment, refactoring, target architecture, testing, cutover, and post\-migration support. * Identify opportunities to modernize legacy or low\-code solutions as scalable web applications or using appropriate **GCP\-native services**. * **AI\-assisted and agentic coding practices** across the software development lifecycle, using coding agents and AI development tools to assist with areas such as requirements analysis, implementation, testing, code review, documentation, and application modernization. * Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, architects, data scientists, QA, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into effective technical solutions. * Design and manage relational and/or NoSQL data solutions, ensuring appropriate performance, security, reliability, and scalability. * Participate in code and architecture reviews and ensure adherence to engineering standards, security requirements, and development best practices. * Build and maintain automated **CI/CD pipelines**, testing, code\-quality controls, and deployment processes. * Troubleshoot complex application and production issues, identify root causes, and implement sustainable solutions. * Contribute to the continuous improvement of DAAA development standards, reusable components, development tooling, and engineering practices. * Evaluate emerging technologies, particularly across **cloud, AI, automation, and agentic software engineering**, and assess their applicability to DAAA solutions. **Job Qualifications** ====================== * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * **4\+ years of professional software engineering experience**, with significant experience designing and delivering production full\-stack applications. * Strong hands\-on experience with **Python** and modern Python frameworks such as **FastAPI, Flask, or Django**. * Strong experience with **React** and modern **JavaScript/TypeScript**, HTML, and CSS. * Strong understanding of API design, including **RESTful APIs**, authentication/authorization, integration patterns, and microservices. * Experience with relational databases such as **PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or MySQL**, with familiarity with modern data and analytics platforms such as **Databricks, Snowflake, or Google BigQuery**. * Practical experience developing or deploying applications on **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, or significant experience with another major cloud platform combined with the ability to transition to GCP. * Experience with cloud and container technologies such as **Docker and Kubernetes**, and familiarity with cloud\-native application architectures. * Experience with **Git/GitHub, CI/CD, automated testing, code\-quality tooling, DevSecOps practices, and Agile delivery**. * Ex ives is highly desirable. * Strong problem\-solving, analytical, and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering, product, architecture, data, and business teams. * Ability to operate independently while contributing effectively within a distributed engineering team. **Nice to Have** ================ * Experience migrating applications from **Azure to GCP**. * Experience with GCP services and technologies such as **Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud SQL, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, IAM, Vertex AI, Gemini, or Looker**. * Experience modernizing **Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, or other low\-code/automation solutions** into cloud\-native or full\-stack applications. * Experience with **AI agents, MCP, agent orchestration, tool calling, coding\-agent workflows, or multi\-agent development patterns**. * Experience with observability, automated testing, security scanning, and production application support. jobs.title: Platform Engineer I
jobs.description: **Take your career further with McLane!** McLane teammates, the driving force behind our success, are diverse professionals who work together seamlessly to keep our operations running smoothly. As a teammate, you will pair your dedication, expertise, and collaborative spirit with your fellow teammates to serve America's most beloved brands. McLane leaders think long\-term, act with purpose, and inspire high performance. They lead with accountability, communicate clearly, and drive results through collaboration, innovation, and continuous growth. They empower each teammate to learn from industry leaders, develop their skills, and build lasting connections nationwide. As a Platform Engineer I, you will support the availability, reliability, and performance of enterprise platforms that power a global digital supply chain. Assist in the implementation, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting of platform technologies, working under the guidance of senior platform engineers and administrators. Maintain the stability of cloud and on\-premises environments, participate in incident resolution, supports deployments, and follow established operational procedures. Responsible for maintaining platform configurations, assisting with updates and patches, performing routine checks, validating system health, supporting automation initiatives, and ensuring environments are running efficiently and securely. Develop hands\-on skills and technical depth while contributing to scalable, resilient platform operations. This is a hybrid position which will require the candidate to report and work from the office at least three days a week. Therefore, interested candidates should be within a 50\-minute radius from Temple, TX. **Benefits you can count on:** * Day 1 Benefits: medical, dental, and vision insurance, FSA/HSA, and company\-paid life insurance. * Paid time off begins day one. * 401(k) Profit Sharing Plan after 90 days. * Additional benefits: pet insurance, maternity/paternity leave, employee assistance programs, discount programs, tuition reimbursement program, and more! **What You'll Do** * Assist with the configuration, administration, and support of enterprise platforms, including cloud services, middleware, integration platforms, and infrastructure tools. * Monitor platform performance, capacity, and health, escalating issues to senior team members as needed. * Perform routine maintenance tasks such as patching, updates, log review, configuration validation, and scheduled system checks. * Support incident resolution by gathering logs, identifying basic issues, testing fixes, and contributing to root\-cause reviews. * Execute standard operating procedures for deployments, configuration changes, and environment updates under direction from senior engineers. * Assist with access requests, role provisioning, and security configuration tasks in alignment with platform controls and governance requirements. * Participate in platform monitoring, alert triage, and service\-health reporting to ensure system stability. * Help maintain platform documentation including configurations, operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles. * Collaborate with engineering, development, security, and infrastructure teams to ensure platform readiness for releases and project requirements. * Support application teams by validating platform availability, environments, and service connectivity during deployments or testing cycles. * Assist with automation tasks and scripting to improve operational efficiency and reduce manual work. Follow change management, incident management, and operational support processes with accuracy and consistency. Contribute to continuous improvement activities by identifying recurring issues or opportunities for optimization. Learn and apply new tools, technologies, and methods to strengthen platform engineering skills and support evolving business needs. * Perform other duties as assigned **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's degree in information systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field; or equivalent practical experience. * Familiarity with platform administration, system operations, cloud services, or infrastructure support concepts. * Basic understanding of operating systems, networking fundamentals, platform monitoring tools, and troubleshooting approaches. * Ability to follow documented procedures accurately and escalate issues appropriately. Strong communication, attention to detail, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work collaboratively across technical teams and contribute in a structured engineering environment. * Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure or GCP. * Basic scripting experience (e.g., PowerShell, Python, Bash). Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automation tools, or container platforms. * Experience with ticketing systems and operational support workflows. Internship or project experience in platforms, infrastructure, or systems engineering * This position requires the ability to read, write, and understand English at a level sufficient to perform job\-related tasks effectively and safely. This includes understanding work instructions, safety protocols, and communications essential to the role. The requirement is directly related to the nature of the job and ensures compliance with workplace safety and operational standards **Fit the following? We want you here!** * Work on enterprise platforms that directly support and enable our HR and people strategies * Partner with experienced HR and IT leaders who value collaboration and innovation * Make a visible impact by owning and improving systems used across the organization * Grow your career in a stable, people\-first company with a strong commitment to technology and continuous improvement **Our roadmap. Our story.** We've been forging our path as a leader in the distribution industry since 1894\. Building an expansive nationwide network of team members for 130\+ years has allowed us to stay agile for our clients across the restaurant, retail, and e\-commerce industries. We look to the future and are ready to continue making industry\-defining moves by embracing the newest technology into our practices, continuing team member training, and emphasizing our people\-centered culture. Candidates may be subject to a background check and drug screen, in accordance with applicable laws. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran. For our complete EEO and Pay Transparency statement, please visit https://www.mclaneco.com/legal/employment/

jobs.title: Senior Distinguished Engineer - EPT
jobs.description: We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on \- 24 Nov 2026 Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact. **A Day in the Life** ===================== Senior Distinguished Engineer Careers That Change Lives The Cardiac and Vascular Group brings all of our cardiac and vascular businesses together into one cross\-functional, collaborative operating unit to employ the full breadth of our talent, technologies, products, services, and solutions to address the needs of customers and patients across the globe. Cardiac Rhythm and Heart Failure offers devices and therapies to treat abnormal heart rhythms, as well as cardiac diagnostic and monitoring solutions. The Platform Architect (PCS Patient Monitors Platform Architect) is accountable for ensuring all software architecture\-related changes consider the entire PCS ecosystem and that all necessary changes to other platforms are accounted for. The person in this role operates as a strategic technology leader who connects technology decisions to business outcomes and helps shape the future direction of our digital health platforms, including our cloud, data, AI, patient\-facing, consumer, and caregiver\-facing platform strategy. This position is in Mounds View, MN. within the Electrophysiology Therapies (EPT) unit. At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In\-person exchanges are invaluable to our work. We are working on\-site 4 days per week as part of our commitment to fostering a culture of professional growth and cross\-functional collaboration as we work together to engineer the extraordinary. This role will require less than 10% of travel to enhance collaboration and ensure successful completion of projects. We believe that when people from different cultures, genders, and points of view come together, innovation is the result —and everyone wins. Medtronic walks the walk, creating an inclusive culture where you can thrive. **A Day in the Life:** In general, the following responsibilities apply for the **Senior Distinguished Engineer role** . This includes, but is not limited to the following: **Architectural Vision and Strategy** ------------------------------------- * Sets the technical architectural vision, design, and technology choices for Patient Monitor solutions in the PCS ecosystem, crossing the software and hardware stack. * Scope includes the portfolio of products that belong to Patient Monitors Platform. * Focuses on the longer\-term strategic direction for one or more Products. * Develops and maintains the architectural and technology roadmap. * Defines the pathway and incremental steps to achieve an architecture or technology vision. Works directly with senior business leaders to ensure technology choices align well with business decisions and highlights emerging changes in our ecosystem and the larger world that can impact our business and technology choices. * **Options, Value, and Risk** ---------------------------- * Provides well\-informed recommendations with multiple options, using POCs and other means of establishing validated learning in critical aspects of the architecture and design. * Provides business/customer value and ROI for different architectural and technology options. * Identifies and documents technical risks and strategies for mitigation. * Is accountable for the technical viability of quality solutions that work within the given cost, scope, and schedule while maximizing progress toward the vision and balancing technical debt. Maps technical decisions and risks to business outcomes with business partners in order to understand and describe the economic impact. * **Governance, Documentation, and Regulatory** --------------------------------------------- * Gains support and approval for architecture and design, which often involves collaboration with multiple stakeholders. * Delivers and maintains architecture documents and presentations needed for review and team guidance. * Leads solution architects relative to overall Architecture and Governance. * Works with Regulatory on the technical impact of emerging and existing legislation with various implications (e.g., DiGA, GDPR, CCPA, ISO62304, ISO 82304, IEC 81001\-5\-1, etc.). jobs.title: Junior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role:** The Mercatus Center is looking for a Junior Cloud Engineer to support our existing AWS cloud infrastructure and on\-site network, to provide on\-site security analysis and triage, and to support in SaaS administration. The Junior Cloud Engineer manages our AWS infrastructure, supports the needs of contractors and scholars with their AWS projects, and ensures that the AWS accounts are following security best practices. This environment consists of many separate, but centrally\-managed accounts used by different units within the organization for providing hosted applications or to run projects including data analysis. Additionally, the role supports the local network infrastructure, manages part of our SaaS portfolio, and works with existing staff to manage security alerts and remediation using our SIEM and existing security playbooks. This will include monitoring and updating network infrastructure and design, managing SaaS permissions, and integrating SSO and identity management for those SAAS apps. On the security side, this role works with our existing security specialist in monitoring and updating the SIEM configuration, responding to security incidents, and updating security response playbooks. We are a small, dynamic IT team, and are seeking a generalist who is able to quickly pivot between systems, learn enough to achieve the required outcome, and move on. Additional duties will include providing backup for the on\-site end user support team and providing on\-call support once every four weeks. The ideal candidate will need to be a fast learner with good troubleshooting skills. Responsibilities will be approximately 20% AWS architecture and management, 10% on site networking, 20% security operations, 30% SaaS administration, 20% triage and remediation.**Specific Duties:*** Responds to and resolves security incidents. * Reviews AWS configurations, especially security configurations. * Works with contracted AWS developers to resolve security configuration issues. * Manages a 3rd party contractor overseeing security in the AWS environment. * Assists scholars and staff with new AWS project design. * Manages SaaS permissions and services. * Manages identity and permissions across the enterprise using identity management tools. * Assists with end user problem resolution. * Assists in help desk ticket triage and resolution. * Participates in on\-call rotation one out of every four weeks. **Required Qualifications**: * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and work experience. * Minimum of 1\-2 years experience managing cloud based compute and storage solutions like AWS or Azure. * Minimum of 1\-2 years experience with TCP/IP networking, including security and firewalls. * Familiarity with MDM and SSO tools like Okta and Jumpcloud. * Experience managing contractors, including scoping work, establishing clear communication protocols, evaluating outcomes, and ensuring alignment with organizational requirements. * Experience troubleshooting unfamiliar issues and finding and applying appropriate solutions. * Excellent communication skills relevant to the technical tools and solutions for non\-technical users or cross\-disciplinary experts. * Familiarity with triage and response to security incidents. * Ability to document processes and create playbooks. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Has built solutions using CloudFormation or other orchestration tools. * Experience with tools like AWS GuardDuty and Security Hub to identify and resolve potential issues with cloud resources. * Experience using IAM tools to manage permissions and roles for users within a cloud environment. * Experience using a trouble ticketing system. * Familiarity with SIEM concepts and usage. **Required certification:** * AWS Solutions Architect Associate **Preferred certifications:** * Network\+ * Security\+ * Okta Certified Professional * Jumpcloud Core Certification **How to Apply** Please submit your cover letter and resume. Your cover letter should indicate your interest in the Mercatus Center's mission. **About the Mercatus Center** The Mercatus Center at George Mason University is where top classical liberal scholars solve real\-world challenges. Grounded in the tradition of market\-oriented thinking and classical liberal ideas, we equip high\-agency talent to apply bold ideas that shape institutions, inform policy, and help people flourish. **Employee Benefits Review** Salary is competitive and will be commensurate with experience. In addition, Mercatus provides excellent benefits to all individual employees, including full health and dental coverage, unlimited paid time off, long\-term disability and life insurance, a 403(b) retirement savings program, parking/travel benefits, and twelve free credits per year at George Mason University. **EEO Statement** The Mercatus Center is an equal employment opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by law. **E\-Verify** The Mercatus Center participates in E\-Verify. Upon hire, Mercatus will provide the U.S. Social Security Administration and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security, with information from each new employee’s Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization.

jobs.title: Business Engineer
jobs.description: Meta's Business Engineering team sits at the intersection of technology and business impact, applying software engineering expertise to help partners succeed across Meta's platforms. In this role, you will build scalable, production\-grade solutions that drive partner growth and product adoption across areas including Video, Commerce, Monetization, AI, Messaging, Gaming, and the metaverse. You will collaborate closely with product engineering teams and cross\-functional partners to translate complex business challenges into technical solutions that create measurable value for partners and the people who use their products. ### **Business Engineer Responsibilities:** * Design, build, and maintain scalable production\-grade systems that drive partner product adoption and business growth across Meta's platforms * Collaborate with Meta product engineering teams and cross\-functional partners to identify and deliver technical solutions aligned to business needs * Architect and integrate end\-to\-end systems with clear launch\-plan strategies that address partner challenges at scale * Apply knowledge of Meta's products and technologies to scope and prioritize short, mid, and long\-term engineering goals that keep the team focused on measurable outcomes * Build and maintain productive relationships with technical counterparts at partner organizations, independently resolving complex technical and business integration challenges * Leverage product insight and domain expertise to influence product roadmap decisions that better serve partner and business needs * Communicate technical concepts and data\-driven recommendations to non\-technical stakeholders to guide workflow changes and build consensus * Conduct and participate in code reviews, providing constructive feedback and acting on feedback received to maintain high code quality and long\-term maintainability * Share knowledge with peers and contribute to a collaborative team environment, including supporting the interviewing and onboarding of new team members * Serve as a subject matter expert within Business Engineering, providing consultation on domain\-level projects and influencing decision\-making through data\-centric analysis ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience * 6\+ years of experience as a software engineer building and shipping production\-quality, scalable, and maintainable code * Experience designing and architecting end\-to\-end systems with relevant documentation and test plans * Experience with open source languages or frameworks such as Python, PHP, Java, JavaScript, Swift, or Android * Experience communicating technical concepts and data\-driven insights to non\-technical audiences including business stakeholders or partners * Experience working in client\-facing or partner\-facing technical roles, independently resolving complex technical and business integration challenges ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies * Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) * Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) * Experience acting as a technical consultant to partners or clients, advising on integration strategies and platform adoption * Demonstrated use of AI tools to optimize engineering workflows or partner integrations, with experience applying responsible and ethical AI practices such as bias mitigation and quality review * Experience breaking down business requirements into product and technical features, scoping the appropriate level of technical investment based on business impact * Experience working on multi\-person codebases, including open source or collaborative projects, with a focus on code quality and cross\-team coordination ### **About Meta:** Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. The ideal candidate is AI\-forward, uses AI\-assisted tools to navigate a large codebase and speed up delivery, and raises the bar for the team. **We welcome candidates from a variety of locations; however, all candidates should be open to occasional in\-person participation for business meetings, team events, or collaboration opportunities. Candidates located within approximately 35 miles of Rochester, NY may be asked to work from the office more frequently based on business or team needs.** **Compensation** $90,000 \- $140,000 **What You’ll Accomplish** * Own major areas of the OpenEdge platform end to end, from problem definition through design, delivery, and production support, keeping it stable while delivering new features. * Plan and carry out the platform’s incremental modernization with the engineering manager, balancing new architecture with day\-to\-day delivery. * Apply AI\-assisted engineering practices (AI DLC) to analyze and document existing code, refactor, generate tests, and support migration, and share effective workflows with the team. * Identify technical debt, assess its impact on delivery and risk, and evidence\-backed alternatives. * Partner with Product in backlog refinement to clarify requirements, estimate effort, and shape deliverable work, and collaborate with Product, CloudOps, and engineers to resolve dependencies. * Build automated tests that make changes safer, apply secure coding practices across application and infrastructure work, and contribute to CI/CD and observability for our cloud architecture. * Raise the bar for the team through code reviews, pairing, and mentoring. * Demonstrate an AI\-first mindset by effectively leveraging AI\-assisted tools and technologies to enhance productivity, accelerate problem\-solving, improve quality, automate routine tasks, and drive innovation in the delivery of solutions and services. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of software engineering experience developing and supporting production systems in an Agile environment. * Significant experience with Progress OpenEdge v12 and above, including object\-oriented ABL. * Proven, hands\-on daily use of AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor, following structured practices like the AI DLC and rigorously evaluating AI output against engineering standards. * Hands\-on experience maintaining and modernizing monolithic applications through incremental migration, re\-architecting, service extraction, or cloud migration. * Experience designing n\-tier applications and RESTful APIs that separate business logic from presentation and data layers, with strong relational database design and data architecture expertise. * Frontend development experience with JavaScript or TypeScript. * Experience with automated testing, source control, code review, and CI/CD pipelines. **Preferred Skills** * Experience with PASOE administration, WebHandlers, ABLUnit, OpenEdge database management (backup/restore, tuning, TDE, replication), OpenTelemetry (OTEL), or OpenEdge Command Center (OECC) is a plus. * Experience with Angular or React, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, Docker, SOC 2 compliance and security\-first development, or Jira or Azure DevOps (ADO) is a plus. * Uses AI to augment expertise and decision\-making while maintaining ownership, accountability, and professional judgment for final work products and outcomes. * Identifies opportunities to use AI to streamline workflows, reduce manual effort, improve efficiency, and increase business value. * Maintains awareness of emerging AI capabilities, tools, and best practices and proactively identifies opportunities to apply them in the workplace. * Demonstrates sound judgment in the ethical, secure, and compliant use of AI technologies while protecting confidential, customer, and company information. * BS degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. **Why Join Mindex?** For more than 30 years, Mindex has helped organizations solve complex business challenges through custom software, cloud, data, and AI solutions. We combine deep technical expertise with a collaborative culture that empowers our employees to innovate, grow, and make a meaningful impact for our clients. In our Product division, our teams have built platforms such as SchoolTool, Advanced Analytics, and our Integrations Platform from the ground up, while also supporting solutions like MTSS Edge and ClearTrack that help schools and organizations make smarter, data\-driven decisions. **Benefits** * + Fully Remote Work Environment + Flexible Time Off + Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance + 401(k) with Company Match + Company\-Paid Life and Disability Insurance + Professional Development Opportunities **Additional Information** * Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the United States. Mindex is unable to sponsor employment visas at this time. **Physical Requirements/Conditions** * + Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer. + No heavy lifting is expected. Exertion of up to 10 lbs.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer Team Lead - Fleet Operations & Experience
jobs.description: **Mission Summary:** As the Principal Engineer \& Team Lead for Fleet Operations \& Experience (FOX) within the Fleet Software Platform group, you will lead the US\-based engineering team responsible for the human\- and agent\-in\-the\-loop operational surfaces that power Motional's driverless fleet. Your mission is to architect, engineer, and scale the operational tooling ecosystem, treating the Motional Operations team as your primary customer. You will lead the engineering of Command Center UI workflows, delivering intuitive, high\-reliability software tools that empower field specialists and fleet watch officers while ensuring a seamless rider experience and rapid incident resolution. **What you'll be doing:** * **People Leadership \& Team Growth:** Directly manage and mentor a dedicated US sub\-team of software engineers. Build an inclusive, high\-velocity engineering culture, manage performance, and drive OKRs focused on operational excellence. * **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Partner directly with Fleet Operations, Product Management, Autonomy, and global Developer Platform teams to translate operational pain points into scalable, highly reliable software solutions. * **Operations Tooling \& UI Architecture:** Lead the development of internal operations tooling and Command Center UI workflows, specifically owning vehicle bring\-up tracking, 1:N Field Recovery tools, and fleet scheduling systems. * **API\-First Integration:** Collaborate closely with the Fleet Orchestration and Vehicle Connectivity layers to ensure your front\-end applications seamlessly consume versioned core platform APIs without bleeding business logic. * **Live Incident Response \& Escalation:** Serve as the L2/L3 engineering escalation point during active US fleet operating hours, acting as the primary first responder for field emergencies and driving time\-to\-resolution for roadside issues to under 10 minutes. **What we're looking for:** * **Experience:** Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with 12\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3\+ years of direct people management. * **Leadership \& Execution:** Demonstrated success in resolving complex organizational dependencies, coaching staff\-level engineers, and maintaining high system uptime under live operational pressure. * **Full\-Stack \& Frontend Mastery:** Expert\-level proficiency in modern web application architectures (e.g., React, TypeScript, Node.js, Python) used for building mission\-critical, real\-time operational dashboards and mobile tools. * **Operational Systems Expertise:** Proven track record of architecting, launching, and operating highly available internal tooling, dispatch systems, or command center portals with strict reliability requirements. * **Incident Management:** Strong background in establishing on\-call rotations, enterprise\-grade observability, and automated incident response workflows for live, physical operations. **Bonus Points(not required):** * Prior experience in the Autonomous Vehicle (AV), Ride\-Hailing/Mobility (e.g., Uber, Lyft, Grab), or IoT Fleet Management sectors. * Hands\-on experience with real\-time video/audio streaming infrastructure (WebRTC media servers, Ant\-Media). * Experience operating cross\-regional engineering escalation rotations and live operations support across time zones (US/Singapore). **Why you should join us:** Join a high\-impact team at the forefront of the commercial driverless revolution. In this role, you will lead an exceptional engineering team in Singapore, partner directly with global transportation leaders, and build the B2B integration platform that powers Motional's commercial autonomous fleet at global scale. **This role is hybrid from our Las Vegas office. It requires in\-office days each week.** \#LI\-AE1 **Motional is a driverless technology company making autonomous vehicles a safe, reliable, and accessible reality. We're driven by something more.** **Our journey is always people first.** We aren't just developing driverless cars; we're creating safer roadways, more equitable transportation options, and making our communities better places to live, work, and connect. Our team is made up of engineers, researchers, innovators, dreamers and doers, who are creating a technology with the potential to transform the way we move. **Higher purpose, greater impact.** We're creating first\-of\-its\-kind technology that will transform transportation. To do so successfully, we must design for everyone in our cities and on our roads. We believe in building a great place to work through a progressive, global culture that is diverse, inclusive, and ensures people feel valued at every level of the organization. Diversity helps us to see the world differently; it's not only good for our business, it's the right thing to do. **Scale up, not starting up.** Our team is behind some of the industry's largest leaps forward, including the first fully\-autonomous cross\-country drive in the U.S, the launch of the world's first robotaxi pilot, and operation of the world's longest\-standing public robotaxi fleet. We're driven to scale; we're moving towards commercialization of our technology, and we need team members who are ready to embrace change and challenges. Formed as a joint venture between Hyundai Motor Group and Aptiv, Motional is fundamentally changing how people move through their lives. Headquartered in Boston, Motional has operations in the U.S and Asia. For more information, visit www.Motional.com and follow us on Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube. *Motional AD Inc. is an EOE. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks. Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector. Visit gomotive.com to learn more. **About the Role:** ------------------- As a Staff Software Engineer on the Equipment Monitoring team, you will build the backend systems that give fleets unmatched visibility into the location, utilization, and health of their equipment \- trailers, reefers, construction machinery, and small assets. Our data comes from IoT devices in the field: Asset Gateways, BLE environmental and door sensors, and Beacons. You will design and operate the ingestion and stream\-processing pipelines (Kafka, Flink) that turn this raw sensor telemetry into accurate real\-time locations, geofence events, trips, and alerts. You will collaborate closely with our Embedded/firmware and IoT teams on device payloads and end\-to\-end data flows, making this a great role for engineers who enjoy working near the hardware while building cloud services at scale. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- * Develop **highly observable, reliable, and scalable** backend services that process telemetry from hundreds of thousands of IoT devices (sensors, beacons, asset gateways). * Build and operate **stream\-processing pipelines** (Kafka, Flink) powering geo\-fencing, alerting, trip construction, and asset location. * **Design, build, and maintain scalable APIs** for both internal and external applications. * **Collaborate with Embedded, IoT, and cross\-functional teams** on device data contracts and end\-to\-end feature delivery. * **Champion engineering excellence** by proactively reducing technical debt and improving code quality. * Leverage AI tools such as Cursor, CoPilot to increase productivity and code quality. * Actively work on our AWS Cloud infrastructure, and **mentor and learn** from other engineers to foster a culture of continuous growth. **What We're Looking For:** --------------------------- * B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science or related field * 5\+ years software development experience * Experience building distributed systems and event\-driven/stream\-processing pipelines (Kafka, Flink, Kinesis or similar) * Experience in modern programming languages. jobs.title: Full-Stack DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **About us** www.mustdoadmin.com, owned by NNRoad Inc., is an early\-stage startup. We run the back office for startups doing business in California, especially foreign companies and companies from other states that are entering California for the first time: HR, payroll, bookkeeping, and the registrations, filings and deadlines that come with a new California entity. Our clients, their employees and our account managers all work through one web portal. We are a small team building that portal now, and we are hiring our first engineer to own it end to end. **The role** You will be the engineer responsible for the MustDoAdmin portal: you build it, ship it and keep it running. That means writing and maintaining the application, deploying it, and operating the servers, databases and security behind it. You will work directly with the founder and our account managers, who use the portal every day. As our first engineer, you will help decide how the product is built, not just build what is specified. This is a full\-time, on\-site role in our downtown San Jose office. **What you will do** Development and maintenance * Build new features across the stack: web front end, back\-end services and APIs, from a clickable design to production. * Maintain and improve the existing code: fix bugs, refactor, write tests and keep dependencies current. * Build and maintain integrations with the systems our clients use, such as payroll platforms, accounting software and e\-signature services. * Build the portal's AI features, such as checking uploaded documents and pre\-filling forms, using cloud or locally hosted models. Deployment * Own the release process: version control, code review, automated builds and tests (CI/CD), staging and production environments. * Ship changes safely and often, with a tested way to roll back. Operations: servers, databases and security * Run and monitor the servers and cloud services the portal runs on; plan capacity and keep costs under control. * Administer the databases: schema changes, backups, restore tests, performance tuning. * Secure the system and the sensitive data in it (personal details, pay and bank information): access control, multi\-factor sign\-in, encryption, patching, logging and alerting. * Respond to incidents, find the root cause and fix it for good. * Keep clear documentation of how the system is built, deployed and run, so that it does not depend on any one person's memory. **What we are looking for** We care more about how you think than how many years you have worked. With today's AI tools, the most valuable skills are knowing exactly what to build and why, and having the judgment to check the result. * Experience building, deploying and supporting a production web application, at work or on your own projects. * Hands\-on skills in a modern back\-end language and framework (such as TypeScript/Node.js or Python) and a front\-end framework (such as React). * Relational database experience (such as PostgreSQL): data modeling, migrations, backups and query tuning. * Linux server administration, a major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud), Docker and CI/CD. * Experience building with large language models, including running models locally. * Familiarity with SOC 2 or similar security and compliance frameworks. * A degree in computer science or a related field. * Clear thinking. You can take a messy business request, find what actually matters, and describe the problem and the requirement precisely enough that a person or an AI tool can build it correctly. * Strong logic. You break a problem into parts, spot gaps and contradictions, and test your assumptions. * Broad working knowledge. You understand how a modern web application fits together end to end: front end, back end, databases, servers, networking and security. You do not need to be an expert in all of it, but you know enough to make sound decisions and find out the rest. * Curiosity and initiative. You explore new tools and approaches, try things, and propose better ways of doing them without waiting to be asked. * Effective use of AI. You already use AI coding and research tools in your work, and you review what they produce instead of trusting it blindly. * Ownership. You are comfortable being the only engineer: you make decisions on your own, explain them in plain English to non\-technical colleagues, and write things down. * Care with sensitive data. You understand that the portal holds people's personal, pay and bank details, and you treat security as part of the job. **Nice to have** * Experience with HR, payroll, accounting or other software that handles regulated data. * Integrations with payroll or accounting APIs (for example Gusto or QuickBooks) or banking APIs. **Schedule, location and work authorization** * Full\-time, fully on site at our office in downtown San Jose, California, five days a week. This role is not remote or hybrid. * Working hours, Monday to Friday, Pacific Time: o Standard time (early November to mid\-March): 11:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m. o Daylight saving time (mid\-March to early November): 12:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m. * The schedule includes a meal break. Occasional work outside these hours for planned releases or urgent production issues. **How to apply** Send your resume to info@nnroad.com with the subject line "Full\-Stack DevOps Engineer". In a few lines, tell us about a system you built and kept running in production: what it did, how you deployed it, and one problem you had to fix under pressure. Links to code or projects are welcome. **Equal opportunity** MustDoAdmin is an equal opportunity employer. Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: AI Forward Engineer
jobs.description: **Role Overview** As an **AI Forward Engineer**, you will operate at the intersection of deep software engineering, customer operations, and product strategy. Unlike standard back\-office ML engineers who build foundational algorithms, you will be embedded on the front lines to solve real\-world, high\-impact business challenges. You will work directly with enterprise stakeholders to identify operational bottlenecks, design custom AI solutions leveraging LLM tool\-calling and RAG architectures, and integrate these systems into complex legacy infrastructure and Navan's API suite. **What You'll Do:** * **Bridge Pilot\-to\-Production:** Build, test, and ship production\-ready AI agents and autonomous workflows that streamline travel booking, expense policy auditing, and financial reconciliation. * **Translate Business to Code:** Engage directly with internal operational teams and external enterprise clients to audit complex manual workflows and codify "tribal knowledge" into custom software solutions. * **Architect \& Integrate:** Integrate advanced LLM pipelines, vector databases, and agentic frameworks into Navan's core backend platforms, enterprise data lakes, and third\-party ERP/HRIS systems (e.g., SAP, NetSuite, Workday). * **Rapid Prototyping \& Feedback Loops:** Develop proof\-of\-concepts (POCs) on\-site or in close collaboration with end\-users, gather real\-time usage data, and iterate rapidly to maximize user adoption and business impact. * **Governance \& Security:** Ensure all custom AI solutions comply with strict enterprise data privacy standards, SOC 2 compliance, and financial auditing frameworks. * **Collaborate with Core Product Teams:** Act as a critical feedback loop to Navan's core Product and AI Engineering teams, bringing real\-world edge cases and customer requirements into the core platform roadmap. **What We're Looking For:** * 4\+ years of experience in software engineering, technical consulting, forward deployed engineering, or solutions architecture. * Experience in corporate travel, fintech, expense management, or enterprise SaaS domains are a plus. * Familiarity with enterprise compliance, audit logs, and security protocols surrounding generative AI. * Strong proficiency in **Python**, **TypeScript/JavaScript**, or **Go**, along with solid experience with REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, and asynchronous architecture. * Hands\-on experience building with modern AI stacks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs), agentic architectures (tool\-calling, multi\-agent frameworks), and RAG pipelines (vector databases like Pinecone, Weaviate, or Qdrant). * Proficiency in SQL, data pipeline integration, containerization (**Docker**, **Kubernetes**), and cloud deployment platforms (**AWS**, **GCP**, or **Azure**). * Ability to design scalable, secure, and fault\-tolerant enterprise software integrations. Navan uses AI\-assisted Automated Employment Decision Tool (Metaview) to assist with evaluating resumes against job qualifications for this role. All final decisions are made by human recruiters and hiring managers. **Human oversight:** Metaview does not automatically reject candidates or make final hiring decisions. Our recruiters and hiring managers review all outputs and make the final hiring decision regarding every application. * **Your rights:** If you prefer to have your application reviewed without AI assistance, you may request a human evaluation by entering your email here. Your decision to do so will not affect how your candidacy is evaluated. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice for more information about our processing of personal data, and your rights.

If you thrive on analyzing problems, building hands\-on solutions, and teaching others, this role is for you. Join us as our newest Sr. AI Solutions Engineer, and help change the world of real estate, one home at a time. What You'll Do: * Discover and design \- Interview stakeholders, map workflows, estimate impact, and choose whether Assist, Automate, or Compose is the right fit, using discovery templates in Miro. * Prototype Assist solutions \- Stand up knowledge copilots with Glean Search and Assistant, Gemini for Workspace, etc. including prompt libraries and retrieval configs. * Develop/Automate solutions \- Build agentic workflows with Google ADK, LangChain, CrewAI, n8n, etc. and harden the winners into production. * Create Compose solutions \- Create fullstack AI applications with integrations across various internal tools. Own and maintain the full lifecycle of these applications, from frontend and backend development, production implementation, cloud resource management, and hand off runbooks to business owners. * Teach and evangelize \- Produce AI flight\-school decks, hands\-on labs, prompt cheat sheets, and run office hours so PMs, analysts, and ops teams can build confidently. * Measure and iterate \- Track adoption, demo outcomes at town halls, and feed lessons into the next solution cycle. What You'll Bring: * Experienced in stakeholder discovery, process mapping, and turning requirements into clear AI use cases. * Hands\-on with Assist and knowledge retrieval tools such as Glean, Gemini, Windsurf, or Claude Code and be able to fine\-tune retrieval settings. * Comfortable with Automate tooling like Glean Agents, Vertex AI and can chain steps across APIs. * Experience with cloud\-based development, deployment, and architecture, including tools and technologies such as CircleCI, Kafka, Kubernetes, GraphQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS), and GCP * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and deployment best practices * Exposure to monitoring systems, incident alerting, and service reliability practices to support SLAs * Skilled at crafting and refining LLM prompts, context engineering, MCPs, A2A protocol, Human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation and feedback, and explaining basics to newcomers. * 2\+ years of experience with data and APIs (SQL, REST, JSON, CSV), and able to integrate them into AI workflows. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related field or related experience * Natural educator who has led workshops or produced self\-serve guides that stick. * Iterative by nature, quick to test, learn, and refine without needing a formal CS degree. How We Work: We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. How We Reward You: Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. jobs.description: **Overview** As Senior AI Engineer, you will design, build and operate the AI systems behind Bible Gateway, from retrieval pipelines and model integrations to evaluations and guardrails. You will collaborate with product, UX, research, and engineering to evaluate and ship the AI experiences that serve users who want to encounter the Bible from a variety of perspectives. Your job is to understand where AI helps users (and where it doesn’t), and to build solutions that meet their needs, stay faithful to the text, respect license agreements, and hold up under heavy traffic. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and maintain production AI services (RAG pipelines, tool calling, structured output, etc.) that power experiences for millions of users. * Manage and extend existing AI features on Bible Gateway to maximize their value to users while balancing business needs, including cost, latency, and performance. * Partner with product, UX, and research to identify potential features (both user\-facing and behind\-the\-scenes), assess their feasibility, prototype their implementation, and deploy them at scale. * Create and manage evals that assess AI performance both quantitatively and qualitatively on multiple dimensions, including accuracy, faithfulness to the text, tone, and safety. * Ensure guardrails appropriately enforce safety and theological constraints. * Analyze data using AI to uncover unmet needs and to size opportunities. * Streamline internal operations using AI where appropriate. **Qualifications** **Knowledge:** * Embedding models, vector databases, hybrid lexical and semantic search, and reranking. * RAG architectures and tradeoffs. * AI security risks: prompt injection, jailbreaks and data leakage. * Privacy regulations as they apply to AI **Areas of Exposure/Experience:** * Familiarity with Node.js a plus. * Familiarity with serving models through Amazon Bedrock a plus. * Familiarity with managing licensed content a plus. * Multilingual NLP, including tokenization and search issues in non\-Latin scripts, a plus. Work **Experience:** * 5\+ years of software engineering, including 2\+ years building and shipping ML or LLM\-powered features in production. * Hands\-on experience with retrieval\-augmented generation: embeddings, vector and hybrid search, chunking, reranking and prompt design. * Shipped AI features in a consumer\-facing product. * A track record of building evaluation pipelines and using them to decide what ships. jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Search
jobs.description: #### **\#TeamNextdoor** Nextdoor (NYSE: NXDR) is the essential neighborhood network. Neighbors, public agencies, and businesses use Nextdoor to connect around local information that matters in more than 350,000 neighborhoods across 11 countries. Nextdoor builds innovative technology to foster local community, share important news, and create neighborhood connections at scale. Download the app and join the neighborhood at **nextdoor.com**. #### **Meet Your Future Neighbors** At Nextdoor, Machine Learning and Search are two of the most important areas we are growing. Search is a strategic priority for us as we work to make Nextdoor the neighborhood hub for local information, recommendations, and exchange. Machine Learning is helping transform the search experience by making it more relevant, personalized, and useful—connecting members with the people, places, services, conversations, and insights that matter most in their communities. Our machine learning team is lean but hungry to drive impact across the platform, including search, newsfeed, notifications, ads relevance, connections, and trust. We believe ML will be integral to making Nextdoor more valuable to our members, while also ensuring that Search helps people discover meaningful local information—not simply more content. We believe ML should be developed ethically, encouraging healthy habits and interactions rather than addictive behavior. We are looking for great engineers who believe in the power of local community and want to help empower members to make their neighborhoods great places to live. At Nextdoor, we operate in an AI\-first environment and expect every team member to actively use AI tools as part of their workflow. We aren't looking for prompt engineers; we're looking for people who use tools like Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, and Glean to challenge their own thinking and take full ownership of AI\-assisted outputs. We also offer a warm, inclusive work environment that embraces a hybrid employment model, blending in\-office presence with work\-from\-home flexibility for our valued employees. The hiring team will go over these expectations with you if you are being considered for a role near one of our offices in San Francisco, Los Angeles, Chicago, Dallas, New York, and London. #### **The Impact You'll Make** * Join a high\-impact Machine Learning Engineering team developing data\-intensive products, including feature engineering, predictive modeling, real\-time inference, and data\-driven experimentation. * Partner closely with Product Management, Data Science, and Software Engineering teams to translate product requirements into scalable machine learning systems and platform capabilities. * Collect, curate, and process large\-scale datasets for supervised learning, real\-time prediction, recommendation systems, ranking, classification, and other production ML use cases. * Develop and optimize low\-latency machine learning models and real\-time decision systems that meet strict production performance, scalability, and reliability requirements. * Deploy, integrate, and maintain machine learning models in production environments, including model serving, inference pipelines, monitoring, automation, and integration with customer\-facing product features. * Conduct online A/B tests and user\-facing experiments to evaluate model performance, measure causal impact, and improve business metrics such as engagement, retention, and user experience. * Analyze experiment results using statistical methods, model evaluation metrics, and product KPIs to guide iterative improvements to model quality and platform functionality. * Collaborate with ML engineers, Data Scientists, Backend Engineers, Product Managers, and other cross\-functional partners to build safe, effective, and scalable user experiences. * Participate in Nextdoor's in\-person trainings, off\-sites, volunteer events, and team\-building activities. * Build strong in\-person relationships with colleagues and contribute to a collaborative, inclusive, and mission\-driven Nextdoor company culture. #### **What You'll Bring To The Team** * M.S. or Ph.D. in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Applied Math, Statistics, or a related field * 5\+ years of industry experience in applying machine learning at scale * Experience with recommendation systems, deep learning models, search/feed/notification relevance, knowledge graphs, Ads, or NLP at scale is required * Experience building ML models for consumer\-facing products * Proven engineering skills, with experience in writing and maintaining high\-quality production code * Ability to work with and analyze large amounts of data * Ability to succeed in a dynamic startup environment #### **Rewards** Compensation, benefits, perks, and recognition programs at Nextdoor come together to create our total rewards package. Compensation will vary depending on your relevant skills, experience, and qualifications. The starting salary for this role is expected to range from $195,000 to $276,000 on an annualized basis, or potentially greater in the event that your 'level' of proficiency exceeds the level expected for the role. The salary range will be determined by the candidate's geographic location. We expect to award a meaningful equity grant for this role. With quarterly vesting, your first vest date will take place within 3 months of your start date. When it comes to benefits, we have you covered! Nextdoor employees can choose between a variety of health plans, including a 100% covered employee only plan option, and we also provide a OneMedical membership for concierge care. At Nextdoor, we empower our employees to build stronger local communities. To create a platform where all feel welcome, we want our workforce to reflect the diversity of the neighbors we serve. We encourage everyone interested in our mission to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, or any other trait that unfairly targets a group of people. In accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we always consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. For information about our collection and use of applicants' personal information, please see Nextdoor's Personnel Privacy Notice, found here. ##### **\#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-Remote**
