jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.** At Nextiva, we're reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation. Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it's through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are. If you're ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong. **Location:** While this role is open to remote candidates across the United States, team members located within 40 miles of our Scottsdale headquarters (9451 E. Via de Ventura, Scottsdale, AZ 85256\) are expected to work onsite four days per week to support collaboration, speed, and execution. Specific scheduling and flexibility will be guided by your leader to support both team collaboration and individual productivity. We are seeking a Staff AI Engineer to help accelerate new AI initiatives and support Nextiva's mission of delivering exceptional customer experiences through a unified, modern platform powered by AI and automation. The Staff AI Engineer is a hands\-on individual contributor role for an experienced engineer with deep technical expertise in Python, distributed systems, and system design. This role will help design, build, and launch new AI\-focused initiatives while working across Nextiva engineering teams and with external technology partners. As a Staff Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of hands\-on engineering, system design, and early\-stage solutioning. You will take ownership of new capabilities from initial technical discussions through design, development, and launch. This is not an architecture\-only position; we are looking for someone who remains close to the code and is comfortable building alongside the team. You will work on initiatives involving NextIQ capabilities, including collaboration with the Google Gemini team to bring capabilities built within Nextiva into partner environments. You will also work closely with global Nextiva product and engineering teams, including teams working on NextOS, to extend NextIQ capabilities across the Nextiva ecosystem. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving ambiguous problems, building new capabilities from the ground up, and taking end\-to\-end technical ownership while contributing as a deeply hands\-on individual contributor. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and launch new AI\-focused engineering capabilities and modules. * Own engineering initiatives end to end, from early\-stage solutioning and architecture through implementation and launch. * Remain deeply hands\-on with software development and contribute production code. * Build solutions using Python and apply strong distributed\-systems engineering principles. * Participate in system design, architecture, and solutioning discussions with engineering teams. * Work closely with the Google Gemini team on initiatives designed to bring NextIQ capabilities into Gemini. * Collaborate with other external technology partners to extend Nextiva capabilities into their environments. * Partner with U.S.\-based Nextiva product and engineering teams on new initiatives. * Work with teams supporting NextOS to help bring NextIQ capabilities into other areas of the Nextiva ecosystem. * Navigate ambiguous, early\-stage technical problems and translate them into practical engineering solutions. * Take accountability for designing, building, and successfully launching the capabilities you own. **Requirements** **Basic Qualifications** * 7–10\+ years of relevant software engineering experience, with strong hands\-on experience building and delivering production software. * Very strong hands\-on Python engineering skills. * Strong system design capabilities. * Experience designing and building distributed systems. * Demonstrated experience owning and launching software modules or capabilities end to end. * Experience taking technical initiatives from solutioning and design through development and launch. * Ability and willingness to remain hands\-on with coding at Staff Engineer level. * Experience contributing to architecture and technical solutioning discussions. * Ability to work effectively on new initiatives where requirements and technical approaches may still be evolving. * Ability to collaborate effectively with internal engineering teams and external technology partners. * Ability to work remotely within a time zone reasonably aligned with the Arizona\-based team. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience operating as a Staff Engineer or at a comparable level in a similarly sized or slightly larger organization. * Experience building new produ d partner environments such as Google Gemini. **Additional Qualities** * Strong sense of ownership and accountability. * Comfortable working through ambiguity and early\-stage technical challenges. * Able to move effectively between system design and hands\-on implementation. * Strong problem\-solving and technical decision\-making skills. * Collaborative approach to working across engineering teams and external partners. * Ability to take ownership of a capability through design, build, and launch. * Self\-directed and comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor. Nextiva DNA (Core Competencies) Nextiva's most successful team members share common traits and behaviors: * Drives Results: Action\-oriented problem solvers who quickly bring clarity and simplicity to ambiguity, challenge the status quo, and lead meaningful change; celebrating wins to fuel momentum. They act swiftly and pragmatically, learning and improving as they go. * Critical Thinker: Data\-driven, forward\-thinking individuals who identify key drivers, anticipate risks, and deliver clear recommendations. They confidently leverage AI and automation to reduce friction, improve decision\-making, and focus on higher\-value work. * Right Attitude: Collaborative, competitive, and resilient team players who jump in to solve tough problems, learn from setbacks, and foster a culture of service, respect, and care for customers and teammates. #### **Total Rewards** Our Total Rewards offerings are designed to allow Nexties to take care of themselves and their families so they can be their best, in and out of the office. Our compensation packages are tailored to each role and candidate's qualifications. We consider a wide range of factors, including skills, experience, training, and certifications, when determining compensation. We aim to offer competitive salaries or wages that reflect the value you bring to our team. Depending on the position, compensation may include base salary and/or hourly wages, incentives, or bonuses. The expected hiring range is $115,000 \- $200,000\. A different level in the job hierarchy may apply to a specific candidate, resulting in a different hiring range. * Health: Multiple health plan options to suit your needs, including medical, dental, vision, and telemedicine coverage * Insurance: Life, disability, and supplemental indemnity plans * + ️ Work\-Life Balance: Flexible Time Off for salaried employees, PTO for hourly employees, Paid Sick Time, Paid Parental Bonding Leave, and holiday pay * Financial Security: 401(k) with company match, Health Savings Accounts with company contributions, Dependent Care FSA * ‍ Wellness: Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and comprehensive wellness initiatives * Growth: Access to ongoing learning and development opportunities and career advancement At Nextiva, we're committed to supporting our employees' health, well\-being, and professional growth. Join us and build a rewarding career! Nextiva is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Nextiva participates in the E\-Verify Program where and as required by law. For additional information about E\-Verify visit USCIS. \#LI\-MS1 \#LI\-Remote Founded in 2008, Nextiva has grown into a global leader trusted by over 100,000 businesses and 1M\+ users worldwide. Headquartered in Scottsdale, Arizona, and with teams across the globe, we're the future of customer experience and team collaboration through our AI\-powered, conversation\-centric platform. Want to see what life at Nextiva is all about? Connect with us on Instagram, Instagram MX, YouTube, LinkedIn, and the Nextiva Blog.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer (Python + TypeScript)
jobs.description: ### **About Northbeam** Northbeam is building the world's most advanced marketing intelligence platform, providing top eCommerce brands a unified view of their business data through powerful attribution modeling and customizable dashboards. Our technology helps customers accurately track ad spend, understand the full customer journey, and drive profitable growth. Machine learning has been at the heart of Northbeam since day one: our full suite of measurement, spanning multi\-touch attribution, MMM\+, and incrementality, is built on it, along with laser\-accurate first\-party data. Now we're taking that foundation further, using AI to help brands operationalize their data and turn Northbeam insights into automated decisions. We're experiencing rapid growth, have strong product\-market fit, and are looking for the right people to help us scale. This is a rare chance to make a meaningful impact at a fast\-moving, high\-growth company. At Northbeam, you'll join a team of driven, collaborative, and talented individuals who value personal growth and excellence. We'd love for you to be part of our journey. We're a remote\-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles. **About the role** ------------------ We're hiring a **Senior Fullstack Engineer** to build Northbeam's mobile attribution product and the data collection layer underneath it. You'll own our client\-side SDKs (JavaScript today, iOS next) and the high\-throughput APIs that ingest the events they send. This is a **fullstack role** with a **strong backend and scaling bent.** Our microservices run in both **TypeScript and Python**, so you'll move between the two daily, and ship React UI when a feature needs it. You'll also partner with our Conversions API (CAPI) team on event ingestion. The ideal person has built web analytics or event tracking at real volume and cares as much about a reliable SDK as about the systems that catch its data. **Your Impact** --------------- * Build Northbeam's mobile attribution solution end to end: SDK, ingestion APIs, data model, and the dashboard views customers use to act on it. * Design and own our client\-side SDKs in JavaScript/TypeScript, and help shape our iOS SDK, so they capture events accurately with minimal impact on customer site and app performance. * Build and scale high\-throughput APIs and microservices in TypeScript and Python that ingest, validate, and route event data from our customers' sites and apps. * Partner with the CAPI team to ingest server\-side conversion events and deliver them reliably to ad platforms. * Own the reliability of these ingestion paths: load testing, monitoring, alerting, and performance tuning. * Ship frontend features in React and TypeScript when a product experience needs them. * Scope projects with product managers, data scientists, and customer success, and help set technical direction for how Northbeam collects data. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years building production software, with deep fullstack experience in TypeScript/JavaScript across frontend and backend. * Professional experience building services or APIs in Python, and comfort working across TypeScript and Python microservices in the same system. * A track record designing and scaling high\-throughput APIs: you've handled request volume, latency, queuing, retries, and idempotency in production. * Hands\-on experience with web analytics or event tracking: building tracking SDKs, pixels, or tag libraries, designing event schemas, and working within browser constraints like cookie restrictions and ad blockers. * Proficiency in SQL; experience with BigQuery or a similar cloud data warehouse. * Startup instincts: you turn ambiguous product needs into sound architecture and ship production\-ready code with minimal guidance. * Interest in mentoring other engineers and raising the bar for what the team ships. **Bonus Skills \& Experience** ------------------------------ * iOS SDK development in Swift, or building SDKs that third\-party developers install and depend on. * Familiarity with mobile attribution: mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch), SKAdNetwork or AdAttributionKit, and Apple's App Tracking Transparency. * Experience with server\-side conversion APIs such as Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or the TikTok Events API. * Streaming or event pipeline experience (Pub/Sub, Kafka, or similar) on GCP or another major cloud. * Experience in marketing, e\-commerce, or ad\-tech. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company\-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work\-from\-home stipend to support your remote setup. **Interview Process** The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30\-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role\-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co\-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5\-7 interviews total and requires around 5\-8 hours of your time. We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

We're a remote\-friendly company with physical offices in San Francisco and Los Angeles. **About the role** ------------------ We're hiring a **Senior Fullstack Engineer** to build Northbeam's mobile attribution product and the data collection layer underneath it. You'll own our client\-side SDKs (JavaScript today, iOS next) and the high\-throughput APIs that ingest the events they send. This is a **fullstack role** with a **strong backend and scaling bent.** Our microservices run in both **TypeScript and Python**, so you'll move between the two daily, and ship React UI when a feature needs it. You'll also partner with our Conversions API (CAPI) team on event ingestion. The ideal person has built web analytics or event tracking at real volume and cares as much about a reliable SDK as about the systems that catch its data. **Your Impact** --------------- * Build Northbeam's mobile attribution solution end to end: SDK, ingestion APIs, data model, and the dashboard views customers use to act on it. * Design and own our client\-side SDKs in JavaScript/TypeScript, and help shape our iOS SDK, so they capture events accurately with minimal impact on customer site and app performance. * Build and scale high\-throughput APIs and microservices in TypeScript and Python that ingest, validate, and route event data from our customers' sites and apps. * Partner with the CAPI team to ingest server\-side conversion events and deliver them reliably to ad platforms. * Own the reliability of these ingestion paths: load testing, monitoring, alerting, and performance tuning. * Ship frontend features in React and TypeScript when a product experience needs them. * Scope projects with product managers, data scientists, and customer success, and help set technical direction for how Northbeam collects data. **What You Bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years building production software, with deep fullstack experience in TypeScript/JavaScript across frontend and backend. * Professional experience building services or APIs in Python, and comfort working across TypeScript and Python microservices in the same system. * A track record designing and scaling high\-throughput APIs: you've handled request volume, latency, queuing, retries, and idempotency in production. * Hands\-on experience with web analytics or event tracking: building tracking SDKs, pixels, or tag libraries, designing event schemas, and working within browser constraints like cookie restrictions and ad blockers. * Proficiency in SQL; experience with BigQuery or a similar cloud data warehouse. * Startup instincts: you turn ambiguous product needs into sound architecture and ship production\-ready code with minimal guidance. * Interest in mentoring other engineers and raising the bar for what the team ships. **Bonus Skills \& Experience** ------------------------------ * iOS SDK development in Swift, or building SDKs that third\-party developers install and depend on. * Familiarity with mobile attribution: mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch), SKAdNetwork or AdAttributionKit, and Apple's App Tracking Transparency. * Experience with server\-side conversion APIs such as Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions, or the TikTok Events API. * Streaming or event pipeline experience (Pub/Sub, Kafka, or similar) on GCP or another major cloud. * Experience in marketing, e\-commerce, or ad\-tech. Actual compensation may vary based on experience, skills, and location. In addition to your base salary, we offer an equity package, comprehensive healthcare benefits (medical, dental, and vision), and a 401(k) plan. Our team enjoys a flexible PTO policy, 12 company\-paid holidays, and 12 weeks of paid parental leave. We also provide a $500 work\-from\-home stipend to support your remote setup. **Interview Process** The interview process varies by role but typically begins with a 30\-minute interview with a Northbeam recruiter, followed by a video interview with the hiring manager. Next, candidates complete a role\-specific video interview followed by video or onsite interviews with several team members. The final step is a video interview with our CEO/Co\-founder. The entire interview process is usually 5\-7 interviews total and requires around 5\-8 hours of your time. We accept applications on an ongoing basis.

agent evaluation systems. * Experience with EDI, supply chain, logistics, or commerce platforms. ### ***Why work at Orderful?*** * **Flexibility \& Balance:** Unlimited PTO, a full week off for the software development lifecycle (SDLC) practices * Experience working with developer tools, CI/CD pipelines, or cloud\-based environments * 1\+ years of demonstrated experience with AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, Cursor, Replit, or similar) * Ability to translate technical workflows into repeatable processes or automation * Strong collaboration and communication skills across technical and non\-technical teams *Preferred Qualifications:** Experience with .NET/C\#, React, and AWS * Experience in software architecture, platform engineering, or developer experience roles * Experience with prompt engineering or AI workflow design * Familiarity with governance, security, or compliance considerations in software delivery * Experience enabling or scaling developer productivity across teams * Exposure to multiple functional domains (e.g., engineering \+ DevOps, or product \+ engineering) Benefits: * Medical and Dental coverage available for employees, dependents, domestic partners, and spouses * Paid Time Off – Flexible options plus 10 paid company holidays where available\*\* * All full\-time positions are hybrid, with many eligible to be completely remote * Fully Paid by Origami Risk – Vision insurance, Short \& Long\-Term Disability Insurance, and Basic Life Insurance * Generous family leave options—including adoption and foster care placements * Pre\-Tax Savings Accounts – Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Commuter Benefits, Dependent Care Savings Account * Retirement Savings – 401(k) with company match up to 4% jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: At Orion, we're building the intelligent infrastructure that powers modern financial advisory, unifying planning, investing, and client engagement for thousands of advisors and millions of investor accounts. We're looking for a Senior AI Engineer who ships, not just experiments. This is a hands\-on, product\-facing role. You'll own the end\-to\-end delivery of AI\-powered features, from architecture to production — working alongside product managers, designers, and engineers to move fast and build things that matter. **Technical Skills:** * Hands\-on experience building and optimizing RAG systems and agentic workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Haystack. * Experience designing agentic pipelines and loop architectures, including multi\-step reasoning, tool use, and autonomous retrieval systems * Working knowledge of at least one vector database (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS, or similar) including indexing and query optimization * Experience building and maintaining data preprocessing, chunking, and vectorization pipelines * Ability to evaluate and select LLMs (GPT\-4o, Claude, LLaMA, Mistral, etc.) based on cost, latency, and real\-world performance * AWS infrastructure experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tooling (Terraform) * Strong API design and service development skills. * Strong experience developing enterprise applications using **C\# and .NET**, with the ability to integrate AI/ML solutions into existing business systems. * Experience designing and maintaining **data pipelines and data architectures** that support AI, analytics, and machine learning workloads. * Ability to build scalable, production\-ready AI solutions while leveraging strong software engineering fundamentals across the Microsoft technology stack. **Responsibilities:** * Own AI features end\-to\-end: design, build, and ship to production * Architect and maintain RAG and agentic pipelines across internal and external data sources * Integrate LLMs and generative AI into products and workflows * Apply prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and custom embeddings to optimize performance in a financial services context * Instrument and monitor AI features in production: quality, latency, regressions, and user impact * Manage cloud infrastructure on AWS using Terraform to support reliable AI service deployment Most companies say they're serious about AI. At Orion, it's the expectation, built into how every engineer on our team works, at every level, every day. Not a tool you reach for occasionally. Not a line on your resume. A force multiplier embedded in the craft. Our CTO put it plainly: AI is not a trend to get ahead of. It is embedded at every level, expected of every engineer, every day. We measure by the leverage we create. At Orion, we build the technology that powers independent financial advisors — the professionals who help everyday people plan for retirement, protect their families, and build financial security. Our platform touches billions in assets under management, which means the software we ship must be fast, reliable, and always getting better. We're not a startup chasing hype. We're a scaled business deliberately building an engineering culture that will take us to the next level — and we're doing it now. Here's what people who've been here a while tend to say: they noticed the informality first and missed the intensity until it caught up with them. Both are real. Nobody is going to make you feel small for not knowing something. And we move fast, care deeply about outcomes, and hold each other to a high standard. The team works hard for each other, which means showing up and contributing at pace isn't just a performance expectation — it's a form of respect. You will own everything you commit. Full stop. Whether you wrote it line by line or shaped it with AI assistance, the standard is the same: you understand it, you can defend it, and it ships with your name on it. AI accelerates execution. It does not replace system design, architectural thinking, or the judgment required to build software that holds up under real load. We operate in fintech, which adds an important layer: client data is sacred and compliance guardrails are non\-negotiable. The engineers who cut corners here are not the engineers who last here. You are not threatened by change — you cause it. You ask "why not?" before you default to the familiar. You experiment, share what you learn, and close gaps fast. You are already using AI tools in your daily workflow. Not as a curiosity. As a practice. \#LI\-AP1 \#LI\-Onsite \#LI\-Hybrid **Recommended Skills:** Artificial Intelligence (AI), Data Processing, Large Language Models (LLMs), Modeling Languages, Software Development, Standard ML (Programming Language)**Salary Range:** $140,935\.00 \- $226,905\.00 The pay listed in this posting indicates the estimated pay at the time of this posting; however, may vary depending on geographic location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition, Orion offers a competitive benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, and disability coverage on day one, 401(k) plan with employer match, paid parental leave, pet benefits including pawternity leave and pet insurance, student loan repayment and more. **About Us** At Orion, we achieve our best work when we support one another, staying personally accountable to each other and the clients we serve. We create a welcoming environment where everyone is respected, valued, and heard. Our commitment to **create raving** **fans** ensures we consistently exceed client expectations. Thinking differently is in our DNA—we **innovate always**, push boundaries, and reject the status quo to deliver transformative outcomes. Together, we **support one another** and **see it through** to success, driving our collective achievements and those of our clients.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Guest App Platform
jobs.description: **About Owner** Owner is the AI\-native system local business owners use to succeed, starting with restaurants. We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business. It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more. **Product philosophy** Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically. Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it. Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you. **Our vision** We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online. But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive. Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type. In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age. **Our traction** Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com website. More importantly, we’ve helped over 20,000 restaurant owners, and saved them nearly $200 million in fees. **Our team** Our team is now in the low hundreds. We’ve got top talent from the most successful companies in SMB software, including: Shopify, HubSpot, DoorDash, ServiceTitan, Rappi, Faire and Stripe. We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth. **Where we work** Owner is a remote\-first, global company headquartered in San Francisco, with a sales hub in Toronto. For a few of our roles we prioritize in\-person collaboration at one of our office locations. Most of our teammates are distributed throughout the globe. Please review the role description and discuss with your recruiter for more details on location! **Role Overview** Owner is the leading all\-in\-one platform for independent restaurants. Guest App Platform is the distribution machine behind thousands of white\-labeled restaurant apps: it launches them, signs them, and keeps every one current on the App Store and Google Play at minimal cost. We're looking for a Staff Engineer to be the technical lead for that platform as we scale to more and more restaurants. You'll work on problems that look very different from a typical mobile role: Temporal workflows that run across thousands of apps, CI/CD and build infrastructure, code signing and provisioning across Apple and Google accounts at scale, and automation (including AI) that removes manual steps while keeping a human fallback where it matters. This is a high\-ownership, hands\-on role. You'll be the technical anchor for the Guest App Platform team, setting strategy, keeping the team focused on its goals, and making the platform self\-serve so product teams and Launch Specialists can ship into the app without us. This role is 100% remote and can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada. For San Francisco\-based candidates: we have a new HQ in the Presidio for optional in\-person collaboration. **Why we’re looking for you** The Guest App Platform team is responsible for launching and keeping thousands of white\-labeled apps up to date while keeping costs at a minimum. We don't build guest\-facing features. We build the distribution machine underneath every app, and the tooling that lets product teams and our Launch Specialists ship into it. If a restaurant joins Owner, our platform is how their app reaches the App Store and stays healthy. This is not a normal mobile role. Most mobile engineers keep a handful of apps up to date. We manage thousands, day in and day out, across Apple and Google ecosystems, and we automate everything we can, including with AI. **Our Tech Stack** * **Mobile:** React Native, Typescript, iOS and Android (universal binaries re\-skinned and re\-signed per brand) * **Orchestration:** Temporal, scheduled workers, Human\-in\-the\-loop systems * **Infrastructure \& Tooling:** CI/CD pipelines, IP proxies, Kubernetes, in\-house bulk deployment tooling * **Backend \& Internal Tools:** Node.js, TypeScript, Postgresql, Kubernetes, various AWS services. * **Automation \& AI:** Browser automation, AI\-assisted workflows **The impact you'll have** * **Lead the team technically**: set strategy and priorities, make architecture decisions, and keep the team focused on its goals * **Operate apps at fleet scale**: own how thousands of separately branded apps are built, signed, deployed and kept current. Design reliable, observable workflows for launches, releases, store submissions and account operations * **Own CI/CD and build infrastructure**: make builds faster, cheaper and more reliable for other developers. * **Build the tooling our internal customers need**: full\-stack tools for Launch Specialists and product teams so they can launch and maintain apps without minimal intervention for us. * **Delete manual steps**: find the work humans do repeatedly and automate it, using AI where it makes sense and keeping humans in the loop where it doesn't * **Navigate Apple and Google**: certificates, provisioning, agreements, App Store review and compliance, at scale * **Partner across the company**: work with product engineering, Launch Specialists and leadership, technical and non\-technical alike * **Build the team**: mentor engineers, interview candidates and raise the bar **What we’re looking for** * Staff\-level experience leading a team or area technically: setting strategy, driving alignment, and delivering through others * **Production experience with Temporal** or other similar orchestration tools (required) * **Strong CI/CD pipeline experience** (required): building, operating and optimizing pipelines and build infrastructure * Full\-stack ability: comfortable building web apps, APIs and database\-backed internal tools * Experience with mobile release engineering: signing, provisioning, store submission, and release management. Experience doing this across many apps, accounts or brands is a strong plus * Strong communicator who works well with both technical and non\-technical coworkers * A bias for automation: you'd rather delete a manual step than add a feature * Experience at a product\-focused startup, scale\-up or technology company * Ownership, and comfort with ambiguity and cross\-cutting problems * Past work experience in hospitality, retail, or IT is a plus **Compensation and benefits** * The estimated starting base salary range for this role is $240K\-$260K USD depending on level, location and experience, plus a generous pre\-IPO equity package * Other benefits include comprehensive health coverage, work from anywhere (remote\-first workplace), unlimited PTO \- plus extra fun perks! **Notice \- Employment Scams** Communication from our team regarding job opportunities will only be made by an Owner team member with an @owner.com email address. We do not conduct interviews over email or chat platforms, and we will never ask you to provide personal or financial information such as your mailing address, social security number, credit card numbers or banking information. If you believe you are being contacted by a scammer, please mark the communication as "phishing" or “spam” and do not respond. \#LI\-AB1

jobs.title: Senior Software Applications Engineer (AI/ML)
jobs.description: Overview: **Role Summary** We are seeking a **Senior Software Applications Engineer(AI/ML)** to join our team, focusing on the development of cutting\-edge machine learning and artificial intelligence solutions for the semiconductor industry. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in creating robust and scalable software, with a strong background in data analysis, machine learning, and containerization technologies. Responsibilities: * **Design and Implement ML/AI Algorithms:** Help develop and implement advanced machine learning and AI\-based algorithms for the automatic classification of defects in semiconductor inspection tools. * **Data Analysis:** Analyze large volumes of defect data to identify critical patterns, trends, and anomalies, using this analysis to inform model development. * **Training and Model Development:** Train, validate, and deploy defect classification models, ensuring they meet strict performance and accuracy requirements. * **System Optimization:** Continuously improves the accuracy, efficiency, and reliability of the defect classification system through iterative development and optimization. Qualifications:* + **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical field. + **Machine Learning Expertise:** Proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch specifically for computer vision tasks (CNNs, Transformers). + **Semiconductor Knowledge:** Familiarity with semiconductor manufacturing processes or inspection metrology is highly preferred. + **Data Proficiency:** Experience handling large datasets and using tools like Pandas, NumPy and SQL for data preprocessing and feature engineering. + **Problem Solving:** Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate complex manufacturing defects into actionable data models, data ingestion, analysis, and visualization. **Preferred Skills*** + Experience with Mismatched Data or Active Learning techniques to handle rare defect types. + Knowledge of ML Ops tools (ML Flow, zen Flow etc.) for model deployment and monitoring in a production environment. + Excellent communication skills to collaborate with cross\-functional hardware and software teams. Pay Range: CAD $120,000\.00 \- CAD $160,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: ENGSWEP4 - Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Purpose in Every Position** Pebl puts a world of talent at your fingertips. With our AI\-powered Global Work Platform, companies can hire, pay, and manage employees in 185\+ countries—removing risk, red tape, and guesswork from global growth. Backed by more than a decade of compliance leadership and local expertise, Pebl helps businesses move fast, stay compliant, and scale with confidence. With Pebl, companies everywhere can hire great talent anywhere. **Where Your Work Moves the Needle.** At Pebl, every team member drives our success. Joining us means more than filling a role—you’re accountable for results and impact. Our values guide how we operate, execute, and collaborate across borders. By putting them into action, you’ll help us scale faster, compete harder, and lead the future of global work. **What Makes You a Great Fit** Pebl moves over a billion dollars across 180\+ countries to make sure each employee gets paid every cent on time. In order to achieve this, Pebl needs both a consistent money movement system to pay out payroll cross border, and a flexible invoicing system to facilitate Pebl customers with the exact amount they need to pay. Every country and every customer’s requirements are different, and so navigating complex global requirements, differing payment systems, and strong fraud rules are critical. The more compliant and transparent our system is, the more trust our customers can have that they are paying their employees on time and reliably. We’re a primarily backend focused team with fullstack capabilities, and are looking for someone to further bolster that expertise. We’re searching for a backend focused engineer that knows how to build reliable, scalable systems that can guarantee stable money movement rails, but also flexibly integrate across many global systems and their specific quirks. They’ll work closely with product and design to transform our new vision for fraud and payments into real features, and collaborate closely with other engineers on the team to really bring it to life. While backend will be the primary body of work, we also are looking for someone who works across the stack to build frontend features and enhance our dedicated frontend engineer’s capabilities. They should also prioritize simplicity and reliability in the face of unknown complexities, while also understanding when to make necessary, clear\-eyed tradeoffs to create business impact effectively. If that sounds like you, we’d love to have you on board. ***This role will require in\-office collaboration Monday\-Wednesday in our Palo Alto, CA office.*** **How You’ll Make an Impact** * Design and build stable systems and new features that allow Pebl’s EOR employees to reliably receive their paycheck through different global financial systems across 180\+ countries * Build experiences for our customers to transparently and painlessly pay their employees * Develop seamless 3rd party integrations with payment vendors that help enhance Pebl’s capabilities and abilities to pay our users * Build new ways for employees to engage with their paychecks, such as through AI agents, that are straightforward, reliable, but also secure. * Build the foundation for a more robust fraud and AML system. * Sharpen and delight the way our customers experience invoices to provide rich and robust data and insights **Let’s Connect If You Have** * 6\+ years of professional fullstack software engineering experience * 1\+ years of experience building backends and API frameworks for invoicing or financial systems, or 2\+ years building backends in domains that require the same uncompromising uptime or accuracy as payments * Strong command of Typescript for backend systems, paired with a foundational understanding of frontend API needs * Experience with AWS or similar cloud services, PostgresQL or similar RDBMS systems, and Kubernetes. * A general understanding of modern frontend frameworks, such as React and tailwind. While this is a primarily backend role, we expect 20% of the work to be frontend. * Proven experience working with designers and product managers to go from product requirements and wireframes to tangible and customer impacting features **Our Commitment to You** At Pebl, we’re committed to supporting our team with comprehensive rewards and benefits designed to meet diverse needs across roles and locations. Our core offerings include: * **Flexible Time Off** – Take the time you need to recharge. * **Parental Leave** – Support for growing families. * **Health and Dental Insurance** – Where applicable, to cover you and your loved ones. * **Retirement Savings \+ Employee Incentive Plan** – Plan for the future while sharing our success. Please visit our career page for more information. **Pebl is an Equal Opportunity Employer.** We power global teams and believe diverse perspectives drive innovation and impact. Employment decisions at Pebl are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive and do the best work of their career—anywhere in the world. Compensation Range: $160K \- $200K

jobs.title: Senior AI Software Engineer

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible. **Senior AI Software Engineer** **Boston, MA Hybrid 2\-3 days a week** PTC’s software is used to design, build and service many of the world’s most complex products, from aircraft and cars to medical devices and industrial equipment. jobs.title: Database Architect
jobs.description: **Database Architect** **Atlanta, GA** **Remote** ***(Local Candidates strongly preferred. )*** **Job Summary** As a Database Architect, you’ll shape reliable, scalable database solutions that support business applications and data needs. You’ll guide database architecture and design, strengthen performance and availability, and collaborate with software and data teams to turn requirements into practical systems. The client's Unified ERP Program is replacing legacy systems for human capital management, financials, and student information with a unified Software as a Service (SaaS) solution. The Data Warehouse Architect will provide dedicated expertise for this work, reducing reporting disruption and supporting reliable access to institutional data during and after implementation. **Position Summary** The Data Warehouse Architect will establish the future\-state reporting and analytics architecture for client’s transition to Workday. The role will define how Workday reporting, the institutional data warehouse, data lake services, legacy data, and downstream analytics fit together. Working with information technology and project stakeholders, the Architect will set design standards and document a practical roadmap that supports report redevelopment, reliable data access, and long\-term institutional use. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Knowledge of enterprise data architecture, data warehousing, and modern data lake patterns * Knowledge of data governance, data quality, metadata, privacy, and access control principles * Ability to evaluate integration and data consumption approaches for reliability, scalability, and maintainability * Strong analytical, documentation, facilitation, and communication skills * Ability to work across technical teams, reporting teams, vendors, and campus stakeholders * Ability to balance immediate transition needs with sustainable future\-state design **Duties/Responsibilities** **Architecture and Strategy (40%)** * Develop the Workday reporting and data warehouse architecture strategy, including data flows, integration patterns, and data consumption approaches. * Define the target\-state data warehouse design and the role of data lake services in supporting reporting and analytics. * Create architecture documentation, design standards, and a phased technical roadmap for implementation. **Data Governance and Legacy Data Planning (30%)** * Recommend data governance standards covering ownership, definitions, quality, metadata, access, and appropriate use. * Develop an approach for retaining and accessing legacy data needed for historical, operational, and analytical reporting. * Assess architectural options and document assumptions, dependencies, risks, and decisions for project leadership. **Technical Design and Implementation Guidance (20%)** * Guide integration and warehouse design decisions and review technical solutions for alignment with the approved architecture. * Partner with the Feed Engineer and report development team to ensure data structures and feeds support prioritized reporting needs. * Advise on data quality validation, testing, deployment, and production support approaches. **Stakeholder Collaboration and Knowledge Transfer (10%)** * Facilitate architecture discussions with business and technical stakeholders and communicate design recommendations clearly. * Maintain architecture records and transfer knowledge to staff responsible for ongoing operations. **Physical Demands** Work is primarily performed in an office setting, involving extended periods of sitting and computer use. The position may require occasional in\-person meetings with project and campus stakeholders. **Impact and Influence** The position will influence technical decisions across reporting, data integration, and analytics workstreams. It will work closely with project leadership, IT staff, business data owners, vendors, and report developers to establish a coherent architecture and guide implementation choices. **About the Project** The Unified Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) Program intends to replace client's legacy systems for human capital management and financials, improve the experience for students, faculty, and staff, streamline core business processes, and unify technology in a single SaaS solution. * Experience designing enterprise data warehouse, data lake, or analytics architectures Required 5 Years * Experience with cloud data platforms, data integration patterns, and enterprise reporting environments Required 5 Years * Experience establishing data governance, metadata, security, and data access practices Required 5 Years * Experience with Workday data and reporting, higher education, or large public\-sector environments Required 5 Years * Ability to translate business reporting needs into scalable technical architecture and roadmaps Required 5 Years Pay: $85\.00 \- $100\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, AI Growth Engineer (Staff+ Level)
jobs.description: **The Mission** --------------- More than 95% of drugs that pass animal testing fail in human trials. A single new drug takes about $2\.6 billion and 12\.5 years to develop, and most of that effort goes to candidates that were never going to work in people. AI was supposed to change this. But most AI for drug discovery is still trained on the same inputs that got us here: animal data, irreproducible papers, and cell lines that don’t respond like living tissue. A model can only learn the biology it’s shown, and no amount of scale or compute fixes bad data. What’s missing is data on how living human tissue responds to a drug, across the range of people who will actually take it. That data barely exists, because there has been no way to generate it at scale without putting patients at risk. Parallel Bio grows it. Our expert biologists build living human immune systems, called immune organoids, from a proprietary biobank spanning ages, sexes, ancestries and disease states. That means we can ask how a drug behaves in an older patient, a specific ancestry or an autoimmune background, not just in an average donor. We've already modeled immunotoxicology, immunogen stimulation and two autoimmune diseases, with more on the way. Our founders are world experts in scalable organoids. Robert is a Stanford\-trained immunologist. Juliana trained in the lab that invented the first organoid and later automated them at System1 Biosciences. We run these experiments in an AI\-driven robotic lab, and every experiment makes our world model smarter, which in turn chooses better experiments. We build every layer ourselves: the biology, the robotics, the data infrastructure, and the model that orchestrates it all. The whole lab is callable over API and MCP, so AI agents can design and run real biological experiments, within safety limits we set. For biologists, that means asking questions at a scale and pace no bench can match. For engineers, it means building AI that learns from real human biology instead of the literature. It's already working. Our platform is 87% concordant with clinical outcomes, compared with roughly 3% translational success for animal models. Five Fortune 500 companies use it to test drugs, and our data has informed a Phase 1 trial. We've raised \~$30M from AIX Ventures, Marc Benioff, Jeff Dean and Y Combinator. With the FDA Modernization Act 3\.0 and the FDA's March 2026 validation framework, regulation is moving our way. The opportunity is generational. We're building the first scaled engine for real human biological data, and using it to know which drugs will work in people before they ever reach a trial. **Your Skills** --------------- Must have experience in high\-scale B2C Growth (Acquisition, Activation, and Retention) and be able to design AI\-powered growth loops **Parallel Bio is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive and respectful workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, or sexual orientation.**

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description: **Build the Path Forward** ========================== At Path Robotics, we're building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI\-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field\-ready AI that is risk\-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real\-world use. Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together. We're seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our Robotics team. You'll use machine learning to improve how our robots plan, scan, and act. You'll frame real robot problems as well\-defined ML problems, train models on data that a fleet of production robotic cells generates every day, and ship them into a production stack where they work alongside classical planning and perception. Your models run on live robots doing real work for customers. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Frame open\-ended problems in planning, scanning, and robot behavior as well\-defined ML problems. * Train models that work with classical methods, such as initial guesses and learned costs for trajectory optimization, plan quality and feasibility predictors, and learned collision models. * Develop viewpoint planning policies that choose where and how to scan, and predict scan quality before the robot commits. * Apply imitation learning, reinforcement learning, and generative models such as diffusion and flow matching where they outperform classical baselines. * Build production ML pipelines: datasets from fleet logs and simulation, training, and metrics. * Evaluate models in the loop, with offline metrics that predict gains on the robot, failure\-mode analysis, and calibrated confidence that determines when the system falls back to classical methods. * Own your models end to end, from prototype to deployment on live robotic cells, with low\-latency inference and monitoring. **Who You Are** --------------- * An MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field. * 2\+ years of applied machine learning for robotics or autonomy, in research or industry. * Fluent in Python with PyTorch or JAX, and experienced training, evaluating, and deploying deep learning models. * Strong foundations in linear algebra, 3D geometry, kinematics, and optimization. * You've run your methods on real robot hardware. * You explain model results and their limits clearly, so planning, perception, and field teams know when to trust them. **Preferred** ------------- * C\+\+, and experience deploying models into a C\+\+ or ROS 2 production stack. * Motion planning, trajectory optimization, or collision checking. * Active perception, next\-best\-view or informative path planning, or 3D point cloud learning. * Uncertainty estimation and calibration, or Bayesian and information\-theoretic planning. * GPU inference optimization (CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX). * Simulation and sim\-to\-real transfer (Isaac Lab, MuJoCo). * Publications at RSS, CoRL, ICRA, IROS, NeurIPS, ICML, or similar venues. **Why You'll Love Working Here** * Daily free lunch to keep you fueled and connected with the team * Flexible PTO so you can take the time you need, when you need it * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 6 weeks fully paid parental leave, plus an additional 6–8 weeks for birthing parents (12–14 weeks total) * 401(k) retirement plan through Empower * Generous employee referral bonuses—help us grow our team! **Who We Are** -------------- At Path Robotics we love coming to work to solve interesting and tough challenges but also because our ideas are welcomed and valued. We encourage unique thinking and are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application process or any part of the hiring process, please contact HR@path\-robotics.com. We are committed to providing equal access and will work with qualified individuals to ensure a fair and accessible hiring experience. We will respond to your request within 48 hours.

For additional information on remote work at Penn State, see** **Notice to Out of State Applicants** **.** This position is funded for 2 year(s); continuation past 2 year(s) will be based on university need, performance, and/or availability of funding. **POSITION SPECIFICS** The **Institute for Computational and Data Sciences (ICDS)** at Penn State seeks a **Lead Systems Engineer** to architect and lead the implementation of LATTICE (Layered and Thin\-Film Technologies with Intelligent Cloud Experimentation), an NSF\-funded Programmable Cloud Laboratory Test Bed. LATTICE will let researchers across the country design, run, and analyze thin\-film materials experiments remotely, with AI agents helping to plan experiments, set instrument parameters, and interpret results. The position will be filled at the **Research Computing Systems Engineer \- Principal Professional OR Senior Professional** level, based on the successful candidate's skill and experience levels. The position reports to the LATTICE Assistant Director, with project priorities set by the LATTICE Principal Investigator. ICDS works with researchers from more than 70 academic departments across nearly all of Penn State’s colleges and campuses, and provides Roar, Penn State’s research supercomputer. As part of ICDS, you will help equip researchers with cutting\-edge computing tools and resources for their science. The LATTICE Cloud Lab brings together advanced deposition and characterization instruments (MBE, MOCVD, sputtering, XRD, AFM and TEM), edge computers next to those instruments, Penn State’s Roar Collab high\-performance computing and storage, the LiST materials database of more than 20,000 samples, a multi\-agent AI framework developed with partners at UC San Diego and Georgia Tech, and web interfaces for external users. As Lead Systems Engineer, you will own how these pieces fit together and work as one secure, reliable system. This position is ideal for an engineer who enjoys system\-level design, working across hardware, software, data and AI, and turning a research vision into a working platform that real users depend on. It also suits someone who can right\-size engineering effort: moving quickly and keeping process lightweight, while applying rigor where it matters most — instrument safety, security and data integrity. **Work Arrangement:** The position requires on\-site work at University Park; a hybrid arrangement may be considered for the successful candidate. Questions related to flexible work arrangement may be directed to the hiring manager during the interview. **Responsibilities:** As the Lead Systems Engineer, your responsibilities include the following: * Develop and manage the system requirements, defining a Minimum Viable Product (12 months), an Enhanced System (18 months) and a Full Production release, and revisit requirements as agile development proceeds. * Architect the Cloud Lab cyberinfrastructure, including instruments, edge computers, HPC and cloud compute, storage, the LiST database, AI agents and user interfaces. * Determine and document where each component runs and where each type of data is stored, moved, backed up and retained; size and provision the compute, GPU, storage and network resources each release needs with ICDS and Penn State IT. * Define the interfaces and data standards every component follows, including a vendor\-neutral instrument control layer through which AI agents generate instrument parameters with human\-in\-the\-loop verification. * Lead the Cloud Lab System working group, directing the project work of   LATTICE sits where materials science, high\-performance computing and AI meet, and you will be the person who makes them work together. You will not own a narrow slice of the system: you will set its architecture, guide the people building it and see researchers across the country use it to make discoveries. You will also be close to the Science. As a member of ICDS, Penn State’s home for research computing, you will work directly with faculty experts in thin\-film materials, AI and simulation, partner with the Materials Research Institute, and help define how programmable cloud laboratories work across a national network of NSF test beds. **How to apply** To receive full consideration for the position, applications should include: * A cover letter expressing the candidate’s interest in the role A current Curriculum Vitae (CV) or resume * **MINIMUM EDUCATION, WORK EXPERIENCE \& REQUIRED CERTIFICATIONS** If filled as Research Computing Systems Engineer \- Principal Professional, this position requires:\&\#xa;Bachelor's Degree\&\#xa;8\+ years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience accepted\&\#xa;Required Certifications:\&\#xa;None\&\#xa;\&\#xa;If filled as Research Computing Systems Engineer \- Senior Professional, this position requires:\&\#xa;Bachelor's Degree\&\#xa;6\+ years of relevant experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience accepted\&\#xa;Required Certifications:\&\#xa;None **BACKGROUND CHECKS/CLEARANCES** Employment with the University will require successful completion of background check(s) in accordance with University policies. Penn State does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of a staff employment Visa. Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. **SALARY \& BENEFITS** The salary range for this position, including all possible grades, is $102,936\.00 \- $173,844\.00\. Salary Structure \- Information on Penn State's salary structure Penn State provides a competitive benefits package for full\-time employees designed to support both personal and professional well\-being. In addition to comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, employees enjoy robust retirement plans and substantial paid time off which includes holidays, vacation and sick time. One of the standout benefits is the generous 75% tuition discount, available to employees as well as eligible spouses and children. For more detailed information, please visit our Benefits Page . **CAMPUS SECURITY CRIME STATISTICS** Pursuant to the Jeanne Clery Disclosure of Campus Security Policy and Campus Crime Statistics Act and the Pennsylvania Act of 1988, Penn State publishes a combined Annual Security and Annual Fire Safety Report (ASR). The ASR includes crime statistics and institutional policies concerning campus security, such as those concerning alcohol and drug use, crime prevention, the reporting of crimes, sexual assault, and other matters. The ASR is available for review here . **EEO IS THE LAW** Penn State is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. If you are unable to use our online application process due to an impairment or disability, please contact 814\-865\-1473\. Penn State is committed to and accountable for advancing equity, respect, and belonging. We embrace individual uniqueness, as well as a culture of belonging that supports equity initiatives, leverages the educational and institutional benefits of inclusion in society, and provides opportunities for engagement intended to help all members of the community thrive. We value belonging as a core strength and an essential element of the university’s teaching, research, and service mission.
