jobs.title: Production Operations Lead
jobs.description: ##### **About Peraton** Peraton is a next\-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure. ##### **About The Role** The Production Operations Lead is accountable for the stability, availability, and recoverability of MARx in production. MARx is the CMS system of record for Medicare Advantage and Part D enrollment, premiums, and plan payments. It serves about 53 million beneficiaries and more than 300 Plan Sponsor Organizations, and supports about $68 billion a month in plan payments. The Lead runs day\-to\-day production operations across the CMS AWS environment, leads incident and problem management, owns the disaster recovery and continuity program, and makes sure the operational calendar is met on time: daily, monthly, and annual processing, payment files, file exchanges, and New Year Preparation. The Lead also drives the automation and process improvements that move capacity from operations and maintenance toward enhancements. The Lead works closely with CMS business owners, the CMS Office of Information Technology (OIT), the MAPD Business Operations Support Contractor (MBOSC), CMS help desks and incident response teams, and the partner systems MARx depends on, including SSA, RRB, HPMS, APPS, and the Common Medicare Environment shared with MEPBS. The position calls for hands\-on operational leadership and sound judgment under pressure. Operations work competes with enhancement work for the same team capacity: ServiceNow ticket triage is continuous, security incidents take absolute priority, and New Year Preparation draws heavily on the team from July through March. The Lead must make clear prioritization decisions that protect payment accuracy, beneficiary coverage, and on\-time delivery to plans. Beyond running production, the Lead serves as a trusted operational advisor to program leadership and CMS, mentors production support staff, and drives the reliability and automation improvements that reduce operational workload over the life of the contract. The Lead will have a real opportunity to shape how MARx is operated, reduce operational workload, strengthen disaster recovery, and build a capable operations team. **Key Responsibilities** * **Production monitoring and availability** * Lead real\-time monitoring of MARx jobs, system health, cost and usage, and security events using CMS\-approved tools (currently Splunk, Splunk On\-Call, Datadog, Amazon CloudWatch, and Amazon QuickSight dashboards). Identify and resolve anomalies and errors before they affect plans or beneficiaries. * Manage and maintain 99\.9% system availability and response time across the production environment, and report performance against that target. * Maintain scalability and code portability for operations in the cloud environment, working with the DevOps Lead and Architectural Lead. * Apply the AWS Well\-Architected Framework to production operations to achieve operational excellence, security, reliability, performance efficiency, and cost optimization in the cloud hosting environment. * Plan capacity for periodic peak processing loads, such as monthly payment processing, the Annual Enrollment Period, and New Year Preparation. * Identify the causes of processing errors and correct them quickly to minimize system downtime. * **Disaster recovery and continuity of operations** * Own the MARx Disaster Recovery (DR) Playbook: organizational roles and contacts, management and escalation, declaration and testing guidelines, notifications, infrastructure and network configuration details, and step\-by\-step failover and failback procedures. * Meet the Recovery Time Objectives and Recovery Point Objectives defined in the Business Impact Assessment. * Lead MARx participation in annual Contingency Plan tabletop tests and in DR exercises CMS requests, and turn the results into corrective actions. * **Incident, problem, and security event response** * Lead production incident response from detection through recovery. Coordinate the scrum teams, the DevOps and Security Leads, and partner systems. * Make sure suspected or confirmed security and privacy incidents and breaches are reported to the CMS Incident Response Team, the COR, and the CO within one hour. Make sure HHS CSIRC and CMS IRT alerts and indicators of compro that process personally identifiable information and financial transactions. * Ability to obtain and maintain the CMS background investigation and HSPD\-12 PIV credential required for the position. **Technical Expertise** * Experience operating batch processing and file\-based data exchanges with external partners on fixed processing calendars. * Working knowledge of federal security operations: FISMA, NIST SP 800\-53, incident reporting, vulnerability remediation, POA\&M management, and ATO support. * Hands\-on knowledge of AWS operations, including compute, containers, serverless, databases, networking, monitoring, and security services. * Experience with observability tooling, centralized logging, alerting, and on\-call management. * Experience with production database operations, including availability, backup, recovery, and data integrity. **Medicare Domain Knowledge** * Understanding of CMS and Medicare program operations, and of how production issues affect beneficiaries, plans, and payments. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with CMS systems and processes, especially Medicare Advantage and Part D enrollment, premium, and payment operations, and the New Year Preparation cycle. * Hands\-on experience with the MARx stack's operations tools: Splunk and Splunk On\-Call, Datadog, CloudWatch, AWS Security Hub and GuardDuty, and Amazon QuickSight. * Familiarity with Aurora MySQL and PostgreSQL, ECS Fargate, Lambda, AWS Batch, SQS/SNS, and CMS Enterprise File Transfer. * Industry certification such as AWS Certified SysOps Administrator or DevOps Engineer, ITIL 4, or an equivalent. * Experience leading SRE\-style automation that measurably reduced operational workload. * Direct experience with MARx production operations, including its batch schedule, interfaces, and operational calendar. * Familiarity with CMS governance: the Target Life Cycle, Technical Reference Architecture, Acceptable Risk Safeguards, and the MEPS Change Control Board process. * Experience with HHS/CMS incident and breach response procedures, including breach reporting under OMB M\-17\-12\. * Experience with ServiceNow incident and case workflows. * Experience applying SI\-enabled monitoring or automation, such as anomaly detection, in a regulated environment. ##### **Details** **Target Salary Range:** $176,000 \- $282,000\. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay. **Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits. **Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on\-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own. **EEO:** Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Associate Director, AI/ML & Digital Health Analytics
jobs.description: **Position Summary** We are seeking a highly motivated Associate Director, AI/ML \& Digital Health Analytics to join the Digital Sciences, Imaging \& Translational AI (DITA) team within AI/ML Quantitative and Digital Sciences (AQDS). The primary focus of this role is the development and application of modern AI/ML technologies, including Generative AI, large language models (LLMs), and agentic AI workflows, to address complex scientific and analytical challenges across pharmaceutical R\&D. The successful candidate will design, prototype, evaluate, and help operationalize AI\-enabled solutions that enhance scientific analysis, automate quantitative workflows, and accelerate data\-driven decision\-making. The candidate will play a key role in establishing rigorous evaluation frameworks, benchmarking strategies, and statistical methodologies for assessing Generative AI and agentic systems. The candidate will work across **multimodal biomedical and healthcare data**, including omics, medical imaging, digital health technologies (DHTs), and real\-world data (RWD), and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to translate emerging AI capabilities into scientifically rigorous and impactful solutions. The role is ideal for an individual who combines strong **AI/ML and computational capabilities** with a solid foundation in **statistics and quantitative sciences**, and who enjoys working at the intersection of emerging technology, data science, and drug development. **Key Responsibilities** **AI/ML, Generative AI \& Agentic AI:** * Lead the development and application of AI/ML solutions to address scientific, analytical, and operational challenges across pharmaceutical R\&D. * Design, prototype, and evaluate Generative AI and agentic AI workflows that automate or augment statistical analysis, data science, programming, scientific reasoning, and other knowledge\-intensive workflows. * Evaluate AI/ML solutions using rigorous, fit\-for\-purpose frameworks addressing factors such as accuracy, reproducibility, robustness, reliability, and human oversight. * Collaborate with statisticians, data scientists, clinicians, scientists, engineers, and technology partners to translate scientific problems into practical AI/ML solutions. **Quantitative Science \& Advanced Analytics:** * Serve as a statistical SME within multidisciplinary project teams, providing guidance on digital biomarker (imaging and wearables) study design, statistical methodology, analysis, interpretation, and evidence generation. * Apply AI/ML, statistical, and data\-science methods to a broad range of multimodal biomedical data, including: omics, imaging, DHT, clinical and real\-world data. * Translate complex analytical findings into clear scientific insights and recommendations for cross\-functional partners. **Basic Qualifications** * PhD with 2 years of relevant professional experience in Data science, Computer Science, Engineering, Biostatistics, Machine Learning, or another quantitative STEM discipline; or * Master's degree with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience in Computer Science, Data Science, Biostatistics, Machine Learning, or a related quantitative field. * Strong hands\-on experience in AI/ML, data science, or advanced quantitative analytics. * Experience developing or applying Generative AI, LLMs, agentic AI, or other modern AI/ML approaches. * Strong programming skills in R and/or Python. * Solid understanding of statistical concepts, experimental/study design, data analysis, and quantitative interpretation. * Demonstrated ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and multifunctional teams. * Excellent written, verbal, and scientific communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex AI/ML and quantitative concepts to both technical and non\-technical audiences. Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact. **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on experience with **PyTorch, TensorFlow**, or comparable machine\-learning/deep\-learning frameworks. * Experience working with **open\-source/open\-weight** **LLMs** and modern LLM development ecosystems. * Experience with including one or more of medical imaging data, digital health technologies such as wearable sensors, omics, and real\-world data. * Experience in foundation models and multimodal AI. * Understanding of clinical development and the use of quantitative evidence in drug development. **Key Capabilities for Success** **AI/ML innovation and execution** Strong hands\-on ability to develop and evaluate modern AI/ML solutions, particularly Generative AI, LLMs, and agentic workflows, while translating rapidly evolving technologies into practical scientific applications. **Quantitative and statistical rigor** Ability to apply  er across multidisciplinary teams. **PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS** office job involving use of computer, ability to type, communicate and work on teams. Relocation support available Work Location Assignment: Hybrid **Last Day to Apply:** November 29, 2026 The annual base salary for this position ranges from $139,100\.00 to $231,900\.00\. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 17\.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits \| (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States. This role is posted in multiple locations. If you are applying for the role in an secondary job posting location where pay transparency regulations apply, your Talent Advisor will share the local pay information with you during the first interview. Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility. **Sunshine Act** Pfizer reports payments and other transfers of value to health care providers as required by federal and state transparency laws and implementing regulations. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Subject to further legal review and statutory or regulatory clarification, which Pfizer intends to pursue, reimbursement of recruiting expenses for licensed physicians may constitute a reportable transfer of value under the federal transparency law commonly known as the Sunshine Act. Therefore, if you are a licensed physician who incurs recruiting expenses as a result of interviewing with Pfizer that we pay or reimburse, your name, address and the amount of payments made currently will be reported to the government. If you have questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact your Talent Acquisition representative. **EEO \& Employment Eligibility** Pfizer is committed to equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status. Pfizer also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. Pfizer is an E\-Verify employer. This position requires permanent work authorization in the United States. Pfizer endeavors to make www.pfizer.com/careers accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process and/or interviewing, please email disabilityrecruitment@pfizer.com. This is to be used solely for accommodation requests with respect to the accessibility of our website, online application process and/or interviewing. jobs.description: Turn technical expertise into breakthrough performance. You will bring Haas equipment repair, maintenance, and troubleshooting to life through engaging classroom instruction, hands\-on demonstrations, and practical learning experiences that build confidence and technical mastery. Working with service leadership, you will develop and continuously improve curriculum, assess learner proficiency, and use disciplined documentation, training data, and actionable feedback to keep instruction aligned with evolving technology and customer needs. Your impact: greater machine uptime, stronger first\-time fix performance, and legendary customer value. By coaching customer\-first problem\-solving, optimizing training schedules, and expanding value\-added learning, you will help make Phillips indispensable to the people we serve. The expected pay range for a qualified person in this role is between $85,000\.00 and $105,000\.00 per year. If you have a different suggestion, please mention it in your application. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package and a profit\-sharing bonus. Phillips Corporation is a global supplier of manufacturing technology products and services primarily focused on machine tools (metalworking). We have been in business for 65 years and have grown from 2 people to over 900 globally \- come grow with us! *Phillips Corporation is an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Phillips Corporation is an E\-verify participant.* **Requirements** * **7\+** years related technical maintenance experience * Personable and able to speak in front of a group. * Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of Haas equipment, CNC systems, and industrial maintenance best practices. * Instructional Design \& Adult Learning: Ability to structure training that engages, retains, and empowers learners with hands\-on application. * Communication \& Coaching: Strong presentation, facilitation, and mentoring skills to inspire confidence and capability in both customers and colleagues. * Customer\-Centric Mindset: Relating training outcomes directly to customer success, satisfaction, and profitability. * Continuous Improvement Orientation: Applying problem\-solving, root cause analysis, and feedback loops to elevate training programs and personal growth. **Computer Skills:** * Learning Management Systems (LMS): Designing, delivering, and tracking training programs through platforms like Moodle, TalentLMS, or similar. * Technical Documentation Tools: Creating clear service manuals, guides, and visuals with tools such as MS Office, Adobe Acrobat, or Snagit. * Virtual Training Platforms: Mastering Zoom, MS Teams, or similar tools for engaging remote/hybrid training sessions. * Data \& Analytics: Using Excel (advanced functions, pivot tables) or Power BI to analyze training outcomes and customer performance metrics. * Multimedia Creation: Developing interactive training content with tools like Camtasia, Captivate, or PowerPoint to make technical learning engaging. **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Retirement Plan (401k, IRA) * Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary \& AD\&D) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Family Leave (Maternity, Paternity) * Short Term \& Long Term Disability * Training \& Development * Profit Sharing Bonus plan

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (BotStopper)
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions: **Is this identity synthetic?** Detect AI\-generated and manipulated voice and video. **Is this identity risky?** Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals. **Is this identity known?** Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals. Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose\-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI\-driven interactions. Pindrop protects billions of high\-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real\-world interactions annually and protected by 300\+ patents. Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG. ### **What you'll do** As a Senior Software Engineer on the BotStopper team, you will help build and scale the cloud\-native services and machine learning inference infrastructure powering Pindrop BotStopper™ our real\-time AI voice detection solution that helps enterprises distinguish human callers from automated interactions and recognize known registered AI voices. Built on Pindrop Pulse detection technology and supported by intelligence from the AI Voice Consortium (AIVC), BotStopper helps enterprises identify automated interactions, protect customer experiences, and respond to emerging AI\-driven challenges across contact centers. You will work at the intersection of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, real\-time processing, and cybersecurity, developing highly reliable services that support detection decisions during live customer interactions. As BotStopper evolves, you'll help engineer the next generation of capabilities, including more sophisticated AI\-agent classification, expanded detection signals, and enterprise integrations. As a senior individual contributor, you'll bring strong backend engineering expertise, take end\-to\-end ownership of complex technical initiatives, and collaborate closely with Engineering, Research, Product, and SRE to transform emerging technologies into secure, scalable, production\-ready systems. This is a fast\-moving product environment where adaptability, technical curiosity, and the ability to navigate changing priorities are essential. *More specifically, you will:* * Architect, develop, test, deploy, and monitor high\-performance backend services and APIs supporting BotStopper's real\-time detection and scoring capabilities, optimizing for low latency, scalability, reliability, and efficient processing. * Independently drive platform features and improvements from ambiguous requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, production rollout, monitoring, and operational support. * Develop and enhance backend capabilities supporting known\-AI\-voice identification, including integration with the AI Voice Consortium (AIVC) infrastructure and Pindrop's broader voice intelligence capabilities. * Partner with Research and Research Engineering to integrate detection models, inference services, and ML\-driven signals into reliable, scalable production workflows, balancing detection effectiveness, latency, cost, and operational complexity. * Improve performance, concurrency, availability, fault tolerance, and infrastructure efficiency across high\-throughput services processing large volumes of real\-world voice interactions. * Help engineer the evolution from human\-versus\-machine detection toward more detailed AI\-caller classification, ensemble signal analysis, explainable scoring, and other emerging detection capabilities. * Design and develop backend services and APIs that support integrations with IVR, Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS), telephony, and conversational AI platforms. * Contribute to architectural decisions, evaluate technical tradeoffs, and partner across Engineering, Research, Product, and SRE to introduce new capabilities without disrupting live customer traffic. * Support production operations through incident response, troubleshooting, and continuous improvements to observability, alerting, deployment safety, and system reliability. After an initial onboarding period of approximately three months, participate in the team's established on\-call rotation. * Mentor engineers through thoughtful code reviews, design discussions, pairing, documentation, and knowledge sharing while encouraging strong software engineering practices. * Strategically leverage AI\-assisted development too rovement. * AI is changing both what we build and how we build it. You'll be encouraged to incorporate AI responsibly into your development workflow, experiment with emerging tools, and identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and quality. * Senior engineers at Pindrop aren't simply handed requirements. You'll help shape design decisions, influence technical direction, recommend improvements, and translate complex challenges into scalable solutions. * Expand your expertise in architecture, technical decision\-making, mentorship, and cross\-functional collaboration, developing the capabilities needed for future Staff\-level impact. ### **What we offer** As a part of Pindrop, you'll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice\-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here's a snapshot of the benefits we offer: * Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO) * Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year, subject to manager approval and applicable company policies. * Flexibility to work remotely from outside your country of residence for up to four weeks per year * Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long\-term success. * While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in\-person moments through regular team on\-sites, company\-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success. * Generous health and welfare plans to choose from \- including one employer\-paid "employee\-only" plan! * Best\-in\-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution * Low\-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind. * Paid Parental Leave \- Including birth, adoptive \& foster parents * + One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It's our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family! * Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work. * Enhanced fertility and GLP\-1 benefits to support family\-building journeys and personalized health needs. * Annual Learning \& Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill\-building, certifications, and continued education. \#LI\-Remote \#LI\-HB1 **Not sure if this is you?** ---------------------------- We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you're not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time. ### **AI \- A Transformative Force** At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting\-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine. Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed. ### **Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer** Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

jobs.description: **EXPERIENCE** Experienced Professionals **LOCATION** New York **FOCUS** Software \& System Engineering **BUSINESS** Point72 ### **A Career with Point72’s Technology Team** As Point72 reimagines the future of investing, our Technology team is constantly evolving our firm’s IT infrastructure and engineering capabilities, positioning us at the forefront of a rapidly evolving technology landscape. We’re a team of experts who experiment and work to discover new ways to harness open\-source solutions, modern cloud architectures, and sophisticated Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions, while embracing enterprise agile methodologies. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
jobs.description: At PrizePicks, we are the fastest\-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000\. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter\-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together? We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Senior Site Reliability Engineer** to join our team. We are passionate about delivering cutting\-edge solutions and pushing the boundaries of what's possible. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer, you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of our infrastructure as we continue to scale and expand our operations. **What you'll do:** * Design, implement, maintain, and monitor reliable production systems at scale. * Lead incident response, mitigate production issues, and conduct post mortem analysis. * Proactively monitor performance, analyze system failures, identify bottlenecks , and propose solutions. * Create and support observability/monitoring tools and vendor integrations. * Drive the growth of a reliability culture, promoting cross\-functional collaboration towards improving system reliability, scalability, resilience, and security. * Train and mentor other engineers. **What you have:** * 5\+ years of experience as a reliability\-focused engineer in a fast\-paced, rapidly growing, enterprise environment. * + Deep understanding of tooling and application development in these areas: + - Cloud computing such as AWS, Azure, and/or GCP. - Infrastructure as code tools such as terraform or crossplane. - Developing applications in languages such as python, ruby, or go. - Deploying and supporting applications in Kubernetes at scale. - Implementing monitoring in tools like grafana, new relic, or datadog. + Experience debugging live, critical production issues. + Familiarity with reliability principles, such as resilient systems, application and supply chain security, and SLO governance. + Ability to work cross\-functionally with diverse engineering teams. **Where you'll live:** * While we prefer candidates based in Atlanta, we are open to qualified applicants from anywhere in the U.S. and are willing to consider remote candidates. \#LI\-Remote **Working at PrizePicks:** ========================== The typical salary range for this position is $120,000 to $175,000\. At PrizePicks, we consider your role, level, and where you'll be working when determining our salary ranges. The compensation info you see on our job postings gives you an idea of the starting pay range for the position. Your actual pay within that range will depend on your specific work location, as well as your skills, experience, and education. Your recruiter will be happy to chat more about the specific pay range for your location and how we arrived at it during the hiring process. This application period will remain open for 30 days. We're committed to finding the best candidate, so this date may be adjusted, and any changes will be reflected in this posting. Date Posted: 11/18/2026 **Benefits you'll receive:** ============================ In addition to your great compensation package, full\-time employees will be eligible for the following perks: * Company\-subsidized medical, dental, \& vision plans * 401(k) plan with company match * Annual bonus * Flexible PTO to encourage a healthy work/life balance (2 weeks STRONGLY encouraged!) * Generous paid leave programs, including 16\-week paid parental leave and disability benefits * Workplace flexibility and modern work schedules focused on getting the job done, not hours clocked * Company\-wide in\-person events and team outings * Lifestyle enhancement program * Company equipment provided (Windows \& Mac options) * Annual performance reviews with opportunities for growth and career development **You must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.** *PrizePicks is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.*

jobs.title: Senior C# .NET Application Developer
jobs.description: Description: **Location:** Remote (Must reside in Kentucky, preferably Metro Louisville) **Department:** Information Technology (IT) **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **Position Summary** DSSI / Amicus is seeking an experienced **Senior C\# .NET Application Developer** to join our Information Technology team. This role is responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and supporting DSSI's Source\-to\-Pay suite of applications. The ideal candidate will be a hands\-on, full\-stack developer who can work closely with business process teams, project coordinators, and other stakeholders to translate business requirements into reliable, scalable, and user\-friendly technology solutions. You will play an important role in expanding the functionality and usability of DSSI's core applications, including both front\-end user experience improvements and back\-end application functionality. This position also provides an opportunity to work with a diverse technology environment that includes .NET, SQL Server, IBM i/AS400, DB2, web services, XML/JSON, and e\-procurement integrations. **Primary Duties and Responsibilities** * Design, develop, enhance, and maintain web\-based applications supporting DSSI's Source\-to\-Pay business processes. * Analyze business and system requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions. * Work closely with business process teams, project coordinators, and their stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver solutions that meet business needs. * Develop new functionality and enhancements to existing applications, including both user interface and back\-end capabilities. * Provide ongoing technical support and troubleshooting for existing applications and production issues. * Develop and maintain applications and services deployed on web servers. * Design and implement software using established object\-oriented programming and enterprise application development practices. * Develop and maintain integrations using RESTful Web Services, Web API, XML, JSON, and related technologies. * Work with relational databases, including SQL Server, and integrate applications with existing IBM i/AS400 and DB2 systems. * Participate in application architecture, system integration, database design, and technical solution development. * Take ownership of assigned projects and development initiatives, ensuring quality deliverables and on\-time completion. * Create and maintain appropriate technical documentation, including application documentation, help text, testing requirements and results, programmer comments, and object descriptions. * Develop and execute unit and integration testing and support User Acceptance Testing as required. * Support user training and assist business users with the adoption of new and enhanced functionality. * Troubleshoot complex technical issues and identify opportunities to improve application performance, reliability, maintainability, and usability. * Participate in code reviews and follow established IT development standards, procedures, and best practices. * Stay current with emerging technologies, development practices, and industry trends relevant to the organization's technology environment. * Collaborate with other developers and IT team members and provide technical guidance and mentoring to less\-experienced developers. * Support the organization's goals for business development, service delivery, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement through effective use of technology. * Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management. * Comply with company policies, IT procedures, programming standards, and project/task management requirements. * Support and maintain the Company's Quality Management System and applicable quality standards. * Promote a professional, respectful, and inclusive work environment consistent with the Company's Equal Employment Opportunity policies. Requirements: **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Data Processing, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About PrologMobile** Nobody in the global reverse supply chain for mobile devices knows exactly what they are buying or selling. PrologMobile fixes that. We are a device intelligence company: give us an IMEI or serial number, and our platform returns essential data points about that specific device, including carrier and SIM lock status, blocklist and financial risk, Find My iPhone and MDM locks, warranty, and whether it will work on a given carrier network. Carriers and MVNOs, insurers, device processors, ITADs, marketplaces, and wholesalers build our data into their trade\-in, resale, and claims workflows. Our customers use it to cut returns, prevent fraud, and price devices accurately. A few things that make us different: * Founders who lived the problem. Our founders have spent more than 20 years in the secondary device market and helped start the mobile device recycling industry in North America. * Real technical moats. We hold a US patent (11,711,755 B1\) and co\-developed the Device Compatibility service with the GSMA. We are active in CTIA and the GSA. * Work that matters. Every device that gets resold instead of scrapped stays out of a landfill. Our data touches the lifecycle of tens of millions of devices a year. * A small team. We are about a dozen people. There is no layer between you and the decision, the customer, or production. Our mission is to be the most trusted, most comprehensive device intelligence platform in the world. **About the role** We are hiring a senior engineer to join a small engineering team that ships quickly and holds a high bar. You will work across the whole platform: the customer portal, the public API, the data pipelines that normalize device data from OEMs and carriers, and the Azure infrastructure it all runs on. Two things define how we work, and they define this role: * AI\-assisted development is our default, not an experiment. We build with Claude Code every day. Our repository carries agent instructions, automated multi\-agent code review on every pull request, and a living catalogue of bug patterns we have learned from. We want someone who already works this way and can direct an AI agent the way a good lead directs a team: clear scope, hard questions, and verification of everything it produces. * Review is where quality comes from. When AI writes much of the code, the engineer's judgment matters more, not less. You will review human and AI\-written code, catch what looks right but is wrong, and prove fixes with tests that fail without them. You will also help shape our next chapter: a new Next.js frontend to replace our current server\-rendered UI. **What you will do** * Design, build, and ship features across an ASP.NET Core (.NET 10\) platform, from database migration to UI * Use Claude Code and similar agents to move faster, while owning the correctness of everything you merge * Perform thorough code reviews and raise the standard of the codebase over time * Write and maintain unit, integration, and UI automation tests * Design and tune SQL Server schemas, queries, and indexes on large, high\-volume tables * Build and maintain API integrations with various data sources * Deploy and operate services on Azure, and investigate production issues when they happen * Help plan and build the Next.js frontend * Take part in sprint planning and backlog refinement in Jira, and break ambiguous goals into shippable tickets * Work directly with customer success and leadership to understand what customers need **What we are looking for** Required * 8\+ years of professional software development, including 5\+ years with C\# and .NET * Strong ASP.NET Core experience (MVC and Web API) and solid object\-oriented design * Hands\-on, daily use of an AI coding agent, ideally Claude Code, on production code * A track record of rigorous code review, giving and receiving * Entity Framework Core with code\-first migrations, and strong SQL Server skills * Automated testing as a habit (we use xUnit) * Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript or TypeScript * Git and pull\-request workflows * Self\-direction: you find the next most valuable thing, do it, and tell people what you did. You do not need to be managed day to day * Clear written and spoken English for work with the team and with customers * Authorization to work in the United States Nice to have * Next.js and React * Azure: App Service, Functions, SQL Database, Key Vault, Redis, Application Insights * Scrum or other agile experience, and Jira * Experience building or consuming high\-volume APIs * GitHub Actions and CI/CD * Background in mobile devices, telecom, insurance, or reverse logistics **Our stack** C\# and .NET 10, ASP.NET Core MVC and Web API, Entity Framework Core, Azure SQL, Azure App Service and Functions, Redis, SignalR, xUnit, GitHub Actions, Claude Code, Jira. Next.js is on the way. **Why PrologMobile** * Real ownership: your work reaches production and customers quickly * A team that treats AI tooling as a core engineering skill and invests in it * A greenfield frontend rebuild alongside a mature, revenue\-generating platform * Fully remote * Salary plus performance bonuses * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid time off * Ongoing training benefits PrologMobile is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected class. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Experience: * C\#: 5 years (Required) * Next.js: 1 year (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: New York, NY **About Prove** =============== As the world moves to a mobile\-first economy, businesses need to modernize how they acquire, engage with and enable consumers. Prove’s phone\-centric identity tokenization and passive cryptographic authentication solutions reduce friction, enhance security and privacy across all digital channels, and accelerate revenues while reducing operating expenses and fraud losses. Over 1,000 enterprise customers use Prove’s platform to process 20 billion customer requests annually across industries, including banking, lending, healthcare, gaming, crypto, e\-commerce, marketplaces, and payments. For the latest updates from Prove, follow us on LinkedIn. Prove is driving the future of digital identity. We are looking for Provers who know how to make an impact. We’re talking self\-starting professionals who thrive in a fast\-paced environment, process information quickly, and make intelligent decisions. The work is challenging and requires not only smart but natural curiosity and tenacity. Teamwork is also important to us – we work together and play together. Prove has big plans, and we’re excited about the future. If this sounds like the place for you – come join our team! **Department:** Data Science **Reports To:** Director of Informatics **FLSA Status:** Exempt **Location:** Hybrid \- New York, NY **Job Summary** As a Lead Data Engineer on Prove’s Data Science team, you will build the technical backbone that translates complex identity data into verified digital trust. Prove is fundamentally a data company: our identity solutions and analytical products are built on extracts spanning all tiers of data sophistication. In this role, every pipeline and architecture you design connects directly to revenue\-generating products that secure transactions and prevent fraud for more than 1,000 global enterprise customers. You will spearhead the development and maintenance of high\-throughput data pipelines that power our core inference systems, taking raw intelligence and refining it into reliable scientific statements. Acting as a bridge across disciplines, you will translate multi\-domain logic into resilient, highly performant directed acyclic graphs (DAGs), while proactively establishing data governance and ontology standards. This is an environment built for experimentation, offering you the autonomy to deploy modern paradigms and tools to solve intricate problems in identity resolution. **Key Responsibilities:** * Architect, build, and maintain resilient data pipelines that power real\-time and batch inference, moving data from raw intelligence to verifiable scientific statements. * Translate complex, multidisciplinary domain logic into efficient, maintainable, and modular directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) and execution workflows. * Proactively implement and advocate for robust data governance frameworks, metadata management, and semantic data ontologies. * Partner closely with data science, informatics, and product engineering teams to serve high\-integrity data extracts that directly power revenue\-generating products. * Continuously evaluate, benchmark, and adopt cutting\-edge data engineering tools, frameworks, and storage paradigms. * Optimize distributed data processing pipelines for high availability, computational efficiency, and cost governance. * Champion engineering excellence across the team through code reviews, architectural discussions, automated testing, and CI/CD practices. * Promote, maintain and enhance our cultural values of humility, passion, inclusion, and leadership. ##### **Qualifications and Experience:** * Strong passion for learning about our products and markets through in\-house and external training. * 7\+ years of professional experience in data engineering or developing complex, data\-driven software products. * Deep, first\-principles understanding of data systems, distributed compute engines, data modeling, and modern pipeline architecture. * Demonstrated track record of collaborating across technical and scientific functions, with the ability to translate cross\-disciplinary logic into concrete data systems. * High intellectual curiosity and a proactive mindset toward experimentation and technological innovation. * Hands\-on experience with modern data orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect) and large\-scale distributed frameworks. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Advanced degree (Master’s or Ph.D.) in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics, or a related quantitative field. * Experience architecting creative solutions for identity resolution, graph data structures, or fraud prevention systems. * Fluent and terminal\-native in Linux/Unix environments, command\-line utilities, and shell scripting. * Experience in high\-growth/pre\-IPO Technology companies. The anticipated salary pay range for Metro 3 areas for this role is $175,000 \- $200,000 plus company bonus. Prove follows a market driven compensation philosophy based on geographic location and respective market rates. Job offers will be aligned to location. Please speak with your recruiter if you have questions. Prove defines: * Metro 2 \- NYC metro area, Seattle metro area, Los Angeles metro area, and the Miami metro area. * Metro 3 \- all other cities across the domestic United States, with the exception of the San Francisco Bay Area. **Benefits \& Perks for FTE Provers:** * Competitive salaries \& Bonus Plan (for eligible roles) and Equity Plan * Modern Health for financial, mental, and physical wellness * 401(k) Retirement Plan \& Match (US Offices) and Local Country Pension (International Offices) * Unlimited Vacation and Flexible hours * Comprehensive medical benefits for you and your family ❤️ * Emotional \& Physical Wellness – Access to wellness services (EAP \& Prove Well\-Being Reimbursement) * Bottomless snacks \& beverages for certain office locations * Daily GrubHub stipend for lunch if coming into the office (US Offices) * A great place to work and connect with other talented Provers like yourself! Don’t meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Prove we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Equal Opportunity Employment:** Prove is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people regardless of race, color, religion, gender or sexual orientation, age, marital status, national origin, citizenship status, disability, veteran status or other personal characteristics **Privacy \& Data Protection:** When you are applying for a job at Prove, we collect and use your personal information in the job application process. To understand more about how Prove uses your personal information, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy on our website. Create a Job Alert Interested in building your career at Prove? Get future opportunities sent straight to your email. Create alert

jobs.title: AI Engineering Lead
jobs.description: Provn is helping CampusEvolve recruit for the following role **About CampusEvolve:** CampusEvolve (campusevolve.ai) is a Seattle\-based, mission\-driven AI startup backed by the Gates Foundation, Schultz Family Foundation, and GitLab Foundation. Pathways is one tool for a person's whole pathway: from high school into a two\-year or four\-year program, a certificate, an apprenticeship, or the military, and on into work. People most often fall off a pathway in the gaps between programs, so Pathways is built to carry them across those gaps. Its retrieval layer covers more than 6,000 post\-secondary credential programs in Washington State, plus financial aid, career guidance, and basic\-needs resources like housing, food, and transportation. The north star is economic mobility, and at CampusEvolve, the mission is the culture. **About the role:** AI Engineering Lead builds Pathways, an AI\-native guide that helps people take real next steps toward education, careers, and economic security, and builds the team's ability to ship it with AI. This is a senior leadership role that's about 80% hands\-on building. You deliver the product rather than make sure it gets delivered, and you make engineering decisions, not recommendations. You'll lead three full\-time engineers, work closely with the Founder/CEO and CTO, and partner with a full\-time product manager and the VP of Community, who runs a network of 100\+ co\-design partners across K\-12, post\-secondary, and workforce programs. State agency partners are ready to roll out Pathways once it's engaging and safe, and you'll lead the engineering that gets it there. **What You'll Work On** Alongside the building, you keep engineering, product, partners, and leadership moving together, and you work directly with end users far more than most engineering leaders do. * Ship simple, mobile\-first AI experiences that turn real learner and job seeker problems into completed next steps, with deep context awareness, more agency for users, and handoffs to human advisors when they need one * Build AI\-native and multiply the team's output. Use coding agents yourself to ship working software fast, coach engineers in using them well, and help define the team's agentic development lifecycle: clear objectives and acceptance criteria, adversarial multi\-model passes on the spec, and a strong evaluation harness * Connect product analytics, AI evaluation, synthetic\-user tests, user research, and real task outcomes to fast release decisions, and show improvements with evidence * Create reusable conversation, planning, resource\-grounding, state, and action patterns that can be configured quickly for new personas, scenarios, localities, and partners * Take features through controlled production, owning architecture, data and state integrity, test automation, observability, performance, cloud cost, and release quality * Architect identity and access for learners, advisors, and partner institutions, including privacy\-preserving sign\-in, consent, delegated access, and role\-based authorization. Outside security and privacy specialists support hardening, reviews, and compliance, and you own integrating their work into the product * Be the technical voice with funders and state agency partners, including answering their hardest questions about safety and outcomes **What Success Looks Like** * Within the first months, Pathways reaches high school students after a few rapid cycles of engineering and hardening * Within six months, it serves thousands of high school users * Within twelve months, it's adapted for many personas, each tied to a real outcome such as enrolling in a post\-secondary program, starting an apprenticeship, or getting a job, on the way to about 100,000 users in Washington State * The team ships faster and with higher quality because of how you build and how you coach **Required Qualifications** We place more weight on what you've built, your impact on users, your production judgment, and your ability to raise the level of your teammates than on executive titles, pedigree, or years managing large teams. No degree required. * You've personally built and shipped LLM\-enabled applications used by real people, as a founder, founding engineer, staff or principal engineer, or deeply hands\-on engineering leader * Advanced fluency with multi\-model agentic development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar), plus the ability to inspect, test, debug, and improve AI\-generated code * Practical experience with LLM orchestration and tool calling, retrieval and grounding, persistent context, APIs, reliable application state, and full\-stack cloud deployments * Strong product instincts. You can design for teenagers and adults with different levels of experience, find the friction, simplify, and move users from exploring to finishing a real step * The judgment to make an early product secure and scalable without overengineering it, from trust boundaries, authorization, and logging to error handling, regression testing, monitoring, and the limits of LLM decision\-making * You've mentored a small engineering team and improved its speed and quality. You earn engineers' respect through your own work, give honest, constructive feedback, and adapt your coaching for senior, mid\-level, and early\-career engineers * Mission\-driven. You want your work to have a direct impact on people's economic mobility, and you're energized by working with students, partners, and end users **Nice to Have** * Leadership experience at a startup, or time at an engineering organization working at the cutting edge of AI development * Building products for schools, public sector agencies, or other institutional partners * Presenting a product to funders or senior stakeholders and answering hard questions on the spot * Experience with student data privacy and with identity and access for users under 18 **Location** This role is fully remote within the U.S., and CampusEvolve doesn't have an office. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. CampusEvolve is unable to sponsor visas or accept H\-1B transfers. **Benefits:** Health, dental, and vision insurance. Paid time off and holidays. Remote\-first, collaborative culture. Possible equity depending on experience and skills. **Estimated annual OTE:** $200k \- $275k.

jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer
jobs.description: Provn is helping Envorso recruit for the following role **About Envorso:** Envorso Sports is building the platform that runs a professional sports team's entire fan\-facing business: ticketing, website, mobile app, and increasingly commerce, CRM, and marketing, from one system instead of six disconnected vendors. Today, most teams run a fragmented stack: a website vendor, a ticketing provider, a separate mobile app, CRM tools, marketing automation, and game\-day engagement solutions bolted together. Teams don't want to pay five vendors and contractors to stitch the data together. That creates a disconnected fan journey and leaves revenue on the table. Our platform is live today with the Seattle Seawolves of Major League Rugby, and the league itself is now on the platform, with individual teams onboarding through the season. Ticketing, website, and mobile app are shipped and in production with paying customers. CRM, marketing automation, personalization, and revenue operations are what we build next, AI\-native from the start. We want candidates to know exactly where the product stands before they join. **About the role:** You'll be our first in\-house engineer. This is a founding role: you'll own the fan data platform for the long term and help shape how we grow engineering, not ship one feature and move on. The problem is simple to state. Our teams and the league sit on a large fan database: ticket transactions, web and app activity, shop purchases, and email engagement. Today almost none of it is used. One salesperson calls season\-pass holders; one marketer sends a broadcast email and sees who bites. Your job is to turn that data into revenue: unify what we know about each fan across ticketing, web, app, shop, and email; decide which fans should get which offer; and deliver it through email and in\-app offers or push. Offers are concrete: a promo code for an abandoned cart, a season pass or match pass, a merch bundle, a seat upgrade. Getting the wrong offer to the wrong fan costs real money and real trust with a small, loyal fan base. You'll build for a three\-to\-five\-year horizon, not just this quarter. We need someone who thinks like an architect (data model, scale, failure handling, consent, cost) while still shipping something a team can use in weeks. You'll also be the engineer closest to our customers' front offices. Part of the job is understanding how a team's revenue and marketing operations actually work, and helping decide what we build first based on impact and effort. You'll report to Gopal Rao and work alongside our five\-engineer team in Argentina as one small group. Expect real overlap\-hours collaboration, and expect to take a problem, make the call, and ship without waiting on someone else. **What You'll Do** * Own the fan data platform end to end: a unified fan record across ticketing, web, app, and email, designed to hold up as we grow from one team's list to a whole league's * Ship fan segmentation and a targeted offers engine that decides which fans get which offer, and delivers it by email reactivation and in\-app offers or push * Build marketing ops and revenue ops driven by agentic AI: fan identity, segments, campaign builder and automation, and propensity, churn, and pricing models * Bring commerce into the fan record: shop purchases alongside tickets, so offers can cross\-sell merch, passes, and seat upgrades * Build the surfaces people use, in TypeScript and Next.js on web and in our mobile app, so offers are something a marketer reviews and a fan acts on, not just an API response * Design for production from day one: consent and opt\-in enforcement, no duplicate sends, failures that are visible instead of silent, and costs you can explain * Work with team front offices to understand their revenue goals, and sequence the roadmap by impact and effort * Make AI how we ship: build an AI\-native product where models change the outcome for a marketer or a fan, and run an agentic development process (AI\-SDLC) with coding agents, specs and tests as guardrails, and human review before anything reaches a fan * Help decide how engineering grows: how we scale with our Argentina team, what we build in\-house, and who we hire next **Required Qualifications** * 3\+ years of software engineering experience shipping production software, including a consumer\-facing (B2C) product used at meaningful scale * Strong system design: you've owned the non\-functional side of a system (scale, reliability, data integrity, monitoring), not just its features * Strong TypeScript, comfortable in a Next.js app and an API\-service codebase. Python is a plus. * Full\-stack enough to ship a feature end to end, comfortable building the web UI (React/Next.js) and, ideally, mobile UI (React Native or native iOS/Android), not just the backend * Product instinct: you can take a business problem, figure out what's worth building, and explain the trade\-off to a non\-technical team * Fluent with AI tools and agentic development in your daily work (coding agents, AI\-assisted testing and review), and able to explain where they help and where they break * Comfortable operating with ambiguity and acting on your own judgment **Strong plus:** * Marketing automation, personalization, CRM, ticketing, or commerce/payments experience (Stripe or similar) * An LLM\-powered feature shipped to production users * Experience leading or mentoring engineers, including a distributed team * Founding or first\-engineer experience * Revenue management, dynamic pricing, or yield optimization * E\-commerce (Shopify or similar) * Propensity or churn models in production * Campaign automation platforms (Braze, Klaviyo, Iterable, or similar) **Work Authorization:** Must be authorized to work in the US. No employer\-sponsored visas for this role. **Benefits:** Competitive base salary plus equity and benefits. The chance to shape a new category, the fan data and revenue platform for pro sports, instead of building an add\-on feature for someone else’s platform. A founding role where what you build now becomes the foundation the next ten engineers inherit, with room to grow as the company scales. **Estimated annual OTE:** $125k \- $145k.

The second is our agent\-sandboxing platform: hardware\-isolated microVMs for running untrusted, agent\-generated code securely and compliantly by construction, where agents operate with least privilege, never see a credential, and a human gates anything that writes to a system of record. You'll write Rust in the morning, a Kubernetes controller after lunch, and a FastAPI control\-plane endpoint before you go home, building the fork engine, the guest agent, and the multi\-substrate model lifecycle. We're looking for individuals who've built this class of stack (an inference\-serving or serverless\-GPU platform), operated it hard at scale, or ideally both. **Responsibilities** * Manage the serving tier for open\-weight models: engine deployment and configuration, cold\-start strategy, per\-model SLOs, and upgrade/canary discipline. * Administer the Kubernetes layer for inference and sandbox workloads: operators and CRDs, autoscaling (KEDA/Karpenter\-class), GPU scheduling and sharing, and node lifecycle. * Own the stateful data plane end to end with restore procedures that are regularly tested. * Oversee the sandbox runtime and its host\-side control plane: lifecycle, exec, snapshot/fork, teardown, metering, and the threat model of the isolation boundary. * Direct the FastAPI control\-plane services, Terraform/OpenTofu, Bicep, and the dashboards. * Run the layer the backend services team builds on, expect to debug into their services, and expect them to read your dashboards. * Manage the open\-source posture: build to OSS standards and release as it matures, with reviewed PRs, real docs, and reproducible builds. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of shipping production systems in a systems language. jobs.description: Provn is helping CampusEvolve recruit for the following role **About CampusEvolve:** CampusEvolve (campusevolve.ai) is a Seattle\-based, mission\-driven AI startup backed by the Gates Foundation, Schultz Family Foundation, and GitLab Foundation. Pathways is one tool for a person's whole pathway: from high school into a two\-year or four\-year program, a certificate, an apprenticeship, or the military, and on into work. People most often fall off a pathway in the gaps between programs, so Pathways is built to carry them across those gaps. Its retrieval layer covers more than 6,000 post\-secondary credential programs in Washington State, plus financial aid, career guidance, and basic\-needs resources like housing, food, and transportation. The north star is economic mobility, and at CampusEvolve, the mission is the culture. **About the role:** VP of AI Engineering builds Pathways, an AI\-native guide that helps people take real next steps toward education, careers, and economic security, and builds the team's ability to ship it with AI. This is a senior leadership role that's about 80% hands\-on building. You deliver the product rather than make sure it gets delivered, and you make engineering decisions, not recommendations. You'll lead three full\-time engineers, work closely with the Founder/CEO and CTO, and partner with a full\-time product manager and the VP of Community, who runs a network of 100\+ co\-design partners across K\-12, post\-secondary, and workforce programs. State agency partners are ready to roll out Pathways once it's engaging and safe, and you'll lead the engineering that gets it there. **What You'll Work On** Alongside the building, you keep engineering, product, partners, and leadership moving together, and you work directly with end users far more than most engineering leaders do. * Ship simple, mobile\-first AI experiences that turn real learner and job seeker problems into completed next steps, with deep context awareness, more agency for users, and handoffs to human advisors when they need one * Build AI\-native and multiply the team's output. Use coding agents yourself to ship working software fast, coach engineers in using them well, and help define the team's agentic development lifecycle: clear objectives and acceptance criteria, adversarial multi\-model passes on the spec, and a strong evaluation harness * Connect product analytics, AI evaluation, synthetic\-user tests, user research, and real task outcomes to fast release decisions, and show improvements with evidence * Create reusable conversation, planning, resource\-grounding, state, and action patterns that can be configured quickly for new personas, scenarios, localities, and partners * Take features through controlled production, owning architecture, data and state integrity, test automation, observability, performance, cloud cost, and release quality * Architect identity and access for learners, advisors, and partner institutions, including privacy\-preserving sign\-in, consent, delegated access, and role\-based authorization. Outside security and privacy specialists support hardening, reviews, and compliance, and you own integrating their work into the product * Be the technical voice with funders and state agency partners, including answering their hardest questions about safety and outcomes **What Success Looks Like** * Within the first months, Pathways reaches high school students after a few rapid cycles of engineering and hardening * Within six months, it serves thousands of high school users * Within twelve months, it's adapted for many personas, each tied to a real outcome such as enrolling in a post\-secondary program, starting an apprenticeship, or getting a job, on the way to about 100,000 users in Washington State * The team ships faster and with higher quality because of how you build and how you coach **Required Qualifications** We place more weight on what you've built, your impact on users, your production judgment, and your ability to raise the level of your teammates than on executive titles, pedigree, or years managing large teams. No degree required. * You've personally built and shipped LLM\-enabled applications used by real people, as a founder, founding engineer, staff or principal engineer, or deeply hands\-on engineering leader * Advanced fluency with multi\-model agentic development tools (Claude Code, Codex, or similar), plus the ability to inspect, test, debug, and improve AI\-generated code * Practical experience with LLM orchestration and tool calling, retrieval and grounding, persistent context, APIs, reliable application state, and full\-stack cloud deployments * Strong product instincts. You can design for teenagers and adults with different levels of experience, find the friction, simplify, and move users from exploring to finishing a real step * The judgment to make an early product secure and scalable without overengineering it, from trust boundaries, authorization, and logging to error handling, regression testing, monitoring, and the limits of LLM decision\-making * You've mentored a small engineering team and improved its speed and quality. You earn engineers' respect through your own work, give honest, constructive feedback, and adapt your coaching for senior, mid\-level, and early\-career engineers * Mission\-driven. You want your work to have a direct impact on people's economic mobility, and you're energized by working with students, partners, and end users **Nice to Have** * Leadership experience at a startup, or time at an engineering organization working at the cutting edge of AI development * Building products for schools, public sector agencies, or other institutional partners * Presenting a product to funders or senior stakeholders and answering hard questions on the spot * Experience with student data privacy and with identity and access for users under 18 **Location** This role is fully remote within the U.S., and CampusEvolve doesn't have an office. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. CampusEvolve is unable to sponsor visas or accept H\-1B transfers. **Benefits:** Health, dental, and vision insurance. Paid time off and holidays. Remote\-first, collaborative culture. Possible equity depending on experience and skills. **Estimated annual OTE:** $200k \- $275k.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** Since opening our first self\-storage facility in 1972, Public Storage has grown to become the world’s largest owner and operator of self\-storage facilities. With thousands of locations across the United States and Europe and more than 170 million net rentable square feet, we are also among the largest landlords globally. Recognized as a Great Place to Work by the Great Place to Work Institute, Public Storage is a member of the S\&P 500 and FT Global 500\. Our common and preferred stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange. As the nation’s leading self\-storage provider, we are known for our iconic orange doors and our commitment to delivering simple, reliable storage solutions to millions of customers. **Job Description** Public Storage runs at a scale that makes the work interesting. More than 4,500 locations and growing, a national customer base, prices that move every day, and a footprint expanding across the U.S. and into Canada. Our Data and Analytics team sits with the business partners who own those decisions and works with them on the critical problems: pricing, promotions, marketing, operations, real estate acquisitions, and forecasting supply and demand. Our platform runs on Google Cloud, including BigQuery, Vertex AI, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Run, GKE, and Terraform, along with dbt Cloud, Airflow/Cloud Composer, Looker, and modern CI/CD. We're a small, senior team that operates like a startup inside an S\&P 500 company. Short paths from idea to production, real ownership, and work that shows up in the business instead of in a slide deck. Join a full\-stack data team where a new engineer ships to production in weeks, not quarters. In this role you'll build and maintain the pipelines that support our customer teams and the analysts and data scientists who serve them, working with customer data every day. You'll be mentored on code\-first data engineering with Python, SQL, dbt, Airflow, and BigQuery, and on the engineering habits that separate a pipeline that works from a pipeline people trust. If you want a place where you learn quickly, own real surface area, and see your work used the same week you ship it, this is it. What You'll Do **Build and Run Pipelines** * Construct and maintain batch data pipelines from internal systems, third\-party APIs, and event streams into BigQuery * Develop transformations in dbt with tests, documentation, and sensible model layering * Author and maintain Airflow / Cloud Composer DAGs with retries, alerting, and dependency awareness * Ensure customer and business data in the lake and warehouse is timely, high\-quality, and well documented **Quality and Craft** * Write data quality tests and monitor freshness, volume, schema, and distribution * Follow engineering best practices: version control, code review, CI/CD, query optimization, and clear documentation * Handle customer data in line with our data governance, privacy, and access standards * Support MLOps workflows: feature refreshes, scheduled retraining jobs, and model input pipelines * Investigate and resolve pipeline failures, and write up what broke so it doesn't break the same way twice **Collaborate** * Work closely with analysts, data scientists, and customer teams to understand what they need from the data and deliver it * Partner with business and IT teams to onboard new source systems * Create and maintain architecture and systems documentation **Qualifications** Required * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related STEM field * 3\+ years of experience building data pipelines or deploying production code in a cloud environment (1\+ year with a Master's degree) * Proficiency in SQL, including relational data modeling and query tuning * Working proficiency in Python for data processing * Familiarity with a cloud analytical warehouse. BigQuery preferred, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks considered * Clear written and verbal communication Preferred * Hands\-on experience with dbt and with orchestration tools such as Airflow, Cloud Composer, Dagster, or Prefect * Experience with Google Cloud Platform services such as BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud Run, and Pub/Sub * Exposure to streaming or event\-driven data (Pub/Sub, Kafka, Dataflow) * Exposure to containerization and infrastructure as code, including Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform * Familiarity with BI and semantic layer tools, preferably Looker * Exposure to MLOps or machine learning infrastructure Skills \& Technologies * Languages: SQL, Python; Git\-based workflows and code review * Data stack: BigQuery, dbt, Airflow / Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage * Cloud: Google Cloud Platform (AWS or Azure equivalent considered) * Practices: data modeling, ELT design, data quality testing, data privacy and access controls, documentation **Additional Information** **Why This Role Will Excite You** * A modern, code\-first stack with no legacy on\-premise burden to carry * Mentorship from senior engineers who review your code and explain the why * Customer data that drives daily pricing and operating decisions at more than 4,500 locations * New pipelines to build from scratch as we expand into Canada **Workplace** * One of our core values is working as OneTeam. We believe in the value of in\-person collaboration while recognizing the importance of flexibility. Public Storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days per week, with the option to use up to three flexible remote\-work days each month. \*\*Sponsorship for Work Authorization is not available for this posting. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without restrictions or requiring sponsorship now or in the future. We do not provide training plans or support for F\-1 OPT, STEM OPT extensions, or future visa sponsorship.\*\*

Framework or Entity Framework Core * Experience with source control, automated testing, CI/CD, and standard software development lifecycle practices * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills coding, testing, documentation, or productivity * Microsoft Azure certifications **Physical Requirements** This is primarily a sedentary role in a professional office environment.
