We encourage candidates within a commutable distance of Worthing, SD or those willing to relocate independently to apply. **What Puck Offers You** We believe our team members deserve a benefits package as strong as the products we build. Full\-time team members are eligible for benefits beginning the first of the month following 60 days of employment. **Health \& Wellness** * Medical insurance through Wellmark Blue Cross Blue Shield — choice of $2,000 PPO or High Deductible Health Plan (HDHP) * Employee\-only medical premium starting at $120/month * Free Doctor on Demand virtual visits (covered at 100% on both plans) * Dental insurance through Delta Dental of Iowa * Vision insurance through Delta Vision * Health Savings Account (HSA) — eligible with HDHP enrollment * Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) — Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care options **Financial Protection** * Company\-paid Basic Life \& AD\&D Insurance (1x annual earnings up to $50,000\) * Voluntary Supplemental Life Insurance for employee, spouse, and dependents * Voluntary Short\-Term Disability — replaces up to 60% of income (up to $1,500/week) * Voluntary Long\-Term Disability — replaces up to 60% of income (up to $7,500/month) * Voluntary Accident, Critical Illness, and Hospital Indemnity Insurance through Mutual of Omaha * 401(k) retirement plan **Support \& Well\-Being** * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) through Mutual of Omaha — free, confidential support for emotional, legal, financial, and personal well\-being available 24/7/365 **Equal Employment Opportunity** Puck provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all team members and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. Puck expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. **Ready to Join the Team?** Apply today at **www.puck.com/careers** or contact our HR team: **Email:** hr@puck.com **Phone:** 712\-655\-9200 *Puck \| Built to Lead.*

jobs.title: Director, Technical Support (Tier 3)
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- United States \& Canada **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Support Small businesses represent 99\.9% of all companies, yet they're still forced to choose between clunky, outdated enterprise phone systems or their personal phones. This multi\-billion dollar market has been overlooked for decades, left to cobble together solutions that slow them down instead of helping them grow. Quo is changing that. We bring calls, texts, and customer information together into one easy\-to\-use, AI\-powered platform. We're not just building a phone system. We're setting a new standard for how businesses connect with their customers. Driven by our values, we move fast, build with determination, and obsess over delivering value to the businesses that have been underserved for far too long. Today, Quo is trusted by more than 120,000 companies and rated \#1 in customer satisfaction on G2\. We're backed by Y Combinator, Tiger Global, Craft Ventures, Slow Ventures, and other top\-tier investors. It's safe to say we're onto something big. **About the role** ================== We're looking for a Director of Technical Support to build Tier 3 Technical Support from the ground up. Tier 3 will be our specialist support engineering function for the most complex customer issues across our AI products, Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities, APIs, integrations, and telecom infrastructure. Tier 2 has built a strong foundation, and Tier 3 will build on it. You'll define the mandate, hire and grow the team, and establish clear ownership and handoffs across Support, Product, Engineering, and Engineering QA. You'll partner closely with Support leadership, who will continue to own Tier 1 and Tier 2 performance. You'll build the team's ability to investigate complex issues, reproduce defects, deliver actionable technical escalations, and validate fixes with Engineering and QA. You'll set standards for technical judgment and customer ownership, with accountability for faster diagnosis, reliable resolution, and fewer recurring issues. As we optimize support, you'll focus Tier 3 on the work where deeper technical expertise has the greatest impact. You'll partner with Engineering and CX Operations on tools, AI, and automation that improve resolution and reduce manual effort, while owning priorities, adoption, and measurable customer outcomes. You'll also be the senior CX partner to Product and Engineering, turning customer challenges into shared priorities for better products, more reliable service, and stronger launch readiness. **Some of the things you’ll do:** --------------------------------- *Design and launch Tier 3* * **Define Tier 3’s mandate:** Establish the operating model and escalation criteria, with clear ownership boundaries across Tier 2, Product, and Engineering. * **Build the technical foundation:** Define the capabilities needed to resolve complex issues across APIs, integrations, MCP, telecom, and AI products. * **Create a phased roadmap:** Plan team structure, specialist roles, tooling, access, and email and phone support. * **Prioritize investments:** Make clear tradeoffs across staffing, service levels, improvement work, and cost, with recommendations tied to expected outcomes. *Build the team* * **Set technical hiring and growth standards:** Define hiring criteria and career paths for a specialist support engineering team. * **Build the right mix of expertise:** Develop internal talent from Tier 2 and recruit external specialists. * **Develop technical leaders:** Hire and coach managers and team leads who strengthen technical judgment and sustain performance. * **Establish clear accountability:** Set expectations for customer ownership, timely resolution, and escalation, and address performance and capability gaps promptly. *Own Tier 3 performance* * **Own customer outcomes:** Deliver against expectations for service levels, resolution quality, and efficiency. * **Measure technical effectiveness:** Track time to actionable diagnosis, resolution within Tier 3’s scope, escalation quality, and repeat issues. * **Build a consistent quality review process:** Assess investigation depth, technical accuracy, customer communication, and fix validation. * **Turn insights into improvements:** Use customer feedback, quality reviews, and operational data to identify gaps and drive measurable results. *Scale resolution through AI and continuous improvement* * **Reduce recurring technical work:** Use ticket data, customer cases, and frontline feedback to identify issues that can be resolved earlier, automated, simplified, or eliminated. * **Improve AI\-assisted resolution:** Partner with CX Ops Engineers to strengthen technical workflows from investigation through resolution. * **Maintain reliable AI outcomes:** Partner with CX QA on quality monitoring and clear criteria for human review and escalation. * **Demonstr teps, environment, configuration, and conditions that trigger an issue. * **Apply software testing knowledge:** Use functional, regression, integration, and API testing practices to guide investigations and collaborate effectively with Engineering QA. * **Strengthen technical diagnosis:** Coach the team to distinguish product defects from configuration issues, integration failures, and expected behavior. * **Set standards for actionable bug reports:** Ensure reports include expected versus actual results, reproduction steps, logs, affected versions, customer impact, and workarounds. * **Partner through fix validation:** Work with QA and Engineering to clarify findings, test proposed fixes, and confirm the affected customer workflow works. * **Improve product reliability:** Turn support trends into shared priorities that reduce recurring issues and avoidable customer demand. * **Prepare Support for launches:** Establish the ownership, training, diagnostics, tooling, and escalation paths needed to support new jobs.description: Description: **Salary**: $60,000 **Job Type**: Full\-Time (Exempt) QuaverEd is a rapidly growing, innovative education technology company founded in 2009\. Our mission is enriching the lives of children by helping educators to engage students in general music, social and emotional learning, as well as health and physical education. We are headquartered in historic Music Row in Nashville, Tennessee. Check out our website at QuaverEd.com. The AI team is small and builds fast. We ship internal tools, content pipelines, and platform features that put AI to practical use across engineering, product, curriculum, sales, and operations. The Junior Developer keeps the AI team's growing set of applications healthy and adds capacity for new project work when we need it. You'll report to the Director of AI. Most weeks, the majority of your time goes to maintaining and supporting apps already in production: fixing bugs, handling requests from the teams who use them, keeping dependencies current, and watching for problems before users find them. The rest goes to project work alongside other engineers, where you'll build features, prototype, and learn how we design AI\-assisted tools. **Job Duties:** **Application maintenance and support** * Own day\-to\-day upkeep of internal web apps and services: bug fixes, small enhancements, dependency and security updates; * Triage and resolve requests from internal users in curriculum, art, sales, and operations; * Monitor logs, errors, and costs on cloud deployments and flag issues early; * Keep documentation, runbooks, and READMEs current so anyone on the team can pick up an app; * Manage access, environment config, and secrets according to our default\-deny security practices; and * Stakeholder management: Handle requests from other teams with patience and diplomacy. When a request is not possible, explain the reason clearly and propose practical alternatives. **Project Work** * Build features and prototypes on new projects with guidance from senior engineers; * Write tests and QA your own work before it reaches review; * Use AI coding tools (Claude Code and similar) daily, and review their output with a critical eye; and * Package changes for the company release cycle and work with QC through patch, alpha, and beta phases. **Team** * Join project planning work, team meetings. * Share what you learn; we expect juniors to grow fast and teach back. Requirements: * 0–2 years of professional development experience, or equivalent through a degree, bootcamp, or a solid portfolio of shipped projects; * Working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript and at least one of React or Node.js; * Some Python, or the willingness to pick it up quickly; * Comfort with Git, pull requests, and reading code you didn't write; * Basic SQL and an understanding of how web apps talk to APIs and databases; * Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants, and the judgment to know when not to trust them; * Clear written communication; you can explain a fix to a non\-technical teammate; and * Follow\-through on unglamorous work. Maintenance is the core of this job. **Nice to Have** * Google Cloud experience (Cloud Run, Firebase, Firestore, Vertex AI) or AWS * Experience calling LLM APIs (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google) or building with MCP * Familiarity with automated testing tools such as Playwright * Exposure to accessibility standards (WCAG) or localization work * Background or interest in music, education, or EdTech * Experience with BI or data pipelines ***Please submit a resume and cover letter along with three references.*** The job role is *not* a remote work position. jobs.title: Client Success Engineer
jobs.description: **About Rebar** --------------- Construction is a $2 trillion industry in the US alone. Most of it still runs like it’s 1995: PDFs, spreadsheets, and email. Every commercial building starts the same way. Someone opens a few hundred pages of blueprints and counts every piece of equipment, duct, and pipe by hand. Then they price it, bid it, and chase it for months. That work decides who builds what, and for how much. It has barely changed in 30 years. Rebar is building the AI platform the trades run on. Our models read blueprints the way a veteran in the trades does. Our agents then do the work that follows: counting the job, pricing it, managing the bid, and tracking it through to the order. Counts that took three days now take one. Customers spend hours a day in Rebar, and thousands of new plan sets flow through it every week. We started with HVAC contractors and their suppliers. Every other trade comes next. Here’s where we go: when a building goes up, the trades that build it run on Rebar. Agents win the job, run the job, and buy the equipment. We’re about 50 people in Union Square, growing fast, and backed by top investors. We’ve built only a fraction of what we need to. **About the Engineering Org** ----------------------------- The role of the engineer is rapidly changing. We're aware, and we're being intentional about adapting with it. We are fostering an engineering culture of growth and development. We strongly emphasize care of craft and winning together. Our core values are: * Everyone operates like an owner * Find a way * We win together That being said, the whole company still works really hard! This is something that you should read and internalize. This might not be the place for everyone. **About the Role** ------------------ We're hiring a software engineer to be the technical arm of our Client Success and Implementation teams. As we sign bigger customers, every deployment comes with more technical work attached. A contractor wants their historical projects loaded in. Another wants our analytics piped into their ERP or BI tool. Another needs an API change, so their internal systems can pull takeoff data. Today, that work lands on the core engineering team as one\-off requests, pulling them off the roadmap. We want one engineer who owns it. You will still sit in the engineering org and have strong mentorship and learning. You'll come to engineering stand\-ups, ship through our normal review process, and attend retros. Your priorities come from our customers. You can think about this role almost as a forward\-deployed engineer. You'll be on calls with customers, figuring out what they actually need and then building it. You’ll get to work with messy data, API integrations, and customer expansion. We understand the challenges and sacrifices that come with joining an early\-stage startup, and we want to emphasize that we're committed to ensuring you leave as a better, more experienced engineer and leader than when you joined. Here you'll own a hard piece of client\-side engineering, and watch it scale from hundreds to thousands of users. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Own customer data work * Build and maintain integrations * Handle customer API requests * Scope technical requirements with customers * Be the escalation path for technical issues * Turn one\-offs into product **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- We want an engineer who likes talking to customers. You should be able to sit on a call with an estimator, understand how their team works, and then go write the script that fixes their problem. You'll be working with messy real\-world data, so you should enjoy digging into it and not be scared of a 50,000\-row CSV with inconsistent columns. We are looking for engineers with good judgment, an inquisitive attitude, and the maturity to represent engineering in front of a customer. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 2\+ years of software engineering experience, or a technical client\-facing role (solutions engineer, implementation engineer, forward deployed engineer) where you wrote real code * Strong Python for scripting and data work * Comfortable with SQL and relational databases (we're on Postgres) * Experience working with REST APIs, JSON, and webhooks * Comfortable talking directly with customers, from end users to technical stakeholders * Writes things down. Your integrations and scripts should be documented well enough that someone else can run them. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Familiarity with TypeScript and React * Experience with AWS (Lambda, S3, DynamoDB) * Experience with GraphQL * Experience with integration platforms or unified APIs (e.g., Merge) * Background in construction, HVAC/mechanical, or another legacy industry * Familiarity with estimating, takeoff, ERP, or project management tools used in construction * Worked at an early\-stage or high\-growth startup **Compensation and Benefits** ----------------------------- * **Salary**: Competitive base salary * **Equity**: Meaningful equity package, commensurate with experience * **Benefits**: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * **Perks**: + Agentic tooling budget + Lunches provided, dinners provided (after a set time) + Great culture in a high\-energy office This is a full\-time, on\-site role in NYC’s Flatiron District, steps from Madison Square Park and Union Square. Occasional travel for on\-site customer visits. *Equal Opportunity* *Rebar is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.* Compensation Range: $120K \- $165K

responsible AI use, including data privacy, access controls, and the limitations of AI\-generated results * Understanding of data analysis techniques with some experience working with data analysis tools (Excel, SQL, PowerBI, Looker, etc.) **Nice to Have:** *These are the skills we look for. jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description: Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable. Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud\-seeding science with weather\-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities. Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course\-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you. The Production team builds, integrates, and maintains every aircraft Rainmaker flies. Manufacturing Engineering is the link between design engineering and the production floor, turning new designs into repeatable, scalable build processes so we can put more aircraft into the field. ### **About the Role** As an Associate Manufacturing Engineer, you’ll help turn Rainmaker’s UAS designs into aircraft we can build quickly, repeatably, and at scale. You’ll work on the production floor alongside technicians and machinists, writing work instructions, designing fixtures and tooling, and solving the build problems that slow us down. You’ll partner closely with design engineers, the Shop Manager, and supply chain to get new parts and assemblies into production. This is a hands\-on role for an engineer who wants to learn fast and see their work fly.### **What You'll Do** * Write and maintain work instructions. Create clear, step\-by\-step build procedures, assembly instructions, and inspection checklists in our production tracking system, and keep them current as designs change. * Design tooling and fixtures. Design, build, and validate jigs, fixtures, and assembly aids that make builds faster, more consistent, and easier to inspect. * Solve problems on the floor. Be the first engineer technicians call when a build stops, troubleshoot assembly and fit issues, and drive fixes back into drawings and procedures. * Support new product introduction. Help bring new parts, assemblies, and design revisions from engineering into production, including first builds and first\-article inspection. * Give design for manufacturing feedback. Review drawings and models with design engineers and recommend changes that improve manufacturability, cost, and quality. * Support the machine shop. Help program and prove out parts on CNCs, 3D printers, and laser cutters, and work with machinists to improve setups, fixturing, and cycle times. * Track quality and drive corrective action. Log nonconformances, help lead root cause analysis, and put corrective actions in place so problems don’t repeat. * Maintain BOMs and production data. Keep manufacturing BOMs, routings, and part data accurate in our MES and ERP so the floor always builds the right configuration. * Improve how we build. Measure build times and yields, find bottlenecks, and run small improvement projects as production scales. ### **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Aerospace, or Industrial Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent hands\-on experience) * You have experience working in manufacturing, production, or hardware engineering spaces, including internships, co\-ops, or student project teams * Hands\-on experience building hardware (machining, fabrication, soldering, 3D printing, etc.), through work, school, or personal projects * Proficiency in CAD (SolidWorks, or similar) * Ability to read and create mechanical drawings, including basic GD\&T * Clear written communication, with the ability to write instructions for technicians * Strong problem\-solving skills and comfort working on the production floor * A genuine interest in manufacturing and a drive to learn quickly in a fast\-paced environment ### **What Will Set Your Apart** * Experience with UAS, aerospace, robotics, or other complex electromechanical hardware * Experience with CAM programming and 3 and 5 axis CNC machining * Experience with MES, PLM, or ERP systems (e.g., ION, NetSuite) * Familiarity with wire harness fabrication, electronics assembly, or IPC standards * Experience with lean manufacturing, root cause analysis, or statistical process control ### **What Success Looks Like In the First 90 Days** In your first 30 days, you’ll learn our aircraft, build process, and production systems by working alongside technicians on the floor and alongside engineers. By 60 days, you’ll own a set of work instructions and be the go\-to engineer for issues on those builds. By 90 days, you’ll have designed and deployed process improvements that measurably cuts build time or defects, and you’ll be contributing manufacturability feedback on new designs. Supporting the people behind the mission Making Earth more habitable is ambitious work. We want the people doing it to feel supported—in the work we share and the lives they’re building. * A stake in what we build. Meaningful stock options and the opportunity to help shape Rainmaker as an early member of the team. * Support for your health. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance. * An investment in your future. A 401(k) with employer matching to help you build long\-term savings. * Time to recharge. Unlimited PTO for rest, exploration, and the people and pursuits that matter to you. * Time for a growing family. Paid parental leave for both parents to welcome a child and spend time together. * Lunch together. Daily lunch provided at our El Segundo headquarters—a chance to share a meal and connect with teammates. * Help making the move. If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it. **About Ramp Labs** ------------------- Ramp Labs is Ramp's AI research and engineering group. We post\-train models on finance work, build the environments and evals they learn from, and ship them into the products 85,000\+ companies use to move money. **About the Role** ------------------ Most agent work today is one agent, one trace, and a person reads the result. We're building systems where that stops working: thousands of agents fanned out over a large search space, each returning partial results, with an orchestrator that turns all of it into something useful: hundreds of merged PRs, a dataset, the input to another system, or something nobody has built yet. You'll design and run those systems: how work gets split, how agents coordinate, how results get deduplicated, verified and ranked, and what it all costs. The problems are general (agent swarms, agentic map\-reduce, long\-running fan\-out workflows) and you'll own them from prototype to production. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Decide how the work gets done: how to break a problem down, what each agent sees, how many agents to run, and which model handles which step * Squeeze accuracy out of the models: context design, self\-verification, voting and consensus across agents, and knowing when more agents stop helping * Measure quality without reading every trace: sampling, automated verification, and precision and recall on the final output * Drive down cost and latency per useful result: model routing, caching, early stopping, and smaller or fine\-tuned models where they hold up * Turn one\-off experiments into reusable workflows on our existing orchestration stack * Evaluate new models, inference setups and training approaches, and bring in what works **What You Need** ----------------- * Experience building applied AI systems and LLM applications that shipped * Hands\-on experience with multi\-agent or high\-fan\-out LLM workloads: parallel agents, map\-reduce over models, large batch inference * Strong engineering in Python; you build concurrent, distributed systems that hold up in production * Judgment about output: you decide what the end result should look like before you scale the swarm, and you can separate signal from agent noise * The habit of measuring: cost, yield, false\-positive rate, and whether a change actually helped * Ownership: you can run a roadmap and a production system with little oversight * Clear written communication **Nice\-to\-Have** ------------------ * Built agent orchestration or job systems (Ray, Temporal, Modal or custom) * Used LLMs to search large spaces: codebases, document sets, logs or other large corpora * Post\-training or hosting open\-source models for high\-volume inference * Distributed systems background * Public work we can look at: an agent jobs.title: AI Automation Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** We are seeking a highly motivated AI Automation Solutions Engineer to drive innovation, operational efficiency, and process transformation through intelligent automation and applied AI solutions. In this role, you will partner with business leaders, project teams, operations teams, engineering organizations, and external vendors to identify opportunities for automation, streamline workflows, and improve service delivery across the organization. You will serve as both a strategic advisor and hands\-on technical contributor, helping translate business challenges into scalable technology solutions. The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering and automation expertise with a consultative mindset, enabling them to identify opportunities, influence stakeholders, and deliver solutions that create measurable business value. **Job Description** ***Please note: This role is not eligible for Work Visa sponsorship, either currently or in the future*** ***This role is a hybrid workstyle:*** ***with the associate expected to work from a Raymond James office location at least three days per week, including either Monday or Friday.*** **Responsibilities** * Partner with business stakeholders, project teams, product owners, and technology leaders to identify automation and AI opportunities that improve operational efficiency and service delivery. * Participate in project planning, discovery sessions, and vendor engagements to evaluate business requirements and recommend scalable automation solutions. * Analyze existing business processes and identify opportunities to eliminate manual effort through workflow automation and intelligent technologies. * Design, develop, implement, and maintain enterprise automation solutions, integrations, and orchestration workflows. * Build and support AI\-powered solutions including intelligent agents, knowledge retrieval systems, conversational experiences, and Generative AI use cases. * Develop integrations between enterprise platforms using APIs, web services, and automation frameworks. * Create reusable automation components, frameworks, and development standards to accelerate solution delivery. * Collaborate with engineering and operations teams to ensure solutions are secure, supportable, scalable, and aligned with enterprise architecture standards. * Monitor automation performance, troubleshoot issues, and continuously optimize existing solutions. * Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to identify new opportunities for automation, AI adoption, and process improvement. * Maintain technical documentation, governance standards, and operational procedures for automation platforms and AI solutions. Contribute to roadmap planning and strategic initiatives focused on digital transformation, intelligent automation, and operational excellence. * **Required Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience in software engineering, automation engineering, platform engineering, systems integration * Experience designing, developing, and supporting enterprise\-scale automation solutions and workflows. * Proficiency in one or more programming or scripting languages such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, PowerShell, Java, or Go. * Experience building APIs, system integrations, and automated business processes. * Knowledge of software development lifecycle (SDLC), source control, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and secure coding practices. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving skills. * Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for business audiences. * Experience gathering requirements and translating business needs into practical technical solutions. Ability to manage multiple initiatives while working effectively across cross\-functional teams. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with prompt engineering, model evaluation, AI governance, guardrails, and responsible AI practices. * Experience with enterprise automation and orchestration platforms such as VMware vRealize Orchestrator, Microsoft System Center Orchestrator, Resolve, or similar technologies. * Experience developing or integrating Generative AI solutions, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, intelligent agents, or chatbot technologies. * ServiceNow development, administration, workflow design, or system integration experience. * Experience with cloud platforms and modern development architectures. * Understanding of DevOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automation frameworks. * Experience supporting Digital Workplace, End User Computing, Infrastructure, or Enterprise Technology organizations. * Relevant certifications related to cloud technologies, AI, automation, software engineering, or DevOps. Experience evaluating third\-party technologies and collaborating with vendors to develop and implement technical solutions. * **Why Join Us** This position offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of intelligent automation and AI across the enterprise. You will work directly with business leaders, technical teams, and strategic partners to design innovative solutions that improve efficiency, enhance user experiences, and drive meaningful transformation at scale. **Education** High School (HS) \- Completed (Required) **Work Experience** General Experience \- 3 to 6 years **Certifications** **Travel** Less than 25% **Workstyle** Hybrid The total compensation for this position includes base salary or wages, and may include components such as additional compensation (cash or equity), discretionary bonuses, or commissions. This position is eligible for a benefits package that may include medical, dental, and vision; life insurance; critical illness insurance and accident insurance; disability benefits; retirement savings; paid time off (including vacation, holidays, and sick leave); and parental leave. Eligibility for benefits and specific offerings may vary based on position and employment status. To view more details of the benefits offered, visit Myrjbenefits.com. At Raymond James our associates use five guiding behaviors (Develop, Collaborate, Decide, Deliver, Improve) to deliver on the firm's core values of client\-first, integrity, independence and a conservative, long\-term view. We expect our associates at all levels to: * Grow professionally and inspire others to do the same * Work with and through others to achieve desired outcomes * Make prompt, pragmatic choices and act with the client in mind * Take ownership and hold themselves and others accountable for delivering results that matter * Contribute to the continuous evolution of the firm At Raymond James – as part of our people\-first culture, we honor, value, and respect the uniqueness, experiences, and backgrounds of all of our Associates. When associates bring their best authentic selves, our organization, clients, and communities thrive. The Company is an equal opportunity employer and makes all employment decisions on the basis of merit and business needs. \#LI\-TC1

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Enterprise Systems
jobs.description: **Description** Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions. Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance. **About the Role: Fullstack Senior Software Engineer** You will be joining the Enterprise Systems tech community, the vital architectural backbone where Realtor.com's most ambitious strategic initiatives transform into reality. Our team doesn't just manage software; we build the high\-speed 'engine room' that powers the entire business lifecycle\-integrating complex sales, billing, inventory, and fulfillment platforms into a seamless, high\-scale ecosystem. At Realtor, you will be part of a forward\-thinking community dedicated to compressing the distance between business intent and execution. We research and deploy cutting\-edge autonomous workflow engines to ensure our customers and internal partners have a best\-in\-class, friction\-free experience. We strive to innovate by building self\-healing infrastructures and AI\-driven automation that make the transaction journey faster and more intelligent than ever before. Join us to push the boundaries of what's possible, turning traditional systems of record into dynamic engines of growth, while learning from world\-class talent in a culture that thrives on experimentation and impact. As a Fullstack Senior Developer, you will be the bridge between complex enterprise data and high\-performance user experiences. You will join the Enterprise Systems tech community to build the tools that empower our customers and partners to navigate the home\-buying lifecycle with unprecedented speed. You aren't just writing code; you are designing the digital workflows that ensure our sales, order, and fulfillment engines run at peak efficiency. **What You'll Do:** * Engineer End\-to\-End Solutions: Design and develop scalable, responsive web applications using React and Node.js/Python that simplify complex enterprise workflows. * Architect Micro\-Frontends: Implement modern frontend architectures that integrate seamlessly with our Salesforce ecosystem and internal microservices. * Optimize Data Pipelines: Build and maintain high\-throughput APIs and event\-driven services (using Kafka or AWS EventBridge) that power real\-time business dashboards. * Embed Intelligence: Integrate Generative AI and machine learning models directly into the UI to provide predictive insights and automated task suggestions for our users. * Champion Quality \& DevOps: Drive the adoption of "Shift\-Left" testing, CI/CD automation, and observability tools to ensure our enterprise tools are as resilient as our consumer\-facing products. * Collaborate \& Mentor: Partner with Product Managers and UX Designers to translate business requirements into technical reality, while mentoring mid\-level engineers through code reviews and pair programming. **What You'll Bring:** * Full Stack Mastery: 5\+ years of professional experience building and scaling production\-grade applications using modern frameworks like React/Next.js and Node.js, Go, Python or Java. * System Design Fluency: Deep understanding of distributed systems, REST/GraphQL API design, and how to optimize for performance across the entire stack. * Cloud\-Native Mindset: Hands\-on experience with AWS (Lambda, ECS, DynamoDB) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) in a CI/CD environment. * Database Expertise: Proficiency with both relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and NoSQL solutions, including experience handling large\-scale data migrations. * Modern Web Expertise: Strong command of CSS\-in\-JS, TypeScript, and state management libraries (Redux/Zustand), with a focus on accessibility and performance. * Agile Leadership: Proven ability to lead features from conception to deployment in an Agile/Scrum environment, making pragmatic trade\-offs between speed and technical debt. * Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field **How We Work:** We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. For most roles, our employees work four or more days in our offices, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together. **How We Reward You:** Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and wellbeing of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to: * Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage * Family forming benefits * 13 Paid Holidays * Flexible Time Off * 8 hours of paid Volunteer Time off * Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match * Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs * 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions * Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program * Free snacks and refreshments in each office location Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com® Here, you'll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you'll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you'll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. In return, we'll provide you with a warm, welcoming, and inclusive culture; intellectual challenges; and the development opportunities you need to grow. Diversity is important to us, therefore, Realtor.com® is an Equal Opportunity Employer regardless of age, color, national origin, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital status, status as a disabled veteran and/or veteran of the Vietnam Era or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Realtor.com® will provide reasonable accommodations for otherwise qualified disabled individuals. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: ***Posting Type*** Hybrid/Remote ***Job Overview*** Who We Are Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI‑powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high‑stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial. The world’s largest law firms, corporations and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we’re deeply committed to expanding access to technology for academic institutions through Relativity Academic and supporting pro bono legal work through Justice for Change What We Do About AI and Data Science at Relativity Over the past two years, billions of documents have benefited from Relativity AI, and we are just beginning. We use AI to improve every user experience, product, matter, and investigation—helping users find the truth faster and act on data with confidence. At the same time, Relativity’s scale creates rich opportunities for data exploration, and our market reach helps turn insights into impact quickly. Our infrastructure makes data available for analysis while keeping it secure and protected, and we continue to invest in modern data\-pipeline and data\-lake technology. We prioritize algorithm excellence to deliver a robust, trusted experience. We are building a world\-class toolset to solve complex challenges quickly. We apply AI across discovery to improve case management and product operations. Our team values curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning. We test boldly, learn quickly, and improve every day. If you’re looking for a data\-rich, AI\-driven environment with large\-scale challenges and room to innovate, you’ll feel at home on Relativity’s AI team. Join us to help shape the culture, practices, and technical vision for machine learning at Relativity. What You’ll Do As a Senior AI Engineer at Relativity, you will design and build the AI/ML platforms and processes that support applied science and product engineering teams. You will focus on standardizing GenAI workflows and model management, ensuring scalability, security, and reliability. This role requires close collaboration across teams to enable impactful machine learning solutions that improve user experiences and product performance. If you're eager to tackle technical challenges and drive innovation in ML Ops, this position is for you. ***Job Description and Requirements*** **Responsibilities** * **Technical Leadership.** Work with a team of engineers from a technical perspective, focused on data science enablement, automation, and model management. * **Solution Design.** Design AI/ML solutions with the appropriate delivery timelines, extensibility, performance, and scale. * **Planning.** Plan larger data science and machine learning efforts in conjunction with data scientists and product managers, minimizing risks and maximizing opportunities. * **Security \& Compliance.** Collaborate with Relativity's security team to ensure robust data protection and compliance. * **Cross\-Team Collaboration.** Collaborate with product managers, data engineers, and data scientists focused on innovation and new product development. * **ML Ops.** Design, communicate, and deploy our machine learning operations processes and platforms (i.e., ML Ops). * **Prototyping.** Prototype new machine learning technologies to find opportunities to reduce costs, gain efficiencies, unlock insights, or facilitate new product development. * **Hands\-On Contribution.** Contribute towards project work and model technical acumen via hands\-on contributions, coaching, code review, and system design review. * **Communication.** Communicate across the broader AI team, keeping the team aware of AI platform innovation, learning opportunities, and future areas of innovation. * **Deployment \& Monitoring.** Deploy and monitor highly available data science solutions via CI/CD with health and performance metrics. What We’re Looking For **Required** * **4\+ years** of experience engineering software systems. * **2\+ years** of industry experience in machine learning\-focused roles and big data environments. * Fluent in **C\#, Python, or Java** . * **3\+ years** of experience with **Docker** . * **2\+ years** of experience creating resources on **AWS, Azure, or GCP** using infrastructure as code (e.g., AWS CloudFormation, AWS CDK, Terraform, CDKTF, Pulumi, etc.). * Experience with **Prefect, Airflow** , or an analogous workflow tool. * Experience with **Helm and Kubernetes** . * Ability and desire to mentor teammates in the use of applied data science and data processing technologies. * Prior experience owning and maintaining a major system within a business from a technical and architecture perspective. * Experience maintaining and monitoring deployed data science solutions for performance and algorithmic health. **Preferred** * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or Artificial Intelligence. * Experience with Azure cloud environment and Azure's big data infrastructure, data processing, and data science toolset. * Experience building or deploying models using frameworks such as **TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch** . * Demonstrated deep experience in a particular area of data science (computer vision, NLP, etc.). * Experience with **MLflow** or **Kubeflow** . * Experience in a DevOps, infrastructure, or site reliability team or function. * Experience deploying solutions in big data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Hadoop, EMR, and Kafka. * Experience tuning data processing engines such as Spark to optimize costs, resource consumption, and execution times. Why We Could Be A Great Fit * **Impactful Mission:** ***Organize Data, Discover the Truth and Act on It*** \- Our customers include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading law firms managing high\-stakes matters on our platform. * **Growth Path:** Engineers gain exposure across the stack, from distributed systems to AI\-enabled workflows, accelerating career growth. * **Engineering Culture:** Continuous delivery, strong observability, and end\-to\-end ownership. * **Inclusive Environment:** Diverse backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger. * **Community Impact:** Volunteer opportunities and company\-sponsored charitable programs. * **Compensation \& Benefits:** Competitive salary, health and retirement programs, wellness resources, discretionary time off (DTO), parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers, two annual company breaks, home office stipend, and an equity program. **Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.** This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long\-term incentives. The expected salary range for this role is between following values: $143,000 and $215,000 The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position. **Required Skills:** Algorithms, Big Data, Cloud Computing, Computer Vision, Data Science, Deep Learning, Natural Language, Natural Language Processing (NLP), Project Management, Software Engineering

jobs.title: Technical Lead, Data Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** Revance is building an Intelligence Platform that will serve as a single source of truth for insights, recommendations, and knowledge across the company. The **Technical Lead, Azure Integration \& Data Engineering** will design and deliver the integrations that connect enterprise systems and the data platform that transforms source information into trusted data for reporting, analytics, and AI. This hands\-on technical leadership role will guide integration and data engineering work while contributing production code. The role partners closely with data science, architecture, business, and compliance teams to enable capabilities serving both practices (B2B) and consumers (B2C). **Reporting to:** Director, Data Engineering **Location:** Hybrid from Nashville TN, Dallas TX, Johnson City TN, or Newark CA; remote from all other US locations **Responsibilities/Essential Duties:** * **Enterprise Integrations:** + Lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise integrations on Microsoft Azure using Logic Apps, Azure Functions, and API Management. + Build and maintain secure, scalable REST and SOAP APIs to exchange data with Salesforce OCE (Orchestrated Customer Engagement), other CRM platforms, and ERP systems. + Design real\-time synchronization, bulk data loads, and change data capture patterns. + Secure integrations using Azure Key Vault, Managed Identity, OAuth 2\.0, and other Azure security services. + Implement robust error handling, retries, logging, alerting through Azure Monitor, and reconciliation processes. * **Data Engineering \& Platform Development:** + Design and build scalable ETL/ELT pipelines from source systems into Snowflake using Azure Data Factory (ADF), ADLS Gen2, Snowflake OpenFlow, Snowpipe, and Streams and Tasks. + Design data models and warehouse layers (raw, curated, and analytics\-ready) using dimensional modeling and modern data architecture practices. + Develop transformations with SQL and Snowpark Python, and orchestrate workflows with ADF or similar tools. + Build datasets, feature pipelines, and data products for AI and ML use cases, including lead scoring, Next Best Action, churn prediction, and personalization. * **AI, ML \& Generative AI:** + Build AI/ML and generative AI solutions using Snowflake Cortex, Snowflake ML, and Azure OpenAI. + Apply retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), vector search, and prompt engineering to healthcare and commercial use cases. + Partner with data scientists to move models into production and support MLOps workflows. * **Technical Leadership \& Delivery:** + Own solution architecture and technical design for integrations and data pipelines while writing production code alongside the team. + Mentor engineers through code reviews, design reviews, and pairing, and help raise the team's technical standards. + Evaluate tools and patterns across Azure, Snowflake, and AI, and recommend solutions for adoption. + Set engineering standards, coding practices, and CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions for integrations and data pipelines. + Translate business requirements into technical designs, estimates, and delivery plans. + Maintain documentation, data flow diagrams, and integration specifications. + Own production support by monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuously improving reliability. + Work in an Agile/Scrum team with developers, architects, and business stakeholders. **Basic Qualifications:** * 10\+ years in data engineering and integration, including 5\+ years in a technical lead capacity. * Deep, hands\-on expertise in Azure integration and data services, including Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management, ADF, ADLS Gen2, Key Vault, and Azure Monitor. * Strong API and integration experience with REST, SOAP, JSON/XML, OAuth 2\.0, error handling, and bulk data patterns. * Experience integrating with Salesforce, particularly Salesforce OCE (IQVIA), using Salesforce REST and Bulk APIs, as well as other CRM and ERP systems. * Hands\-on Snowflake skills, including advanced SQL, data modeling, Snowpark Python, OpenFlow, and performance tuning. * Data warehousing and ETL/ELT experience, including dimensional modeling, data quality, and large\-volume data processing. * Hands\-on experience with Snowflake Cortex, Snowflake ML, or Azure OpenAI, and building production\-grade data and AI/ML pipelines. * Proficiency in Python and SQL. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and documentation skills, including the ability to explain technical topics to non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience in medical aesthetics, life sciences, or healthcare, ideally involving commercial data such as practice and injector (HCP/HCO) data, CRM, loyalty programs, and consumer data. * Certifications/Licenses: Snowflake SnowPro; Azure Data Engineer (DP\-203\); Azure Developer (AZ\-204\); or Azure Solutions Architect (AZ\-305\). **Company Summary:** Revance is a global company developing, producing, and distributing industry\-leading, differentiated products across aesthetics, skincare, and therapeutics. Revance drives innovation beyond convention to offer treatment options for individuals across generations. The Company's vision is to redefine excellence in aesthetics, skincare, and therapeutics through science\-powered innovation, with an unwavering commitment to its providers, patients, and consumers. Revance's award\-winning products are the result of robust research and development, a cornerstone for the Company, driven by renowned scientists. For more information about Revance, please visit us at www.revance.com. **What Revance invests in you:** * Competitive Compensation including base salary and annual performance bonus. * Flexible PTO, holidays, and parental leave. * Generous healthcare benefits, HSA match, 401k match, employer paid life and disability insurance, pet insurance, wellness discounts and much more! *This section of the job description is required by the American with Disability Act (ADA). The ADA requires that job descriptions reflect the physical and mental demands required to effectively perform the essential duties of the job. The ADA prohibits employers from discriminating against a "qualified individual with a disability" in all aspects of the employment relationship. A "qualified individual with a disability" is "an individual who meets the education, experience, skill, and other job\-related requirements of a position held or desired, and who, with reasonable accommodation, can perform the essential functions of a specified job."* *Revance is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

jobs.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Ripple, we're building a world where value moves like information does today. It's big, it's bold, and we're already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. If you're ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value. **THE WORK:** Ripple is building the Internet of Value: infrastructure that moves money as fast as information moves today. Every payment that flows across our network passes through real\-time financial crimes controls: sanctions screening, wallet risk analysis, transaction monitoring, and travel rule compliance. The Financial Crimes Engineering team builds and operates that layer. This is the engineering that determines whether payments clear or hold, whether Ripple meets its regulatory obligations across jurisdictions, and whether the network can scale without compromising on compliance. The problem space is genuinely hard: high\-throughput distributed systems, real\-time decisioning, multi\-source coordination across external compliance data providers, regulator\-grade audit trails, and resilience. As a Senior Staff Software Engineer on this team, you will set the multi\-year technical direction for the compliance control plane and drive its adoption beyond your own team. You will own the architecture of the vendor\-agnostic, resilient, provable system that lets Ripple move value without moving financial crime, and you will shape how compliance engineering works across the company. This is a role for someone who defines which problems the organization solves, not only how they get solved: you will set the technical strategy other teams build against, establish the patterns that become organizational standards, and serve as the senior\-most engineering voice on how regulatory obligations become durable infrastructure. **WHAT YOU'LL DO:** * Own the multi\-year architectural vision for the compliance control plane: real\-time screening orchestration, the resilience and observability layer, vendor\-agnostic integration, and the decision and data plane, sequenced against where Ripple's products and regulatory surface will be in three years, not where they are today * Drive the hardest, highest\-ambiguity technical problems end to end: multi\-vendor failover, sub\-second decisioning under load, regulator\-grade auditability, and resilience across partial dependency failures * Set technical direction that extends beyond FinCrimes: define the integration contracts, resilience patterns, and compliance primitives that partner engineering teams adopt, and drive alignment across organizational boundaries where no single team owns the outcome * Translate evolving regulatory obligations and organizational goals into durable engineering primitives and a sequenced technical roadmap, and influence what the organization invests in to get there * Anticipate platform risks and scaling constraints years before they become incidents, and lead the initiatives that address them * Partner directly with executive leadership across Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and Product to shape how regulatory requirements become engineering reality, and represent the platform's technical position to auditors, regulators, and external partners * Set standards for production ownership across the team and beyond: observability, alerting, incident response, and the reliability bar that other teams calibrate against * Multiply the technical capability of the organization: mentor staff and senior engineers, elevate design quality through architecture review, and raise the ceiling of what the team can take on **WHAT YOU'LL BRING:** * 12\+ years building production backend systems, with deep expertise in Java (or comparable JVM languages, Go, Rust) * A track record of owning architecture for complex distributed systems at scale across multiple teams or organizations, defining the designs that others build against and that outlast your involvement * Demonstrated ability to set technical direction at the organizational level and drive adoption of standards and patterns across team boundaries without formal authority * Strong resilience and distributed\-systems design instincts: failover, graceful degradation, idempotency, high\-throughput real\-time decisioning, and designing systems that survive the failure of dependencies you do not control * Excellent API design judgment (REST/gRPC) and a history of establishing patterns that become organizational defaults * Proven skill navigating ambiguity in a regulated environment, turning regulator findings, audit obligations, and partner asks into shippable, durable engineering plans, and defending those decisions to auditors and examiners * Working knowledge of Kubernetes, observability tooling (Grafana, OpenTelemetry, or similar), and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) * A track record of developing senior and staff engineers and measurably lifting the technical bar of an organization * Experience in fintech, payments, identity, or compliance technology is a strong plus, though exceptional systems architects from adjacent high\-stakes domains are welcome **WHY THIS ROLE:** * **Consequence**: your architecture decides whether real payments clear, in real time, for real customers. * **Ownership beyond the platform:** you are not owning a service or even a system, you are shaping the compliance control plane that every Ripple product depends on and the standards that partner teams build to. * **Building the next generation:** we are actively designing the vendor\-agnostic, resilient compliance platform built to scale across new jurisdictions and product surfaces. This is the person who leads that design and sets its direction for the next several years. * **Executive\-level influence:** you will work directly with senior leaders across Engineering, Compliance, Legal, and Product. The job is technical, but the influence is organizational. * **Technical leadership without leaving the code:** the senior\-most IC voice on a team where the engineering genuinely matters. Other common names for this role: **WHO WE ARE:** Do Your Best Work * The opportunity to build in a fast\-paced start\-up environment with experienced industry leaders * A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact. A professional development budget to support other modes of learning. * Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team. * In\-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10\+ days a month they come in. * Bi\-weekly all\-company meeting \- business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team * We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more! Take Control of Your Finances * Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity * Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support * Employee giving match * Mobile phone stipend Take Care of Yourself * R\&R days so you can rest and recharge * Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite \& virtual programming * Generous vacation policy \- work with your manager to take time off when you need it * Industry\-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits. * Catered lunches, fully\-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events *Benefits listed above are for full\-time employees.* *Ripple is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We do not discriminate against qualified employees or applicants because of race, color, religion, gender identity, sex, sexual identity, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, marital status, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, military status, or any other characteristic protected by local law or ordinance.* *Please find our California, UK/EU, Singapore, DIFC, ADGM, Australia, and Switzerland* *Applicant Privacy Notice* *for reference.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Spend Product
jobs.description: **About Rippling** ------------------ Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. ##### **About the Spend Product Team** We build the system that gives companies real time visibility and control over every dollar they spend. Rippling Spend unifies corporate cards, reimbursements, procurement, bill pay, and travel into a single workflow that connects directly to accounting and payroll. Unlike point solutions that reconcile after the fact, we enforce policy, approvals, and accounting in real time. That lets finance teams operate proactively, and it creates a hard systems problem across payments, data consistency, permissions, and scale. If you like building deeply integrated platforms that replace fragmented tooling, this is the work ### **What We Build** We build the products that help companies control, automate, and gain real\-time visibility into every way money moves through the business, from cards and expenses to bill pay and travel. * **Corporate Cards:** Rippling Corporate Cards powers company spending through physical and virtual cards with built\-in controls, configurable limits, and policy enforcement. For engineering candidates, it’s a chance to work on payments infrastructure, risk systems, authorization flows, and high\-trust financial user experiences. * **Expense Management:** Rippling Expense Management helps employees submit expenses and helps finance teams review, approve, and reimburse them in a streamlined workflow. From an engineering standpoint, it brings together policy engines, approvals, mobile and web experiences, and deep integrations with payroll and accounting systems. * **Bill Pay:** Rippling Bill Pay gives companies a unified way to manage vendor invoices, approval chains, and outgoing payments. It’s a product area that combines document ingestion, workflow automation, financial operations, and money movement in a single system. * **Trave**l: Rippling Travel connects booking workflows with the rest of the spend stack so travel activity, approvals, and downstream reconciliation all live in one ecosystem. For engineers, it’s an opportunity to build across booking experiences, policy enforcement, compliance, and post\-purchase spend workflows. * **Procurement:** Rippling Procurement provides a centralized way for employees to request, approve, and manage purchases before money is spent. It brings together intake workflows, approval chains, vendor coordination, and purchase tracking into a single system. From an engineering perspective, it involves building flexible workflow engines, dynamic forms, vendor management systems, and deep integrations with bill pay, accounting, and policy enforcement to ensure spend is controlled from the very first request. * **Banking:** Rippling Banking enables companies to store, move, and manage their money with built\-in controls and real\-time visibility. It brings together accounts, transfers, cash management, and reconciliation into a single system tightly integrated with the broader spend stack. From an engineering perspective, it spans ledgering systems, money movement rails, compliance and risk controls, and high\-reliability infrastructure to ensure accuracy, security, and trust at scale. **What you will do** -------------------- * Own the design and implementation of core backend services and APIs that power critical product capabilities and complex business logic. * Ensure all systems are built for high\-volume scale, reliability, and security, making strategic decisions about infrastructure and data integrity. * Work seamlessly with product, frontend, and platform teams to translate feature goals into robust, high\-performance technical solutions. * Elevate the team's technical standards, lead code and design reviews, and mentor engineers on backend best practices. **What you will need** ---------------------- * 5\+ years of experience in a production environment using Python, Go, or a similar high\-scale backend language. * Deep expertise in distributed systems architecture, data modeling, and performance optimization of relational databases. * You have seen and contributed to systems operating at a significant technical and organizational scale. * Strong understanding of CS/algorithms fundamentals and experience with complex project delivery. * Exceptional communication skills with technical and cross\-functional stakeholders. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office\-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role. This role will receive a competitive salary \+ benefits \+ equity. The salary for US\-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here. A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below. **The pay range for this role is:** 159,000 \- 278,250 USD per year(US Tier 1\)
