jobs.title: AI Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description **Job Description** Rockwell Automation is looking for an experienced Agentic AI Systems Engineer to serve as an enterprise systems engineer for agentic AI within our Data, Analytics, and Insights – AI Innovation \& Engineering organization. This role shapes how agentic AI is adopted across a large, global enterprise: you will assess use cases end to end, decide where to buy, build, or extend, and design the target architecture that lets agents work safely across our business systems. You have a proven track record of making sound technology investment decisions, designing integrated enterprise platforms, and guiding solutions from concept through production at scale. This is a Hybrid role. You will report to the Director of Agentic AI. **Your Responsibilities** * Serve as the architecture lead across a portfolio of agentic AI use cases, owning the technical specification, solution architecture, and delivery approach for each. * Lead buy vs. build vs. extend decisions for AI capabilities, evaluating vendor platforms, embedded AI features in existing enterprise applications (e.g., ERP, CRM, ITSM, productivity suites), and custom\-built solutions against total cost of ownership, time to value, differentiation, risk, and long\-term supportability. * Develop and maintain the enterprise Agentic AI / Orchestration reference architecture for agentic AI, including agent platforms, orchestration, tool and data access, identity, observability, and guardrails. * Define decision frameworks, architecture patterns, and reusable standards that help product teams choose the right approach consistently and reduce duplicated spend across functions. * Partner with AI Strategy, Product, Cybersecurity, Data \& Analytics, Procurement, and business stakeholders to rationalize the AI application portfolio and identify consolidation opportunities. * Lead technical vendor evaluations, proofs of concept, and architecture reviews; translate findings into clear recommendations for senior leadership. * Provide perspective on resource needs, cost models, and delivery risk, and advise stakeholders on sequencing and investment priorities. * Champion responsible AI by embedding governance, security, privacy, and compliance requirements into every architecture decision. **Key Technical Skill Expectations** **Enterprise Architecture \& Buy vs. Build Strategy:** Apply structured methods (e.g., TOGAF, capability mapping, TCO and ROI analysis) to assess build, buy, partner, or reuse options, and document architecture decisions with clear trade\-offs. **Agentic AI Systems Design:** Architect AI agents that use tools and skills, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients and servers, and design multi\-agent orchestration using frameworks such as LangGraph, or Agent\-to\-Agent (A2A) protocols. **Platform \& Vendor Landscape:** Maintain a working knowledge of the agentic AI market, including hyperscaler agent platforms (Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, Google Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock, Databricks Agentbricks), SaaS\-embedded agents, and open\-source frameworks, and understand where each fits. **Enterprise Integration:** Design how agents securely access enterprise systems and data, including ERP, CRM, PLM, and ITSM platforms, through APIs, event\-driven integration, and retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines backed by vector and NoSQL stores. **System Architecture \& Security:** Design secure architectures for AI products that comply with enterprise data governance and security policies, including identity and access for agents, PII filtering, guardrails, and human\-in\-the\-loop controls. **Operations, Observability \& Cost:** Define standards for AI deployment, evaluation, monitoring, and cost management (LLMOps/FinOps), leveraging containerization, infrastructure\-as\-code (e.g., Terraform), and CI/CD on cloud platforms. **The Essentials \- You Will Have** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. * Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. **The Preferred \- You Might Also Have** * Typically requires a minimum of 10 years of relevant professional experience, including 3\+ years in an enterprise or solution architecture role. * Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Analytics, or a similar discipline. * Demonstrated experience leading buy vs. build decisions and vendor selections for enterprise technology, including business cases and TCO analysis. * Hands\-on experience designing and deploying Generative AI solutions, RAG pipelines, and multi\-agent systems in production, regardless of the underlying cloud vendor. * 5\+ years of experience with major cloud platforms, such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Experience integrating with enterprise applications such as ERP (e.g., IFS Cloud, SAP), CRM (e.g., Salesforce, Dynamics 365\), or ITSM (e.g., ServiceNow). * Proficiency in Python and familiarity with modern API, integration, and event\-driven architecture patterns. * Enterprise architecture certification (e.g., TOGAF) or cloud architect certification (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect Expert, AWS Solutions Architect Professional). * Familiarity with AI governance and risk frameworks such as the NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001\. * Experience working and coordinating with a geographically diverse team across multiple time zones. * Familiarity with Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies. **What We Offer** * Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision * 401k * Paid Time off * Parental and Caregiver Leave * Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life * To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com * We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation. *At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.* \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-LifeAtRok \#LI\-SB1 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at \+1 (844\) 404\-7247\. Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

jobs.title: Semantic AI Engineer
jobs.description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description **Job Description** Rockwell Automation is looking for an experienced Semantic AI Engineer to build the knowledge foundation that our enterprise AI agents depend on. This role sits within our AI Engineering organization and focuses on how agents remember, reason over, and share what the company knows. You will design and build a corporate knowledge graph that agents both draw from and contribute to, along with the agentic memory systems that let agents keep context across tasks, users, and time. You have a proven track record of modeling complex business domains, building production knowledge graphs or semantic layers, and connecting them to LLM\-based applications. This is a Hybrid role. You will report to the Director of Agentic AI. **Your Responsibilities** * Design, build, and evolve a knowledge graph that represents Rockwell's people, products, customers, processes, systems, and data, and serves as shared context for AI agents across functions. * Design write\-back patterns that let agents contribute new facts, relationships, and learnings to the knowledge graph safely, with provenance, confidence, validation, and human review where needed. * Architect agentic memory for our agent platform, including short\-term (working) memory, long\-term episodic and semantic memory, and shared organizational memory, with clear policies for retention, summarization, and forgetting. * Develop ontologies, taxonomies, and semantic models with business and data owners, and keep business definitions consistent across analytics, BI, and AI tools. * Build ingestion and extraction pipelines that turn structured and unstructured enterprise content (documents, tickets, ERP and CRM records, engineering data) into graph entities and relationships using LLM\-assisted entity and relation extraction. * Implement GraphRAG and hybrid retrieval (graph traversal combined with vector and keyword search) to ground agent responses and reduce hallucinations. * Expose the knowledge graph and memory services to agents through standard interfaces such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and APIs. * Establish governance for the knowledge graph, including access control, data lineage, quality checks, freshness, and alignment with enterprise data governance and security policies. * Partner with stakeholders across the enterprise to prioritize knowledge domains and measure the impact on agent accuracy and usefulness. **Key Technical Skill Expectations** **Knowledge Graphs \& Semantic Modeling:** Design ontologies and graph schemas using property graph (e.g., Neo4j, Amazon Neptune, Azure Cosmos DB for Apache Gremlin) and/or RDF/OWL approaches, with query languages such as Cypher, Gremlin, or SPARQL. Apply entity resolution, schema alignment, and graph data quality techniques. **Agentic Memory:** Architect memory layers for AI agents, including working memory, episodic and semantic long\-term memory, memory consolidation and retrieval, and shared memory across multi\-agent systems, using frameworks such as LangGraph, Mem0, Zep/Graphiti, Hindsight, LLMWiki etc. **Corporate Knowledge Graph for Agents:** Build a living, agent\-writable knowledge graph with provenance, trust levels, versioning, and conflict resolution so that knowledge produced by agents can be reviewed, trusted, and reused across the enterprise. **GraphRAG \& Retrieval:** Implement retrieval pipelines that combine knowledge graph traversal with vector search (e.g., Azure AI Search, pgvector, Redis) and embeddings to deliver accurate, explainable context to LLMs. **Semantic Layer \& Open Standards:** Understand semantic layers and metric definitions, and how open standards keep business meaning consistent as it moves between AI agents, BI platforms, and data tools. **Agent Integration \& Security:** Expose knowledge and memory services through MCP servers and APIs, with fine\-grained access control, PII handling, and audit logging that comply with enterprise governance and security policies. **The Essentials \- You Will Have** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Science, or a related field. * Legal authorization to work in the U.S. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. **The Preferred \- You Might Also Have** * Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of relevant professional experience, including 3\+ years building knowledge graphs, semantic layers, or search and retrieval systems. * Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Knowledge Engineering, or a similar discipline. * Hands\-on experience building and operating a production knowledge graph in an enterprise setting. * Experience designing memory for LLM agents and multi\-agent systems in production. * Familiarity with Apache Ossie (incubating, formerly Open Semantic Interchange), the vendor\-neutral standard for performant interfaces, using shared, reusable components. * Write front\-end unit and integration tests, and partner with QA on end\-to\-end coverage. **Backend** * Design, build and maintain the services and APIs behind those interfaces (REST and GraphQL), including the customer\-facing API work for match, enrichment, authentication and entitlements. * Integrate machine learning and LLM capabilities into Atlas by calling frontier models through their APIs, including prompt design, evaluation, cost and latency management, and safe handling of customer data. * Design and maintain epic sizing steps. * Harden failure handling across services: retries, dead\-lettering, idempotent processing, and detection of stuck or partially processed batches. **Application support** * Act as the technical escalation point for the Atlas applications: triage, diagnose and fix production issues across the UI, API and data layers, working with Support, QA and DevOps. * Take part in the on\-call and incident rotation for Atlas applications, and lead root\-cause analysis and post\-incident follow\-up for the issues you handle. * Reduce repeat incidents by fixing underlying causes, adding monitoring and alerting, and improving release quality. * Write and maintain runbooks, architecture notes and support documentation so application knowledge does not sit with one person. **Team and delivery** * Work within our Agile SDLC: sprint planning, estimation, code review in GitHub, and release through GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines. * Use LLM\-led development practices day to day, model APIs. * Experience building and deploying on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). * Experience with GitHub and GitHub Actions, automated testing, CI/CD and code review. * Hands\-on application support experience: debugging live issues, reading logs and metrics, tracing and metrics collection and handling incidents calmly and methodically. * Clear written and verbal communication with engineers, QA, support and non\-technical stakeholders. * Comfort with ambiguity: able to work in a greenfield, fast\-changing product without over\-engineering process. **Preferred qualifications** * Experience with BigQuery. * Experience with Grafana for dashboards and alerting, and with other observability tools. * Experience with backend\-for\-frontend patterns and API gateway design. * Familiarity with jobs.title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** Sage is a global leader in accounting and business management software, trusted by millions of businesses worldwide. We're investing heavily in AI. Our AI Infrastructure team is building the platform that lets AI agents take engineering intent and carry it through the software development lifecycle end to end: planning, coding, testing, review and merge, with controls that let each team increase agent autonomy as trust builds. The team designs and runs everything that makes that work: orchestration, isolated development environments, agent identity and access, model access and routing, context and memory, evaluation, and the feedback loops that make agents better over time. It's an unusual mix of distributed systems, systems engineering and applied AI, much of it not yet done at enterprise scale, and you'll be building it from the early stages with engineering teams across Sage as your first users. \*\*\* Please note that this role is hybrid and requires working 3 days a week from our San Jose office. \*\*\* **Key Responsibilities** - Build and ship well\-scoped features in platform components such as workflows, sandboxes, gateways, evaluation tooling or developer SDKs. - Write design notes for your work and take part in design reviews. - Write clean, tested code, with the logging, metrics and traces needed to support it in production. - Build integrations with Jira, GitHub, CI/CD and Slack, and help teams onboard their repositories. - Investigate agent failures and production issues, and fix the root cause. - Take part in code reviews, on\-call and incident reviews. - Keep up with fast\-moving AI tooling and share what you learn with the team. What You'll Own - Implementation and testing of your assigned work, raising risks and questions early, and keeping your code production\-ready. What We're Looking For - Software engineering experience, ideally with hands\-on experience using LLM\-powered tools or agents. - Solid programming skills in one or more of Python, TypeScript, Go, Java or Rust. - A good grasp of system and API design, data modelling and testing. - Experience building and deploying services in the cloud with containers; exposure to Kubernetes and infrastructure as code. - Understanding of async processing, queues and handling failures in distributed systems. - Hands\-on experience building with LLM APIs: tool use, prompts, RAG or simple agents. Side projects count. - Usage of AI coding tools day to day. In this location, the base salary range is $120,000 to $150,000, depending on experience. \#LI\-AS1

KPIs and evaluate whether deployed models are producing the intended outcomes. * Translate analytical findings and model outputs into actionable recommendations for technical, product, engineering, patterns, and business requirements. * Optimize ML workloads for performance, scalability, reliability, and cloud cost. **Automotive, Manufacturing \& Engineering Analytics** * Apply data science to automotive and manufacturing problems involving vehicle, quality, plant, engineering, sales and planning, and connected\-data domains. * Develop predictive and analytical approaches for areas such as quality intelligence, anomaly detection, vehicle health, manufacturing performance, demand/v dation * Model explainability * Experiment design * Model performance monitoring * Experience building solutions using large, complex, heterogeneous datasets. * Experience taking ML solutions from prototype/POC through production deployment and operational support. * Strong analytical problem\-solving jobs.title: AI Engineer (Agent OS Platform)
jobs.description: **Ready to be a Titan?** ServiceTitan runs the businesses behind the trades: jobs, trucks, technicians, equipment, contracts, payments, warranties, compliance obligations, and customer history. Agent OS is the shared runtime, context, memory, action, trust, and evaluation layer behind role\-specific AI experiences across Atlas, office, field, voice, mobile, and future product surfaces. This is not a collection of chatbots. It is the platform that lets agents help contractors run their businesses with the right evidence, permissions, approvals, and audit trails. You will help build the core engineering primitives behind that platform: agent runtime, typed tools, context and memory assembly, trust and approval flows, evaluation infrastructure, and production observability. You are not building one agent for one product surface. You are building the platform that product teams use to build many agents safely. You will work on a small, senior AI platform team and partner closely with Product, Architecture, Security, Data Platform, Atlas, and domain engineering teams. **What You’ll Build** * Agent runtime and workflow execution: Build the runtime for role\-specific agents, tool use, delegation, pause/resume, durable checkpoints, retries, and failure recovery. Agents must resume safely without losing state or duplicating side effects. * Typed tools and action contracts: Build deterministic controls around non\-deterministic reasoning: governed reads, proposed writes, precondition checks, business invariants, scoped permissions, idempotency, audit trails, and rollback. * Context and memory systems: Build tenant\-scoped context assembly, retrieval, freshness controls, provenance, transcripts, artifacts, tool results, and replayable evidence. ServiceTitan systems of record stay authoritative; memory provides context and coordination. * Trust and approval infrastructure: Build human\-in\-the\-loop gates, approval thresholds, reversibility, tenant policy enforcement, and audit history for financial, contractual, dispatch, warranty, and compliance\-sensitive workflows. * Evaluation and observability: Build offline and online evals, scenario libraries, simulation, trajectory review, regression detection, cost and latency telemetry, and autonomy promotion gates. * Reusable capability platform: Help product teams package prompts, tools, context requirements, policies, evals, rollout controls, ownership, and rollback into governed capabilities for owners, CSRs, dispatchers, technicians, managers, and back\-office teams. * Model and inference architecture: Make practical tradeoffs across latency, cost, quality, structured outputs, caching, fallback behavior, provider choice, and model routing behind a shared platform layer. **What You’ll Do** * Design and implement core Agent OS platform services. * Write production code and review implementation details from other engineers. * Build reliable APIs, workflows, tools, and services for agent execution. * Inspect traces, debug failures, and improve production behavior. * Design evaluation scenarios and regression suites for agent workflows. * Work through real agent failure modes: stale context, wrong tool calls, missing permissions, unsafe actions, poor retrieval, latency spikes, and cost regressions. * Partner with domain teams to turn agent use cases into reusable platform patterns. * Help define platform contracts for tools, actions, approvals, context, memory, evidence, and evaluation. * Contribute to technical direction while staying grounded in what can ship quickly and safely. * Communicate clearly with engineers, product managers, architects, security partners, and engineering leadership. **What You’ll Bring** * 7\+ years of production software engineering experience. * B.S., M.S., or PhD in Computer Science, Physics, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). * Strong hands\-on coding ability in Python, Java, C\#, or another backend language. Python experience is strongly preferred. * Experience building AI, ML, data, platform, infrastructure, workflow, automation, or developer\-platform systems in production. * Practical understanding of modern LLM application architecture: model gateways, prompt and context assembly, retrieval, tool calling, structured outputs, memory, agent workflows, and human approval patterns. * Experience with distributed systems, event\-driven systems, async workflows, queues, durable execution, or message\-driven architectures. * Strong production\-safety instincts for non\-deterministic systems: typed contracts, scoped permissions, precondition checks, idempotency, audit trails, rollback, and monitoring. * Experience designing or operating evaluation systems: behavioral evals, regression suites, scenario tests, trajectory review, simulation, online metrics, or production moni eement, the invoice, the warranty, and the business policy. They need to explain what evidence they used. They need to know when to ask for approval. They need to recover when something fails. The engineer in this role helps set the technical standard for every AI surface ServiceTitan builds next. This is a high\-leverage engineering role for someone who wants to build the platform underneath production agents, not just another agent demo. **Remote Location (US and Canada only)**\- Candidates based in PST highly preferred. **Be Human With Us:** Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. AI tools are not used to make hiring decisions; all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. **What We Offer:** When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career: * **Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work**: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. jobs.title: Revenue Operations (RevOps) AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- Singlewire Software, based in Madison, Wisconsin, is dedicated to shaping a future where every organization can protect its people with confidence. We deliver innovative solutions, including InformaCast critical communication and incident management software, the InformaCast Wearable Alert Badge, and Visitor Aware visitor and safety management software. Our technology helps organizations instantly reach the right people, coordinate responses, and manage critical events — empowering schools, healthcare systems, manufacturers, enterprises, and public organizations to create safer environments. Just as important as what we build is how we work. We’re a collaborative, supportive team that cares deeply about our mission, our customers, and each other. **The Opportunity** ------------------- Our business and our solutions are growing. We are creating a position to support Revenue Operations (RevOps), which supports Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance. You will help leadership shape critical go\-to\-market insights and actions through various technologies and data analytics. We are looking for this role to build out the workflows, data integrations, and intelligence layers that turn our operational data into high\-leverage business decisions. Your focus will be acting as a pragmatic engineer and system builder: connecting cross\-platform data pipelines, designing autonomous or human\-in\-the\-loop AI agents, building automated GTM workflows, and helping drive enterprise AI governance. Are you motivated, have a growth mindset, and want to build the revenue engine from scratch rather than inherit someone else's legacy system? Then you might be just the person we’re looking for to join our dynamic, growing company consistently rated as one of the best places to work in Madison. **What You’ll Do** Your responsibilities may include: * Architect the GTM Data Foundation: Partner with IT to evaluate and improve our centralized GTM data warehouse layer and ingestion pipelines, building reliable cross\-system extraction from Salesforce, Gong, Outreach, Orum, 6sense, ZoomInfo, etc. * Collaborate on Data Definitions \& Quality: Partner with RevOps, Sales, Marketing, and Finance leadership to refine and align on existing funnel definitions (MQL, SQL, pipeline stages) and data models; implement identity resolution across platforms and build automated checks to catch and resolve discrepancies before they reach reporting. * Build AI Workflows and Agents: Prototype, test, and ship end\-to\-end automations — from deterministic API workflows to autonomous multi\-step agents — to deliver real\-time GTM intelligence, including automated deal\-risk alerts, cross\-system pipeline summaries, meeting prep briefs, account intent signals, and hygiene nudges. * Business Process Improvement: Understand current business processes, develop tools to support or redefine processes to optimize workflows and go to market effectiveness driving business goals including Revenue growth. * Lead Build vs. Buy Strategy: Audit native AI capabilities embedded within our existing SaaS licenses (Gong, Outreach, 6sense, ZoomInfo, Salesforce) and make clear recommendations on whether to extend native tools or build custom AI agents based on business impact and cost considerations. * Adhere to and Operationalize AI Governance \& Security: Partner directly with IT and Security to operationalize enterprise AI policies and data\-security standards. Implement technical guardrails—including access control tiers, sandbox environments, audit logging, and data\-scrubbing workflows for regulated customer data (education, healthcare, government)—while actively providing feedback to security leadership regarding security policy and controls. * Integrate with Modern Protocols: Integrate LLMs directly with business data via direct REST APIs, SDKs, or Model Context Protocol (MCP) connections, building effective execution harnesses and guardrails. * Collaborate with Admins \& Stakeholders: Work day\-to\-day with the Director of RevOps and Salesforce Administrator, translating business bottlenecks into automated technical solutions without getting bogged down in routine CRM ticket administration. * Measure Impact: Track every automation and agent by tangible operational leverage: hours saved, data latency reduction, and pipeline conversion impact. * Partner with key stakeholders to ensure adoption of automations through user training, tuning and support. **The Person We’re Looking For** -------------------------------- **Required Qualifications:** * A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical work experience. * 4\+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or technical RevOps/GTM engineering, including hands\-on pipeline building. * Experience standing up or working with cloud data warehouses and implementing automated pipelines to ingest, clean, and model SaaS data into analytics\-ready tables. * Strong SQL proficiency and hands\-on programming skills (e.g., Python or TypeScript) with practical experience writing scripts and connecting to third\-party REST APIs. * Hands\-on experience developing or connecting AI ingestion models to business systems. * Hands\-on experience building production applications with LLMs, including API integrations, agentic workflows, prompt design, tool/function calling, retrieval, and output validation. * A pragmatic builder mindset with a bias toward shipping, rapid iteration, and business outcomes over theoretical perfection — knowing how to establish testing guardrails, sandbox harnesses, and access controls while moving fast. * Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the proven ability to translate complex technical architectures into plain business terms for senior leaders. **Other Skills That Will Make You Stand Out:** * Working knowledge of Salesforce data structures (standard/custom objects, Opportunity history, lead lifecycles, and security models) and experience collaborating effectively with Salesforce Admins. * Prior integration experience with our specific stack: Gong, Outreach, Orum, 6sense, ZoomInfo, Qualified, or Tableau. * Experience closing the loop by syncing data, signals, and model outputs back into frontline operational systems (CRM, engagement platforms) so teams can take immediate action * Experience implementing technical security controls, data\-masking routines, and audit logging for applications handling sensitive customer data in regulated sectors (such as education, healthcare, or government). * Experience operating as a founding technical contributor in a high\-growth SaaS business. **More About this Role** ------------------------ Our current application stack includes: * Salesforce (Sales Cloud, CPQ, Account Engagement, Experience Cloud) * Tableau Next \& Cloud Data Infrastructure (BigQuery / Warehouse layer) * 6sense, ZoomInfo, Qualified, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, BriteVerify * Gong, Outreach, Orum * Jira (to track work) * Enterprise LLM platforms, custom Python/API connectors, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations **Our Culture** --------------- At Singlewire, we believe what we do truly matters. We’re passionate about protecting people and helping organizations respond when it counts. We’re a team of collaborators who support each other, work hard toward shared goals, and celebrate successes together. Singlewire Software LLC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, status as a protected veteran, among other things, or status as a qualified individual with disability. XJ6

jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Skiffra** ================= Skiffra is building the intelligence layer for operational decision\-making in physical industries. We're developing AI\-native orchestration systems that turn complex, high\-stakes operations into intelligent, adaptive workflows. We're starting with mining and natural resources, where decisions move people, equipment and capital, and where the consequences of getting them wrong are real. Our ambition extends well beyond mining. We're building a platform designed to change how physical industries make decisions. As a Founding AI Engineer, you will be the architect of our core intelligence. This is a role for a high\-leverage builder who can move fluidly between prompt engineering, backend systems, and model optimization. You will design the "brain" of Skiffra, moving agentic workflows from whiteboards to production\-grade systems that handle real enterprise data at scale. This is a founding\-level role for builders who value shipping over dogma and real\-world impact over demos. This is a full\-time role in our Los Angeles office. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Architect \& Build Agentic Systems: Design, prototype, and harden production\-grade orchestration frameworks that leverage LLMs, persistent memory, and tool\-integration to navigate complex, non\-linear enterprise tasks * Build the Data Flywheel: Implement sophisticated RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) pipelines, ensuring high\-fidelity context retrieval from fragmented data sources * Evaluate \& Iterate: Build internal benchmarking and evaluation suites to measure and improve model reliability, grounding, and latency * Strategic Modeling: Architect high\-performance intelligence stacks by making pragmatic trade\-offs between Frontier Reasoning Models for long\-horizon agentic planning, Fine\-tuned Open\-Weight Models for data sovereignty and low\-latency inference, and Deterministic Heuristics for reliable, cost\-efficient guardrails * Cross\-Collaboration: Partner with product and engineering to turn ambiguity into working software **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * Systems Engineering: 7\+ years of experience and a deep background in building production software. You understand that "AI" is only as good as the infrastructure surrounding it * Modern AI Fluency: Deep practical experience with the transformer\-based stack: embeddings, vector databases, tool\-calling, and context window management * Production LLM Experience: 2\+ years shipping LLM\-based products to real users in production * Python Power\-User: You are comfortable building entire systems, not just experimenting in notebooks * Reliability Mindset: You have strong instincts for failure modes (hallucinations, API timeouts, "infinite loops" in agents) and how to build guardrails against them * Security Mindset: You treat access to enterprise data as part of the design, not an afterthought * Clear communicator with founder\-level ownership mindset **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience in building complex, multi\-step workflows using frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex or PydanticAI * Hands\-on experience with Fine\-tuning and PEFT (LoRA/QLoRA) to adapt open\-weight models for domain\-specific tasks * Experience with human\-in\-the\-loop workflows and enterprise identity (SSO, role\-based access) * A background in Enterprise Operations (Industrial, Logistics, Fintech, or CRM workflows). * Strong opinions on where AI creates value and where it's just expensive noise ### **How We Work** We value speed, clarity, and technical rigor. We favor simple systems over clever ones, prototypes over over\-planning, and ownership over handoffs. You’ll work directly with founders and ship things that matter quickly. ### **Location \& Work Model** This is a hybrid role requiring regular in\-person collaboration at the designated office location, as specified in the job posting (Los Angeles, San Francisco, Montreal, or Brisbane). We are not a fully remote company. ### **Work Authorization** Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where this role is based. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. ### **Benefits \& Eligibility** This position is eligible for Skiffra’s standard benefits, including health insurance and retirement plans, and may also qualify for participation in the Company’s bonus and incentive programs. ### **Equal Opportunity** Skiffra is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Compensation Range: $220K \- $250K

jobs.description: Smart Commercial Construction (SCC) and Jarrod Smart Construction (JSC) are building an AI capability that starts with their own information and repeatable work. The business decides what to automate and what success looks like. This role turns those requirements into working technology. You will connect our systems and data, build and maintain AI agents and the MCP connections they depend on, and make sure the result is secure and usable. You will work for both companies, so you need to be comfortable serving two teams with different platforms and a shared Microsoft 365 environment. jobs.title: Staff Backend Graph Engineer
jobs.description: **Why Socure?** --------------- Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day. We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading. **About the Job** ----------------- Build the graph that decides who’s real. Every day, Socure’s Identity Graph helps businesses decide whether to trust the person on the other side of a screen. It links billions of signals (names, addresses, devices, emails, phones) into one picture of identity, and it does this in milliseconds. Fraudsters move fast. The graph has to be faster. As a Staff Engineer on this team, you’ll set the technical direction for the platform behind that decision. You’ll own hard problems end to end, work across Engineering, Data Science, Product, and Security, and see your work shape the products that protect millions of people. **What You Will Do** -------------------- * Shape the graph. Define the schemas, relationships, and ontology that make identity data consistent and extensible. * Own entity resolution at scale. Decide how records, people, devices, and addresses connect, and how confident we are, across data that is messy, sparse, and sometimes adversarial. * Build for speed and volume. Design batch and real\-time pipelines, low\-latency APIs, and serving systems that hold up under heavy load. * Power fraud intelligence. Ship the production systems behind our ML features, model inference, and graph analytics. * Move the numbers. Improve performance, reliability, and cost, and prove it with measurements. * Set the direction. Lead architecture decisions, document the tradeoffs, and carry initiatives from first design through production rollout. * Raise the bar. Mentor engineers and set the standard for design reviews, testing, CI/CD, and operations. * Protect identity data. Build privacy, security, and PII protection into every system from day one. * Your toolkit:Java, Scala, or Python. Spark, Kafka, Flink, Airflow, and AWS, including EMR. Graph technologies like Neo4j and Amazon Neptune. **What You Will Bring** ----------------------- * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or related field * 7\+ years building and running distributed systems in the cloud, with at least 2 at Staff or Senior Staff scope, or the equivalent * Production scale you can quantify. You can tell us what you built, how big it was, and how much you improved latency, reliability, or cost * Deep Spark, Kafka, or Flink experience in both batch and streaming, including debugging them in production * Low\-latency serving. You have built and tuned APIs where milliseconds matter * Graph or entity\-resolution experience. You have modeled connected data, matched records across noisy sources, or built an identity graph. Fraud or identity verification is a strong plus * Cloud and operations fluency. AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and real production observability * ML data pipelines on Databricks, SageMaker, or similar, plus orchestration with Airflow or equivalent * Technical leadership. You have led ambiguous, cross\-team work, mentored engineers, and changed the direction of a system through design docs and influence, not authority **What This Job is Not** ------------------------ * It’s not a role for someone who hasn’t owned a system end to end in production, including being on call for it. * It’s not feature work on platforms someone else designed. * It’s not a defined backlog. You’ll frame ambiguous problems yourself. * It’s not a place to treat data privacy as a compliance checkbox. *Socure is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in all its forms within our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.* *If you need an accommodation during any stage of the application or hiring process—including interview or onboarding support—please reach out to your Socure recruiting partner directly.* **Follow Us!** YouTube \| LinkedIn \| X (Twitter) \| Facebook Compensation Range: $225K \- $250K

jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. that enhance operational efficiency, provide critical insights, and meet the unique challenges of protecting users, advertisers, and the platform at global scale. #### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design, build, develop, and deploy mission\-critical tooling for content moderation and enforcement, abuse and risk detection, brand safety controls, legal request processing and compliance, reviewer workflows, and ops case management. * Monitor and optimize applications for security compliance. * Build and maintain scalable back\-end systems using languages like Java and Scala. * Integrate with and maintain secure, reliable databases (e.g., PostgreSQL or MySQL). * Collaborate with trust and safety, brand safety, legal, and operations stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable technical solutions. * Develop APIs and middleware to connect systems and facilitate seamless data exchange, including data pipelines and insights that support safety operations. * Ensure high performance, reliability, and scalability in all applications. * Write clean, maintainable, and well\-documented code. #### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or software engineering. #### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and one or more front\-end frameworks (React, Angular, or Vue.js). * Strong experience with back\-end frameworks. * Expertise in designing and working with RESTful APIs and/or GraphQL. * Hands\-on experience with SQL databases. * Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization tools like Docker or Kubernetes. * Strong problem\-solving skills and a commitment to delivering quality solutions. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. * A security\-first mindset, with a commitment to protecting the privacy of our users' data. * A demonstrated ability to succeed in fast\-paced, dynamic environments. #### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:** $140,000 \- $225,000 USD Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short \& long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: East Coast Time Zone Remote - Agentic AI platform Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview Spectrix Analytical Services is seeking an Agentic Platform Engineer. This role focuses on building and operating the AWS platform that hosts AI agents, MCP servers, and agent tooling for discovery research groups. This is a full\-time (40 hours/week) remote position open to candidates in the United States. Working hours within one to two hours of US Eastern time are preferred; West Coast candidates who can overlap with Eastern business hours will also be considered. The contractor will own the runtime, access control, and deployment path that agents run on. Agents and MCP servers built by the team call internal APIs, Snowflake, and scientific applications on behalf of individual scientists, so the platform has to authenticate users through Entra ID, scope what each agent can reach, keep credentials out of agent code, and record what each agent did. In addition to the platform, the contractor will build MCP servers, agent skills, and other integrations as needed, and we expect the work to move between platform and integration as priorities shift. Areas of work: * **Agent runtime.** Stand up and operate the runtime that hosts agents and MCP servers, using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore or a comparable agent runtime, together with serverless (Lambda) and container (ECS or EKS) workloads. Define how a new agent or MCP server is packaged, deployed, versioned, and retired. * **Infrastructure as code.** Write and maintain the Terraform modules for the runtime, networking, gateways, and supporting services, so that a new environment, AWS account, or region is created from configuration. * **Gateway and access control.** Run the API gateway layer in front of agents and tools. Integrate Entra ID for user authentication, map Entra groups to the agents and tools each user can call, and implement token exchange so an agent calls downstream services with the requesting user’s permissions. * **Identity and secrets.** Design IAM roles and workload identity for agents and MCP servers, manage credentials for Snowflake and internal APIs through AWS Secrets Manager or equivalent, and automate rotation. * **CI/CD and observability.** Build the pipelines that test and deploy agents, MCP servers, and platform components. Instrument agent and tool calls with tracing, logs, and metrics so that latency, error rate, model usage, and cost can be reported per agent and per user group. * **MCP servers and integrations.** Build MCP servers and agent skills that connect agents to Snowflake, internal APIs, and scientific applications. Provide templates, a local development path, and documentation so that other teams can ship their own MCP servers and skills onto the platform without platform changes for each one. Key Responsibilities: * Develop and maintain production Python services, MCP servers, platform tooling, and CLI utilities. * Write and review Terraform for all platform infrastructure as part of daily workflow. * Deploy and operate agent, serverless, and container workloads across AWS accounts and environments. * Maintain the access\-control model for agents and tools and review new integrations for how they handle identity, secrets, and data scope. * Work directly with scientists, application developers, and IT security to decide what to build, and support adoption through documentation and hands\-on help. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree with 7–10 years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 5 or more years of relevant experience. * Experience having built and run a shared internal platform used by other engineering teams, including its deployment path, support, and upgrades. * Strong AWS experience with both serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions or similar) and container (ECS or EKS) workloads. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore or a comparable agent runtime is strongly preferred. * Strong Terraform experience, including module design and multi\-account deployments. * Experience with API gateways and access control using Entra ID (Azure AD), including OAuth 2\.0 and OIDC flows. * Experience with cloud identity and secrets management: IAM, workload identity, Secrets Manager or Vault, and credential rotation. * Experience building CI/CD pipelines and observability for production services (tracing, structured logging, metrics, alerting). * Strong Python development skills with experience building production\-grade services or tooling. * Experience building LLM agents in production, including tool use, prompt and context design, and evaluation of agent behavior. * Experience building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or comparable tool integrations that let LLM agents call internal APIs and data sources. * Experience on a small team (roughly 3–10 engineers) where individuals own systems end to end, set their own priorities within a goal, and ship without a dedicated QA, SRE, or release function. * Routine use of agentic coding harnesses (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, or equivalent) as part of day\-to\-day development, with a view on where they help and where they do not. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock is a plus. * Experience with Snowflake or SQL\-based data access from services is a plus. * Experience in a life sciences, chemistry, or drug discovery environment is a plus. * Effective communicator who can work independently in a remote environment and collaborate with engineers, scientists, and IT security. Primary Location: United States (Remote — working hours within one to two hours of US Eastern preferred; West Coast considered) collaborate with both engineers and scientists. *Spectrix offers flexible schedules, competitive salaries, and a committed work environment to its employees; the company provides automatic benefits of life insurance and short and long term disability insurance. Optional benefits for full time employees include health, dental, and vision insurance, college loan assistance, and an employer matched retirement savings plan. Spectrix is not a placement agency.* *Spectrix is participating in the E\-Verify program of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (phone number: 888\-897\-7781, and website: www.dhs.gov/E\-Verify).* Pay: $48\.00 \- $58\.00 per hour Application Question(s): * Are you authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship now or anytime in the future? * Have you built a shared platform that was utilized by multiple engineering teams that you were responsible for from end to end? * Do you have direct Agentic AI experience developing and managing a large number of users in a cloud\-based environment? * Do you have several years of Python development experience building production\-grade servides or tooling? * Do you have several years of hands\-on experience working with AWS with both serverless and container workloads? * Do you have relevant recent experience with Amazon Bedrock Agent core? * Do you have experience with API gateways and access control Entra ID (AzureAD), Oauth 2\.0, and OIDCflows? Experience: * Python programming: 7 years (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

Occasional travel will be required for team on\-sites. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Design and build scalable, high\-quality software across complex, ambiguous problem areas in existing or new initiatives. * Lead group technical design sessions for large projects; routinely provide high\-value feedback in design forums and architectural reviews. * Use AI to reason about system\-level tradeoffs (scalability, performance, reliability) and integrate AI into team workflows—e.g., PR templates, debugging playbooks, and documentation—while ensuring all AI\-assisted work meets rigorous quality standards. * Evaluate new AI tools and techniques; share learnings with the team and help establish standards for AI\-assisted engineering. * Decompose significantly complex engineering problems into straightforward, well\-scoped solutions. * Coordinate cross\-group efforts, keeping everyone informed of appropriate context and progress. * Routinely provide perspective to identify and mitigate risks for others’ projects, not just your own. * Drive and complete projects end\-to\-end—sometimes more than one at a time—from conception through deployment and iteration. * Model engineering excellence: your code reviews are instructive, your designs are exemplary, and you proactively simplify and improve the code corpus. * Mentor engineers in both technical areas and career growth; motivate action by clearly explaining context, rationale, and roles. * Lead hypercare investigations and high\-stakes bug responses; communicate progress quickly and clearly to stakeholders. * Evaluate and integrate third\-party vendors into our systems safely and performantly. **What success looks like in this role** ---------------------------------------- * **Technical Excellence –** Your architecture solutions are exemplary in terms of efficiency, stability, extensibility, and ability to evolve. Your software is robust in the presence of failures, scalable, and cost\-effective. * **AI\-Augmented Engineering –** You actively integrate AI into your workflow and your team’s—evaluating tools, establishing quality standards, and helping teammates use AI effectively and responsibly. * **Cross\-Team Impact –** You solve complicated problems across service domains, coordinate with other teams as needed, and routinely reduce complexity for the engineers around you. * **Project Leadership –** You drive and complete large, complex projects end\-to\-end with high stakeholder satisfaction—sometimes leading more than one initiative at a time. * **Engineering Excellence –** Your code reviews make the overall codebase better. You proactively simplify, refactor, and improve—accounting for the full project lifecycle including continuous improvement. * **Mentorship \& Org Health –** You make your superpod more effective through significant contributions to individuals’ growth and engineering efficiency. Junior and mid\-level engineers seek you out for guidance. * **Operational Leadership –** You lead investigations calmly under pressure, with clear direction and communication to stakeholders throughout. **AI Fluency Expectations (Capable)** ------------------------------------- * Uses AI to reason about system\-level tradeoffs, improving the system to achieve greater operational scale, optimized cost and more reliable performance * Integra ure * Stays current with latest AI Safety tooling and testing expectations and ensures their work is fully compliant * Regularly performs at the "AI Capable" level or greater, per the AI Fluency Matrix **What you’ll bring** --------------------- * 6–8\+ years of professional software development experience * Expertise in Ruby on Rails and React. * Proven experience building and scaling Fullstack systems * Uses AI to reason about system\-level tradeoffs and integrates AI tools into team workflows—evaluates output critically and helps set quality standards for AI\-assisted work * Proven track record leading delivery of complex, multi\-team technical projects * Strong cross\-functional collaboration skills; able to influence and align stakeholders across teams * Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers on both technical skills and career growth * Strong problem\-solving skills with a focus on clean, scalable, maintainable architecture * Embraces writing well\-designed tests that accompany all code * Proven ability to thrive in ambiguous environments and establish strategic direction amidst uncertainty * Bonus: Previous experience working in healthcare or digital health **Note**: We have even more benefits than listed here and below, your recruiter will provide more in\-depth information as you continue in the interview process. Benefits are subject to individual plan requirements and eligibility criteria. * Health, Dental, Vision benefits start on your first day at Spring. You and your dependents also receive access to **One Medical**accounts HSA and FSA plans are also available, with Spring contributing up to $1K for HSAs, depending on your plan type. * Employer sponsored 401(k) match of up to 2% for retirement planning * A yearly allotment of no cost visits to the Spring Health network of therapists, coaches, and medication management providers for you and your dependents. * We offer competitive paid time off policies including vacation, sick leave and company holidays. * At 6 months tenure with Spring, we offer parental leave of 18 weeks for birthing parents and 16 weeks for non\-birthing parents. * Access to **Noom****,** a weight management program—based in psychology, that’s tailored to your unique needs and goals. * Access to fertility care support through **Carrot**, in addition to $4,000 reimbursement for related fertility expenses. * Access to**Wellhub**, which connects employees to the best options for fitness, mindfulness, nutrition, and sleep in one subscription * Access to **BrightHorizons**, which provides sponsored child care, back\-up care, and elder care * Up to $1,000 Professional Development Reimbursement a year. * $200 per year donation matching to support your favorite causes. **Not sure if you meet every requirement?** Research shows that women and people from historically underrepresented communities often hesitate to apply for roles unless they meet every qualification compared to other similarly\-qualified candidates. At Spring Health, we are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and supported to Thrive. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. ***Our privacy policy:*** ***https://springhealth.com/privacy\-policy/*** *Spring Health is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: IT Support Engineer Level 1 Healthcare
jobs.description: Starling Oncology (NASDAQ: STLN) is advancing oncology by delivering highly specialized, value\-based cancer care in the community setting. Formerly known as The Oncology Institute, Starling Oncology offers cutting\-edge, evidence\-based cancer care to a population of approximately 2\.1 million patients, including clinical trials, transfusions, and other care delivery models traditionally associated with the most advanced care delivery organizations. With more than 400 employed and network clinicians and over 100 clinics and network locations of care across five states and growing, Starling Oncology is changing oncology for the better. For more information, visit www.starlingoncology.com. Join an oncology practice where your technical expertise directly supports compassionate, life\-changing patient care. As an IT Coordinator, you will play a vital role in keeping critical systems secure, reliable, and efficient so clinicians and staff can focus on delivering exceptional cancer care. In return, we offer meaningful work with real impact, close collaboration with healthcare professionals, opportunities to grow your skills in a highly specialized environment, and the chance to help advance innovation in a mission\-driven organization. **JOB PURPOSE AND SUMMARY:** ---------------------------- The IT Support Engineer I provides secure, reliable support for endpoints, identity, connectivity, Microsoft 365, and business and clinical applications. The role resolves incidents, protects PHI, documents work, and supports service improvement, automation, cloud operations, and security within approved controls. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** ------------------------------------------ * Provide Level 1 and developing Level 2 technical and customer support through approved ticketing, phone, chat, remote, and onsite channels. * Research, diagnose, resolve, document, and escalate hardware, software, account, application, and connectivity issues. * Set up, secure, maintain, and retire Windows workstations, mobile devices, printers, peripherals, and conferencing equipment. * Support Microsoft 365, Microsoft Entra ID, MFA, groups, licensing, and authorized account lifecycle tasks. * Provide first\-line support for assigned business and clinical applications while following privacy, downtime, and patient\-safety procedures. * Document and track incidents, requests, assets, troubleshooting history, customer communication, and resolution details. * Create and maintain knowledge articles, user guides, SOPs, and runbooks. * Perform approved entry\-level Azure, monitoring, backup, security, remediation, reporting, scripting, automation, and data\-quality tasks. * Protect PHI, PII, credentials, and confidential information; recognize and escalate security or privacy events. * Assist with projects, implementations, migrations, clinic openings, go\-lives, planned maintenance, vendor coordination, disaster recovery, and business continuity activities. * Identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve service, controls, standardization, and automation. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** ------------------------------------- * Strong troubleshooting skills across endpoints, identity, Microsoft 365, connectivity, applications, and user workflows. * Working knowledge of Windows, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune concepts, MFA, role\-based access, networking, and secure remote support. * Ability to use logs and diagnostic tools, document findings, and distinguish symptoms from probable root causes. * Foundational knowledge of Azure, cloud operations, monitoring, backup, scripting, automation, APIs, JSON, and cybersecurity principles. * Understanding of HIPAA\-aligned PHI handling, least privilege, secure sharing, auditability, and healthcare downtime procedures. * Clear communication, sound prioritization, accountability, teamwork, and willingness to learn. **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE, EDUCATION AND/OR TRAINING:** --------------------------------------------------- * High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree in IT, cybersecurity, cloud computing, health informatics, or a related field preferred. * Two or more years of IT service desk, desktop support, or technical support experience; relevant internships, military experience, labs, or applied projects may be considered. * Experience with ticketing systems, Windows, Microsoft 365, user accounts, endpoints, peripherals, connectivity, and defined escalation and change procedures. * Ability to support scheduled onsite, implementation, maintenance, go\-live, or after\-hours activities as needed. Relevant certifications or applied experience in service management, Microsoft 365, networking, endpoint management, identity, cloud, security, automation, or healthcare IT are preferred. **PHYSICAL WORKING REQUIREMENTS:** ---------------------------------- The position involves prolonged periods of sitting at a desk, extensive computer use, and phone or virtual interaction. The role may require travel between supported locations and occasional lifting, moving, or installation of office technology equipment weighing up to 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the position.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most. Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential: Responsibilities: Join State Farm's **Enterprise Technology (ET) Claims – TPAR team** as a Software Engineer and help modernize critical claims applications and transition the Enterprise Claims System (ECS) to AWS. You'll work with a collaborative engineering team to build and enhance applications, APIs, and database solutions that support essential claims operations. **What You'll Do:** * Design, develop, and maintain applications and APIs using Java, Spring Boot, and Angular. * Support the modernization of legacy applications and migration of services and data to AWS. * Build and maintain **DevOps pipelines using GitLab**, supporting CI/CD, automated testing, and reliable deployments. * Develop and optimize SQL queries and database integrations, including DB2 and AWS database technologies. * Troubleshoot application, database, and performance issues to deliver reliable solutions. * Collaborate with engineers and business partners to design, test, and implement modernization initiatives. * Contribute to a collaborative Agile team through daily standups, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications** * **DevOps:** Hands\-on experience with GitLab, CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and Git. * **AWS \& Databases:** Experience with AWS cloud services, SQL, relational databases, and database development or integration. * **Angular:** Experience developing and maintaining web applications using Angular. * **Backend Development:** Strong Java and Spring Boot experience, including REST APIs and microservices. * Experience with automated testing, debugging, and application performance optimization. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with DB2, Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, or database modernization. * Familiarity with AWS services such as API Gateway, Lambda, S3, and Secrets Manager. * Experience with Docker, JUnit, Python, and secure API integrations. * Experience modernizing legacy enterprise applications or migrating systems to AWS. * Familiarity with claims systems or enterprise insurance applications. * Experience leveraging GitHub Copilot or other AI\-assisted development tools. **Work Locations**: Bloomington, IL\-Corporate, Dunwoody, GA\-Park Center Hub, Richardson, TX\-CityLine Hub or Tempe, AZ\-Marina Heights Hub locations. **Hybrid Work Arrangement:** A “Hybrid” position means selected candidates will be assigned to a facility and will spend some time working both in the office and from home. For Enterprise Technology, a hybrid work arrangement will require approximately 40% in\-office time each month, beginning in late 2027\. **SPONSORSHIP**: Applicants for this position are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g. H\-1B visa) for this opportunity. Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week! * Potential starting salary range: $105,000 \- $120,000 * + Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience + High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!*** **Get Paid!** On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. * **Stay Well!** Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in\-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! * **Develop and Grow!** Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top\-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. * **Plan Ahead!** Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! * **Take a Little “You” Time!** You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! * **Give Back!** We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. * **Finish Strong!** Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. **Visit our** **State Farm Careers** **page for more information on our** **benefits****,** **locations****, and the** **hiring process** **of joining the State Farm team!**

jobs.title: Salesforce Application Developer DOH9036
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- **Salesforce Application Developer** We are hiring for multiple positions. This home\-based (remote) position is open to Washington residents and those living in Oregon and Idaho only. **The Opportunity** As a Salesforce Application Developer working on Community Health and Licensing team, you will design, develop, maintain, and improve enterprise applications and databases used by the Washington State Department of Health (DOH). Working within the Executive Office of Innovation and Technology, you will develop and manage technology solutions that support professional licensing, regulatory oversight, complaint investigations, facility inspections, and other essential agency operations. You will work across the application development lifecycle, translating business needs into functional solutions, developing application features and integrations, managing databases, and resolving complex technical issues. This includes working with technologies such as Salesforce, Microsoft SQL Server, .NET, JavaScript, and Microsoft Azure. You will also collaborate with developers, business teams, vendors, and other technology professionals to ensure applications remain secure, reliable, and responsive to changing business needs. The applications and databases you develop and maintain are used by DOH programs, healthcare providers, local health jurisdictions, and state and federal partners. Your work helps ensure the technology behind essential agency services remains dependable, secure, and accessible. **Key Responsibilities Include:** * Design, develop, test, implement, and maintain web applications and software solutions that meet agency and program needs. * Develop application features, Salesforce solutions, and integrations that connect systems and enable information sharing across platforms. * Design, manage, and maintain relational databases, data integrations, and automated processes to ensure information is accurate, accessible, and reliable. * Develop and maintain data queries, reporting tools, dashboards, and data extracts that help program teams access and use information. * Research, analyze, and resolve complex application, database, and system issues, including identifying root causes and implementing effective solutions. * Plan and coordinate technical implementation activities, manage project tasks and timelines, and communicate progress, risks, and technical considerations. * Conduct code reviews, system testing, and quality assurance to ensure applications meet functional, security, coding, and accessibility standards. * Maintain technical documentation and contribute to development standards, practices, and continuous improvements across supported applications. **Why You'll Love This Role** You'll work on technology that plays an important role in the Department of Health's ability to deliver essential services across Washington. The applications and databases you develop help agency programs, healthcare professionals, and public health partners carry out critical work.
