jobs.title: AI Enablement Engineer
jobs.description: **Sophisticated Work. In a Great City. Making a Difference.** The State of Wisconsin Investment Board (SWIB) manages more than $178 billion in assets, including those of the fully\-funded Wisconsin Retirement System (WRS). SWIB operates at a level more often seen in top\-tier global asset managers than in typical public pension funds. SWIB is a home for top talent. Approximately 61 percent of SWIB’s investment professionals are Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) charterholders. The City of Madison, the state capitol and home of Wisconsin’s flagship university, makes regular appearances on lists of best places to live, eat, and play. SWIB offers a modern workspace, hybrid work options, and competitive compensation and benefits. Serving over 703,000 WRS beneficiaries, SWIB is driven by a clear mission: securing the financial future of those who serve Wisconsin. When you work at SWIB, you know your work matters. **Job Description:** **Position Overview:** We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled AI Enablement Engineer to join our team. The engineer will play a key role in advancing SWIB’s adoption of artificial intelligence by partnering with investment and operational teams to identify, develop, and deploy innovative AI solutions that improve business processes, increase efficiency, and enhance decision\-making. The engineer will report to the Data Services and Engineering Director and work directly with teams throughout the organization to translate complex business needs into prototypes, AI\-powered workflows, and production\-ready solutions. This role requires strong software engineering and data integration capabilities, hands\-on experience with generative AI technologies, and the ability to balance innovation with enterprise security, architecture, and governance standards. **Essential activities:** * Partner directly with front\-office and operations teams to identify AI opportunities, understand business processes, gather requirements, and deliver solutions aligned with investment and operational priorities. * Design, prototype, develop, and deploy AI\-powered applications, assistants, and agentic workflows using platforms such as OpenAI Agent Workspace, Claude Cowork, and other emerging enterprise AI technologies. * Design, develop, and maintain Model Context Protocol (MCP) solutions that securely connect AI capabilities with enterprise data, applications, APIs, and business processes. * Develop reusable AI engineering patterns, frameworks, and integrations that accelerate solution delivery, promote consistency, and enable adoption across the organization. * Leverage programming languages such as Python and SQL to build AI applications, automate workflows, integrate enterprise data, and extend the capabilities of AI platforms. * Develop and implement AI evaluation, testing, observability, and monitoring capabilities to ensure solution accuracy, reliability, performance, and ongoing effectiveness. * Establish appropriate security controls, access management, human oversight, and risk mitigation practices for AI\-enabled solutions in alignment with enterprise architecture and governance standards. * Evaluate emerging AI platforms, models, tools, and capabilities. Conduct proofs of concept, assess technical feasibility, and recommend solutions based on business value, scalability, security, and maintainability. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical challenges involving AI applications, model behavior, data integration, API connectivity, and workflow execution. * Promote responsible AI adoption by providing technical guidance, training, demonstrations, and knowledge transfer to business and technology teams. * Maintain comprehensive documentation of AI solutions, technical designs, integrations, evaluation results, operational procedures, and supporting architecture. * Support automated testing, version control, deployment, and Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) practices to improve the reliability and maintainability of AI solutions. Collaborate with technology, architecture, information security, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions comply with organizational standards and approved implementation practices. * **The ideal candidate:** * Demonstrates a proactive, innovative, and business\-focused approach to identifying opportunities where AI can deliver measurable value. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for technical and non\-technical audiences. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field. * 6\+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, application development, or related technical disciplines. * Hands\-on experience developing solutions using generative AI, large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and AI\-enabled workflow automation. * Experience with enterprise AI platforms and tools such as OpenAI Agent Workspace, Claude Cowork, ChatGPT Enterprise, or comparable technologies. * Experience developing and integrating solutions using Model Context Protocol (MCP), APIs, and enterprise data services. * Strong programming experience with Python, SQL, and API\-based application development. Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript is a plus. * Experience designing and implementing AI solutions using techniques such as retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), tool calling, prompt engineering, and agent orchestration. * Experience implementing AI evaluation frameworks, automated testing, observability, and monitoring to assess model outputs, solution quality, and operational reliability. * Strong understanding of AI security, data privacy, access controls, human\-in\-the\-loop workflows, and responsible AI development practices. * Experience integrating applications with enterprise data platforms, databases, and cloud\-based services. * Experience developing, deploying, and supporting production applications using cloud providers such as Azure. * Experience with software development lifecycle principles, version control, CI/CD, and production support practices. * Ability to independently evaluate emerging technologies, rapidly develop prototypes, and transition successful solutions into maintainable production capabilities. * Ability to work directly with business stakeholders, understand complex workflows, and identify practical opportunities for AI\-driven improvements. * General knowledge of and interest in the investment industry. * Direct experience in financial services, investment management, or asset management is a plus. Experience with Snowflake, Azure AI services, and enterprise AI governance frameworks is a plus. * SWIB Offers: * Competitive total cash compensation, based on AON (formerly McLagan) industry benchmarks * Comprehensive benefits package * Educational and training opportunities * Tuition reimbursement * Challenging work in a professional environment Hybrid work environment * The position requires U.S. work authorization. Pursuant to our Hybrid Remote Work Policy, all staff have the flexibility to work remotely but are required to have a weekly presence in our offices, the frequency of which is dependent on their distance from office or the job position. Staff are not required to reside locally; however, we offer relocation reimbursement to the Dane County area per our policy. All SWIB employees are subject to SWIB’s Ethics Policy and Personal Trade Approvals Policy. These policies include restrictions on outside business activities and employment and have limits on personal trading. You may request copies of these policies from SWIB’s talent acquisition team and any questions can be answered by SWIB’s compliance team.

The role owns automation initiatives end\-to\-end, from business discovery through prototype, production deployment, adoption, and measurement of outcomes. prototype, production deployment, adoption, and measurement of outcomes * Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand workflows, pain points, and opportunities for automation; lead discovery jobs.title: Senior Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: **Analytics Engineer** ====================== **About the Role** ------------------ We’re looking for a skilled, detail\-oriented Analytics Engineer to help build the trusted analytical data layer behind a fast\-growing, technology\-enabled healthcare platform. You’ll partner closely with clinical, operations, data, and engineering teams to transform complex healthcare data into reliable datasets, governed metrics, and actionable insights. Your work will directly support business intelligence, operational decision\-making, and emerging AI\-enabled analytics, including natural\-language querying. This is a high\-impact opportunity to help shape how data is modeled, governed, and consumed across an organization focused on making healthcare more accessible, timely, and seamless. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Build reusable, tested, and well\-documented analytical datasets supporting business intelligence, self\-service analytics, and operational data products * Own and evolve the analytical modeling layer of the data warehouse, including dimensional models, data marts, semantic models, and governed enterprise metrics * Partner with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to translate complex clinical and operational requirements into reliable analytical models * Define and maintain consistent metrics, dimensions, aggregation rules, and semantic metadata across analytics tools * Build the governed data foundation needed to support AI\-enabled analytics and natural\-language querying * Optimize analytical models and queries across large, complex healthcare datasets * Develop datasets supporting future machine learning and AI use cases, including feature development, historical analysis, training and evaluation datasets, and model outputs * Implement automated data quality testing, documentation, and lineage to ensure analytical data remains accurate, trusted, and reusable * Maintain high standards around data integrity, security, governance, and HIPAA compliance * Establish analytics engineering standards and modeling conventions that can scale with the organization **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- * 3\+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, healthcare informatics, analytics, or a related technical role * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Clinical Informatics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field * Experience working within healthcare technology or with healthcare datasets, such as clinical, operational, or claims data * Advanced SQL skills and experience working with large\-scale databases and data warehouses * Strong experience with dbt or a similar transformation framework, including model development, testing, documentation, and deployment * Strong understanding of analytical data modeling, including model grain, joins, fact and dimension concepts, and aggregation behavior * Working proficiency in Python for data analysis, validation, and automation * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure * Experience with modern data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift * Experience defining and implementing governed business metrics, semantic models, or reusable data marts * Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, security, and healthcare compliance best practices * Experience with software engineering practices for analytics code, including Git, code review, automated testing, and CI/CD * Ability to communicate technical concepts effectively across both technical and non\-technical teams **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience supporting AI\-enabled analytics or natural\-language querying * Experience building governed semantic layers or metadata that allow AI systems to reliably interpret business data * Familiarity with ML\-ready datasets, feature engineering, historical correctness, training/evaluation datasets, or model outputs * Experience working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth healthcare technology environment **Why Join** ------------ This is an opportunity to build the analytical foundation behind a healthcare platform focused on making high\-quality care dramatically more accessible. Your work will directly influence how clinical and operational teams understand the business, how quickly patients receive care, and how data and AI are used across the organization. The company offers a competitive total rewards package including: * Competitive base compensation * Meaningful equity through stock options * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * 401(k) retirement plan * Flexible Paid Time Off * Dedicated Paid Sick Leave * 11 paid company holidays * Paid family leave * Additional benefits including life insurance, disability coverage, and HSA options If you’re excited about owning a modern analytical data layer and building at the intersection of healthcare, data, and AI, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description: **How You'll Make An Impact** At Strive Health, patients come first. We're on a mission to transform chronic conditions by identifying risk earlier, coordinating thoughtful care, and supporting people through every stage of their health journey. Our work reduces emergency visits, improves outcomes, and helps patients live fuller lives. You'll work alongside passionate Strivers who care deeply about making an impact, show up for one another as One Team, and find ways to elevate the everyday. If you're looking for meaningful work where your contributions truly matter, you'll feel right at home at Strive! **Benefits \& Perks** * **Hybrid\-Remote Flexibility** –Work from home while fulfilling in\-person needs at the office, clinic, or patient home visits. * **Comprehensive Benefits** – Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance programs, employer\-paid and voluntary life and disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts. * **Financial \& Retirement Support** – Competitive compensation with a performance\-based bonus program, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources. * **Time Off \& Leave** – Paid holidays, vacation time, sick time, and paid birthgiving, bonding, sabbatical, and living donor leaves. * **Wellness \& Growth** – Family forming services through Maven Maternity at no cost and physical wellness perks, mental health support, and an annual professional development stipend. To learn more about our offerings, click **here**. **What** **You'll** **Do** As a Staff Software Engineer in our Product \& Technology organization, you will help define and evolve the technical strategy and architecture of Strive's platform, ensuring engineering decisions align tightly with our clinical and business goals. This is a senior, hands\-on individual contributor role. You will take on the most complex and ambiguous technical problems, designing and building scalable, reliable, and secure software while balancing the need to maintain and scale existing systems with the need to deliver new capabilities for patients, clinicians, and partners. Your impact will extend well beyond the systems you build yourself. You will help teams make sound architectural decisions, establish reusable patterns and standards, address systemic technical risk, and mentor engineers across multiple teams, raising the bar on design, implementation quality, and cross\-functional collaboration. This role reports to a Senior Engineering Manager or Director of Engineering. **The Day to Day** * Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for one or more critical domains within Strive's platform, grounded in our business objectives and long\-term product vision. * Design and deliver end\-to\-end solutions for complex, cross\-team initiatives, from problem framing and architecture through implementation, rollout, and production operation. * Stay hands\-on in the code, writing high\-quality, well\-tested, observable software, especially where complexity, risk, or ambiguity calls for senior engineering leadership. * Make pragmatic architectural tradeoffs that balance scalability, reliability, security, compliance, delivery speed, cost, and long\-term maintainability, while keeping the platform simple for other engineers to build on. * Design and evolve the APIs, services, data models, integrations, and distributed systems that support Strive's products and healthcare operations. * Partner with Product, Clinical, Data, Security, and Operations leaders to make sure we solve the right problems in the right order, with clear outcomes and measures of success. * Identify systemic technical risks, architectural limitations, performance bottlenecks, and technical debt, and lead the work to address them. * Establish reusable architectural patterns, reference implementations, and engineering standards that help teams build consistently and effectively. * Drive platform\-wide improvements in developer experience, reliability, observability, security posture, and performance that measurably improve how engineering delivers value. * Provide technical leadership across teams by facilitating design and architecture reviews, guiding major engineering decisions, and unblocking teams through hands\-on help. * Participate in production support and incident response, helping teams find root causes and turn operational lessons into better architecture, tooling, and practices. * Collaborate with Security and Compliance to ensure systems protect sensitive healthcare information and meet regulatory and organizational requirements. * Mentor and coach engineers and tech leads through design discussions, code reviews, pairing, and day\-to\-day work, helping them strengthen their technical judgment and grow as owners of their domains. * Evaluate emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted engineering tools, and identify opportunities to improve developer productivity, software quality, and engineering effectiveness. * Co xperience building them into application and system design. * Strong experience designing and scaling distributed systems, event\-driven architectures, and data pipelines on AWS or a similar cloud platform. * Familiarity with healthcare interoperability, clinical data, electronic health records, or standards such as FHIR and HL7\. * Experience with relational and non\-relational data stores and systems processing significant volumes of operational or clinical data. * Experience influencing engineering strategy beyond a single team, such as setting technical direction or establishing architecture, testing, observability, and operational standards across teams. * Experience leading modernization efforts involving legacy systems, architecture evolution, or significant technical debt. * Experience with AI\-assisted software development tools, and with evaluating new technologies through prototypes, reference implementations, and incremental adoption. * Exposure to kidney care, value\-based care, or other complex clinical workflows. **About You** * You are a builder who enjoys designing systems, writing code, solving hard problems, and seeing your work run successfully in production. * You are energized by ambiguous, high\-impact problems and can turn loosely defined challenges into clear technical approaches, even where process and systems don't yet exist. * You pair broad knowledge of software engineering with deep expertise in one or more areas, and you use that breadth to weigh the organizational impact of technical choices. * You have strong technical judgment and know that the best solution isn't always the most complex one, or when a long\-term platform investment is worth it versus a simpler approach. * You balance short\-term needs with long\-term architectural investments and keep a clear view of tradeoffs and sequencing over time. * You are an excellent systems thinker and communicator who explains decisions and the reasoning behind them, and proactively shares risks, tradeoffs, and progress. * You raise engineering standards through influence, collaboration, and example rather than authority, and you enjoy helping others grow their skills and autonomy. * You challenge assumptions constructively while staying open to different perspectives and new information. * You take ownership of outcomes, including the reliability and maintainability of software long after it ships. * You approach privacy, security, and risk thoughtfully because the systems you build support patients and clinicians, and you handle sensitive information with integrity and discretion. * You are collaborative, low\-ego, and motivated by the success of the broader team rather than ownership boundaries. * You are outcome\-driven and curious, using data, experimentation, and feedback loops, as well as thoughtful adoption of AI and other new capabilities, to keep improving the platform and how engineering works. **Annual Salary Range: $130,000 \- $163,000\. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 15%** Final compensation will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications. Strive Health is an equal opportunity employer and drug free workplace. At this time Strive Health is unable to provide work visa sponsorship. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please apply even if you feel you do not meet all qualifications. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to talentacquisition@strivehealth.com. **We do not accept unsolicited resumes from outside recruiters/placement agencies. Strive Health will not pay fees associated with resumes presented through unsolicited means.**

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer (CTO) – Software Engineering & Technology Strategy
jobs.description: **Chief Technology Officer** **Organization:** National Nonprofit Organization **Reports To:** Chief Executive Officer **Department:** Technology **Work Location:** Remote **Employment Status:** Regular, Full\-Time, Exempt **Position Level:** Executive / Senior Leadership **Salary Range:** $225,000–$250,000 annually **ABOUT THE ORGANIZATION** We are a national nonprofit organization committed to advancing our mission through innovative programs, strategic partnerships, and technology\-enabled services. We work with diverse stakeholders across the country to deliver programs, strengthen operations, and achieve meaningful outcomes. We are seeking an experienced, hands\-on Chief Technology Officer to lead our technology function, strengthen operational performance, and guide the continued evolution of our technology infrastructure and digital platforms. This is an opportunity to join our executive leadership team and play a critical role in shaping our technology strategy, strengthening our systems and capabilities, and ensuring technology supports our organizational mission and long\-term priorities. **POSITION SUMMARY** The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) serves as our senior technology executive and technical authority, with overall accountability for enterprise technology strategy, engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity, data governance, and technology delivery. This is a hands\-on executive leadership role requiring a combination of deep technical expertise, strategic thinking, business acumen, and operational leadership. The CTO directly supervises the technology team, provides technical direction, oversees production changes, and ensures the reliability, security, and performance of our critical systems. The position combines responsibilities often distributed across an engineering manager, vice president of engineering, and chief technology officer. The successful candidate must be equally comfortable making complex technical decisions, leading a multidisciplinary team, developing long\-term technology strategies, and advising executive leadership on investments, operational risks, and organizational priorities. The CTO leads a team of employees and contractors responsible for enterprise applications, digital platforms, data and reporting systems, cloud infrastructure, and internal IT operations. The role carries direct accountability for the availability, performance, security, and continued modernization of business\-critical systems. **POSITION DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Executive Leadership and Accountability:** Serve as a member of the executive leadership team, advising the CEO and senior leaders on technology strategy, investments, risks, and opportunities. Translate complex technical matters into business implications and contribute to organizational strategy, resource planning, and executive and board discussions. * **Team Leadership and Supervision:** Directly supervise engineering, analysis, and IT staff and coordinate contractor resources. Establish delivery priorities, manage team performance, and build technical depth through cross\-training, professional development, and succession planning for critical systems. * **Technical Strategy and Final Authority:** Serve as the organization's senior technical authority, resolving complex technical questions and setting architectural direction across legacy enterprise systems and modern cloud\-based platforms. Develop and execute a multiyear technology roadmap aligned with organizational priorities and long\-term sustainability. * **Production Change Approval:** Oversee production releases, requiring documented risk assessments, testing, and rollback plans for significant changes. Lead incident response for business\-critical systems and ensure post\-incident reviews result in lasting improvements to reliability and performance. * **Technology Delivery and Performance:** Maintain accountability for technology project delivery, including scope, timelines, quality, and operational risks. Establish priorities, align technology initiatives with organizational commitments, and monitor performance measures to ensure reliable systems and effective delivery. * **Financial, Vendor, and Platform Stewardship:** Oversee cloud infrastructure, hosting, platform migrations, and technology vendors. Manage the technology budget, evaluate vendor performance and investments, negotiate contractual scopes, and ensure responsible stewardship of organizational resources in partnership with Finance and legal counsel. * **Security, Compliance, and Continuity:** Lead cybersecurity strategy, identity and access management, data protection, regulatory compliance, and business continuity planning. Assess technology risks, establish appropriate safeguards, and ensure the security and resilience of critical organizational systems. * **Modernization, Data, and Innovation:** Lead modernization of legacy and contemporary systems, strengthening documentation, knowledge transfer, and long\-term maintainability. Provide strategic oversight of data governance, analytics, and the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence and emerging technologies to improve organizational effectiveness. **QUALIFICATIONS** * Minimum of 10 years of progressively responsible professional experience in software engineering, technology management, or related technical fields, including at least four years of direct supervision of engineering professionals. * An engineering background is required. The role reviews code changes, approves production releases, and settles technical disputes from first\-hand understanding. * Experience operating and changing business\-critical production systems, ideally systems that move money or carry regulatory or compliance obligations. * Experience with both legacy system modernization and cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent platform). * Experience presenting technical matters to executives or boards, and exposure to vendor evaluation, contracts, or build\-versus\-buy decisions. * Experience in nonprofit organizations, government, or other mission\-driven environments. **SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES** * Hands\-On Technical Leadership \- Demonstrates the technical depth to engage directly with engineers, evaluate systems and code, and resolve complex technical issues. Comfortable serving as both an executive leader and a hands\-on technical resource within a lean organization. * Strategic Vision and Business Acumen \-Connects technology strategy and investments to organizational priorities. Anticipates future technology needs and evaluates decisions through the lenses of cost, risk, operational impact, and long\-term organizational value. * Sound Judgment and Decision\-Making \-Makes timely, well\-reasoned technical and operational decisions. Establishes clear documentation, communicates decisions effectively, and promotes transparency and accountability. * Incident and Risk Management \- Provides calm, structured leadership during technology incidents and operational disruptions. Anticipates risks, coordinates effective responses, and ensures lessons learned translate into sustainable improvements. * Executive Communication and Influence \-Communicates technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, including engineers, operational leaders, executives, board members, and external stakeholders. Builds alignment around technology priorities and decisions. * People Leadership and Development \-Builds and develops high\-performing teams, establishes clear expectations, provides constructive feedback, and creates opportunities for professional growth and shared accountability. * Pragmatism and Adaptability \- Develops practical, scalable technology solutions appropriate to our organization's needs, resources, and operating environment. Demonstrates flexibility and sound judgment in navigating changing priorities. *We are an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to providing equal employment opportunities in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.* Pay: $225,000\.00 \- $250,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * How many years of professional experience do you have in software engineering, technology management, or a related technical field? * How many years of direct supervisory experience do you have managing software engineers or other engineering professionals? * Do you have a hands\-on software engineering background, including experience reviewing code, making architectural decisions, and overseeing production releases? \- Yes \- No * Have you managed business\-critical production systems and led technology modernization initiatives involving legacy systems and cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent)? \- Yes \- No Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Director, Software Design Quality Engineering (Contract)
jobs.description: **GROW WITH US:** Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no\-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry. **STAY AWESOME:** Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control\-IQ\+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human\-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com **A DAY IN THE LIFE:** The Director of Software Design Quality Engineering for the overall quality and compliance of all products developed by the Company. Partners with department staff to determine quality system requirements and provide design quality and quality engineering support for the product development process, including cross\-functional cooperation as part of core product development teams and transfer to manufacturing. This role will focus on primarily on software quality engineering as it relates to IEC 62304\. A Director of Software Design Quality Engineering at Tandem also: * Functions as a key business partner with R\&D and product management and contributes to the overall strategic direction and success. * Drive functional excellence in design quality by coaching and mentoring on product design control and development best practices via creating, using, and maintaining Risk Management file(s) throughout the product’s full life cycle. * Provide critical quality engineering direction to projects concerning generally accepted quality engineering tools/principles, such as product and component qualification, process validation, measurement systems analysis, test method validation, root cause analysis, risk analysis, risk mitigation, sampling, and control plans. * Develop, collaborate, communicate, and implement strategies to improve product and development project performance. * Work cross\-functionally to evaluate new projects, assign quality resources to core teams and ensure resourcing aligns with company priorities, monitor progress, identify and resolve technical issues, and manage escalations. * Drive and evaluate project and department progress, technical development plans, and results. * Responsible for driving strategic decision\-making based on quality strategy, identifying, and addressing areas of risk. * Maintains expertise in current and emerging GMP, QSR, Sterilization, regulatory compliance standards, including but not limited to ISO13485, ISO 9001, IEC 62304, ISO 60601, ISO 14971, 21CFR Part 820, and international standards. * Acts as Tandem representative in FDA and other regulatory inspections; provides direct interaction with officials during audits, inspections, and inquiries. * Works closely with the Regulatory team to complete FDA submissions; liaising with the FDA as needed. * Assists in the review and approval of new products and design changes to ensure they are developed, verified, validated and documented in accordance with internal and regulatory requirements. * Leads the risk analysis and disposition of software anomalies and verification and validation failures. * Provides quality input and support to Complaint, FI, CAPA, NCR investigations; directs, supports, and executes corrective actions when applicable. * Leads Risk Analysis activities, Design Reviews, Test Method Validation, DOEs, and Verification and Validation Testing. * Reviews documents on Change Orders to ensure that the Quality System remains in compliance with all applicable laws and standards and that the system is as efficient and effective as possible. **WHEN \& WHERE YOU’LL WORK:** Remote: This position is fully remote and open to candidates within the United States. Equipment for the role will be provided and training will occur virtually. Schedule: This position has a schedule of standard business hours in Pacific Time or equivalent based on time zone. Travel: This role will require car and air travel up to 10% of time Please note that this a **temporary**position with an anticipated duration of 3 months but could vary in duration. jobs.title: Senior PHP Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior PHP Engineer – CATS Platform \& AI Features** Top Echelon Software is seeking a Senior PHP Engineer to help own and evolve CATS, our established SaaS applicant tracking system running in AWS. This is a hands\-on role combining production ownership, thoughtful modernization, and practical AI development. You’ll maintain a product customers depend on, improve how we build and deliver software, and develop AI\-enabled features that help recruiters work more effectively. This is a full\-time role based in Canton, OH. U.S. work authorization required. **About the role** CATS is a mature, revenue\-generating product with an established customer base and a substantial codebase. We’re looking for an engineer who enjoys understanding complex systems, making sound technical decisions, and delivering improvements incrementally. You’ll take primary engineering responsibility for application health and contribute directly to its evolution. That includes resolving production issues, improving performance and maintainability, using AI coding assistants effectively, and turning promising AI capabilities into reliable product features. Our stack includes PHP, MySQL, Vue, JavaScript/TypeScript, REST and GraphQL APIs, Redis\-compatible caching and queues, OpenSearch, Docker, and AWS infrastructure. The application combines established legacy code with newer components, including integrations for embeddings and vector search. **What you’ll do** * Own application reliability, maintenance, and targeted enhancements. * Diagnose production issues across application code, database queries, background jobs, integrations, and deployment infrastructure. * Modernize selected areas of the codebase while preserving customer workflows and backward compatibility. * Improve automated tests, static analysis, observability, CI/CD, and operational documentation. * Use AI coding assistants for code exploration, implementation, debugging, and testing, while remaining accountable for correctness and security. * Develop repeatable AI\-assisted engineering workflows that produce small, tested, reviewable changes. * Build and extend AI\-enabled capabilities such as semantic search, summarization, information extraction, and recruiter workflow assistance. * Evaluate AI features for usefulness, accuracy, latency, cost, and reliable behavior when dependencies fail. * Protect customer and candidate data through appropriate access controls, tenant isolation, and careful handling of data sent to AI services. * Help prioritize technical debt and provide clear input on roadmap feasibility, tradeoffs, and risk. **Required experience** * Substantial professional software development experience, typically 7\+ years, with deep PHP expertise. * Experience maintaining and improving a complex, long\-lived application. * Strong MySQL/SQL skills, including query optimization, indexing, and safe data changes. * Experience operating production SaaS systems and diagnosing issues across multiple layers. * Experience with APIs, third\-party integrations, and asynchronous or background processing. * Working proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and an ability to contribute to an existing frontend. * Experience with Docker, automated testing, and CI/CD. * Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants on real development work, including reviewing generated code and validating changes. * Practical experience integrating LLMs or other AI services into an application, with an understanding of evaluation, failure handling, and data privacy. * Ability to work independently, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and carry changes through deployment and follow\-up. **Preferred experience** * Vue, particularly maintaining or modernizing Vue 2 applications. * AWS services such as EKS, RDS, EC2, and S3; Kubernetes deployment and troubleshooting. * OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, Redis/Valkey, and search relevance tuning. * Embeddings, vector search, retrieval\-augmented generation, and structured model outputs. * Shipping and operating customer\-facing AI features. * Building agent\-assisted development pipelines or “software factories”: repeatable workflows connecting specifications, implementation, tests, review, and release controls. * Technical ownership of a mature SaaS product or experience working on a small engineering team. * Recruiting, applicant tracking, or other workflow\-intensive business software. **What success looks like** * Customers can depend on CATS, and recurring production problems become less frequent. * Improvements ship in manageable increments with appropriate testing and clear rollback options. * AI\-assisted development improves delivery speed without sacrificing quality. * AI features solve measurable customer problems and behave reliably in production. * Documentation and tooling make the platform easier for others to understand and support. **Benefits** Competitive salary, PTO and flexible floating holidays, 401(k) match, health benefits, and an education stipend.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Data Platform
jobs.description: ### **About Traversal** Traversal is the AI Site Reliability Engineer (AI SRE) for the enterprise. Production complexity was already outpacing what engineering teams could manage manually, and AI\-generated code is accelerating that gap. Traversal is built for that challenge, autonomously understanding and reasoning across even the largest, most complex production environments to diagnose, fix, and prevent incidents. Our mission is to free engineers from endless firefighting and give them more time to focus on creative, high\-impact work. Today, Traversal operates in mission\-critical environments at some of the world’s largest enterprises, including PepsiCo, Nubank, Harvey, and DigitalOcean. Our roots remain deeply embedded in AI research, and we’ve brought together researchers from institutions including MIT, Harvard, Berkeley, Columbia, and Cornell with world\-class technical staff and operators from companies like Google, Meta, Datadog, ServiceNow, and Citadel Securities to take on one of the hardest problems for AI to solve. Traversal is backed by Sequoia Capital, Kleiner Perkins, Redpoint Ventures, and Khosla Ventures. ### **The Role** The Traversal AI SRE agent's performance and accuracy are hugely dependent on the data it reasons over. When Traversal investigates a production incident at a Fortune 100 company, we rely on having the right data, in the right shape, in the right place, and at the right time, to deliver the best and fastest outcomes to our customers. This is the crucially important role of Traversal's Production World Model and petabyte\-scale data platform: hundreds of billions of log lines a day from a single customer, ingested at hundreds of megabytes per second, and queryable by the agent within minutes of being emitted. We're hiring a Principal Engineer, Data Platform, to own the technical direction of that platform. You'll define how data enters Traversal, how it's stored and queried, and how it's transformed into the derived products our agents and researchers rely on — across SaaS and BYOC deployments in some of the most demanding enterprise environments in the world. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role: you'll shape roadmaps and write the design docs that set the direction, write the code that proves it out, and raise the bar for the engineers who build alongside you. This is also a rare seat where data infrastructure meets frontier AI. The agent is the platform's most demanding customer, and AI Research is its closest partner. You'll see firsthand how an AI agent reasons over production data, and your decisions will directly shape how well it does. At our stage, a Principal Engineer doesn't work from a ticket queue. You'll work directly with leadership on what we build and why, sit in front of our largest customers, and learn how an enterprise AI company is built from the inside. ### **What You'll Do** * **Own the data platform architecture.** Define the long\-term architecture across our four data paths — direct push ingestion, scheduled pulls from third\-party observability platforms, non\-telemetry data, and transformation pipelines — including the interfaces, invariants, and evolution path that let them scale together. * **Set the storage and query strategy.** Decide what our storage layer looks like at 10–100x today's scale: time\-series, columnar/OLAP, and lakehouse tradeoffs; retention and cost; performance commitments for the agent's key queries. * **Serve the agent as a first\-class workload.** An AI agent is the platform's most demanding consumer. Design the query interfaces it depends on: performance commitments for its key tool queries, freshness guarantees for the data it reasons over, and safe sandboxing for the ad\-hoc queries an LLM will inevitably write. * **Build the data foundation for AI research.** Work side by side with our AI Research team to give the agent and its auto\-research loops the data they need: investigation history, evaluation datasets, and the derived signals that make the agent measurably better. You'll learn how a production AI agent is built, evaluated and improved, and you'll see your data decisions show up in its accuracy. * **Shape the company, not just the platform.** Work directly with engineering and company leadership on the technical roadmap and how it serves the business. Join architecture reviews and deployments with Fortune 100 customers. Bring what you learn from Product, Forward Deployed Engineering and Go\-to\-Market back into what we build. * **Build the orchestration and transformation backbone.** Lead the framework for scheduled, idempotent, observable jobs that ingest non\-telemetry context and produce derived data — materialized views, rollups, entity graphs, and LLM\-based summarization and enrichment that's cached ahead of investigations rather than computed during them. * **Own reliability, performance, and cost end to end.** Define and meet SLOs for availability, data freshness, and query latency; build systems that ship with their monitoring, runbooks, and safe rollouts; and lead the technical response when things break. * **Govern customer data.** Design redaction, tenant isolation, and data\-residency controls that satisfy the security and compliance teams of the world's largest banks, payment companies, and tech companies. * **Multiply the team.** Mentor senior engineers, and set standards and reference implementations that teams beyond Data Platform adopt. ### **What We're Looking For** * Senior\-level depth in building and operating data infrastructure in production (typically 10\+ years), including a track record of setting architecture for a data platform used by multiple teams. * Deep distributed\-systems expertise in streaming data, analytical storage, and query engines: Kafka (or equivalent), ClickHouse/Doris/Druid/Pinot, data lakehouse technologies, and building scalable and reliable multi\-tenant data systems. * Strong systems programming in Rust (our primary data platform language) or comparable experience in Go, plus comfort in Python. * Experience shipping on Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, and AWS, ideally into environments you don't fully control (BYOC, on\-prem, or regulated customer clouds). * A record of leading multi\-quarter migrations and platform transformations through to adoption and deprecation, not just design. * You still write production code regularly, and can walk us through recent work you personally shipped. * Sound cost judgment: you reason about tradeoffs between performance, cost, durability, and simplicity with real numbers, and you know what your systems cost to run. * Clear technical writing and judgment: you can make a crisp tradeoff call, get alignment without authority, and hold your own in an architecture review with an enterprise customer. ### **Nice to Have** * Experience building the backend of an observability, logging, APM, or SIEM product. * Fluency with OpenTelemetry/OTLP and the data models and APIs of major observability vendors (Datadog, Splunk, Elastic, Prometheus, Dynatrace). * Experience with workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Temporal) and data pipeline frameworks. * Experience building LLM\-powered data pipelines: enrichment, summarization, embeddings, and controlling their cost. * Background in data governance: PII redaction, data residency, and regulated industries such as financial services. * Contributions to open\-source data infrastructure. ### **Compensation** We offer competitive compensation, startup equity, health insurance, and additional benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time, in\-person role in New York is $275,000 to $350,000 USD, plus equity and benefits. Our salary ranges are based on location, level, and role. Individual compensation is determined by experience, skills, and job\-related knowledge. ### **Why You Should Join Us** If you've mastered data infrastructure and want to be at the center of AI, rather than next to it, this is the role. Traversal is a place to take on hard, meaningful problems with real ownership from day one. You’ll work alongside people who challenge you to grow, learn constantly, and help define a new category of infrastructure software. We think long term, move quickly, and hold a high bar without taking ourselves too seriously. We offer competitive salary and equity packages, health insurance, fertility benefits, a great tech setup stipend and flexible time off. Plus in\-office snacks, team happy hours and outings, an annual company offsite, and plenty of built in time to collaborate across teams. Traversal is fully in\-office, 5 days a week, based in New York near Madison Square Park. We have a collaborative, hard\-working culture and are energized by building the future of AI\-powered software maintenance.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description: TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk. At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI\-powered future. AI Fearlessly. We are looking for a **Senior Data Engineer – Data Platform** to help design and build the next generation of the **Vision One Data Platform** . This is a highly technical, hands\-on role focused on creating a modern data foundation that enables Vision One engineering teams to discover, govern, access, transform, and analyze data across the platform. You will work at the intersection of **distributed databases, data engineering, data governance, semantic discovery, and self\-service analytics** . A key part of the role is enabling **dbt as a self\-service data transformation and modeling capability across Vision One OLTP databases** , while building the underlying architecture, governance, and data movement infrastructure required to do this reliably at scale. You will work closely with platform, product, security, and data engineering teams to establish common data standards and infrastructure that can be reused across Vision One. **What You’ll Do** * Design and build the **Vision One Data Platform** , including data ingestion, replication, transformation, governance, discovery, and serving capabilities. * Build scalable data pipelines and **change\-data\-capture (CDC)** architectures using technologies such as **Datastream** and similar streaming/replication technologies. * Enable **self\-service dbt** across Vision One OLTP data sources, providing product teams with governed capabilities to transform, model, test, document, and expose their data without requiring the central data platform team to build every pipeline. * Establish patterns for safely extracting and replicating data from **OLTP and distributed SQL databases** into analytical and downstream data systems. * Design architectures around distributed SQL technologies such as **YugabyteDB, CockroachDB** , or similar platforms. * Work with technologies such as **Databricks** and modern analytical processing engines to support large\-scale data processing and analytics. * Build a comprehensive **data catalog and metadata foundation** that enables teams and AI agents to understand what data exists, where it comes from, what it means, and how it can be used. * Develop **semantic data discovery** capabilities that allow engineers, analysts, applications, and AI agents to discover relevant data based on business meaning rather than only database/schema names. * Establish data governance standards covering **ownership, lineage, schemas, quality, access control, retention, and lifecycle management** . * Develop reusable data platform primitives and APIs that product teams can consume as self\-service capabilities. * Build automated mechanisms for **data quality, schema evolution, lineage, observability, and freshness monitoring** . * Design for evolving product schemas and ensure the platform can accommodate continuous changes without creating excessive duplication or operational overhead. * Partner with security and platform engineering teams to establish appropriate **fine\-grained data access controls** across databases, schemas, tables, and data products. * Help establish the **source\-of\-truth architecture** for Vision One data while minimizing unnecessary data duplication. * Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to other data engineers and product engineering teams. Drive engineering standards around reliability, scalability, performance, cost efficiency, and operational excellence. * **What You Bring** **Required:** * 4\-7 years of experience in data engineering, distributed systems, backend engineering, or a related field. * Strong experience designing and building **large\-scale data platforms and data pipelines** . * Deep understanding of **OLTP and OLAP architectures** and the tradeoffs between them. * Hands\-on experience with **CDC, data replication, and streaming architectures** . * Strong SQL expertise and experience working with relational databases at scale. * Experience with **distributed SQL databases** , such as YugabyteDB, CockroachDB, Spanner, or similar technologies. * Experience building data transformation workflows using **dbt** or similar data modeling frameworks. * Experience with modern analytical/data platforms such as **Databricks, Spark, Trino, Snowflake, BigQuery** , or equivalent. * Strong understanding of data governance concepts including **metadata, lineage, data quality, ownership, access control, and data catalogs** . * Experience designing systems that support **self\-service d owledge graphs, or ontology\-driven data discovery** . * Experience building platforms that expose data to **AI/agentic applications** . * Experience with data mesh, data products, or domain\-oriented data architectures. * Experience implementing **fine\-grained authorization** for data platforms. * Experience managing large\-scale telemetry, security, observability, or other high\-volume data. * Experience balancing **data quality, query performance, platform reliability, and infrastructure cost** . **What Success Looks Like** In this role, you will help establish a Data Platform where: * Vision One data can be **discovered through a common semantic layer** , rather than requiring teams to understand every underlying database and schema. * Product teams can use **dbt as a governed self\-service capability** across their OLTP data. * Data lineage, ownership, quality, and access policies are **built into the platform rather than managed manually** . * Data can move reliably from distributed OLTP systems into analytical and downstream systems through standardized CDC and streaming patterns. * Product teams can consume platform capabilities without repeatedly building their own ingestion, transformation, governance, and discovery infrastructure. * The platform provides a **trusted source of truth** while minimizing unnecessary copies of data. * The resulting data foundation can support not only traditional analytics and applications, but also **AI and agentic experiences across Vision One** . **Why Join TrendAI?** --------------------- TrendAI is a leader in AI security. We not only delivered the first open\-weight, cybersecurity\-focused large language model, but also the industry's first security companion agent evaluated directly by customers. Trend Vision One integrates endpoint, cloud, network, email, identity, AI application, and data security into a single, unified platform. In this role, you will help define how a security\-critical product is built — including how AI shapes the development process itself. You will partner with engineering leaders applying AI to that process, working in an environment where the bar on systems thinking, critical review, and security instinct has gone up, not down. **What We Offer You:** You're important to us. What matters to you, matters to us too. TrendAI provides benefit options for you and your family. * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision insurance * Life insurance * Short \& Long Term Disability * Pre\-partum, maternity, parental and medical leave * Mental Health Wellness Program * Adoption Assistance * Wellness Incentive * Pet Insurance * 401(k) with company match * Paid Time Off * 14 Annual Holidays * Tuition Assistance Employee Resource Groups * We offer competitive compensation with bonus opportunity tied to company performance, along with room to enhance your skills through ongoing learning and broad technological opportunities. Achieving work\-life balance is a priority, complemented by team activities, fostering an environment rooted in equity, inclusion, and collaboration, that is reflected in both our culture and our work. This role is not eligible for employer\-provided work visa sponsorship, now or in the future. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States for this employer without sponsorship. Be Passionate. Be Innovative. Be a Trender. \#LI\-JL At Trend Micro, we embrace change, empower people, and encourage innovation in a connected world. Our diversity and multicultural workforce are key contributing factors to our success across the globe. Trend Micro provides equal employment opportunity for all applicants and employees. Trend Micro does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy and childbirth or related medical conditions, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care leave status, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, or gender identity.

jobs.title: Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary:** We are seeking a skilled Firmware Engineer to join our dynamic team in Lebanon, Tennessee. This permanent, full\-time position plays a crucial role in the manufacturing and production sector, focusing on the development and optimization of firmware for our innovative products. The ideal candidate will play a critical role in developing high\-reliability, safety\-critical firmware for our high\-power EV charging systems. You will design, develop, test, and maintain embedded firmware across the full product lifecycle, from early development through certification, production and field support. **Responsibilities:** * Design, code, and implement embedded firmware in C/C\+\+ and Rust, including RTOS\-based applications, for a range of microcontrollers for TI, NXP, and Microchip. * Develop and maintain firmware architecture, APIs, and low\-level hardware drivers that are robust, modular, and scalable. * Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize firmware for performance, reliability, and efficient use of system resources. * Develop and execute unit, integration, validation, and regression tests to ensure firmware quality and safety. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define firmware requirements and specifications. * Troubleshoot and debug firmware issues, providing timely solutions to enhance product performance. * Work within Agile development practices and use CI/CD pipelines to support consistent, high\-quality firmware releases. * Conduct code reviews and maintain documentation to ensure compliance with industry standards. * Stay updated with the latest technologies and trends in firmware development and manufacturing processes. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. * Minimum of 3\+ years of hands\-on embedded firmware development. * Strong proficiency in programming languages such as C/C\+\+, Rust and RTOS * Experience with microcontrollers and low\-level hardware interfaces (CAN, I2C, SPI, UART). * Strong understanding of embedded systems and hardware\-software integration. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and attention to detail. * Familiarity with ISO 26262 or similar standards. * Ability to work collaboratively in a team\-oriented environment. ### **Company Overview** Please visit https://tritiumcharging.com/ for more information

Modifies program sequence and/or codes when required based on testing feedback * Provides reference for use of server and personal computers by writing and maintaining user documentation and manuals relating to the application * Maintains programming guidelines by writing and updating policies and procedures. * Reads manuals, periodicals, and technical reports to learn ways to develop programs that meet user requirements. Conveys this information to other team members involved in the project * May train end users in the created application and provide support after updates * Reviews current applications for possible enhancements or efficiency upgrades * Other duties as required **QUALIFICATIONS:** Minimum: * Requires a Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience in computer science, minimum 5 years hands on experience in same or similar position * Solid working knowledge of coding languages: .NET, SQL, JAVA etc. * Working knowledge of Windows O/S * Basic understanding of computer hardware and peripherals. * Strong written and verbal communication skills * Proficient in Microsoft Office suite of products – Excel, PowerPoint, etc. **QUALIFICATIONS (continued):** Preferred: * Advanced training or certification on specific systems and languages * System Project management from inception to completion * Experience directing small groups (1\-2 individuals) on projects

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Platform Engineering
jobs.description: **Who we are** At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences. Our dedication to remote\-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands. . **Hiring and how we work** We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! Also, while we are a remote\-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad\-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off\-sites or customer meetings. . **See yourself at Twilio** Join the team as Twilio's next Software Development Engineer 1 \- Platform Engineering. **About the job** This position is needed to help operate, secure, and modernize Twilio's shared Kubernetes platform substrate (OTK, Segment, and ZipWhip EKS fleets) at scale. Join our Cloud Native Container Operations team as an entry\-level platform engineer. You will help manage over 1,000 Kubernetes clusters, tackling real\-world multi\-cloud complexity. This high\-impact role offers structured mentorship from senior engineers, hands\-on experience with modern automation tools, and a direct path to improving platform reliability. It is the perfect environment to launch your career in infrastructure engineering at a massive scale. **Responsibilities** In this role, you'll: * Assist in lifecycle management of cloud hosted Kubernetes platforms serving all of Twilio. * Remediate container and kernel\-level CVE vulnerabilities to keep the shared substrate secure. * Write automation scripts in Go and Shell to streamline day\-to\-day cluster operations. * Collaborate with senior engineers to deploy infrastructure changes safely using Terraform and GitOps. * Troubleshoot basic platform issues, applying lessons learned to continuously improve system reliability. **Qualifications** Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table! Required: * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical training. * Foundational programming skills in Go (Golang) and scripting with Shell. * Basic exposure to cloud environments, specifically AWS. * Familiarity with Infrastructure\-as\-Code concepts using Terraform and YAML. * Academic or internship exposure to containerization technologies like Docker or Kubernetes. * Practical understanding of version control (Git) and core software development life cycle (SDLC) concepts. Desired: * Familiarity with GitOps workflows and tools like ArgoCD. * Basic understanding of networking, operating systems, and distributed systems. * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code) for coding or debugging. * Strong problem\-solving skills and an eagerness to learn complex infrastructure concepts. **Location** This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA. **Travel** We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. We are an agile team moving at startup speed with the full weight of Uber behind us: global reach, world class infrastructure, and one of the largest human networks in the world. We pair that network with machine learning to produce the high quality, model ready data that the most advanced AI teams on earth depend on. Our work spans every modality, from text, images, and video to audio and physical AI and AVs, and reaches across dozens of countries. This is a place for builders who want real ownership. Here you own a problem, not a ticket: you take a vertical from start to finish, the machine learning, the backend systems, and the product, and drive it from a blank page to something the best customers in AI rely on every day. You work shoulder to shoulder with product managers and other exceptional engineers, go as deep as the problem demands, and make the calls that decide whether your area wins. It is the closest thing to running your own company, with a rocket strapped to it. If you want your work to show up in the AI systems shaping the world, and you want to build it like a founder, this is the team. **What you’ll do** * Build the ML and backend systems that make the growth real and durable, going deep on the hardest problems yourself. * Own your vertical end to end: set the direction, find where the growth is, and drive the business metrics that matter, such as revenue, customers, and market reach. * Move fast and decisively in ambiguity, making the strategic and technical calls that decide whether the business wins. * Be a trusted technical partner in the most important customer relationships, using them to grow the account and shape what you build next. * Build the team and raise the bar so the business can keep scaling. **Basic Qualifications** * Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or a related discipline. * 7\+ years building and shipping products powered by ML, with a history of owning jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Engineer
jobs.description: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Marketplace Planning \& Intelligence About the Role How should Uber price trips and invest in promotions and incentives, in hundreds of cities every week, to hit its growth and revenue goals while keeping the marketplace healthy? That is the question our team answers. We build the planning system behind Uber Rides pricing and incentives. It forecasts how the marketplace will respond to different pricing and incentive choices, optimizes the plan against business targets and constraints, deploys it to real time pricing systems, and corrects course as actual results come in. Its decisions directly move gross bookings and net revenue for Uber's global Mobility business. We are moving from a world where Tech recommends plans to one where Tech runs pricing and incentive planning autonomously for entire markets. That only works if our forecasts and simulators predict real outcomes with high fidelity. As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will set the technical direction for those models, define what they need from the data and ML platforms underneath them, and lead a mixed team of ML engineers, backend engineers, and scientists to deliver it. The challenges go beyond building a more accurate model. How do we predict the causal effect of a price change, not just its correlation with outcomes? How do we keep a plan on target when the marketplace shifts mid week? How do we make sure the metrics our models predict are the same metrics the business measures? How do we shape data foundations so that a better model actually turns into a better business outcome? You will answer these questions through hands\-on modeling, technical leadership, and influence across teams. What You Will Do * **Lead the modeling vision:** Set the technical direction for large scale production forecasting models and marketplace simulators that predict, with high fidelity, how trips, revenue, and spend respond to pricing and incentive decisions across hundreds of cities. These models are the foundation every plan is built on, and you will define where they go next. * **Push the frontier of predictive and causal accuracy:** Advance our models on two fronts at once: forecasting what will happen with high predictive accuracy, and estimating what would happen under different pricing and incentive choices with high causal accuracy. Draw on causal inference, deep learning, time series, and sequence modeling so that both the baseline forecast and the simulated "what if" outcomes hold up when plans go live. Set the standard for how we prove it, through backtesting, forecast versus actual tracking, causal validation against experiments, and explainability that lets the business trust and act on the predictions. * **Turn predictions into decisions:** Partner on the optimization, pacing, and control layers that consume your models, so that every gain in model fidelity becomes a better plan that stays on target as the marketplace shifts. * **Shape the data foundations that make models land:** Define what modeling needs from the data and ML platforms, including feature coverage, historical reconstruction for backtesting, and business metric definitions that match what Finance measures. Influence platform strategy so that better models translate into better business outcomes. * **Lead and multiply:** Lead a mixed team of ML engineers, backend engineers, and scientists from mathematical formulation through production and experimentation. Partner with Product, Operations, Finance, and Science to shape priorities, and mentor engineers to raise the modeling bar across the organization. Basic Qualifications * MS/BS or PhD in Computer Science, Operations Research, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field. * 8\+ years of industry experience building and shipping ML or optimization systems (or 6\+ years with a PhD). * Deep expertise in machine learning modeling and optimization algorithms, with a track record of deploying them in production at scale. * Solid understanding of the data and ML platforms behind production models, such as data pipelines, feature stores, and training and evaluation infrastructure, and a track record of driving data or ML platform strategy as the modeling lead to improve model outcomes. * Proficiency in one or more languages such as Python, Go, Java, or C\+\+, and experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch. * Fluency working with AI coding agents and LLM tools as part of daily engineering, using them to accelerate modeling, experimentation, and analysis, with the judgment to verify their output and hold it to production standards. * Demonstrated technical leadership: setting direction for a multi engineer effort spanning multiple quarters and teams. * Strong communication skills and the ability to influence cross functional partners and senior leadership. Preferred Qualifications * Experience with marketplace, pricing, revenue management, ads bidding, or budget allocation problems. * Experience with time series forecasting at scale, causal inference, and experimental design. * Experience with mathematical programming (for example mixed integer or nonlinear optimization), budget pacing, or control theory (for example PID controllers). * Experience with reinforcement learning or sequence models applied to sequential decision making. * Experience partnering with platform teams on feature store, data quality, lineage, or metric governance strategy for ML. * Familiarity with large scale data and compute technologies such as Spark, Hive, and Ray. * Experience building evaluation, monitoring, and root cause tooling for production ML systems. * Experience building agentic workflows that automate parts of the ML lifecycle, such as data exploration, experiment analysis, model diagnostics, or root cause investigation, and that raise the productivity of the whole team.
