jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer: iOS (Core Build)
jobs.description: **About the Role and Team** Core Build is Uber’s centralized build platform team. We own the common build substrate—Bazel, Gazelle, build rules, client\-side remote build caching and execution, and the shared build/test CI pipelines—across Uber’s Java, Android, iOS monorepos. Our vision is simple: make builds fast with less friction. Because the stack is shared, an improvement we make once can benefit engineers across Uber. We work across three pillars: * **Velocity**: Make builds faster everywhere with fewer resources—in CI, in remote development environments, and on laptops—through caching, remote execution, sharding, and build\-graph optimization. * **Reliability \& Diagnosability**: A build failure should never leave an engineer stranded. Every failure should say what failed, how to fix it, and who can help. * **Modernization, Unification \& Scale**: Keep the platform on the latest Bazel, maximize CI fleet utilization with smart test selection and build\-graph pruning, and apply GenAI/ML to automate diagnosis and optimization. Our next step\-change is to stop compiling the same code thousands of times: make mobile builds remote\-first so developers reuse cached build outputs wherever possible, and run only the tests a change can actually affect. As the Staff iOS engineer on the team, you will be the technical owner for the iOS side of that roadmap. As a Staff Software Engineer you will lead the design, development, and evolution of the build systems and CI infrastructure that every iOS engineer at Uber depends on. Every change to Uber’s iOS apps—Rider, Driver, Uber Eats, and more—flows through the build. In this role, you will own the iOS build end to end: the Bazel build graph and rules, Apple toolchains, remote caching, and the CI pipelines that verify every change before it lands. You will set the technical direction for making iOS builds faster, more reliable, and cheaper at monorepo scale, and lead the cross\-team work to get there. **What You’ll Do** * Own the iOS build end to end: the Bazel build graph, Starlark rules and toolchains for Swift, Objective\-C, and Apple platforms, and dependency management across a large, multi\-app iOS monorepo. * Drive down CI and local build latency through remote build caching, remote execution on macOS workers, build\-graph optimization, critical\-path parallelism, and cost\-aware CI sharding. * Improve local and CI consistency through aligned Xcode, SDK, compiler, and test configurations, so developers can reliably reproduce CI checks locally. * Make every build failure actionable: eliminate flakiness and cache\-correctness issues, add per\-target telemetry and smarter retry policies, and ensure engineers and AI coding agents know what failed, how to fix it, and who to contact. * Keep the iOS build modern: lead Bazel and Swift toolchain upgrades, along with build\-rule and dependency\-automation improvements, as coordinated campaigns that minimize disruption. * Improve the Xcode development workflow, including project generation, indexing, debugging, and simulator integration, in partnership with iOS Platform. * Partner on smart test selection over the shared Bazel graph so each change runs only the tests it can affect, without sacrificing quality. * Define and track build health—latency, success rate, cache hit rate, flakiness, and resource utilization—and catch regressions before developers feel them. * Lead through influence: write design docs, set standards, mentor engineers, lead build incident response, and partner with iOS Platform, CI Platform, and product teams to land changes across the organization. **Basic Qualifications** * A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 8\+ years of full\-time software engineering experience. * A systematic approach to problem\-solving and knowledge of algorithms, data structures, and complexity analysis. * Strong understanding of iOS development, Swift, and the Apple development ecosystem. **Preferred Qualifications** * Deep, hands\-on experience with Bazel or Buck for iOS builds, including build\-graph design and dependency management; experience with Bazel’s Starlark rules, rules\_apple, and rules\_swift is a plus. * Remote build caching and remote execution, including the Remote Execution API, macOS worker infrastructure, and cache correctness across Xcode and SDK versions. * iOS build internals: Xcode build systems, Swift and Clang compilation, Swift/Objective\-C interoperability, module dependencies, linking, resource processing, app bundling, and code signing. * Optimizing Swift compilation, incremental builds, module boundaries, and dependency graphs in large codebases. * Xcode project generation and developer workflows, including indexing, debugging, and simulator support for Bazel\-based projects. * CI systems at scale, such as Buildkite: macOS fleet utilization, sharding, test orchestration, and flaky\-test management. * iOS test infrastructure: XCTest, XCUITest, snapshot testing, and simulator lifecycle management at scale. * Build performance analysis and observability using Bazel profiles, Build Event Protocol, compiler timing data, metrics, and regression dashboards. * Leading large\-scale build migrations or upgrades, such as Buck/Xcode to Bazel, Bazel major versions, Bzlmod adoption, or Xcode and Swift upgrades. * Experience building developer tools in Swift, Go, or Python; familiarity with Objective\-C and mixed\-language iOS codebases. * Applying LLMs and AI agents to developer tooling, such as automated build\-failure diagnosis. This position works closely with internal and external partners to create cost\-effective systems that meet state and federal standards, ensure accurate financial transactions, and protect the health and safety of citizens. **This position may require on\-call or after\-hours support** for the Origin batch process, as well as the ability to adapt across all functional coding areas when needed. As a mentor to junior team members, you will help us to develop and build our diverse work family. **This role is a hybrid of remote work and in\-office work. Remote work is embraced to the fullest extent possible without interfering with business. There is an expectation of reporting to the Salem office once a month for scheduled team meetings. jobs.title: Principal Infrastructure Security Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About the role** You will be the senior technical authority on how Unity's infrastructure is secured. Unity runs a high\-scale production platform across GCP, AWS, and Azure, built on Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD pipelines, alongside a large corporate environment. It powers the engine, cloud services, and ads business behind games played by billions of people, and a fast\-growing set of AI and agentic workloads. This is a high\-craft individual contributor role with company\-wide reach. You will set the security architecture and standards for our infrastructure, make the hard technical calls, and build the guardrails and paved roads that make the secure path the default path for engineering. You will be the most senior individual contributor in the security organization: the escalation point for technical ICs, the security voice with architects across Unity (not only those in security), and a peer and sounding board to the security leadership team. You will lead through influence: partnering with platform and engineering leaders, guiding senior engineers across the security team, and helping leadership decide where to invest. **What you will own** --------------------- * **Infrastructure security architecture**: set the target security architecture and standards for our multi\-cloud environments, and drive adoption across platform and engineering teams. * **Cloud and Kubernetes security**: design and build guardrails for cloud accounts, Kubernetes and container platforms, networks, and workloads, using infrastructure as code and policy as code. * **Identity and secrets**: lead the architecture for workload and non\-human identity, just\-in\-time and least\-privilege access, PKI, and secrets and key management. * **Software supply chain**: secure our build and release path, including CI/CD platform security, artifact integrity, image signing, and admission controls. * **AI and agentic infrastructure**: set the security patterns for AI workloads and agents running in our infrastructure, including data boundaries, identity, and permissions. * **Risk and prioritization**: lead threat modeling and design reviews on company\-level architecture and major changes, improve the processes teams use to assess and reduce risk, and advise leadership on which investments reduce the most risk. * **Technical leadership**: act as the escalation point for technical ICs and the consulting architect for security decisions, mentor senior engineers, raise the technical bar across the security organization, and partner with Offensive Security, Security Operations, and GRC. **What success looks like in the first 12 months** -------------------------------------------------- * A published infrastructure security architecture and multi\-year technical roadmap, agreed with security and platform leadership. * Guardrails and paved roads in place for our highest\-risk cloud and Kubernetes environments, with adoption measured. * Measurable reduction in standing privileged access and static credentials, moving toward just\-in\-time access and short\-lived credentials. * A secured software supply chain path, with signed artifacts and deploy\-time enforcement on critical services. * Security patterns defined for AI and agentic workloads, and applied to new launches before release. * Security controls that produce audit evidence automatically, reducing manual compliance work for engineering. **What you bring** ------------------ ### **Required** * 12\+ years in security or infrastructure engineering, including substantial time as a principal, staff, or architect\-level engineer on large\-scale systems, or as the hands\-on security leader of a smaller organization. * Deep, hands\-on expertise in cloud security across at least two of GCP, AWS, or Azure, including identity, networking, and workload security. * Strong experience securing Kubernetes, containers, and CI/CD at scale. * Hands\-on engineering ability with infrastructure as code (for example Terraform) and a programming language (for example Go or Python). You build and prototype yourself. * Track record of setting technical direction and standards that other teams adopted, without direct authority. * Ability to explain technical risk and trade\-offs clearly to engineers, senior leaders, and auditors. * You build strong relationships with architects and engineers across the company and can lead technical discussions with executives. You enjoy working as part of a team, sharing ideas, offering support, and celebrating wins together. ### **Preferred** * Experience with zero trust, just\-in\-time access, workload identity, and PKI at scale. * Experience securing AI and agentic systems in production infrastructure. Base Salary Range: We determine the base salary range for this role based on your primary work location: Zone A: $220,000 \- $330,000 USD gross Zone B: $248,600 \- $373,000 USD gross Zone C: $279,400 \- $419,200 USD gross *This range reflects the anticipated base salary for this position. Beyond base salary, this role may be eligible for equity awards and participation in our company incentive plans (such as annual discretionary bonuses or sales commissions). The final offer amount will depend on several factors, including geographic location and the candidate’s relevant experience, professional background, and skill set.* **Benefits** At Unity, we want our team members to thrive. We offer a wide range of benefits designed to support well\-being and work\-life balance. Please note: Benefits eligibility, specific offerings, and coverage vary based on the country and employment status. While specific benefits vary, here are some of the ways we strive to take care of our eligible team members globally: Comprehensive health, life, and disability insurance \| Commute subsidy \| Employee stock ownership \| Competitive retirement/pension plans \| Generous vacation and personal days \| Support for new parents through leave and family\-care programs \| Office food snacks \| Mental Health and Wellbeing programs and support \| Employee Resource Groups \| Global Employee Assistance Program \| Training and development programs \| Volunteering and donation matching program **Life at Unity** Unity \[NYSE: U] is the world’s leading game engine, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. The top mobile games in the world, the most played PC indie titles, the most innovative console games, and virtually all of the top XR and Web Games are developed, deployed, and grown in Unity. Unity also enables teams across industries like automotive, manufacturing, and healthcare to design, simulate, and collaborate in 3D — closing the gap between ideas and reality. For more information, please visit www.unity.com. *Unity is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and celebrate our employees across age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law. Our differences are strengths that enable us to support the growing and evolving needs of our customers, partners, and collaborators. If you have a disability that means there are preparations or accommodations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please fill out* *this form* *to let us know.* *Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.* *This position requires the incumbent to have a sufficient knowledge of English to have professional verbal and written exchanges in this language since the performance of the duties related to this position requires frequent and regular communication with colleagues and partners located worldwide and whose common language is English.* *Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this Web site or directly to managers. Unity does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Unity will not pay fees to any third\-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Unity.* *Your privacy is important to us. Please take a moment to review our**Prospect* *and**Applicant* *Privacy Policies. Should you have any concerns about your privacy, please contact us at DPO@unity.com.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world. **Software Engineer — Publishing Platform** Downtown Music Publishing is looking for a driven individual to join us as a **Software Engineer** to help build our next\-generation music publishing platform from the ground up. You'll help in shaping the architecture, tooling, and engineering culture of a catalog management platform that powers musical work registration, rights tracking, and royalty collection for publishers worldwide. Currently seeking candidates local to the Nashville Area. **What you'll do** * Build a new platform from first principles — data model, API design, and infrastructure — rather than maintaining legacy systems, while making pragmatic decisions that hold up at production scale. * Design and implement a schema\-first GraphQL API (Apollo Server) over PostgreSQL, including multi\-tenant data isolation (row\-level security), type\-safe query layers, and performance patterns like DataLoader batching. * Develop React/TypeScript (Next.js) interfaces used by both internal teams and clients to manage catalogs, registrations, and data\-quality workflows. * Build AI\-native features as a core part of the product: AI\-assisted data ingestion and matching, agent\-accessible APIs via Model Context Protocol (MCP), and LLM\-powered workflows using the Vercel AI SDK and Amazon Bedrock. * Work in an AI\-augmented, spec\-driven development workflow — architecture specs, agent\-assisted implementation, and rigorous automated review are how the team ships, not an experiment on the side. * Own components end\-to\-end: design, implementation, integration testing against real databases, deployment (AWS CDK), and operational responsibility. * Model and implement music publishing domain logic — works, writers, shares, agreements, and society registration formats (e.g., CWR) — with the precision that financial and rights data demands. **You are / have** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, software development, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of experience developing web\-based software solutions. * Experience architecting new systems or services from scratch — you're comfortable with ambiguity, and you document the "why" behind decisions, not just the "what." * Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js across the full stack. * Solid relational database fundamentals: schema design, migrations, transactions, and query performance in PostgreSQL (or similar). * Experience with both traditional software development lifecycle and agentic software development — including spec\-driven development, AI\-augmented engineering, and working effectively with coding agents. * Interest in the music industry — prior experience with rights management, royalties, or metadata standards (CWR, DDEX, ISWC/ISRC) is a plus, not a requirement. **Ideally, significant experience with some of the following technologies or similar tools:** **Backend:** Node.js, GraphQL (Apollo Server, schema\-first), PostgreSQL, etc. **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, modern state management (e.g., Zustand) **AI/Agents:** Vercel AI SDK, SpecKit, CodeX, Amazon Bedrock, Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLM tool design. **Infrastructure:** AWS (including CDK), Docker, Terraform, GitHub Actions **Testing:** Vitest, Testcontainers (integration testing against real databases), Playwright **Observability:** Datadog, Sentry, structured logging **Perks Playlist:** Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer): * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage * Including 100% coverage for out\-patient in\-network mental health services * Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants * Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year) * Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement * **401(k) with 100% immediate vesting** on the first 5% of your contributions, plus an additional UMG contribution A variety of ways to prioritize much\-needed time away from work including: * Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for exempt employees * 3\-weeks PTO for non\-exempt employees * 2\-weeks paid Winter Break * 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day) * Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day) * Generous paid parental leave for every type of parent Check out our full overview of benefits on the Perks Playlist page of the career site. **Disclaimer: This job description only provides an overview of job responsibilities that are subject to change.** **Universal Music Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer** We are an E\-Verify employer in Alabama, Arizona, Georgia, Mississippi, North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Utah. Please note, UMG is not enrolled in E\-Verify in California and New York, and cannot support employment of candidates whose employer must enroll in E\-Verify, for example candidates on STEM\-OPT. jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **JOIN OUR TEAM TODAY** ----------------------- Universal Stainless \& Alloy Products, Inc., established in 1994, is headquartered in Bridgeville, PA, with plants in North Jackson, OH, Dunkirk, NY, and Titusville, PA. Universal Stainless produces semi\-finished and finished specialty steel long products and plate including stainless steel, tool steel, bearing steel, gear steel, and aircraft quality low alloy steels for use in a variety of industries. Universal is committed to providing the best quality, delivery, and service possible. The Site Reliability Maintenance Engineer is a key player in Universal Stainless’ newly created Reliability Program. This position is responsible for identifying and managing reliability improvements to steel\-producing equipment and facilities, minimizing downtime, and supporting operational efficiency through predictive and preventative maintenance programs. This position is located at North Jackson, OH. The position is plant\-based and reports to the Preventative Maintenance Engineer designated for each location. **Basic Responsibilities:** --------------------------- * On a regular basis, access and search the CMMS (Maximo) and other equipment databases for information as needed. * Analyze and update engineering standards based on equipment failure data and lessons learned. * Work independently on special initiative projects under the direction of the Corporate Preventative Maintenance Engineer. * Lead or participate in Equipment Criticality Assessments, Critical Spares Analyses, Root Cause Analyses, and FMEA. * Provide technical expertise to plant personnel on troubleshooting failures and repairs, and evaluate equipment reliability and design improvements to meet intended or existing service conditions. * Work with the Engineering Department to ensure the reliability and maintainability of new and modified installations. * Periodically travel to other USAP sites to benchmark reliability initiatives and develop best practices. **Skills:** ----------- * Strong knowledge of mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems, specifically in a heavy industrial setting. * Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot complex equipment issues. * Ability to manage time, prioritize tasks, and maintain accurate records with minimal direction. * Ability to collaborate effectively and work cross\-functionally with other departments. * Accurate and meticulous record\-keeping. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with different locations. * Strong knowledge of and adherence to safety policies and procedures. **Experience:** --------------- * 5\+ years of experience in heavy industrial or manufacturing environments; steelmaking experience preferred. * IBM Maximo EAM experience preferred. * Reliability\-centered maintenance experience. **Education:** -------------- * B.S. in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or relevant equivalent education. Universal Stainless is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

jobs.title: AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** **The eScience Institute has an outstanding opportunity for an AI Engineer to join their team.** **About this Opportunity** As part of the university’s AI@UW Initiative, the eScience Institute has an outstanding opportunity for an AI Research Engineer with strengths in research applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI). As a member of the newly formed UW AI Corps within our broader eScience Institute team and the AI@UW initiative, the AI Research Engineer will participate in expanding campus\-wide opportunities at the intersection of AI, data science, and disciplinary domains through collaborative research, consultation, support of curriculum development, development of AI training programs and community building initiatives. The eScience Institute works with researchers and students in all fields across the University of Washington to answer fundamental and transformative questions. As the hub of data\-intensive discovery on campus, we lead a community of innovators in the techniques, technologies, and best practices of data science and AI. Positions within the AI Corps in the eScience Institute provide guidance and expertise to the University of Washington community, including students, post\-docs, staff and faculty on the best\-practices for, and appropriate application of ML, generative AI, and data science methods. In addition, they are expected to support researchers in developing AI workflows and provide guidance on selecting the appropriate tools and computational infrastructure to complete research tasks. These interactions may be structured around a set of programmatic and thematic activities that are core to the eScience Institute mission as well as developing technical tutorials and other university wide offerings. The AI Research Engineer contributes directly to projects with real\-world impact, solving complex research problems across disciplines using cutting\-edge AI techniques, and involves working with faculty, staff, and students from across the campus in a variety of formal and informal settings. **Key Responsibilities** **AI Research \& Technical Collaboration (40%)** * Collaborate with researchers across UW to advance research and scholarship rooted in AI and data\-intensive methods, proactively proposing and executing practical solutions to research challenges. * Build AI system workflows, pipelines, and infrastructure to support research teams. * Serve as the go\-to expert on AI tools, methods, and responsible use, advising on approaches that are technically sound, ethically grounded, and aligned with institutional values. Contribute to collaborative research outputs such as publications, reports, and open\-source tools that advance the field and amplify the Institute's impact. * **Teaching \& Community Engagement (40%)** * Develop and lead workshops, short courses, and training programs that foster AI literacy and support thoughtful integration of AI into research design and execution. * Support faculty and staff in the creation and use of AI in educational settings. * Create user\-facing resources including guides, tutorials, and code notebooks enabling researchers and students to learn and apply AI methods independently. * Participate in core Institute programs such as the Data Science \& AI Accelerator. * Collaborate with campus partners including academic departments, AI@UW (campus\-wide AI initiative), UW\-IT (UW Information Technology), and UW Libraries to advance shared goals around research innovation and responsible AI integration. Evaluate the effectiveness of educational offerings and iterate based on participant feedback and learning outcomes. * **Organizational Service (10%)** * Participate actively in core team meetings, planning activities, and Institute\-wide initiatives. * Provide weekly office hours open to the campus community Serve on standing and ad hoc committees contributing to shared governance and institutional health. * **Ongoing skill development (10%)** Dedicate time to independent study and hands\-on experimentation with emerging AI tools, models, and research methods relevant to the Institute's work. * **Required Qualifications** To be considered for this opportunity your application must demonstrate you meet both the minimum qualifications and additional qualifications listed below. Equivalent education and/or experience may substitute for minimum qualifications except when there are legal requirements, such as a license, certification, and/or registration. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in a Research or Engineering Field * Four years of professional or educational experience using advance computational techniques. * **Applicants who do not meet these qualifications WILL NOT be forwarded to the Hiring Manager.** **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience with appropriate application of ML, generative AI, and data science methods in several research areas. Previous experience with collaborative open source software development. * **Application Requirement** Cover Letter Questions: * Describe a workshop, tutorial, or training you designed or led. How did you decide what to include, and how did you know whether people learned the material? * Tell us about an AI or data pipeline you built. What tradeoffs did you make, and what would you do differently today? Why does a role centered on supporting others’ research and learning appeal to you compared with a role focused on your own research agenda? * **Visa Sponsorship** This recruitment is open to applicants who will require employer sponsorship for an H\-1B or E\-3 visa. **Compensation, Benefits and Position Details** **Pay Range Minimum:** $103,200\.00 annual **Pay Range Maximum:** $120,000\.00 annual **Other Compensation:** * **Benefits:** For information about benefits for this position, visit https://www.washington.edu/jobs/benefits\-for\-uw\-staff/ **Shift:** First Shift (United States of America) **Temporary or Regular?** This is a regular position **FTE (Full\-Time Equivalent):** 100\.00% **Union/Bargaining Unit:** UAW Research **About the UW** Working at the University of Washington provides a unique opportunity to change lives – on our campuses, in our state and around the world. UW employees bring their boundless energy, creative problem\-solving skills and dedication to building stronger minds and a healthier world. In return, they enjoy outstanding benefits, opportunities for professional growth and the chance to work in an environment known for its diversity, intellectual excitement, artistic pursuits and natural beauty. **Our Commitment** The University of Washington is committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful and welcoming community for all. As an equal opportunity employer, the University considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin, citizenship, sex, pregnancy, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, disability, or veteran status consistent with UW Executive Order No. 81 . To request disability accommodation in the application process, contact the Disability Services Office at 206\-543\-6450 or dso@uw.edu . Applicants considered for this position will be required to disclose if they are the subject of any substantiated findings or current investigations related to sexual misconduct at their current employment and past employment. Disclosure is required under Washington state law .

jobs.title: Research Software Engineer III/IV
jobs.description: **Job no:** 542039 **Work type:** Staff Full\-Time **Location:** Main Campus (Gainesville, FL) **Categories:** Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence **Department:**14500000 \- IT\-RC RESEARCH COMPUTING **Classification Title:** Research Software Engineer III **Classification Minimum Requirements:** **RSE Level III:** A Bachelor’s Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and five years of experience; Master’s Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and three years of experience; Doctoral Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and one year of experience. **RSE Level IV:** A Bachelor’s Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and seven years of experience; Master’s Degree in computer or physical science, software engineering, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and five years of experience; Doctoral Degree in computer or physical science, statistics, bioinformatics, data science or AI, or similar field and three years of experience. Applicants will be considered at the level for which they qualify. Appropriate college coursework or vocational/technical training may substitute at an equivalent rate for the required *experience* but does not negate the minimum degree requirement(s). **Job Description:** UF Information Technology (UFIT) is seeking a professional\-level Research Software Engineer to join Research Computing, a unit within UFIT. The applicant is expected to work at locations across the campus to work closely with faculty and their research teams on software engineering in computational, data processing, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) projects in research and education. The final applicant will be considered at the level for which they qualify. UF Information Technology (UFIT) enables teaching, learning, research, and service on campus and across the region with state\-of\-the\-art enterprise IT systems, including SEC and SUS universities, and the opportunity to teach using HiPerGator. UF has been operating HiPerGator for close to a decade. It is the fastest supercomputer owned and operated by a university in the USA. HiPerGator has become a critical service for UF because of the growth of the community of researchers, faculty, students, and collaborators that UF Research Computing serves, not only in size but also in the breadth of research domains. The workloads running on HiPerGator cover a wide range of research disciplines, from physical science and engineering to medicine and drug discovery, as well as business, law, arts and humanities. The demand for HiPerGator’s computing power to carry out research in foundational and agentic AI has also dramatically increased with UF’s AI Initiative in all aspects of human activity. The University of Florida is seeking people who are looking for an exciting career supporting the research performed by world\-class faculty and their students and collaborators in their quest to solve the most challenging problems facing the world today. The people in these positions are part of a collaborative team that values innovative ideas and viewpoints, and they will be expected to work closely in faculty\-led teams on software engineering projects. This position will involve constant learning and professional development. If you think this environment is a match for you or an exciting challenge, you are encouraged to use the cover letter to explain why you are a good fit. Some key responsibilities and characteristics of this position are: * Learn through independent study, reading textbooks and research papers, and online learning materials about problem domains in which work is needed. * Design, program, document, debug, test, deploy, and maintain software for specific projects in diverse scientific and scholarly domains. * Follow best practices for software engineering and data science, large\-scale computing, AI, digital twin, and cybersecurity. * Often, software to be developed will be open source, new, or a contribution to an existing tool, library, or framework. * Act as a consultant and mentor on software engineering principles for the project team you are part of for a given project. * Contribute to papers and documentation to be produced as deliverables of the assigned project. * Optimize code for performance and maintainability. * Keep updated on new developments in software engineering techniques and tools that could improve research outcomes. Professional development opportunities: * Learn the underlying science for the software you are developing with the project team. * Access a community of professionals who are committed to providing excellent research computing support. * Take training through various options ranging from workshops and online training certif y\-building collaboration for our state, our nation, and our world. UF is in Gainesville, a city of approximately 150,000 residents in North\-Central Florida, 50 miles from Florida’s West Coast, 67 miles from the Atlantic Ocean, and within a 2\-hour drive to large metropolitan areas (Orlando, Tampa, Jacksonville). The beautiful climate and extensive nearby parks and recreational areas afford year\-round outdoor activities, including hiking, biking, and nature photography. UF’s large college sports programs, museums, and performing arts center support various activities and cultural events for residents to enjoy. Learn more about what Gainesville has to offer at Visit Gainesville. **Exceptional Benefits** UF provides various leave programs based on an employee’s salary plan, including vacation, sick leave, holidays, personal leave days, and paid family leave. In addition to paid time off, the University of Florida offers a very competitive benefits package. **Expected Salary:** RSE III: $90,000\-$110,000; commensurate based on education and experience. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Pricing Platform
jobs.description: **About Upstart** At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital\-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80\+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital\-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in\-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in\-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. **The Team:** Upstart's Core Pricing team drives key initiatives that directly influence our revenue streams, unit economics, and product strategy. The team builds and evolves the common systems used to translate underwriting insights into accurate risk and profitability decisions for every loan we originate, while enabling a seamless borrower experience across products. As a Principal Software Engineer on Core Pricing, you will provide technical leadership that spans engineering, machine learning, and product organizations — not just the Pricing team. You will shape the long\-term architecture, strategy, and operating model for pricing systems that serve multiple product lines and stakeholders across the company. Working in close partnership with engineering, ML, product, and business leaders across Personal Loans, Auto, HELOC, and adjacent platforms, you will lead the development of scalable, low\-latency, highly reliable services that convert ML underwriting outputs into pricing decisions, and you will help define the future of Upstart's pricing platform as the company expands into new products, markets, and capabilities. Our stack spans Python (Django, FastAPI, Celery), Kotlin/Spring Boot, gRPC/Protobuf, Temporal for workflow orchestration, AWS (S3, RDS/Postgres, ElastiCache), Kubernetes/Helm, and Datadog for observability. **How you'll make an impact** * Define the cross\-company technical vision and roadmap for Upstart's pricing platform, ensuring alignment across Pricing, Personal Loans, Auto, HELOC, ML, and Product organizations. * Lead the architectural evolution from tightly coupled, sequential workflows toward modular, reusable platform capabilities across loan products. * Design and improve Tier 0/Tier 1 services where latency, throughput, availability, and financial correctness are all critical. * Partner closely with machine\-learning scientists and engineers to create reliable, scalable boundaries between models and production pricing systems. * Balance the sometimes\-competing needs of engineering, machine learning, and product teams across organizations, making pragmatic trade\-offs that serve Upstart's broader technical and business strategy. * Clarify service, API, configuration, and ownership boundaries across Pricing, Personal Loans, Auto, HELOC, and adjacent platform teams. * Evaluate runtime and language choices pragmatically, including where Python, Kotlin, Rust or Go best serve long\-term system needs. * Reduce operational burden through better testing, observability, failure isolation, incident learning, and architecture that limits blast radius. * Lead company\-wide technical discussions, surface trade\-offs clearly, and build alignment across Engineering, ML, Product, Data, Security, Compliance, and business partners. * Stay close to implementation through design reviews, prototypes, and critical code while mentoring senior technical leaders and making the people around you more successful. * Prioritize technical\-debt and platform investments based on business value, risk reduction, and long\-term return rather than technical elegance alone. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field \- or equivalent practical experience \- plus 8 or more years of software engineering experience. * A track record of setting architecture and technical direction for large, complex distributed  ancial systems, or other quantitative domains. * Experience in a rapidly scaling or changing organization where architecture had to evolve alongside the business. **Position location** Remote **Travel requirements** As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: ###### **About Vasion** For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration. So we created simple, cost\-effective, and easy\-to\-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal. ###### **About the role** At Vasion, we make print intelligent. Intelligent Print Automation treats File \> Print as the entry point to a workflow rather than the end of one: the moment a document is created or captured, it becomes structured, secure, auditable data instead of a page that disappears. Three products run on one cloud\-native platform — serverless print management that eliminates print servers, drivers, and scripts; output management that moves business\-critical ERP print off legacy on\-premise infrastructure; and document automation that captures, classifies, and routes documents with AI at the point of capture, built on AWS Bedrock with connectors into Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure AI, and others. More than 14,000 organizations run on the platform, concentrated in healthcare, government, education, financial services, and manufacturing. We are FedRAMP High Authorized, ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 certified, and SOC 2 Type II audited. This role owns where that platform meets the device: the embedded control panel application (CPA) that runs on multifunction printers from HP, Xerox, Ricoh, Canon, and others. The panel is where a user authenticates, releases a job, and starts a scan — the moment print stops being paper and becomes an intelligent workflow. We are a cloud\-native and agent\-native product organization, and we expect our product managers to work that way. ###### **Why This Role Exists** Millions of the documents that move through business organizations still start or end at a multifunction printer. This role owns that moment: what the application does at the device panel, how it authenticates a user, how it releases a job, how it captures a scan, and how it stays consistent across thousands of devices from different manufacturers. The panel is where digital transformation meets paper, and our platform is reinventing what happens there — turning that critical physical step in the document lifecycle into the first intelligent one. We are building the AI and cloud\-native MFP applications of the future, with no customer infrastructure behind them. Just as we eliminated print servers in print management, we are removing the infrastructure that supports the MFP so the platform meets customers where they already are: any device, any manufacturer, any identity provider, any location, and nothing to install in between. Zero trust by default, and it just works. This role owns that surface — what we build at the panel, which manufacturers get it and in what order, and what the experience becomes for the thousands of organizations that reach us there every day. ###### **What you'll do** * **The embedded Control Panel Application (CPA) across supported manufacturers.** Own the roadmap, requirements, and release decisions for the CPA: secure print release, panel authentication (badge and proximity card, PIN, SSO through customer identity providers), copy and scan, administration and installation, fleet management, cost and quota management, automation and AI solutions at the device, etc. Decide what ships natively per platform versus what runs through a shared cloud service, and defend the trade\-off. * **Driving the platform to zero customer infrastructure.** Own the sequence that takes each manufacturer to a no\-infrastructure experience — authentication, scanning, and installation handled without anything running in the customer's environment. Decide what "infrastructure\-less" means per platform, what is committed versus targeted, and how customers on the current architecture get to the new one without disruption. * **Multi\-manufacturer capability strategy.** Maintain the capability matrix across every supported platform. Decide which manufacturers get which features first, sequence work against each OEM's firmware and certification calendar, and make explicit calls about where we accept a platform limitation versus invest to work around it. * **Capture and document workflows at the device.** Own scanning and capture: OCR, destinations and cloud connectors (SharePoint, OneDrive, Google Drive, email, etc.), and metadata. Drive the shift from scan\-to\-folder toward document intelligence and agent\-assisted capture at the point of scan. * **Security and compliance posture at the panel.** Partner with security and compliance to keep the on\-devi u can reason about SDKs, APIs, and authentication (SSO and identity providers, badge, PIN), understand how technical choices change the product, and hold your own with engineers on architectural trade\-offs. * Working AI fluency in your own practice. You use AI tools in real, repeatable workflows for research, analysis, documentation, or prototyping. * Strong written communication. You write briefs, requirements, and decision documents a cross\-functional team can act on. * Bachelor's degree in a related discipline or equivalent practical experience. * Working on\-site in Lehi or St. George is a significant plus. Fully remote is fine, with occasional travel to Utah. ###### **Preferred Qualifications** * Print, output management, document capture, or scanning domain experience. * Familiarity with printing standards and protocols: IPP, SNMP, Mopria, SOAP, etc. * Experience building for regulated and public\-sector buyers: healthcare (HIPAA, EMR printing), government (FedRAMP), education, or financial services, including zero trust and VDI environments. * Experience with serverless or cloud print, or a comparable migration off on\-premise servers. * Experience defining evaluation sets or shipping AI, machine learning, or document intelligence features in production. * Experience working directly with OEM developer and certification programs or a hardware partner ecosystem. ###### **What Good Looks Like** ###### **By 90 days** You have built a working command of the manufacturer capability matrix and are leading conversations about it rather than following them. You have talked with IT administrators and end users across at least two verticals, spent time at real devices across multiple brands, and established a point of view on the top constraints and opportunities in the embedded portfolio. ###### **By six months** You own the CPA roadmap outright. You have shipped at least one meaningful improvement to on\-device authentication, release, or capture; made and defended at least one hard per\-OEM sequencing decision; and instrumented the adoption and secure release metrics you are accountable for. ###### **By one year** Your area shows measurable movement: CPA adoption across the installed base, secure release reliability, and scan workflow completion trending up; field defect and support rates on device releases trending down. You are leading a managed, sequenced roadmap, and your team ships predictably against it. ###### **Benefits** * Flexible work environment * Discretionary Vacation Bonus * Flexible paid time off * Paid parental leave * Competitive pay * A full suite of traditional benefits * Training/Advancement opportunities * 401k with company match and immediate vesting * Mental health \& coaching support * Financial wellness education * Company\-contributed HSA * On\-site perks include gym, pickleball, snacks \& drinks, arcade, theater room, etc. ###### **Our Core Values** Vasion looks for people who will exemplify its four core values and are driven to become: * **Disruptive Visionaries:** Our customers are the heroes, and our role is to be a guide on their journey, truly listening and identifying the needs and wants of our customers. * **Relationship Builders:** We treat people as people, building strong relationships through empathy, compassion, and honest communication. * **Candor Seekers:** Candid conversations are critical to achieving objectives, and we nurture a culture of caring personally and challenging directly. * **Action Owners:** Every employee takes ownership of any failures and develops a plan to win, no matter their tenure or circumstance. ###### **More about Vasion** Visit https://www.vasion.com to learn more about Vasion. ###### **Additional Information** Vasion is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, age, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation and other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: Remote / Telecommuting (Candidate must reside within the State of Colorado; strong preference for local / Denver Metro candidates) The Data Engineer is responsible for realizing the vision of the Data Architect through the technical implementation of data pipelines using Snowflake and Informatica. Data Engineers are technical coding experts focused on moving data from line\-of\-business, transactional, or partner agency source systems into analytical data platforms, building transformations, managing data cleansing and quality, and presenting structured data for consumption by analysts and scientists. In the context of the Statewide Longitudinal Data System an Data Engineer is expected to join the project team in January 2027 under a shared delivery model with a 3rd party implementor. The Data Engineer will participate in a structured knowledge\-transfer progression (shadowing, co\-running, and checking), leading specific new source ingestions, and progressively will take over production operations and upkeep of the SLDS data foundation and analytics layer. 1\. Scope of Responsibilities Data Ingestion \& Pipeline Engineering: Design, develop, test, and deploy automated ETL/data pipelines in Informatica and Snowflake to ingest data from partner state agencies and third parties into the SLDS common data model. Transformation \& Analytics Layer Support: Implement transformation logic to convert raw agency feeds into harmonized, linked longitudinal records and analytics layer data models, adhering to core naming and modeling standards established with the Data Architect. Record Linkage \& Identity Matching: Execute the SLDS internal matching logic to link newly ingested agency records to master longitudinal student and workforce profiles, handling match exceptions and cross\-agency reconciliations. Production Pipeline Operations \& Incident Response: Maintain operational ownership of scheduled feed runs, monitoring job execution, resolving run failures, reloading late or corrected files, reconciling row counts, and rebuilding downstream objects. Data Quality \& Governance Compliance: Implement L1 (structural/format), L2 (completeness/de\-duplication), and L3 (referential integrity/logic) validation checks, layout\-change detection, and audit trails; enforce data privacy, suppression rules, and compliance standards (FERPA, COPPA, ADA, and state statutes). KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES * Experience executing source acceptance testing and collecting, validating, and communicating test data for complex manufacturing systems. * Skilled at interpreting work instructions, build sequences, specifications, and test requirements to complete system assembly accurately. * Working knowledge of structured troubleshooting, discrepancy resolution, and root\-cause analysis in a manufacturing environment. * Ability to identify practical improvements to assembly methods while following approved engineering change and escalation processes. * Skilled at explaining technical findings clearly to Manufacturing Engineering, Field Service Engineering, Technical Support, Software, Materials, and production team members. * Ability to coordinate final inspection activities, maintain quality standards, and guide less\-experienced engineers through complex builds. * Commitment to continuous learning, knowledge sharing, and reliable execution in a team\-based manufacturing environment. **Salary and Benefits** The expected salary range for this position is X—Y, plus a bonus opportunity. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Vercel Agent
jobs.description: * Engineering * New York City * Full Time **About Vercel:** ----------------- Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience. Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide. **About The Role:** ------------------- We’re looking for a Software *Engineer* to join the *Vercel* Agent team. Our mission is simple: deploying on *Vercel* should feel like adding a seasoned *infrastructure* *engineer* to your team. The *Vercel* Agent investigates incidents before you see them, fixes failing builds, reviews *code* with deep *production* context, and answers questions about your *running* app with the authority of someone who has read the logs. Today, this work spans multiple shipped *products:* automated *code* review on every PR, *AI*\-driven investigation of *production* anomalies, an intelligent support agent that resolves the majority of customer issues without human intervention, and conversational *code* *generation*. We’re now unifying these into a single agent that appears pervasively across surfaces (like the *Vercel* dashboard, *Vercel* CLI, Slack, and many more), and is capable of multi\-step reasoning, *code* execution in sandboxed environments, and taking real actions on your behalf. Two things we’re most excited about: **self\-driving** ***infrastructure***, where 90% of what requires manual DevOps today gets handled automatically by the *platform*; and **framework\-defined agents**, where the agent is customized to each customer’s application, injecting the right skills when they’re needed rather than dumping generic best practices. This is a small team with an outsized mandate. You’ll work directly with leadership and across *product,* *design*, and *infrastructure* teams to define what self\-driving *infrastructure* looks like — then *build* it. If you’re based within a pre\-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in\-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location\-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team. **What You Will Do:** --------------------- * *Design* and *build* agentic *systems* that autonomously investigate, diagnose, and remediate *production* issues — from 500 errors and *build* failures to *performance* regressions and security anomalies. * Architect multi\-step agent workflows that coordinate across tools, *APIs*, and sandboxed *code* execution environments, with durable state that survives crashes and timeouts. * *Build* the skills and *tool* *integrations* that give the agent deep knowledge of the *Vercel* *platform*, such as deployments, functions, logs, metrics, DNS, and the full lifecycle of a web application. * Ship polished, *user*\-facing experiences across multiple surfaces (Slack, dashboard, CLI) without waiting for a designer to hand you a mockup. This team values *engineers* with strong *product* and UI instincts. * *Develop* the *infrastructure* for dynamic skill injection, so the agent acquires new capabilities at runtime rather than through redeployment, routing the right logic to the right context at the right time. * Collaborate with other *engineers* on prompt *engineering,* model evaluation, and retrieval\-augmented *generation* (RAG) *pipelines* that ground the agent in accurate, up\-to\-date knowledge. **About You:** -------------- * 7\+ years of full\-time software *engineering* experience, with strong *TypeScript* proficiency. *Engineers* with deep Python experience who are excited to work in *TypeScript* are also a great fit. * A track record of *openness* and adaptability: you’ve shifted into new technologies, new domains, or new roles and thrived. This space is changing faster than anyone can claim expertise; we want people who learn and adapt, not people who play expert. * Strong *product* and UI sensibility. jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: ### **When you join Verizon** You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere \& always. Want in? Join the \#VTeamLife. ### **What you’ll be doing...** As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer within Verizon’s Transformation Command Center (TCC), you will embed directly into the frontline of Verizon’s core Business Units to solve our most critical, ambiguous, and high\-stakes operational challenges. Operating with technical ownership, you will help to architect, build, and deploy production\-grade agentic systems, enterprise RAG engines, full\-stack microservices, and decision systems into live operations. You are a technical anchor; you pair deep systems craftsmanship with a product mindset, cutting through operational ambiguity to design production architectures, implement custom orchestration layers (via LangGraph, Temporal, or custom state machines), and enforce context management strategies that scale into enterprise assets. Beyond shipping point solutions, you will run workloads reliably on Domino, Airflow, and Kubernetes, abstracting bespoke code into reusable SDKs, shared libraries, and architectural playbooks that scale company\-wide. Key Responsibilities include: * End\-to\-End Architectural Understanding: Utilizing the full\-stack architecture for embedded AI initiatives, including multi\-agent orchestration, state machines, latency/cost budgets, security boundaries, and enterprise back\-end integrations. * Agentic Orchestration Engineering, Workflow Automation and Governance: Implementing stateful agent workflows complying with established agentic governance rules, using tools like LangGraph, Temporal, or event\-driven state machines, establishing strict protocols for tool calling, execution sandboxing, and deterministic fallback logic. * Context \& Retrieval Systems: Designing production RAG infrastructure incorporating hybrid search, re\-ranking algorithms, metadata filtering, and semantic caching, directly informing and scaling Verizon’s context architecture. * Runtime \& Cloud Deployment: Deploying production agent services and scheduled workflows to target runtimes (e.g., Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes microservices, and serverless compute across AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Evaluation Harness Design: Architecting offline and online evaluation frameworks (e.g., LLM\-as\-a\-judge, synthetic test generation, human\-in\-the\-loop review queues, live A/B rollouts) to measure model drift, context hallucination rates, and task completion metrics. * Platform Codification: Generalizing custom domain deployments into reusable internal SDKs, API primitives, and modular UI components. * Strategic Discovery \& Scoping: Embed alongside BU leadership to map intricate operational processes, cut through organizational noise, and isolate the highest\-leverage intervention points where applied AI delivers measurable uplift. * Executive Translation: Serving as a technical engineer in the room with Directors and above, demystifying algorithmic behaviors, failure modes, and performance trade\-offs. **What we’re looking for...** You’ll need to have: * Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. * Four or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through work experience and/or military experience. * Extensive hands\-on experience leveraging frontier LLMs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) and agentic developer frameworks (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build scalable solutions and achieve core business milestones. * A strong foundation in statistics and machine learning, applied to problems such as forecasting, prioritization, or optimization. * Strong proficiency in Python and modern TypeScript/Node.js for full\-stack API integration and backend orchestration. * Experience with containerized deployments (Docker), API design, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure). * Proven track record implementing both offline evaluation benchmarks and online evaluation/observability pipelines (latency, token costs, hallucination tracking, eval\-driven development). * Proven experience deploying containerized services and data workflows across enterprise platforms such as Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), and hyperscaler cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure). * Proven track record designing offline/online eval harnesses, guardrail frameworks, and observability systems (latency, token optimization, tracing). * Demonstrated ability to interface directly   layer platforms. * Three or more years shipping production software and/or demonstrated experience deploying LLM applications, agentic workflows, or autonomous tool\-calling pipelines into production. * Demonstrated ability to independently scope ambiguous technical initiatives and present architectural designs to senior executive stakeholders. * Prior forward\-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting experience in top\-tier technology firms or hyperscalers. * Record of turning one\-off operational builds into enterprise\-wide shared libraries, with associated technical publications or filed patents. * Domain knowledge in telecommunications, network capacity optimization, capital planning, or large\-scale customer care operations. * Deep expertise in retrieval and context architectures: designing production RAG pipelines, vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, Pinecone), hybrid search (dense \+ sparse/lexical), and dynamic context management. * Advanced full\-stack programming mastery in Python, SQL, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript stacks. * Demonstrated experience designing, building, validating, and deploying machine learning models for time series forecasting and analysis, including statistical methods (ARIMA/SARIMA, exponential smoothing, Prophet) and ML/deep learning approaches (gradient boosting such as XGBoost/LightGBM, LSTM, or transformer\-based models). * Proficient in time series feature engineering (lags, rolling windows, seasonality, holiday and event effects), handling missing data, outliers, and structural breaks, and applying backtesting and cross\-validation methods suited to temporal data. * Able to quantify forecast uncertainty with prediction intervals and scenario ranges, evaluate accuracy using metrics such as MAPE, RMSE, and MASE, and monitor deployed models for drift. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. ### **Where you’ll be working** In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.### **Scheduled Weekly Hours** 40### **Equal Employment Opportunity** Verizon is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to veteran status, disability or other legally protected characteristics. ### **Benefits and Compensation** Our benefits are designed to help you move forward in your career, and in areas of your life outside of Verizon. From health and wellness benefit options including: medical, dental, vision, short and long term disability, basic life insurance, supplemental life insurance, AD\&D insurance, identity theft protection, pet insurance and group home \& auto insurance. We also offer a matched 401(k) savings plan, up to 8 company paid holidays per year and up to 6 personal days per year, paid parental leave, adoption assistance and tuition assistance, plus other incentives, we’ve got you covered with our award\-winning total rewards package. Depending on the role, employees have the opportunity to receive compensation in the form of premium pay such as overtime, shift differential, holiday pay, allowances, etc. Newly hired employees receive up to 15 days of vacation per year, which grows with additional service. For part\-timers, your coverage will vary as you may be eligible for some of these benefits depending on your individual circumstances. The salary will vary depending on your location and confirmed job\-related skills and experience. This is an incentive based position with the potential to earn more. For part\-time roles, your compensation will be adjusted to reflect your hours. The annual salary range for the location(s) listed on this job requisition based on a full\-time schedule is: $81,000\.00 \- $155,000\.00\.

jobs.title: Assistant Professor - Artificial Intelligence in Civil and Environmental Engineering
jobs.description: * 538604 * Blacksburg, Virginia, United States * Civil \& Environmental Engineering * Engineering * Instructional / Teaching Faculty * Faculty (Salaried) * Virginia Tech **Job Description** The Charles E. Via, Jr. Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering at Virginia Tech invites applications for a tenure\-track Assistant Professor position from candidates with demonstrated expertise in developing, adapting, or applying artificial intelligence (AI) methods to address substantive civil and environmental engineering challenges. This open search welcomes candidates across all sub\-disciplines: construction engineering and management; environmental and water resources engineering; geotechnical engineering; structural engineering and materials; sustainable land development; and transportation infrastructure and systems engineering. The successful candidate will establish an externally funded research program and mentor students; contribute to undergraduate and graduate education that integrates AI with engineering fundamentals and professional practice; and contribute to departmental and professional service. Example research directions include AI\-enabled sensing and monitoring, physics\-informed modeling, digital twins, autonomous experimentation, and intelligent design and decision support for the built and natural environments. We particularly welcome approaches that integrate AI with engineering fundamentals to accelerate scientific discovery and address complex engineering challenges. Virginia Tech is making significant institutional investments in artificial intelligence, positioning AI as a strategic research priority. These investments include the Sanghani Center for Artificial Intelligence and Data Analytics, the Institute for Advanced Computing, expanded high\-performance computing and GPU resources through Advanced Research Computing (ARC), and HokieAI, a university\-supported platform providing secure access to AI tools. Together with world\-class laboratory facilities and a substantial presence in the Washington, D.C., region, these resources create opportunities for interdisciplinary research, collaboration with industry and federal agencies, and AI\-driven innovation across the built and natural environments. The CEE Department has 52 tenured/tenure\-track faculty and 8 professors of practice. Eight faculty are recent early investigator award recipients, and numerous other faculty are recognized nationally and internationally. The department is home to 741 undergraduate students and 255 full\-time graduate students. The civil and environmental engineering graduate programs are currently ranked 8th and 5th, respectively, and the civil and environmental engineering undergraduate programs are ranked 10th and 7th, respectively, by U.S. News \& World Report (USN\&WR). Primary responsibilities include: * Develop and sustain an externally funded research program that develops, adapts, or applies AI methods to civil and environmental engineering challenges * Teach undergraduate and graduate courses supporting the department's educational mission, including AI applications across CEE program areas * Advise and mentor graduate and undergraduate students * Publish scholarly work and disseminate research to academic, practitioner and public audiences * Contribute service to the department, college, university and profession **Required Qualifications** * Doctoral degree in civil engineering, environmental engineering, or a closely related discipline (such as computer science or electrical engineering), prior to the effective date of the appointment * Demonstrated research experience in developing, adapting or applying AI or machine learning methods to civil or environmental engineering problems, evidenced by peer\-reviewed publications or other substantive research outputs * A research plan in AI for civil and environmental engineering that could support external funding, as described in the research statement * Ability to teach undergraduate and graduate courses that integrate AI, computing, and data analytics with civil and environmental engineering, as described in the teaching statement * A strong record of academic accomplishments commensurate with rank, a proven ability to work collaboratively, and a commitment to interdisciplinary research and instruction **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience preparing or securing competitive external research funding, as PI, co\-PI or senior personnel * Experience applying AI methods to experimental, computational, field, or operational data from civil or environmental engineering systems * Experience with methods that combine AI with engineering knowledge, such as physics\-informed or hybrid models, uncertainty quantification, or interpretable models * Experience mentoring graduate or undergraduate students in research **Overtime Status** Exempt: Not eligible for overtime **Appointment Type** Regular **Salary Information** Commensurate with experience and qualifications. **Hours per week** 40 **Review Date** 1/4/2027 **Additional Information** The successful candidate will be required to have a criminal conviction check. **About Virginia Tech** Dedicated to its motto, *Ut Prosim* (That I May Serve), Virginia Tech pushes the boundaries of knowledge by taking a hands\-on, transdisciplinary approach to preparing scholars to be leaders and problem\-solvers. A comprehensive land\-grant institution that enhances the quality of life in Virginia and throughout the world, Virginia Tech is an inclusive community dedicated to knowledge, discovery, and creativity. The university offers more than 280 majors to a diverse enrollment of more than 36,000 undergraduate, graduate, and professional students in eight undergraduate colleges, a school of medicine, a veterinary medicine college, Graduate School, and Honors College. The university has a significant presence across Virginia, including Blacksburg, the greater Washington, D.C. area, the Health Sciences and Technology Campus in Roanoke, sites in Newport News and Richmond, and numerous Extension offices and research institutes. A leading global research institution, Virginia Tech conducts more than $650 million in research annually. Virginia Tech endorses and encourages participation in professional development opportunities and university shared governance. These valuable contributions to university shared governance provide important representation and perspective, along with opportunities for unique and impactful professional development. Virginia Tech does not discriminate against employees, students, or applicants on the basis of age, color, disability, sex (including pregnancy), gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, ethnicity or national origin, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, or military status, or otherwise discriminate against employees or applicants who inquire about, discuss, or disclose their compensation or the compensation of other employees or applicants, or on any other basis protected by law.
