jobs.description: **Data Engineer – Snowflake, Informatica CDGC, ETL/ELT \& Azure DevOps** **Job Details** **SEO\-Friendly Job Title:** Data Engineer – Snowflake ETL/ELT, Informatica CDGC, Terraform \& Azure DevOps **Job Title:** SLDS Data Engineer **Location:** Colorado (Remote) **Work Arrangement:** Remote / Telecommuting **Employment Type:** Temporary / Contract **Contract Duration:** 6 Months **Estimated Start Date:** January 4, 2027 **Estimated End Date:** June 30, 2027 **Candidate Pay Rate:** $65/hr W2 **Number of Openings:** 1 **Submission Deadline:** November 24, 2026 **Working Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8 hours per day **Working Hours:** 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM MST **Position Overview** The Data Engineer will be responsible for implementing and maintaining data pipelines, transformations, and data integration processes within a Statewide Longitudinal Data System (SLDS). This position focuses on translating data architecture designs into technical solutions using Snowflake and Informatica. The selected candidate will work with data from multiple state agencies and third\-party sources, transforming raw data into structured, reliable, and harmonized datasets for analytical and reporting purposes. The Data Engineer will collaborate with Data Architects, Data Scientists, Visualization Designers, Operations Engineers, and external implementation partners to develop automated ETL/ELT pipelines, implement data quality controls, perform identity matching, and maintain production data operations. The role will initially involve knowledge transfer and collaboration with an existing implementation partner, followed by progressively assuming responsibility for production operations and ongoing maintenance of the data foundation and analytics layer. The successful candidate will also support data governance, privacy compliance, performance optimization, testing, documentation, and release management. **Education Requirement** No specific educational qualification was provided. **Required Skills / Experience** * Minimum 5 years of demonstrated experience building, orchestrating, and optimizing complex ETL/ELT data pipelines and transformation logic natively within the Snowflake platform. * Minimum 1 year of hands\-on experience with Informatica Cloud Data Governance and Catalog (CDGC), including metadata management, data profiling, cataloging, and automated data quality validation. * Minimum 1 year of experience utilizing Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), including provisioning, configuring, and maintaining cloud infrastructure and resources. * Demonstrated proficiency implementing automated build, test, and release deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps. * Expert proficiency with Git and version control workflows, including branching strategies, pull requests, automated merge checks, and code reviews. * Strong experience developing, maintaining, and troubleshooting data pipelines and transformation processes. * Ability to perform data validation, cleansing, reconciliation, and quality checks. * Ability to work with structured data from multiple source systems and integrate it into analytical data platforms. * Must currently reside within the State of Colorado for the duration of the engagement. **Preferred Skills / Experience** * Prior experience working with public\-sector data systems. * Experience with longitudinal education and workforce data systems, such as CDE, CDHE, CDLE, CDEC, and National Student Clearinghouse. * Experience with record linkage, entity resolution, and deterministic or probabilistic identity matching across disparate public records. * Familiarity with federal and state student/workforce privacy regulations, including FERPA and COPPA. * Familiarity with cell suppression standards and data privacy requirements. * Experience authoring and executing structured test plans using Azure Test Plans. **Job Responsibilities** **1\. Data Ingestion \& Pipeline Engineering** * Design, develop, test, and deploy automated ETL/data pipelines using Informatica and Snowflake. * Ingest data from partner state agencies and third\-party sources into a common data model. * Develop data mappings and transformation processes based on established technical specifications. * Build and maintain scheduled data ingestion workflows. * Validate incoming data files and resolve data loading issues. **2\. Data Transformation \& Analytics Layer Support** * Transform raw agency data into harmonized, linked longitudinal records. * Develop and maintain analytics\-layer data models. * Follow established naming conventions, data modeling standards, and architecture specifications. * Maintain production views, tables, and transformation objects. * Support enhancements to reporting metrics and analytical datasets. **3\. Record Linkage \& Identity Matching** * Execute internal record\-matching processes to connect newly ingested agency records with existing student and workforce profiles. * Handle matching exceptions and cross\-agency data reconciliation. * Maintain identity\-matching routines and related documentation. **4\. Production Operations \& Incident Management** * Monitor scheduled data feed executions and pipeline operations. * Troubleshoot failed jobs and resolve data loading issues. * Reload late, corrected, or malformed data files. * Reconcile source\-file row counts against loaded records. * Rebuild downstream data objects when required. * Maintain operational procedures and runbooks. * Respond to ad\-hoc data inquiries and export requests. **5\. Data Quality \& Governance** * Implement L1 structural and format validation checks. * Implement L2 completeness and de\-duplication checks. * Implement L3 referential integrity and business logic validation. * Maintain layout\-change detection and audit trails. * Enforce data privacy requirements, suppression rules, and applicable compliance standards, including FERPA, COPPA, ADA, and state statutes. **6\. Performance Optimization** * Optimize Snowflake query execution, warehouse compute, and pipeline performance. * Identify and tune heavily used data models and performance bottlenecks. * Improve processing efficiency, cost, and latency. * Support ongoing maintenance of the data platform. **7\. Testing \& Release Management** * Develop and execute manual and automated test cases using Azure Test Plans. * Record testing evidence and resolve defects before production deployment. * Participate in peer code reviews. * Follow release processes across Development, Test, UAT, and Production environments. * Maintain release documentation and change logs. * Use Azure DevOps for development and deployment coordination. **8\. Collaboration \& Knowledge Transfer** * Work with external implementation partners during knowledge transfer and operational transition. * Shadow existing engineering teams and participate in co\-running production feed cycles. * Gradually assume independent responsibility for production operations. * Collaborate with Data Architects on physical and logical data models. * Support Data Scientists and Visualization Designers by integrating new data sources for Tableau dashboards. * Coordinate with Operations Engineers on Snowflake compute management, warehouse auto\-shutdown, user permissions, and CI/CD pipelines. **Ideal Candidate** The ideal candidate is an experienced Data Engineer with strong hands\-on expertise in Snowflake ETL/ELT development, Informatica CDGC, Terraform, Azure DevOps, and Git. The candidate should have experience building and maintaining complex data pipelines, integrating data from multiple sources, implementing data quality controls, and supporting production data environments. Experience with public\-sector, education, or workforce data systems and longitudinal record matching will be beneficial. The candidate must be comfortable collaborating with external implementation partners, participating in knowledge transfer, troubleshooting production issues, and progressively taking ownership of operational data engineering responsibilities. **Important:** Candidates must currently reside in Colorado throughout the engagement. Remote work is permitted, with a strong preference for candidates located in the Denver Metro area.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Simulator Orchestration
jobs.description: Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self\-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo's fully autonomous ride\-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider\-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15\+ U.S. states. ### **The Challenge** Waymo's simulator is one of the most complex virtual environments ever built. It blends deterministic logic, physical dynamics, and advanced AI to create a realistic training ground for the Waymo Driver. As we expand autonomous driving into new geographies, complex weather conditions, and next\-generation capabilities, our goal is to build a highly adaptable, generic simulator that works across any environment. The Simulator Orchestration team is at the heart of tackling this scaling challenge. Our mission is to deliver simulation solutions that power evaluation and training across a diverse range of challenging requirements. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer who is passionate about solving complex evaluation problems with simulation technology and thrives on delivering practical solutions within a vast technical ecosystem. ### **The Role** This is a hybrid role. As a core contributor to the Simulator Orchestration team, you will focus on solving practical simulation challenges by intelligently configuring and orchestrating simulator features. **You will:** * Architect Simulation Solutions: Drive the simulator development of the environments required for new initiatives, such as complex weather setups, new geography expansions (e.g., left\-hand traffic), and adapting the simulator to support next\-generation onboard capabilities. * Design the Orchestration Layer: Design and implement systems that dynamically select and compose simulator features based on the specific environment and context, bringing us closer to a truly universal simulator. * Navigate Complex Systems: Dive deep into a massive C\+\+ codebase of onboard and simulator code. You are willing to get your hands dirty. You will rely on strong code\-reading and debugging skills to trace and resolve complex interactions between different systems, shipping robust, production\-ready code. * Collaborate Across Boundaries: Act as the technical glue between teams. You'll partner closely with partners from Simulator, Eval and Onboard orgs, taking the building blocks they provide and turning them into complete, end\-to\-end simulation solutions. ### **What You Bring** We are looking for a strong generalist software engineer who leans heavily toward practical execution and is comfortable navigating large\-scale, interconnected systems. **You have:** * **Engineering Craftsmanship:** * + 5\+ years of industry experience in software development. + Solid proficiency in C\+\+ (preferred) or Python, with a strong ability to read, navigate, and debug large, existing codebases. + Experience building orchestration, dynamic configuration, or integration layers for large\-scale software systems. * **Practical Problem Solving:** * + A proven track record of delivering working solutions in highly complex, ambiguous technical domains. + A pragmatic approach to engineering. You are willing to find compromises and make the right trade\-offs to achieve the broader goal, avoiding the trap of over\-engineering or getting stuck in "ideal land." * **Collaboration \& Communication:** * + Exceptional communication skills. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, negotiating technical boundaries, and building successful partnerships with upstream and downstream teams. **We prefer:** * Deep passion for solving complex evaluation problems with simulation technology to advance autonomous driving. * Track record in delivering goals via practical solutions. * Background in fields that rely heavily on complex systems integration, such as autonomous vehicles, robotics, simulation, or large backend infrastructure.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: **Join the Market Leader in Electric Power Data and Analytics Solutions** The electrical grid is the largest and most complicated machine ever built. Yes Energy's industry\-leading electric power trading analytics software provides real\-time visibility into the massive amount of data generated by the North American electrical grid daily. Our unique and innovative view of the data informs real\-time trading decisions and mid\-to\-long\-term investment decisions that keep utility prices low, support the energy transition, and keep the grid running. It's both challenging work and work with a purpose. **Be a part of our successful, growing business during international transformation.** **Position Summary** In the Product Infrastructure and Operations group, we are accelerating the product vision by building solutions in a fun, collaborative, efficient, and adaptive team. As a Senior Backend Engineer focused on data integration, you will own how data is shared between systems at Yes Energy — across operational databases, our cloud data platform, internal applications, partners, and customers. Whether the right answer is database replication, change data capture, an API, or an event\-driven integration, you will choose the approach, build it, and make it reliable. Strong technical skills are only part of this role. We are looking for someone who communicates clearly, collaborates well with teams across Yes Energy, and shows leadership by guiding technical decisions, mentoring others, and helping interview future teammates. For the right person, there is room to grow into a lead role over time. We are curious people who take pride in our work, value high\-quality communication, and strive to improve continuously. **Position Details** * Salary range: $116,129\- $185,806 * Location: Dedham, MA * Full\-time * Hybrid \- Will be required to work in the office 2\-3 days a week * Reporting to: Kirk Mitchener, Senior Director, Platform Technology **Primary Responsibilities** * Lead technical decisions on data integration through expertise and influence: propose standards, review designs, and share patterns other teams can reuse * Design, build, and operate integrations that share data between Yes Energy systems, partner platforms, and customer environments, choosing replication, change data capture, APIs, messaging, or scheduled data transfers as each problem requires * Design, build, and version REST APIs and data\-delivery services that expose energy data to internal applications and customers * Replace fragile point\-to\-point integrations with reusable, well\-documented patterns, and record the trade\-offs behind each decision in cost, latency, coupling, and operational burden * Partner with product, data engineering, operations, infrastructure, and customer\-facing teams to understand their data needs and turn them into well\-scoped work * Take part in interviewing candidates, and mentor and support teammates * Communicate plans, progress, and risks clearly to leadership and non\-technical stakeholders * Engage directly with cross\-functional stakeholders — product, domain experts, and occasionally customers — to shape the right solutions **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or related field (or equivalent practical experience) * 7\+ years of software engineering experience with demonstrated technical leadership (e.g., leading projects, setting technical direction, or mentoring others) * Strong programming skills in Python or another modern language; we value sound engineering judgment over expertise in any specific language * Advanced SQL and strong experience with relational database management systems such as SQL Server and Oracle, including query and performance tuning * Hands\-on experience with database replication or change data capture (e.g., SQL Server CDC, Oracle GoldenGate, Debezium, Fivetran, Snowflake Streams/Snowpipe) * Extensive experience designing, building, and consuming REST APIs * Extensive experience developing for and working in cloud environments, Snowflake preferred * Experience interviewing engineering candidates or otherwise contributing to hiring * Excellent written and verbal communication; able to explain technical decisions to non\-technical audiences and build working relationships across teams * Self\-directed and comfortable supporting the needs of multiple teams, systems, and products **Key Competencies / Preferred Qualifications** * **Collaboration \& Influence:** Builds strong working relationships with teams outside their own, aligns stakeholders with competing needs, and earns trust through follow\-through * **Effective Communication:** Writes clear design documents and decision records, and explains complex system choices to technical and non\-technical stakeholders alike * **Leadership:** Leads through expertise and initiative: mentors others, drives design discussions, raises the technical bar, and interviews thoughtf  with event streaming or messaging platforms (e.g., Kafka, Azure Event Hubs, Service Bus) or ETL/ELT tools (e.g., Dagster, Airflow) is a plus * **Energy Industry \& Customer Understanding:** Background in data\-intensive environments (e.g., equities/commodities trading) or a strong desire to learn the wholesale electric power industry **At Yes Energy, we value connecting directly with candidates. We kindly ask that third\-party recruiters and agencies not submit resumes, as we are not open to external recruiting partnerships.** **ABOUT YES ENERGY** **Overview** Yes Energy delivers real\-time market data and electric power trading decision solutions. Over 1,000 market participants use Yes Energy solutions daily. The business is a leader in all aspects of information content collection and management, developing and delivering data and market analytics solutions. Since its inception in 2008, Yes Energy has become a trusted and respected supplier of innovative and reliable solutions focused on the needs of power market analysts, traders, and trade managers. Yes Energy has a team of 400\+ amazing professionals in Boulder, CO (HQ); Boston, MA; Chicago, IL; Glendora, CA; Richmond, VA; London, United Kingdom; Auckland, New Zealand; and Bucharest, Romania. **Culture** Yes Energy has been named one of the Best Places to Work in Colorado, and we have the culture to prove it. At Yes Energy, we care about saying "Yes" to customers. We like to listen, learn, and develop our solutions in line with their needs. We think about customers as business partners, and when we help them be more successful … we are more successful, too. Around the office, our culture is driven by some pretty fundamental values that we're proud of: * We love innovation and solving tough challenges; We are "high standards people" who combine passion and pride with hard work and rewards of all kinds* \- in an ethic that is consistent across the company. We're team\-focused with a flat hierarchy* \- we work in small teams on well\-defined projects that directly impact the success of the business; * We play to the strengths and experience of each person while each of us also works along a continuum of roles adjacent to our focus area. This presents the challenge of maintaining a broad set of skills as well as an opportunity to learn and contribute in many ways. * We are constantly growing. Professional development happens every day and every year. **Compensation and Benefits** We offer highly competitive salaries and real bonuses that are achievable and that you can impact. Our benefits package is also very competitive, including medical insurance, a 401 (k) Plan with matching, flexible vacation, and flexible work schedules. Yes Energy encourages and funds investment in both formal and informal professional development. At Yes Energy, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't perfectly align with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. In accordance with Colorado law, the range provided is Yes Energy's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may be higher or lower based on non\-discriminatory factors such as location, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. *Yes Energy provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Yes Energy complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location where the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Yext (NYSE: YEXT) is the enterprise agentic marketing platform. Built on the world's most comprehensive structured data platform for local businesses, Yext gives brands and their partners the visibility intelligence to win every moment of discovery – across AI and traditional search. Yext's API\-first architecture connects structured data to APIs, MCP servers, and generative interfaces, so partners and developers can build purpose\-built experiences on the same infrastructure powering Yext's own products. Thousands of brands and digital marketing partners in financial services, healthcare, retail, hospitality, and food rely on Yext to manage, measure, and optimize visibility at scale. For more information, visit yext.com. At Yext, **Product Engineering** builds and evolves the technology behind our products and services. We're looking for senior software engineers who want to solve challenging technical problems, lead the development of systems at scale, and help shape what we build next. We work in an agile environment with two\-week sprints and regular demos that keep teams aligned and give engineers clear visibility into the impact of their work. As a senior engineer, you'll remain deeply involved in designing and building software while providing technical leadership to the engineers around you. You'll partner closely with Product and Engineering leaders to turn broader priorities into sound technical plans, guide projects through delivery, and help less\-experienced engineers continue to grow. We are looking for a **Senior Software Engineer** to join as an early member of our paid media engineering team. We work with multi\-location brands to drive meaningful engagement and conversion with local, personalized content while preserving brand integrity across thousands of locations. We do this by launching brand playbooks into localized, cross\-channel campaigns at every location, launched in one click and on brand by default. We serve many of the biggest brands and franchises on the planet and deliver data\-backed advertising results to their locations around the world. This team builds the platform behind every campaign: the ads infrastructure, the integrations with Meta, Google, TikTok, Yelp, and Apple Maps, and the AI agents that connect a marketing team's tools. We value building beautiful, easy\-to\-use products within a culture focused on speed, sustainability, and engineering without ego. This role is based in Covington, KY, just across the river from Cincinnati, where in\-person collaboration plays an important part in how our teams work, learn, and build relationships. We're looking for people who genuinely value that environment and are comfortable coming into the office at least three days per week. At the same time, we don't prescribe specific in\-office days and want employees to have the flexibility to handle personal needs without disrupting their work or team collaboration. **What You'll Do** * Build the ads infrastructure that powers millions of dollars in ad spend across thousands of locations * Ship new platform integrations quickly, usually in days or weeks rather than months * Build enterprise\-ready AI agents and MCP servers that connect a marketing team's key tools in one shared workspace * Expand the platforms we support, including TikTok, Yelp, and Apple Ads * Craft short\-form video tools that help customers create and repurpose content * Build a predictive content engine that learns from customers' past social and ad performance to recommend and automate creative * Develop, deploy, and maintain core infrastructure on AWS and Google Cloud with Docker, GitHub, and CI/CD * Serve as a technical leader for the team while continuing to contribute directly to the design, implementation, and operation of production software * Own complex development efforts from problem definition and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation * Design sound technical solutions, write and review technical designs, and guide architectural and implementation decisions within the team's systems * Partner with Product and Engineering leadership to translate product priorities into technical plans, identify dependencies and risks, and help determine how the team should approach the work * Break complex technical initiatives into clear, manageable pieces and help guide engineers through successful delivery * Solve difficult technical problems independently and provide guidance when other engineers encounter challenges * Foster a high bar for engineering quality through thoughtful design discussions, code reviews, testing, operational readiness, and continuous improvement * Mentor and share knowledge with other engineers, helping less\-experienced teammates strengthen their technical skills and judgment * Lead production incident response and follow\-up, helping the team diagnose complex problems, restore service, and make improvements that prevent recurrence * Collabo ring standards * Model effective AI\-enabled engineering practices, experiment with new capabilities and workflows, and share successful approaches with other engineers **What You Have** * A BA/BS in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent college\-level education * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience * Hands\-on experience with generative AI models and tools (frontier models, AI agents, Codex, Claude, LangChain) and the judgment to validate what they produce * A keen eye for quality and a drive to build software people use and love * Comfort operating in ambiguity and wearing multiple hats: front end, back end, DevOps, and talking to customers * A growth mindset and eagerness to learn new technologies * Enjoyment of working closely with an interdisciplinary team * A track record of leading significant technical projects and delivering complex production systems * Experience providing technical leadership, mentoring engineers, and supporting the growth of less\-experienced team members * Experience supervising or managing software engineers, or demonstrated readiness to take on direct\-report responsibilities * Deep technical judgment and a strong foundation in software architecture, design, data structures, and algorithms * Experience designing software systems, evaluating competing approaches, and communicating technical decisions clearly to other engineers * The ability to remain deeply hands\-on while also guiding the technical work of others * Experience diagnosing difficult production problems and leading technical incident response * Strong communication and collaboration skills, including experience working across engineering teams and with Product or other business partners * Fluency with Node.js (Typescript), React, MySQL, Java, Go, C\+\+, Python, or a similar programming language (we code primarily in Node.js, Java and Go) * Experience recruiting, interviewing, or evaluating software engineers * Experience using AI\-assisted development tools and the ability to critically evaluate their output as part of a responsible engineering workflow * Sound judgment regarding data privacy, intellectual property, security, and the appropriate use of confidential information when working with AI tools * Openness to new technologies, new ways of working, and creative solutions * Comfort working in a fast\-paced environment \#LI\-JB2 Yext is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a results\-driven, engaging culture where every employee has the opportunity to contribute to the success of the Company, perform at the highest possible level, and grow their skills and capabilities. Yext welcomes employees and applicants of all backgrounds and demographics, and does not engage in discrimination on the basis of any protected characteristic recognized under applicable law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. The Company believes a broad variety of life experiences across the Yext team is critical to its mission to help every business in the world be visible everywhere customers search. By seeking out fresh perspectives and fostering a positive interview experience and employee experience, Yext can remain at the forefront of innovation, and better serve its customers. It is Yext's policy to provide reasonable accommodations to people with disabilities as required by applicable law. If you have a disability that requires an accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, or participating in the employee selection process, please complete this form. **Security Alert** All legitimate Yext communications come from @yext.com email addresses. US: $130000 \- $187000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, build, and maintain reliable batch ETL/ELT data pipelines, dimensional data models, and warehouse migrations using Python and SQL. * Perform exploratory data analysis and profiling to evaluate new data sources, define validation standards, and troubleshoot pipeline or data\-quality issues. * Implement and scale structured insight\-extraction workflows using applied Machine Learning, batch LLM inference, and multi\-level product taxonomies. * Build and version curated analytical tables and semantic layers powering Looker and business intelligence dashboards for partner and product teams. * Maintain privacy controls, data life\-cycles, quote isolation, and role\-based access governance across sensitive partner and product datasets. jobs.title: Contract Student Worker- Software Engineer Mobile Developer Experience
jobs.description: **About Zoox** Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose\-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets. **About Our Contract Worker Program** Zoox's contract student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters. ### **Role Overview** Zoox is looking for a Software Engineering contract student worker to join our Mobile Apps Engineering team. In this role, you will help build and improve the CI/CD pipelines and tooling that our engineers use to build, test, and ship Zoox's iOS and Android rider apps. You will work closely with senior engineers to make our development and release process faster, more reliable, and more secure, so that every update reaches our riders with confidence.### **Responsibilities** * Help build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that compile, test, and package our iOS and Android applications. * Automate repetitive build and release tasks, such as versioning, code signing, and distribution to internal testers via TestFlight and Google Play. * Improve build speed and reliability by investigating pipeline failures, flaky tests, and bottlenecks. ### **Required Qualifications** * Add automated quality checks (unit tests, linting, static analysis) that catch issues before they reach riders. * \[placeholder] * Create dashboards and alerts that give the team visibility into build health and release status. * Write clear documentation so engineers can easily understand and use our tooling. ### **Bonus Qualifications** * Collaborate with mobile, cloud, and release engineering teams across Zoox to learn how software moves from a pull request to a rider's phone. * Currently pursuing or has obtained a BS / MS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * Familiarity with at least one programming or scripting language (e.g., Python, Ruby, TypeScript, Bash, Kotlin, or Swift). * Basic understanding of Git and version control workflows. ### **Program Requirements** * Comfort working from the command line on macOS or Linux. * Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline. * Strong problem\-solving skills, curiosity, and an eagerness to learn from feedback. * Available to commit to a minimum three\-month assignment. * Able to commit a minimum of 40 hours per week. * Able to work on\-site at one of our office locations. * Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations. **Closing** We want to be transparent: this is not an internship. jobs.title: VP of Engineering
jobs.description: **About Us:** At apexanalytix, we’re lifelong innovators! Since the date of our founding nearly four decades ago we’ve been consistently growing, profitable, and delivering the best procure\-to\-pay solutions to the world. We’re the perfect balance of established company and start\-up. You will find a unique home here. And you’ll recognize the names of our clients. Most of them are on The Global 2000\. They trust us to give them the latest in controls, audit and analytics software every day. Industry analysts consistently rank us as a top supplier management solution, and you’ll be helping build that reputation. Read more about apexanalytix \- https://www.apexanalytix.com/about/ **The Role:** Apexanalytix is seeking an engineering executive to serve as VP of Engineering, based in the United States, reporting to the Chief Product \& Technology Officer (CPTO) and sitting on the CPTO's leadership team. The role leads the engineering behind our two customer journeys, Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey. It is accountable for delivering them predictably, at high quality, and in a way that teams can own and run in production. We are moving to the product operating model. Product, engineering and design are organized into four persistent trios, each funded against outcome goals: Supplier Journey, Buyer Journey, Data \& Intelligence, and Platform. The VP of Engineering leads the Supplier and Buyer engineering leads and the US engineering teams in those journeys. With both journeys in one engineering organization, the moments suppliers and buyers share (onboarding, validation and payment status) have a single engineering owner. **Quick Take:** The VP of Engineering is the engineering partner to the VP of Product and the Head of Design in each trio, and works closely with the Head of AI \& Data, who leads the Data \& Intelligence trio, including the engineering for the data products we sell, machine learning, data science, data engineering and the agent platform. The role also works with the SVP Engineering \& Head of India GCC, whose Noida engineers work in these trios; the Chief Architect; the VP Technology Operations; and the Head of GRC. Experience leading engineering for enterprise SaaS products in empowered, outcome\-funded teams is required. **Trusted Advisor:** * Advises the CPTO and the executive team on engineering capacity, delivery risk, technical debt and the engineering investment needed to meet product and revenue goals. * Brings an honest, data\-backed view of feasibility to product discovery and investment decisions, so the company commits to what it can deliver well. * Represents engineering to clients and partners on complex integrations, escalations and roadmap commitments, alongside Product and Go\-to\-Market leaders. **The Work:** ***Engineering for the customer journeys*** * **Journey engineering.** Leads the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey engineering leads and their teams. Supplier Journey covers onboarding and validation (bank, tax, sanctions), the supplier portal and self\-service, and inquiries and payment status. Buyer Journey covers supplier risk and compliance, invoice and payment controls, duplicate and fraud prevention, and Assurance \& Recovery. * **Shared moments.** Owns engineering for the moments suppliers and buyers share, so they work as one workflow seen from two sides, with clear lead and partner teams for each. * **Agents in the workflow.** Makes sure journey teams build the agent experiences inside their workflows (such as onboarding, inquiry handling and duplicate\-payment triage) on the shared building blocks from Data \& Intelligence, to the same engineering and production standards as the rest of the product. ***Partnership with Data \& Intelligence*** * **Shared building blocks.** Works with the Head of AI \& Data so journey teams use the shared data, scores, models and agent building blocks well, through clear, stable interfaces rather than one\-off integrations. * **Workflow data.** Makes sure journey workflows capture clean, well\-defined data that Data \& Intelligence can use to enrich data products and improve models. * **Consistent standards.** Agrees with the Head of AI \& Data how models and agents move into production in journey workflows, so they meet the same engineering, production and audit standards. ***Delivery and engineering excellence*** * **Empowered teams.** Builds persistent engineering teams that own outcomes with their product and design partners, not tickets handed to them. Engineers join discovery early to test feasibility and shape solutions. * **Predictable delivery.** Is accountable for predictable, high\-quality delivery against the outcomes each trio commits to. Runs the engineering operating cadence with product and design and fixes delivery problems at the root. * **Quality and practices.** Raises the bar on code quality, automated testing, CI/CD, observability and secure development. Tracks and improves DORA measures, defect escape rat r reporting on delivery, quality, reliability and team health, with each metric backed by data that can be re\-run. **First\-Year Priorities:** * Organize engineering into persistent teams aligned to the Supplier Journey and Buyer Journey, and appoint or hire the engineering leads to run them. * Agree first\-year outcome goals and engineering plans with product and design leaders for both journey trios. * Agree with the Head of AI \& Data how journey teams use shared data and agent building blocks, and ship at least one agent experience in a journey workflow to production standards. * Assign a lead team for each supplier–buyer shared moment, and deliver at least one measurable improvement to a shared workflow. * Set a baseline for delivery predictability, DORA measures, defect escape rate and production incidents, and show measurable improvement against it. * Make sure every team owns its services in production, with on\-call, runbooks and service\-level objectives agreed with Technology Operations. * Establish career ladders and a hiring plan for US engineering, including the technical track. **Required Skills:** * 15\+ years in software engineering, including 7\+ years leading engineering organizations of 50\+ engineers through managers and directors in enterprise SaaS. * A proven record of delivering complex B2B products predictably and at high quality, and of turning around delivery or quality problems. * Experience building integration\-heavy, data\-intensive workflow products for enterprise clients at scale. * Experience working in empowered product teams under the product operating model, as an equal partner to product and design in discovery and delivery. * Strong technical depth in cloud\-native SaaS architecture, distributed systems, integration and data\-intensive platforms, sufficient to lead design reviews and make sound technical calls. * Hands\-on familiarity with modern engineering practices: CI/CD, automated testing, observability, DevSecOps and AI\-assisted development. * Experience bringing AI and agent capabilities into production workflows with appropriate guardrails and quality measures. * A track record of hiring, developing and retaining strong engineering leaders and senior engineers. * Experience leading distributed teams across US and India time zones. * Experience operating in security\- and compliance\-regulated environments (for example SOC 1, SOC 2 and ISO 27001\). * Strong executive presence, able to represent engineering credibly to the CPTO, the executive team, clients and, as needed, the Board. **Preferred Skills:** * Domain experience in procure\-to\-pay, accounts payable, supplier management, payment fraud prevention, risk or fintech. * Experience building integrations with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle or Microsoft Dynamics. * Experience in a PE\-backed or high\-growth SaaS company, connecting engineering investment to revenue and margin. Over the years, we’ve discovered that the most effective and successful associates at apexanalytix are people who have a specific combination of values, skills, and behaviors that we call “The apex Way”. Read more about The apex Way \- https://www.apexanalytix.com/careers/ **Benefits** At apexanalytix we know that our associates are the reason behind our successes. We truly value you as an associate and part of our professional family. Our goal is to offer the very best benefits possible to you and your loved ones. When it comes to benefits, whether for yourself or your family the most important aspect is choice. And we get that. apexanalytix offers competitive benefits for the countries that we serve, in addition to our BeWell@apex initiative that encourages employees’ growth in six key wellness areas: Emotional, Physical, Community, Financial, Social, and Intelligence. With resources such as a strong Mentor Program, Internal Training Portal, plus Education, Tuition, and Certification Assistance, we provide tools for our associates to grow and develop.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer
jobs.description: ### **About Dawn** Dawn started with a realization: every security stack is missing a crucial layer. Identity tools know who you are. Data tools know what you have. Nothing in between can tell whether the access that just happened was legitimate. The breach doesn’t start with a break\-in. It starts with a login, and the missing layer is where it goes unnoticed. That’s why Dawn exists. We are the Access Intelligence Platform, the first to unite identity and data and fill that layer, for every human, machine and AI agent, with a human in the loop on purpose. We’re growing our team, and how you build matters as much as what you know. We’re looking for people who are: * Curious about the problems everyone else has decided are unsolvable, and restless until they’re solved * Rigorous in the standard they hold themselves to, because being right matters more than being loud * Owners of the outcome, who would rather ship something real this week than something perfect that never arrives Because a missing layer doesn’t build itself. And first light is the best time to arrive. ### **Job Description** We're looking for a Senior Python Backend Developer to build the core platform services that power our data access intelligence engine. This is a high\-impact role with significant ownership — you'll shape the architecture of a multi\-tenant SaaS platform processing millions of files and events daily. **Requirements** ### **Must Have** * **7\+ years** Python backend development experience * Strong **PostgreSQL** experience (complex queries, indexing, performance tuning) * Experience with **message queues** (Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, Kafka, or similar) * **API design** and implementation (REST, async patterns) * Experience with **multi\-tenant architectures** or database\-level isolation * Understanding of **security fundamentals** (authentication, authorization, data isolation) * Experience with **containerized deployments** (Docker, Kubernetes) * Strong **testing practices** (unit tests, integration tests, pytest) ### **Nice to Have** * **Django** or similar Python frameworks * **GCP** experience (Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, GKE, BigQuery) * **LLM/AI integration** experience (OpenAI, Anthropic APIs) * **Vector search** experience (FAISS, embeddings) * Background in **security or compliance** products ### **Responsibilities** **Backend Services** — Design, build, and maintain Python services for data discovery, analysis, and classification **Data Processing** — Build reliable pipelines for processing files, extracting content, and handling large\-scale data ingestion **Database Design** — Design schemas, write migrations, optimize queries, and implement data isolation patterns **API Development** — Build and maintain internal APIs for service communication and external integrations **Performance \& Reliability** — Ensure services are performant, resilient, and scale under load **Code Quality** — Write clean, well\-tested code; participate in code reviews; maintain documentation **Benefits** * Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental \& Vision) * Paid Time Off (Vacation, Sick \& Public Holidays) * Work From Home * Stock Option Plan

Understands user requirements and helps translate them into sound technical designs and implementation plans. Contributes to the integration of AI/ML capabilities into broader enterprise solutions, with a focus on quality, scalability, and user impact. **Your Key Responsibilities** * Develop, test, deploy, and support production\-grade AI/ML, generative AI, and intelligent automation solutions. * Solve complex technical problems across development, integration and production support through coding, debugging, testing, troubleshooting, and structured design remediation. * Translate user requirements into technical designs, APIs, workflows, and supportable implementation patterns. * Build and integrate LLM, RAG, and agentic solution components into enterprise solutions, applications and platforms. * Support project delivery through disciplined execution, estimation, documentation, status of communication, and risk identification. * Participate in design reviews, providing thoughtful trade\-off analysis and implementation of input. * Use modern AI\-assisted software engineering tools such as Claude Code, Codex, or equivalent agentic coding platforms as part of day\-to\-day engineering delivery to improve delivery speed, code quality and engineering efficiency. **AI and Engineering SkillsGen AI Foundational** * Experience designing, building, and maintaining production\-grade LLM applications, including end\-to\-end pipelines from data ingestion through model output delivery (e.g. Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI etc.). * Demonstrated practical experience building retrieval\-augmented systems that ground model outputs in enterprise knowledge sources, including chunking strategies, embedding pipelines, and retrieval optimization (e.g. LlamaIndex, LangChain, Pinecone, Weaviate, Azure AI Search, pgvector etc.). * Working technical knowledge of embedding models, vector search, and semantic retrieval patterns used to ground LLM outputs in enterprise knowledge sources (e.g. OpenAI Embeddings, Azure AI Search, pgvector etc.). * Proficiency in prompt engineering techniques including zero\-shot, few\-shot, chain\-of\-thought, and structured output design, with the ability to systematically evaluate and iterate on prompt performance (e.g. DSPy, PromptFlow etc.). **Agentic and LLM Ops** * Experience designing and building agentic systems including multi\-agent orchestration patterns, tool use, and memory design across single and multi\-step workflows (e.g. LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, NVIDIA NIM etc.). * Ability to debug, troubleshoot, and remediate production of LLM and agentic systems including failure diagnosis across retrieval, orchestration, and generation layers. **Software Engineering** * Hands\-on software engineering proficiency in Python, with the ability to write clean, modular, production\-quality code for LLM pipelines and agentic applications. * Experience working with structured and unstructured data sets to support LLM application development, including data curation, preparation, and quality validation for model inputs and model responses. * Working familiarity with RESTful and event\-driven API patterns including asynchronous workflows, service boundaries, and integration of enterprise data sources to expose LLM and agentic capabilities. * Practical understanding of containerization and orchestration concepts for packaging and deploying LLM applications in cloud environments (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Container Apps, AWS ECS etc.). * Understanding software engineering best practices as applied to ML systems, including modular code design, testing patterns for AI pipelines, and data quality validation. * Familiarity with Data Monitoring and Data Observability in cloud environments (OpenTelemetry, Azure Application Insights, etc.). * Exposure to CI/CD and operationalization practices for AI systems, including model and workflow deployment, versioning, environment promotion, and release support in cloud or containerized environments. **Soft Skills and Additional Attributes for Success** * Clear communicator able to explain complex AI system behavior and trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including risk and compliance. * Strong ownership and accountability, taking responsibility for AI systems from design through production and issue resolution. * Able to operate effectively as requirements, regulations, and technologies evolve. * Collaborative and cross\-functional, working closely with engineering and product teams. * Bachelor's degree preferred. * 2\+ years of applied engineering experience, including meaningful experience in AI/ML engineering roles. * Partner with Development, Engineering, Product, Data, Architecture, and project leadership teams to deliver high\-value AI capabilities. * Ability to build and maintain model observability pipelines including tracing of multi\-step agentic reasoning chains, output degradation detection, and behavioral drift monitoring in production (e.g. LangSmith, Arize, Datadog, Azure Monitor, etc.). * Familiarity with LLM fine\-tuning approaches including instruction tuning and preference optimization, with an understanding of when fine\-tuning is appropriate versus prompt\-based solutions (e.g. LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, NeMo Framework etc.). * Familiarity with responsible AI principles including bias and fairness evaluation, human\-in\-the\-loop design, and explainability approaches in financial services contexts. * Familiarity with data pipeline design for AI workloads including ingestion, transformation, and quality validation. * Familiarity with cloud\-based platforms for building, training, and deploying scalable LLM solutions (e.g. Azure ML, AWS SageMaker, Google Vertex AI etc.). * Familiarity with AI\-assisted software engineering tools for accelerating development, implementation, and code review practices (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Codex etc.). * Strong grounding in traditional AI/ML and deep learning fundamentals, including supervised and unsupervised learning, feature engineering, model evaluation, neural network architectures, and training trade\-offs, with the ability to apply these concepts when shaping enterprise AI solutions. knowledge sharing, and advocating with Product where customer needs outpace the platform today. **Requirements** ---------------- * Minimum 7 years as a solutions architect or forward\-deployed engineer in enterprise software, with recent experience designing AI solutions for external customers. * Demonstrated depth in AI architecture, covering agentic systems, LLM\-based workflows, tool use, and context and retrieval design, with the judgment to know when an AI approach outperforms a deterministic one. * Experience defining how AI quality is measured and maintained in production, spanning evaluation, guardrails, human review, and observability. * Enterprise data architecture experience across complex technology landscapes, including data mobility work such as ETL, migrations, and conversions, and a read on what makes a customer's data ready for AI to act on. * Fluency across integration approaches — API and event\-driven integration, iPaaS and low\-code platforms, and custom middleware — and command of the standards behind them, including REST, GraphQL, webhooks, SCIM, SAML 2\.0/OAuth 2\.0, and MCP. * Working proficiency in Python or TypeScript and regular use of AI\-assisted editors such as Cursor or Claude Code, sufficient to prototype a design and to evaluate the approach an engineer proposes for building it. * Working knowledge of enterprise security, compliance, and governance requirements, including how AI systems handle customer data, and the ability to hold a design to them under review. * Experience estimating delivery effort and creating statements of work for AI builds, data migrations, integrations, and custom application development, and building the models that let other people estimate consistently. * Commercial acumen sufficient to run technical discovery in front of a customer and support the sale of technical services rather than just deliver them. * Strong customer\-facing and presentation skills, with superb written and verbal communication, able to establish credibility with technical stakeholders and executives and to articulate technical topics to a non\-technical audience. * Detail\-oriented with strong problem\-solving and documentation skills, able to work across simultaneous engagements at different stages, with a positive attitude, empathy, and the ability to take initiative and adapt. * Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time. * BA or BS degree preferred. **What** **monday.com** **can offer you:** * Join a customer\-obsessed team where transparency and ownership are how we actually operate \- not just things we put on a wall * Work on a multi\-product suite powered by advanced AI, where what you ship reaches hundreds of thousands of customers worldwide * Competitive jobs.title: IT Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: **The Role** T1 Energy is hiring an IT Software Development Engineer at G1\_Dallas, our 5GW solar module facility in Wilmer, Texas, just south of Dallas. You own the Nintex business process management (BPM), Infor warehouse management system (WMS), and IBM integration platform as a service (iPaaS) systems that run warehouse and business operations. You work with business teams in Human Resources, Finance, and Production to improve workflows and keep systems integrated. This is an on\-site role in a manufacturing environment. **What You’ll Do** * Manage and maintain Nintex BPM, Infor WMS, and IBM iPaaS systems. * Develop and deploy cross\-system integrations using C\#, Java, and Python. * Perform database administration tasks for Oracle (WMS) and SQL Server (BPM). * Optimize SQL scripts and stored procedures for Oracle and SQL Server. * Partner with business teams to gather requirements and implement workflow and process enhancements. * Monitor system performance and troubleshoot real\-time issues. * Ensure compliance with IT security and audit requirements. * Support project acceptance and delivery of WMS implementations for new warehouse facilities. * Develop and deploy localized customizations for WMS inbound processes and order fulfillment. * Provide daily WMS support and manage user access. * Manage on\-site incidents, including scanner, printer, and workflow disruptions. * Manage the WMS codebase and server environments. * Handle basic Oracle database tasks, such as deadlock resolution and order resets. * Maintain the OpenShift container platform for enterprise integrations. * Deploy, update, and manage the integration lifecycle for ERP, WMS, and BPM systems. * Diagnose application programming interface (API) latency, transaction failures, and data inconsistencies across integrated platforms. * Implement real\-time monitoring for transaction bottlenecks and high\-latency operations. * Manage 35\+ active business processes across Human Resources, Finance, and Production, with 300\+ approval nodes. * Maintain the approval matrix, organizational structures, and user permissions. * Own requirements documentation, code implementation, and functional testing for new business processes. * Design and develop custom business reports and ad\-hoc analytics tools. **Who You Are** * Strong at problem\-solving: you diagnose and fix issues in real time. * Accountable: you thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-accountability manufacturing environment. **Qualifications** * Strong proficiency in C\#, Java, and Python. * Hands\-on experience with SQL Server and Oracle Database, including query optimization. * Familiarity with Windows Server and Red Hat Linux environments. * Experience with enterprise workflow or business process management systems and WMS operations. **Preferred Qualifications** * Fluency in English and Mandarin. * Experience with Nintex. * Experience with IBM iPaaS or similar integration platforms. * Familiarity with Git version control and continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines. * Experience supporting Oracle\-based WMS systems in a production setting. **About T1 Energy** At T1 Energy (NYSE: TE), we build energy. We are an American solar manufacturer building the future of energy abundance. From our headquarters in Austin, Texas, we’re pioneering a domestic solar supply chain with one mission: to invigorate America with scalable, reliable, and low\-cost energy. We started with G1\_Dallas, one of the most advanced solar manufacturing facilities in the world. The 5GW facility is located in Wilmer, Texas. It has the capacity to produce more than 20,000 solar modules a day for solar farms that power American homes, businesses, and keep our energy grids resilient. Next is G2\_Austin: Our new solar cell fab in Rockdale, Texas. Its first 2\.1GW phase is designed to produce next\-generation TOPCon cells beginning in 2027\. As the fab grows, it’s expected to support up to 1,800 manufacturing jobs. Modules assembled at G1 can run on cells from G2\. What comes after G2? Come join us and help figure that out. And then build it. The sun has always shone on America. Now you can turn it into abundant electricity. **The T1 Way** We’re all in on the mission, and we pursue it as one team. We move fast, own our results, and treat each other with respect. Egos stay at the door: no one is too senior to roll up their sleeves, and no idea is too small to share. Be sharp, be honest, be human. If you can hold the line and keep a sense of humor, you’ll fit right in. T1 Energy is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants and do not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristics.
